```swift
import Foundation

/// How one mark of the minute-marks dial is drawn (F1 design §4.2). MapleDesign's `Theme.Dial` holds each state's
/// colour and its Increase Contrast value; this type holds no colour, so it stays pure and nonisolated.
public enum MarkState: String, Sendable, Hashable, CaseIterable {
    /// The start screen's preview of the length: `textPrimary` 42%.
    case plan
    /// Time still to come in a running session: 16%.
    case ahead
    /// Passed minutes, and on the receipt the minutes that counted: 88%.
    case lit
    /// The minute in progress: season tint, brightening from 55% to 100% through its minute.
    case current
    /// Break time still left: `#C9D3E3` at 78%.
    case rest
    /// Minutes that didn't count (the receipt): 9%, drawn shorter.
    case gap
    /// Press-and-hold progress: 100%.
    case hold
    /// Needs Screen Time, and a break's marks once they have gone out: 10%.
    case off

    /// Gap marks are drawn shorter: from radius 86 to 92 of the 200-unit box, not from 80 or 84 (§4.1).
    public var isShort: Bool { self == .gap }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// Which Needs Screen Time card shows (F1 design §5.3).
public enum NeedsScreenTimeState: String, Sendable, Hashable, CaseIterable {
    case notAsked, declined, restricted, noPasscode, freeBuild

    /// The card a probe calls for; nil when blocking is allowed. A build that can't block always shows the free
    /// build's card, whatever the probe says (F1-17).
    public init?(probe: BlockingProbe, capability: BlockingCapability) {
        guard capability.canBlock else {
            self = .freeBuild
            return
        }
        switch probe {
        case .allowed: return nil
        case .notDetermined: self = .notAsked
        case .declined: self = .declined
        case .restricted: self = .restricted
        case .noPasscode: self = .noPasscode
        case .unavailable: self = .freeBuild
        }
    }
}

/// Every fixed Focus string that no screen model owns (F1 design §5, ruling P3), so views hold no copy and every line
/// is tested. Sentence case, no "!", and never "fail", "quit" or "streak lost".
public enum FocusCopy {
    // MARK: Start (§5.1, §5.2, §5.4, §5.16)

    /// The intention line's placeholder (§5.1, §5.16).
    public static let intentionPrompt = "What's this for?"
    /// The "+" chip, read aloud and shown at accessibility sizes (§5.13, §5.17).
    public static let newPreset = "New preset"
    /// The dial's caption until the member has turned it once (§4.5).
    public static let turnHint = "turn to set the length"
    public static let chooseApps = "Choose apps"
    public static let returnToSession = "Return to session"
    /// What a plain tap on Locked's hold shows, for `holdHintSeconds` (§5.2, F1-21).
    public static let holdHint = "Hold to start. Locked ends early only by emergency release."
    public static let holdHintSeconds = 4.0
    /// Locked's hold to start (§5.2).
    public static let holdToStartSeconds = 1.5
    /// The block couldn't be applied or read back (§5.1).
    public static let couldntLock = "Couldn't lock your apps · Start as a plain timer?"
    public static let startPlainTimer = "Start as a plain timer"
    /// Under the running dial, in the first session only (§5.4, P4).
    public static let firstSessionLine = "You can lock your phone. Maple keeps time."
    public static let keepGoing = "Keep going"
    public static let done = "Done"

    /// Locked's capsule: "Hold to start · 50m".
    public static func holdToStart(minutes: Int) -> String {
        "Hold to start · \(FocusTimeText.length(minutes: minutes))"
    }

    /// A hold-to-start button's VoiceOver name (§4.9): "Hold to start, Locked 50 minutes".
    public static func holdToStartName(minutes: Int, locale: Locale) -> String {
        "Hold to start, Locked \(FocusTimeText.spokenLength(minutes: minutes, locale: locale))"
    }

    /// The start dial's VoiceOver label (§4.9): "Session length, 50 minutes".
    public static func sessionLengthLabel(minutes: Int, locale: Locale) -> String {
        "Session length, \(FocusTimeText.spokenLength(minutes: minutes, locale: locale))"
    }

    /// A session's header (§5.4, §5.8): "Study · Chemistry ch. 4", or the preset alone without an intention.
    public static func sessionTitle(presetName: String, intention: String?) -> String {
        guard let intention = intention.flatMap({ RecentIntentions.normalized($0) }) else { return presetName }
        return "\(presetName) · \(intention)"
    }

    // MARK: Needs Screen Time (§5.3, F1-17)

    public struct ScreenTimeCard: Sendable, Hashable {
        public let title: String
        public let body: String?
        /// The primary capsule; nil when there is nothing Maple can ask for.
        public let primary: String?
    }

    public static let turnOnScreenTime = "Turn on Screen Time"
    /// The link under every card (§5.3).
    public static let plainTimerLink = "Use a plain timer · it won't count"

    public static func card(_ state: NeedsScreenTimeState) -> ScreenTimeCard {
        switch state {
        case .notAsked:
            ScreenTimeCard(
                title: "Lock apps with Screen Time",
                body: "Maple keeps your chosen apps resting while you focus. It never sees which apps you use.",
                primary: turnOnScreenTime
            )
        case .declined:
            ScreenTimeCard(title: "Screen Time is off for Maple", body: "Turn it on to count your focus time.", primary: turnOnScreenTime)
        case .restricted:
            ScreenTimeCard(title: "Screen Time is managed on this iPhone", body: "A parent can allow Maple in Screen Time settings.",
                           primary: nil)
        case .noPasscode:
            ScreenTimeCard(title: "Set a passcode to use Screen Time", body: nil, primary: nil)
        case .freeBuild:
            ScreenTimeCard(title: "This version of Maple can't lock apps", body: "The timer still runs, but it won't count.", primary: nil)
        }
    }

    // MARK: Strictness (§5.13)

    public static func strictnessName(_ strictness: Strictness) -> String {
        switch strictness {
        case .gentle: "Gentle"
        case .steady: "Steady"
        case .locked: "Locked"
        }
    }

    /// Each level's one honest line in the strictness chooser (F1-21).
    public static func strictnessLine(_ strictness: Strictness) -> String {
        switch strictness {
        case .gentle: "Unlock an app when you need it. Unlocked time doesn't count."
        case .steady: "Two unlocks a session. Ending early takes a hold and 15 seconds."
        case .locked:
            "No unlocks. Ending early takes a 10-second hold and a breath. Calls and Always Allowed apps keep working, and you can turn off Screen Time for Maple in Settings."
        }
    }

    /// A looser level waiting for the next day (`FocusPreset.pendingStrictness`): "Steady starts tomorrow".
    public static func pendingLine(_ strictness: Strictness) -> String {
        "\(strictnessName(strictness)) starts tomorrow"
    }

    // MARK: Break (§5.5, §4.9)

    public enum BreakTime {
        public static let header = "Break · apps stay locked"
        /// Under the break dial's numeral.
        public static let caption = "left of your break"
        public static let backToStudying = "Back to studying"
        /// Something to do away from the phone, one at a time.
        public static let suggestions = ["Stand up and stretch.", "Look out of a window.", "Get a glass of water."]
        /// Each suggestion shows this long, so a 5-minute break shows all three.
        public static let suggestionSeconds: TimeInterval = 100

        public static func suggestion(secondsIntoBreak: TimeInterval) -> String {
            suggestions[Int(max(0, secondsIntoBreak) / suggestionSeconds) % suggestions.count]
        }

        /// "The break counts. Back to studying at 14:28."
        public static func line(backAt: Date, locale: Locale, calendar: Calendar) -> String {
            "The break counts. Back to studying at \(FocusCopy.clock(backAt, locale: locale, calendar: calendar))."
        }

        /// The break dial's VoiceOver label (§4.9): "4 minutes of break left. Back to studying at 14:28." Minutes round
        /// up, as the dial's numeral does; the last minute reads in seconds.
        public static func dialLabel(secondsLeft: TimeInterval, backAt: Date, locale: Locale, calendar: Calendar) -> String {
            let left = max(0, secondsLeft)
            let wholeSeconds = max(0, Int((left - 1e-9).rounded(.up)))
            let amount = wholeSeconds >= 60
                ? HomeFormat.spokenDuration(minutes: Int((left / 60 - 1e-9).rounded(.up)), locale: locale)
                : "\(wholeSeconds) \(wholeSeconds == 1 ? "second" : "seconds")"
            return "\(amount) of break left. Back to studying at \(FocusCopy.clock(backAt, locale: locale, calendar: calendar))."
        }
    }

    // MARK: End early (§5.6)

    public enum EndEarly {
        public static let title = "End this session?"
        public static let holdToEnd = "Hold to end"
        /// Steady's hold, then its quiet countdown that "Keep going" still cancels.
        public static let holdSeconds = 3.0
        public static let countdownSeconds = 15
        /// Offered while the preset's break is unused; it is cut short at the planned end.
        public static let takeBreakInstead = "Take a 5-minute break instead"
        /// Gentle's way out: a 5-second breathing ring, then the session ends.
        public static let gentleEnd = "End session"
        public static let gentleBreathSeconds = 5.0

        /// From counted seconds only: "18 minutes saved so far. They stay yours either way."
        public static func savedLine(countedSeconds: Int) -> String {
            let minutes = countedSeconds / 60
            if countedSeconds <= 0 { return "This session isn't counting toward leaves." }
            if minutes == 0 { return "Under a minute saved so far. It stays yours either way." }
            if minutes == 1 { return "1 minute saved so far. It stays yours either way." }
            return "\(minutes) minutes saved so far. They stay yours either way."
        }

        /// "Ending in 15s".
        public static func endingIn(seconds: Int) -> String {
            "Ending in \(max(0, seconds))s"
        }
    }

    // MARK: Emergency release (§5.7)

    public enum Emergency {
        public static let title = "Emergency release"
        /// The button, and its VoiceOver name and named action (F1-22).
        public static let holdToRelease = "Hold to release"
        public static let holdSeconds = 10.0
        /// The dial's caption; it reads `keepHolding` while the hold is pressed.
        public static let holdCaption = "hold to release"
        public static let keepHolding = "keep holding"
        public static let breatheIn = "Breathe in"
        public static let breatheOut = "and out"
        /// Each half of the breath.
        public static let breathSeconds = 4.0
        public static let endedLine = "Session ended. It won't count as finished."

        /// Under the title: "Study · Locked".
        public static func subtitle(presetName: String) -> String {
            "\(presetName) · Locked"
        }

        /// The hold's countdown in the dial: "10s", whole seconds rounded up.
        public static func secondsLeft(_ seconds: Double) -> String {
            "\(max(0, Int((seconds - 1e-9).rounded(.up))))s"
        }

        /// "Ends this session now. Your 18 minutes stay yours, but it won't count as finished." With nothing counted
        /// the middle of it is left out.
        public static func body(countedSeconds: Int) -> String {
            let minutes = countedSeconds / 60
            if countedSeconds <= 0 { return "Ends this session now. It won't count as finished." }
            if minutes == 0 { return "Ends this session now. Your time so far stays yours, but it won't count as finished." }
            if minutes == 1 { return "Ends this session now. Your 1 minute stays yours, but it won't count as finished." }
            return "Ends this session now. Your \(minutes) minutes stay yours, but it won't count as finished."
        }

        /// The ended state's caption under its numeral ("18m").
        public static func endedCaption(countedSeconds: Int) -> String {
            countedSeconds > 0 ? "saved · they stay yours" : "not counted toward leaves"
        }
    }

    // MARK: Release all apps (§5.12)

    public enum ReleaseAll {
        /// The Settings row, and the confirmation's destructive button.
        public static let title = "Release all apps"
        public static let question = "Release all apps?"
        public static let body = "Every app Maple is resting opens again now."
        public static let cancel = "Cancel"
    }

    /// "14:28" or "2:28 PM".
    static func clock(_ date: Date, locale: Locale, calendar: Calendar) -> String {
        HomeFormat.clock(HomeFormat.clockTime(of: date, calendar: calendar), locale: locale)
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// What a selection holds, in words (F1 design §5.1, §5.4, §5.14).
public enum SelectionText {
    /// The start screen's Blocking line (§5.1, §5.2): what is blocked, the strictness, then "›". Locked draws
    /// `lock.fill` before its name; `printed` leaves the symbol out.
    public struct BlockingLine: Sendable, Hashable {
        /// "Blocking 6 apps", "Choose apps to block", "Allowing 24 apps · 20 or fewer count".
        public let text: String
        /// Nil when a prompt or a warning takes the line.
        public let strictness: Strictness?
        /// The selection can't count as it is: no apps, one that doesn't qualify, or apps to choose again.
        public let needsAttention: Bool

        public var showsLock: Bool { strictness == .locked }
        public var strictnessName: String? { strictness.map { FocusCopy.strictnessName($0) } }

        /// As printed, without the lock symbol: "Blocking 6 apps · Locked ›".
        public var printed: String {
            strictnessName.map { "\(text) · \($0) ›" } ?? "\(text) ›"
        }

        /// For VoiceOver: "Blocking 6 apps, Locked".
        public var spoken: String {
            strictnessName.map { "\(text), \($0)" } ?? text
        }
    }

    /// The Blocking sheet's counter (§5.14).
    public struct Counter: Sendable, Hashable {
        /// "6 apps · 1 site".
        public let text: String
        /// "Up to 50 apps can rest at once", near the limit.
        public let limitNote: String?
    }

    /// From this many tokens across every set (`AppSetStore.totalTokens`), the counter names the 50-app limit.
    public static let nearLimit = 40

    /// Checked in `StartReadiness`'s order: no apps, a selection that can't count (R3), expired tokens.
    public static func blockingLine(_ selection: SelectionSummary?, strictness: Strictness, expired: Bool) -> BlockingLine {
        guard let selection, !selection.isEmpty else {
            return BlockingLine(text: "Choose apps to block", strictness: nil, needsAttention: true)
        }
        if !selection.qualifies {
            return BlockingLine(text: notQualifying(selection), strictness: nil, needsAttention: true)
        }
        if expired {
            return BlockingLine(text: "Some apps need choosing again", strictness: nil, needsAttention: true)
        }
        return BlockingLine(text: "\(verb(selection.mode)) \(list(selection))", strictness: strictness, needsAttention: false)
    }

    /// The running header's line under the title (§5.4): "6 apps resting"; an allow list or categories read "Apps
    /// resting"; a plain timer reads "Plain timer · apps aren't locked".
    public static func restingLine(_ selection: SelectionSummary?, isPlainTimer: Bool) -> String {
        guard !isPlainTimer, let selection else { return "Plain timer · apps aren't locked" }
        guard countsByName(selection) else { return "Apps resting" }
        return "\(list(selection)) resting"
    }

    /// The capsule after Start, until the read-back confirms the block (§5.1): "Locking 6 apps…".
    public static func locking(_ selection: SelectionSummary?) -> String {
        guard let selection, countsByName(selection) else { return "Locking apps…" }
        return "Locking \(list(selection))…"
    }

    public static func counter(_ selection: SelectionSummary, totalTokens: Int) -> Counter {
        let items = parts(selection)
        return Counter(
            text: items.isEmpty ? "No apps chosen yet" : items.joined(separator: " · "),
            limitNote: totalTokens >= nearLimit ? "Up to \(SelectionSummary.tokenLimit) apps can rest at once" : nil
        )
    }

    // MARK: Private

    /// A block list of apps and sites, without categories, names its count; anything else reads "apps".
    private static func countsByName(_ selection: SelectionSummary) -> Bool {
        selection.mode == .blockThese && selection.categories == 0 && !selection.isEmpty
    }

    private static func notQualifying(_ selection: SelectionSummary) -> String {
        let held = "\(verb(selection.mode)) \(list(selection))"
        if selection.mode == .onlyThese {
            if selection.categories > 0 { return "\(held) · allow apps, not categories" }
            if selection.apps + selection.sites > SelectionSummary.onlyTheseLimit {
                return "\(held) · \(SelectionSummary.onlyTheseLimit) or fewer count"
            }
        }
        return "\(held) · \(SelectionSummary.tokenLimit) or fewer count"
    }

    private static func verb(_ mode: SelectionSummary.Mode) -> String {
        switch mode {
        case .blockThese: "Blocking"
        case .onlyThese: "Allowing"
        }
    }

    /// "1 category", "6 apps", "1 site", in that order, for what the selection holds.
    private static func parts(_ selection: SelectionSummary) -> [String] {
        var found: [String] = []
        if selection.categories > 0 { found.append(count(selection.categories, "category", "categories")) }
        if selection.apps > 0 { found.append(count(selection.apps, "app", "apps")) }
        if selection.sites > 0 { found.append(count(selection.sites, "site", "sites")) }
        return found
    }

    /// "6 apps", "1 category and 2 apps", "1 category, 2 apps and 1 site".
    private static func list(_ selection: SelectionSummary) -> String {
        let items = parts(selection)
        guard let last = items.last else { return count(0, "app", "apps") }
        return items.count == 1 ? last : items.dropLast().joined(separator: ", ") + " and " + last
    }

    private static func count(_ value: Int, _ one: String, _ many: String) -> String {
        "\(value) \(value == 1 ? one : many)"
    }
}
```

`MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Focus/StartScreenModel.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// The Focus start screen as values (F1 design §5.1, §5.2, §4.5): the capsule, the Blocking and counts lines, the dial's
/// caption and leaf dot, the forecast, and whether a start can go straight ahead. Home's Start is built from the same
/// model (`FocusStart(model:)`), so Home and the start screen always agree (F1-20).
///
/// When `blocking` isn't `.ready` the Focus tab shows Needs Screen Time instead (§5.3); the model still answers, for
/// Home's `FocusStart`. In `.running`, ignore `forecast` and `readiness`: the live dial reads the running session.
public struct StartScreenModel: Sendable, Equatable {
    /// Where the start screen is.
    public enum Stage: Sendable, Hashable {
        /// Choosing a preset and a length.
        case choosing
        /// After Start, until the read-back confirms the block.
        case locking
        /// A session runs, minimised: the dial is live and can't be turned, and the chips and lines are hidden.
        case running
    }

    /// What the primary capsule does.
    public enum Primary: Sendable, Hashable {
        /// One tap starts the session.
        case start
        /// Locked: a 1.5-second hold starts it, and a plain tap shows `plainTapHint` for 4 seconds (§5.2).
        case holdToStart
        /// No app set yet: the capsule opens the Blocking sheet.
        case chooseApps
        /// Waiting for the read-back: the capsule does nothing.
        case locking
        case returnToSession
    }

    public let preset: FocusPreset
    /// This session's length, kept to 20 minutes–3 hours.
    public let minutes: Int
    public let stage: Stage
    /// The level a session started now uses: a looser change waits for the next Maple day.
    public let strictness: Strictness
    public let forecast: SessionForecast
    public let readiness: StartReadiness
    public let primary: Primary
    /// "Start study · 50m", "Hold to start · 50m", "Choose apps", "Locking 6 apps…", "Return to session".
    public let capsuleTitle: String
    /// Wind-down and night dim the capsule; it still works (§5.1).
    public let capsuleIsDimmed: Bool
    public let blockingLine: SelectionText.BlockingLine
    /// "You'll reach Field maple at minute 35", the first session's definition, or a bedtime or cap line; nil when
    /// hidden.
    public let countsLine: String?
    /// "turn to set the length" until the dial has been turned once (§4.5).
    public let hint: String?
    /// Under the numeral: the hint, then the preset's name.
    public let caption: String
    /// The leaf dot's minute; nil hides it.
    public let leafMinute: Int?
    /// The next hours leaf, "Field maple"; nil when there is none.
    public let leafName: String?
    /// The dial's numeral: "50m", "1h 30m".
    public let lengthText: String
    /// "Session length, 50 minutes" (§4.9), with an adjustable action of ±5 minutes.
    public let dialLabel: String
    /// The hold button's VoiceOver name and named action: "Hold to start, Locked 50 minutes" (§4.9, F1-22).
    public let holdName: String?
    /// What a plain tap on the hold shows.
    public let plainTapHint: String?
    /// The chips, the intention, the Blocking line and the counts line show.
    public let showsDetails: Bool
    /// The dial can be turned to set the length.
    public let canTurn: Bool

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - preset: The selected preset. `minutes` is the dial's length, which can differ from the preset's.
    ///   - selection: The preset's app set's summary; nil without one.
    ///   - expiredTokens: iOS no longer recognises some of the set's apps (`AppSet.tokensExpired`).
    ///   - blocking: Whether Maple can block now.
    ///   - isFirstSession: No session has ever started (`!AppSettings.hasStartedFocus`, P4).
    ///   - phase: The phase now (wind-down and night dim the capsule and send Home's Start to this screen).
    ///   - day: The Maple day a start now counts toward (`focusWindow(at: now, context:).day`).
    ///   - window: The frozen awake window for a start now (`focusWindow(at: now, context:).window`).
    ///   - now: Trusted time (`FocusSessionStore.now`).
    ///   - progress: The next hours leaf (counters only); anything that isn't a locked hours rung is ignored.
    ///   - displayToday: Seconds saved today, counted plus a running session's provisional time.
    ///   - stage: Choosing, locking, or a session running behind the minimised screen.
    ///   - hasTurned: The member has turned the dial once.
    public init(
        preset: FocusPreset, minutes: Int, selection: SelectionSummary?, expiredTokens: Bool, blocking: FocusStatus.Blocking,
        isFirstSession: Bool, phase: NowPhase, day: LocalDay, window: AwakeWindow, now: Date, progress: LeafProgress?,
        displayToday: Int, stage: Stage = .choosing, hasTurned: Bool = false, locale: Locale = .current,
        calendar: Calendar = .current
    ) {
        let minutes = DialLayout.stepped(minutes, by: 0)
        let strictness = preset.strictness(on: day)
        let canBlock = blocking == .ready
        let leaf = progress.flatMap { $0.category == .hoursSaved && $0.state == .locked && $0.remaining > 0 ? $0 : nil }
        let leafName = leaf.flatMap { LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: $0.speciesID)?.displayName }
        let forecast = SessionForecast(
            start: now, plannedSeconds: minutes * 60, window: window, now: now,
            canCount: canBlock && (selection?.qualifies ?? false),
            // Counters hold whole seconds, so the rounding is exact.
            secondsToLeaf: leaf.map { Int(($0.remaining * 3600).rounded()) }, leafName: leafName,
            roomLeftToday: max(0, HoursCredit.dailyCap - displayToday), firstEver: isFirstSession
        )

        let primary: Primary
        switch stage {
        case .running:
            primary = .returnToSession
        case .locking:
            primary = .locking
        case .choosing:
            if canBlock && (selection?.isEmpty ?? true) {
                primary = .chooseApps
            } else {
                primary = strictness == .locked ? .holdToStart : .start
            }
        }
        let length = FocusTimeText.length(minutes: minutes)
        let hint = stage == .choosing && !hasTurned ? FocusCopy.turnHint : nil

        self.preset = preset
        self.minutes = minutes
        self.stage = stage
        self.strictness = strictness
        self.forecast = forecast
        readiness = StartReadiness.check(
            strictness: strictness, blockingAllowed: canBlock, selection: selection, expiredTokens: expiredTokens,
            isFirstSession: isFirstSession, phase: phase, countsLine: forecast.countsLine
        )
        self.primary = primary
        switch primary {
        case .start: capsuleTitle = "\(preset.verb.startTitle) · \(length)"
        case .holdToStart: capsuleTitle = FocusCopy.holdToStart(minutes: minutes)
        case .chooseApps: capsuleTitle = FocusCopy.chooseApps
        case .locking: capsuleTitle = SelectionText.locking(selection)
        case .returnToSession: capsuleTitle = FocusCopy.returnToSession
        }
        capsuleIsDimmed = stage == .choosing && (phase == .windDown || phase == .night)
        blockingLine = SelectionText.blockingLine(selection, strictness: strictness, expired: expiredTokens)
        countsLine = stage == .running ? nil : forecast.countsLine.text(locale: locale, calendar: calendar)
        self.hint = hint
        caption = hint ?? preset.name
        leafMinute = stage == .running ? nil : forecast.leafMinute
        self.leafName = leafName
        lengthText = length
        dialLabel = FocusCopy.sessionLengthLabel(minutes: minutes, locale: locale)
        holdName = primary == .holdToStart ? FocusCopy.holdToStartName(minutes: minutes, locale: locale) : nil
        plainTapHint = primary == .holdToStart ? FocusCopy.holdHint : nil
        showsDetails = stage != .running
        canTurn = stage == .choosing
    }
}

extension FocusStart {
    /// Home's Start, from the start screen's own model, so both say the same thing (F1-20). Build the model for the
    /// last-used preset at its own length, at `stage: .choosing`.
    public init(model: StartScreenModel) {
        self.init(presetID: model.preset.id, verb: model.preset.verb, minutes: model.minutes, strictness: model.strictness,
                  readiness: model.readiness)
    }
}
```

### Task 5: After-session models

**Decisions in this task:**
- **Which ending.** The ending is picked in this order. Cost if wrong: one `switch`.
  1. An emergency release.
  2. End early or Release all apps, both `.endedEarly`.
  3. A blocking session whose selection doesn't qualify, `.notQualifying`.
  4. Nothing counted, `.countedNothing`. This covers a plain timer, after bedtime and over the cap.
  5. Ended away, when the end was noticed more than 60 s after the planned end. The app refreshes every 15 s and at the planned end while it is open, so a later end event means Maple was closed.
  6. On time.

  For every ending except an emergency, the finish plays only within 10 minutes of `endedAt`.
- **The numeral.** For a session that can count it is the counted minutes, as the mockup says: "the number is only what counted". So after bedtime reads "0m". For a plain timer and a selection that can't count, it is the minutes focused, with the caption saying why it didn't count.
- **The caption.** With under a minute saved today, it reads "saved · none yet today", echoing Home's "none yet today". A plain timer reads "focused · not counted toward leaves". A selection that doesn't qualify reads "Not counted · add an app to count", which is §5.8's line for it.
- **The breakdown names one reason: the uncounted rule with the most seconds.** Ties go in the order override, unconfirmed, after bedtime, before morning, cap, overlap. Lines:
  - after an unlock: "45m locked · 5m unlocked, not counted" (the design's words);
  - otherwise: "30m counted · 20m after bedtime", "10m counted · 40m over today's 6h", "· 30m before morning", "· 10m overlapped another session" or "· 5m unconfirmed" (my words);
  - with nothing counted: the design's "After bedtime · this didn't count" or "Over today's 6h · this didn't add".

  "· 1 break" is appended to "Locked the whole time" and to the counted and locked forms. Lost proof always reads "Couldn't confirm the block after 14:10", at the last checkpoint. Cost if wrong: copy.
- **`beforeMorning` reads "After bedtime" when nothing counted.** A start after bedtime freezes the next day's window, so all of its time is `.beforeMorning`. To the member, that time is after bedtime.
- **Marks after an early end are gaps.** The skeleton says "a gap otherwise", and those minutes weren't saved. A plain timer's marks are lit wherever it ran (§5.8).
- **The leaf line:**
  - It is hidden for a plain timer and a selection that can't count.
  - After an emergency release it shows only when a leaf opened.
  - `leafOpened`, where the centre leaf grows, is true only when an hours leaf opened, looked up in `RewardCatalog`. A sessions-finished leaf names itself but doesn't grow the dial's leaf.
- **An emergency release has no Again, no "How did it go?" and no breakdown.** §5.7's ended state lists only the numeral, the caption, the line and Done.
- **Durations read "1h 5m", from `HomeFormat.duration`, as on Home and in every leaf line.** The focus spec's §3.3 example writes "1h 05m". Two styles side by side on one receipt ("saved · 2h 05m today" next to "Field maple · 1h 5m to go") would read as a mistake. Cost if wrong: one formatter, used in both models.
- **Saved today:**
  - Each session is one row.
  - Reasons are summed per rule, in the order the time happened.
  - Only "Unlocked 5 min" carries minutes, as §3.3 writes it. "After bedtime", "Over today's 6h" and "Couldn't confirm the block" stand alone.
  - A row that counted nothing drops its duration ("Study · 14:00–14:50").
  - Hidden sessions are left out, and so are sessions under a minute that counted nothing. That second kind is the ghost of a start that couldn't be written (F1a ledger, Task 22).
  - The time span runs from the countdown start to `endedAt`, or to now while running.
- **`CreditWords` for rules the design doesn't word:** `plainTimer` "Plain timer", `notQualifying` "Selection didn't count", `overlap` "Counted in another session". `beforeMorning` reads "After bedtime", as on the receipt.
- **How we count:** "Unlocks don't count.", without "and phone breaks". Phone breaks are F2, and F1 must not name a feature it doesn't have. The empty state is "Nothing saved yet today.".
- **The streak week:**
  - Today shows finished once a session finishes today, so the dot agrees with the title, which already counts today.
  - Days still to come are neutral, like rest days and misses, so nothing on the week counts down.
  - VoiceOver reads "3 finished days this week".
- **The break dial:**
  - Marks go out clockwise from 12 o'clock, so the passed part of the turn dims, as the session dial lights its passed part.
  - Spent marks are `.off`.
  - Every 5th mark is long, as on every dial (§4.1); Task 6's `MinuteDial` draws that, so this type has no `isLong`.
  - Pass the break's real length: 5 minutes, or less when it was cut short at the planned end.
- **Extra public names beyond the skeleton:**
  - `ReceiptModel`: `playsFinish`, `countedSeconds`, `subtitle`, `note`, `numeralParts`, `leafOpened`, `endedLine`, `layout`, `dialLabel`, `reflectionPrompt`, `choices`, `again`, `finishWindow`, `awayAfter`;
  - `CreditWords.line(_:seconds:)`;
  - `SavedTodayModel`: `title`, `emptyText`, `emptyLine`, `definition`, `howWeCount`;
  - `StreakWeek`: `days`, `weekLabel`;
  - `BreakDialLayout`: `secondsPerMark`, `angle(ofMark:)`.

**§5.8 and §5.7, line by line, and the test that holds each:**

| Design line | Test |
|---|---|
| Header "Apps open again" | `onTime`, plus `FocusCopy.sessionTitle` (Task 4) for "Study · Chemistry ch. 4" |
| "50m", captioned "saved · 2h 10m today" | `onTime` |
| No leaf: "Field maple · 1h 10m to go" | `onTime` |
| One leaf: "… is yours · it opens after this session" or "… opens in the morning" | `leafLines` |
| More: "2 new leaves are yours" | `leafLines` |
| "Locked the whole time · 1 break" | `onTime`, `noBreak` |
| "How did it go?" with All done · Partly · Not yet | `onTime`, `noBreak` |
| "Done", "Again · 50m" | `onTime` |
| Ended while away (finish within 10 minutes only) | `endedAway` |
| Ended early: no gold, "Ended at 18 of 50m" | `endedEarly` |
| Emergency release: §5.7's ended state ("18m", "saved · they stay yours", "Session ended. It won't count as finished.", Done) | `emergency` |
| Counted nothing: a white finish, no gold | `afterBedtime`, `overCap`, `plainTimer` |
| Didn't qualify: "Not counted · add an app to count" | `notQualifying` |
| Unlocked minutes as gaps: "45m locked · 5m unlocked, not counted" | `unlocked` |
| Plain timer: lit marks, "50m focused · not counted toward leaves" | `plainTimer` |
| Lost confirmation: "Couldn't confirm the block after 14:10" | `lostConfirmation` |
| After bedtime: "After bedtime · this didn't count" | `afterBedtime` |
| Over the cap: "Over today's 6h · this didn't add" | `overCap` |
| Receipt dial read: "50 minutes saved. 2 hours 10 minutes today." | `onTime` |

```swift
@Suite("Receipt marks")
struct ReceiptMarksTests {
    private let start = at(2026, 10, 23, 14)

    private func stretch(_ from: Double, _ to: Double, _ rule: CreditRule? = nil) -> CreditStretch {
        CreditStretch(DateInterval(start: start.addingTimeInterval(from * 60), end: start.addingTimeInterval(to * 60)), rule)
    }

    @Test("A break counts, so its minutes light like any others")
    func breakCounts() throws {
        let script = SessionScript(start: start, plan: FocusFixtures.plan(breakMinutes: 5))
        script.write(.shieldApplied)
        script.after(30 * 60, .breakStarted(seconds: 300))
        script.after(5 * 60, .breakEnded)
        script.after(15 * 60, .sessionEnded(.completed, verified: true))
        let session = try #require(script.record)
        let credit = try #require(HoursCredit.credit([session], crediting: [.live], now: script.time.now).first)
        let marks = ReceiptMarks.marks(layout: DialLayout(plannedMinutes: 50), countdownStart: session.countdownStart,
                                       stretches: credit.stretches)
        #expect(marks == Array(repeating: .lit, count: 50))
    }

    @Test("An unlock leaves gaps, and a mark the unlock only touched is a gap too")
    func override() {
        let marks = ReceiptMarks.marks(layout: DialLayout(plannedMinutes: 50), countdownStart: start,
                                       stretches: [stretch(0, 20.5), stretch(20.5, 25.5, .override), stretch(25.5, 50)])
        #expect(marks == Array(repeating: .lit, count: 20) + Array(repeating: .gap, count: 6) + Array(repeating: .lit, count: 24))
    }

    @Test("Time after the last confirmed block is a gap")
    func unconfirmedTail() {
        let marks = ReceiptMarks.marks(layout: DialLayout(plannedMinutes: 50), countdownStart: start,
                                       stretches: [stretch(0, 38), stretch(38, 50, .unconfirmed)])
        #expect(marks == Array(repeating: .lit, count: 38) + Array(repeating: .gap, count: 12))
    }

    @Test("65 minutes: 33 marks of 2 minutes, and the last mark covers only the final minute")
    func sixtyFive() {
        let layout = DialLayout(plannedMinutes: 65)
        #expect(layout.markCount == 33)
        #expect(layout.minutesPerMark == 2)
        // The whole plan counted: the short last mark is lit, though a 2-minute span would run past the end.
        #expect(ReceiptMarks.marks(layout: layout, countdownStart: start, stretches: [stretch(0, 65)]) == Array(repeating: .lit, count: 33))
        let tail = ReceiptMarks.marks(layout: layout, countdownStart: start, stretches: [stretch(0, 64.5), stretch(64.5, 65, .unconfirmed)])
        #expect(tail == Array(repeating: .lit, count: 32) + [.gap])
        let capped = ReceiptMarks.marks(layout: layout, countdownStart: start, stretches: [stretch(0, 61), stretch(61, 65, .dailyCap)])
        #expect(capped == Array(repeating: .lit, count: 30) + [.gap, .gap, .gap])
    }

    @Test("Nothing counted lights nothing; overlapping stretches can't light a mark they only partly cover")
    func edges() {
        #expect(ReceiptMarks.marks(layout: DialLayout(plannedMinutes: 20), countdownStart: start, stretches: [])
            == Array(repeating: .gap, count: 20))
        let overlapping = ReceiptMarks.marks(layout: DialLayout(plannedMinutes: 20), countdownStart: start,
                                             stretches: [stretch(0, 40.0 / 60), stretch(10.0 / 60, 50.0 / 60)])
        #expect(overlapping.first == .gap)
    }
}

@Suite("Receipt")
struct ReceiptModelTests {
    typealias Ended = (session: SessionRecord, credit: SessionCredit)

    /// Field maple, the 3h rung, with 1h 10m to go.
    static let fieldMaple = progressRow("campestre", .hoursSaved, threshold: 3, current: Double(3 * 3600 - 70 * 60) / 3600, estimate: nil)

    private func replay(_ script: SessionScript) throws -> Ended {
        let session = try #require(script.record)
        let credit = try #require(HoursCredit.credit([session], crediting: [.live], now: script.time.now).first)
        return (session: session, credit: credit)
    }

    /// A 50-minute session from `start`, its block confirmed at once unless `applied` is false, then `body`.
    private func session(
        at start: Date = at(2026, 10, 23, 14), plan: FocusPlan = FocusFixtures.plan(), applied: Bool = true,
        _ body: (SessionScript) -> Void
    ) throws -> Ended {
        let script = SessionScript(start: start, plan: plan)
        if applied { script.write(.shieldApplied) }
        body(script)
        return try replay(script)
    }

    /// 14:00–14:50, a 5-minute break at minute 30, every read-back confirmed.
    private func clean() throws -> Ended {
        try session(plan: FocusFixtures.plan(breakMinutes: 5)) {
            $0.after(30 * 60, .breakStarted(seconds: 300))
            $0.after(5 * 60, .breakEnded)
            $0.after(15 * 60, .sessionEnded(.completed, verified: true))
        }
    }

    private func receipt(
        _ ended: Ended, unlocks: [LeafUnlock] = [], held: Bool = false, next: LeafProgress? = ReceiptModelTests.fieldMaple,
        today: Int = 130 * 60, reflection: Reflection? = nil, now: Date? = nil
    ) -> ReceiptModel {
        ReceiptModel(
            session: ended.session, credit: ended.credit, unlocks: unlocks, heldUntilMorning: held, next: next, todaySeconds: today,
            reflection: reflection, now: now ?? ended.session.endedAt ?? ended.session.plannedEnd, locale: enGB, calendar: utc
        )
    }

    private func leaf(_ id: String) -> LeafUnlock {
        LeafUnlock(speciesID: id, date: at(2026, 10, 23, 14, 50), season: .autumn, colourway: .autumn)
    }

    @Test("On time: counted minutes, today's total, the next leaf, the breakdown, the reflection and the buttons")
    func onTime() throws {
        let model = receipt(try clean())
        #expect(model.ending == .onTime)
        #expect(model.playsFinish)
        #expect(model.isGold)
        #expect(model.countedSeconds == 3000)
        #expect(model.subtitle == "Apps open again")
        #expect(model.numeral == "50m")
        #expect(model.numeralParts == [.value("50"), .unit("m")])
        #expect(model.caption == "saved · 2h 10m today")
        #expect(model.note == nil)
        #expect(model.leafLine == "Field maple · 1h 10m to go")
        #expect(!model.leafOpened)
        #expect(model.breakdown == "Locked the whole time · 1 break")
        #expect(model.endedLine == nil)
        #expect(model.layout == DialLayout(plannedMinutes: 50))
        #expect(model.marks == Array(repeating: .lit, count: 50))
        #expect(model.dialLabel == "50 minutes saved. \(HomeFormat.spokenDuration(minutes: 130, locale: enGB)) today.")
        #expect(model.dialLabel.hasPrefix("50 minutes saved. 2 hours"))
        #expect(model.reflectionPrompt == "How did it go?")
        #expect(model.choices.map(\.title) == ["All done", "Partly", "Not yet"])
        #expect(model.choices.allSatisfy { !$0.isSelected })
        #expect(model.again == "Again · 50m")
        #expect(FocusCopy.done == "Done")
    }

    @Test("Without a break the breakdown is Locked the whole time; a chosen reflection is marked")
    func noBreak() throws {
        let ended = try session { $0.after(50 * 60, .sessionEnded(.completed, verified: true)) }
        let model = receipt(ended, reflection: .partly)
        #expect(model.breakdown == "Locked the whole time")
        #expect(model.choices.map(\.reflection) == [.allDone, .partly, .notYet])
        #expect(model.choices.map(\.isSelected) == [false, true, false])
    }

    @Test("Leaf lines: one leaf now or in the morning, several, and a leaf that isn't the dial's")
    func leafLines() throws {
        let done = try clean()
        let one = receipt(done, unlocks: [leaf("campestre")])
        #expect(one.leafLine == "Field maple is yours · it opens after this session")
        #expect(one.leafOpened)
        #expect(receipt(done, unlocks: [leaf("campestre")], held: true).leafLine == "Field maple is yours · it opens in the morning")
        let two = receipt(done, unlocks: [leaf("campestre"), leaf("buergerianum")])
        #expect(two.leafLine == "2 new leaves are yours")
        #expect(two.leafOpened)
        let sessionLeaf = receipt(done, unlocks: [leaf("buergerianum")])
        #expect(sessionLeaf.leafLine == "Trident maple is yours · it opens after this session")
        #expect(!sessionLeaf.leafOpened)
        #expect(receipt(done, next: nil).leafLine == nil)
    }

    @Test("Ended while away: the finish plays only within 10 minutes of the end")
    func endedAway() throws {
        let late = try session { $0.after(2 * 3600 + 50 * 60, .sessionEnded(.completed, verified: true)) }
        let model = receipt(late, now: at(2026, 10, 23, 16, 50))
        #expect(model.ending == .endedAway(playsFinish: false))
        #expect(!model.playsFinish)
        #expect(model.isGold)
        #expect(model.numeral == "50m")
        let soon = try session { $0.after(55 * 60, .sessionEnded(.completed, verified: true)) }
        let fresh = receipt(soon, now: at(2026, 10, 23, 14, 55))
        #expect(fresh.ending == .endedAway(playsFinish: true))
        #expect(fresh.playsFinish)
        // On time, but seen 40 minutes later: the final frame shows still.
        let done = try clean()
        #expect(receipt(done, now: at(2026, 10, 23, 15, 30)).ending == .onTime)
        #expect(!receipt(done, now: at(2026, 10, 23, 15, 30)).playsFinish)
    }

    @Test("Ended early: no gold, and Ended at 18 of 50m over the counted time")
    func endedEarly() throws {
        let early = try session { $0.after(18 * 60 + 20, .sessionEnded(.endedEarly, verified: true)) }
        let model = receipt(early)
        #expect(model.ending == .endedEarly)
        #expect(!model.isGold)

        #expect(receipt(released).ending == .endedEarly)
    }

    @Test("Emergency release: §5.7's ended state, with Done only")
    func emergency() throws {
        let released = try session(plan: FocusFixtures.plan(strictness: .locked)) {
            $0.after(18 * 60, .sessionEnded(.emergencyRelease, verified: true))
        }
        let model = receipt(released)

        #expect(!model.playsFinish)
        #expect(!model.isGold)
        #expect(model.numeral == "18m")
        #expect(model.caption == "saved · they stay yours")
        #expect(model.endedLine == "Session ended. It won't count as finished.")
        #expect(model.breakdown == nil)
        #expect(model.leafLine == nil)
        #expect(model.again == nil)
        #expect(model.reflectionPrompt == nil)
        #expect(model.choices.isEmpty)
        #expect(receipt(released, unlocks: [leaf("campestre")]).leafLine == "Field maple is yours · it opens after this session")
    }

    @Test("After bedtime: a white finish, 0m, and why")
    func afterBedtime() throws {
        let late = try session(at: at(2026, 10, 23, 23, 10), plan: FocusFixtures.plan(day: "2026-10-24", window: FocusFixtures.window(24))) {
            $0.after(50 * 60, .sessionEnded(.completed, verified: true))
        }

        #expect(model.leafLine == "Field maple · 1h 10m to go")

    func crossingBedtime() throws {
        let crossing = try session(at: at(2026, 10, 23, 22, 30)) { $0.after(50 * 60, .sessionEnded(.completed, verified: true)) }

        #expect(model.breakdown == "30m counted · 20m after bedtime")

        let unlocked = try session {

    @Test("Over the cap: Over today's 6h · this didn't add, or the part that did")
    func overCap() throws {

@Suite("Saved today")
struct SavedTodayModelTests {
    private let today = LocalDay(year: 2026, month: 10, day: 23)

    private func model(_ credits: [SessionCredit], _ sessions: [SessionRecord], now: Date, locale: Locale = enGB) -> SavedTodayModel {
        SavedTodayModel(credits: credits, sessions: sessions, day: today, now: now, calendar: utc, locale: locale)
    }

    /// Study 14:00–15:10 with a 5-minute unlock at minute 30, then Quick 16:00–16:25.
    private func typicalDay() -> FocusDay {
        let day = FocusDay(at(2026, 10, 23, 14))
        day.session(minutes: 70, overrides: [(minute: 30, seconds: 300)])
        day.at(at(2026, 10, 23, 16))
        var quick = FocusFixtures.plan(minutes: 25)
        quick.presetName = "Quick"
        day.session(minutes: 25, plan: quick)
        return day
    }

    @Test("Each session's counted stretch, its greyed time with the reason, and the day's total")
    func typical() {
        let day = typicalDay()
        let saved = model(day.credits(), day.ledger.sessions(), now: at(2026, 10, 23, 17))
        #expect(SavedTodayModel.title == "Saved today")
        #expect(saved.rows.map(\.title) == ["Study · 14:00–15:10 · 1h 5m", "Quick · 16:00–16:25 · 25m"])
        #expect(saved.rows.map(\.reasons) == [["Unlocked 5 min"], []])
        #expect(saved.rows.map(\.countedSeconds) == [3900, 1500])
        #expect(saved.rows.allSatisfy { !$0.isRunning })
        #expect(saved.totalSeconds == 5400)
        #expect(saved.total == "1h 30m")
        #expect(saved.emptyLine == nil)
        let twelveHour = model(day.credits(), day.ledger.sessions(), now: at(2026, 10, 23, 17), locale: enUS)
        #expect(twelveHour.rows.first?.title == "Study · 2:00 PM–3:10 PM · 1h 5m")
    }

    @Test("Over the cap: the greyed reason is Over today's 6h, and the total stops at 6h")
    func capped() {
        let day = FocusDay(at(2026, 10, 23, 8))
        day.session(minutes: 180)
        day.at(at(2026, 10, 23, 11, 30))
        day.session(minutes: 180)
        day.at(at(2026, 10, 23, 15))
        day.session(minutes: 50)
        let saved = model(day.credits(), day.ledger.sessions(), now: at(2026, 10, 23, 16))
        #expect(saved.rows.map(\.title) == ["Study · 08:00–11:00 · 3h", "Study · 11:30–14:30 · 3h", "Study · 15:00–15:50"])
        #expect(saved.rows.map(\.reasons) == [[], [], ["Over today's 6h"]])
        #expect(saved.total == "6h")
    }

    @Test("A running session's time since its last checkpoint counts as display credit, not as a reason")
    func running() throws {
        let script = SessionScript(start: at(2026, 10, 23, 14))
        script.write(.shieldApplied)
        script.after(30 * 60, .shieldVerified)
        let session = try #require(script.record)
        let now = at(2026, 10, 23, 14, 32)
        let saved = model(HoursCredit.credit([session], crediting: [.live], now: now), [session], now: now)
        #expect(saved.rows.map(\.title) == ["Study · 14:00–14:32 · 32m"])
        #expect(saved.rows.first?.reasons == [])
        #expect(saved.rows.first?.isRunning == true)
        #expect(saved.totalSeconds == 32 * 60)
        #expect(saved.total == "32m")
    }

    @Test("Lost confirmation and a plain timer each say why; a row that counted nothing drops its duration")
    func reasons() throws {
        let revoked = SessionScript(start: at(2026, 10, 23, 9))
        revoked.write(.shieldApplied)
        revoked.after(10 * 60, .shieldVerified)
        revoked.after(30, .shieldLost)
        revoked.after(39 * 60 + 30, .sessionEnded(.completed, verified: false))
        let plain = SessionScript(start: at(2026, 10, 23, 14), session: UUID(), plan: FocusFixtures.plan(kind: .plainTimer, selection: nil))
        plain.after(50 * 60, .sessionEnded(.completed, verified: false))
        let lost = try #require(revoked.record)
        let timer = try #require(plain.record)
        let credits = HoursCredit.credit([lost], crediting: [.live], now: revoked.time.now)
            + HoursCredit.credit([timer], crediting: [.live], now: plain.time.now)
        let saved = model(credits, [lost, timer], now: at(2026, 10, 23, 17))
        #expect(saved.rows.map(\.title) == ["Study · 09:00–09:50 · 10m", "Study · 14:00–14:50"])
        #expect(saved.rows.map(\.reasons) == [["Couldn't confirm the block"], ["Plain timer"]])
        #expect(saved.total == "10m")
    }

    @Test("Other days, hidden sessions and starts that never got going are left out")
    func leftOut() throws {
        let yesterday = SessionScript(start: at(2026, 10, 22, 14), session: UUID(),
                                      plan: FocusFixtures.plan(day: "2026-10-22", window: FocusFixtures.window(22)))
        yesterday.write(.shieldApplied)
        yesterday.after(50 * 60, .sessionEnded(.completed, verified: true))
        let hidden = SessionScript(start: at(2026, 10, 23, 9), session: UUID())
        hidden.write(.shieldApplied)
        hidden.after(50 * 60, .sessionEnded(.completed, verified: true))
        hidden.write(.sessionHidden)
        let ghost = SessionScript(start: at(2026, 10, 23, 11), session: UUID())
        ghost.after(1, .sessionEnded(.endedEarly, verified: false))
        let scripts = [yesterday, hidden, ghost]
        let records = try scripts.map { try #require($0.record) }
        let credits = zip(scripts, records).flatMap { HoursCredit.credit([$1], crediting: [.live], now: $0.time.now) }
        let saved = model(credits, records, now: at(2026, 10, 23, 17))
        #expect(saved.rows.isEmpty)
        #expect(saved.totalSeconds == 0)
        #expect(saved.total == "0m")
        #expect(saved.emptyLine == "Nothing saved yet today.")
    }

    @Test("How we count, in five lines, and the definition")
    func howWeCount() {
        #expect(SavedTodayModel.howWeCount == [
            "Counts only while your chosen apps are locked.", "Sleep doesn't count.", "Unlocks don't count.", "Overlaps count once.",
            "Up to 6 hours count each day.",
        ])
        #expect(SavedTodayModel.definition == "Time your chosen apps stayed locked while you were awake.")
    }

@Suite("Streak week")
struct StreakWeekTests {
    /// A Friday.
    private let today = LocalDay(year: 2026, month: 10, day: 23)

    private func days(_ list: [Int]) -> [(day: LocalDay, zone: String)] {
        list.map { (day: LocalDay(year: 2026, month: 10, day: $0), zone: "UTC") }
    }

    private func calendar(firstWeekday: Int) -> Calendar {
        var calendar = utc
        calendar.firstWeekday = firstWeekday
        return calendar
    }

    @Test("The title is the current run, with the best run and the rest-day rule under it")
    func lines() {
        let week = StreakWeek(focusDays: [], today: today, calendar: utc, current: 12, best: 21)
        #expect(week.title == "12 days")
        #expect(week.lines == ["Best: 21 days", "Up to 2 rest days in any 7 days"])
        let one = StreakWeek(focusDays: [], today: today, calendar: utc, current: 1, best: 1)
        #expect(one.title == "1 day")
        #expect(one.lines.first == "Best: 1 day")
    }

    @Test("A broken run reads its best: never lost, never rest days left")
    func broken() {
        let week = StreakWeek(focusDays: days([12, 13]), today: today, calendar: utc, current: 0, best: 21)
        #expect(week.title == "0 days")
        #expect(week.lines.first == "Best: 21 days")
        let words = ([week.title, week.weekLabel] + week.lines).joined(separator: " ").lowercased()
        #expect(!words.contains("lost"))
        #expect(!words.contains("left"))
        #expect(!words.contains("0 rest"))
    }

    @Test("Monday first: finished days tinted, a miss neutral, today pending, the days ahead neutral")
    func mondayFirst() {
        let week = StreakWeek(focusDays: days([19, 20, 22]), today: today, calendar: calendar(firstWeekday: 2), current: 4, best: 21)
        #expect(week.days.count == 7)
        #expect(week.days.first == LocalDay(year: 2026, month: 10, day: 19))
        #expect(week.days.last == LocalDay(year: 2026, month: 10, day: 25))
        #expect(week.dots == [.finished, .finished, .neutral, .finished, .pending, .neutral, .neutral])
        #expect(week.weekLabel == "3 finished days this week")
    }

    @Test("Sunday first: the same days, one place later in the row")
    func sundayFirst() {
        let week = StreakWeek(focusDays: days([19, 20, 22]), today: today, calendar: calendar(firstWeekday: 1), current: 4, best: 21)
        #expect(week.days.first == LocalDay(year: 2026, month: 10, day: 18))
        #expect(week.dots == [.neutral, .finished, .finished, .neutral, .finished, .pending, .neutral])
    }

    @Test("Today turns finished once a session finishes; a Monday is the first dot of a Monday week")
    func todayTurnsFinished() {
        let finished = StreakWeek(focusDays: days([22, 23]), today: today, calendar: calendar(firstWeekday: 2), current: 2, best: 2)
        #expect(finished.dots == [.neutral, .neutral, .neutral, .finished, .finished, .neutral, .neutral])
        #expect(!finished.dots.contains(.pending))
        let monday = StreakWeek(focusDays: days([25]), today: LocalDay(year: 2026, month: 10, day: 26),
                                calendar: calendar(firstWeekday: 2), current: 1, best: 21)
        #expect(monday.dots == [.pending, .neutral, .neutral, .neutral, .neutral, .neutral, .neutral])
        #expect(monday.weekLabel == "No finished days yet this week")
        #expect(StreakWeek(focusDays: days([23]), today: today, calendar: utc, current: 1, best: 1).weekLabel == "1 finished day this week")
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation

/// Why time didn't count, in the receipt's and Saved today's words (F1 design §3.3 step 10, §5.9; focus spec §3.3, with
/// "Couldn't confirm the block" in place of "Protection was off").
public enum CreditWords {
    public static func reason(_ rule: CreditRule) -> String {
        switch rule {
        case .override: "Unlocked"
        case .unconfirmed: "Couldn't confirm the block"
        case .afterBedtime: "After bedtime"
        case .beforeMorning: "After bedtime"
        case .dailyCap: "Over today's \(HoursCredit.dailyCap / 3600)h"
        case .overlap: "Counted in another session"
        case .plainTimer: "Plain timer"
        case .notQualifying: "Selection didn't count"
        }
    }

    /// One greyed line in Saved today: an unlock says how long ("Unlocked 5 min"); other reasons stand alone.
    public static func line(_ rule: CreditRule, seconds: Int) -> String {
        guard rule == .override else { return reason(rule) }
        return "Unlocked \(max(1, Int((Double(seconds) / 60).rounded()))) min"
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// Which marks of a finished session's dial counted (F1 design §4.2, §5.8).
public enum ReceiptMarks {
    /// One state per mark of `layout`, from the countdown's start: lit when the mark's whole span counted, a gap
    /// otherwise. Each span is `minutesPerMark` long, and the last stops at the planned end, so a 65-minute plan's last
    /// mark covers 1 minute. Breaks count, so their marks light.
    public static func marks(layout: DialLayout, countdownStart: Date, stretches: [CreditStretch]) -> [MarkState] {
        let counted = merged(stretches.filter(\.counted).map(\.interval))
        let end = countdownStart.addingTimeInterval(TimeInterval(layout.plannedMinutes * 60))
        let span = TimeInterval(layout.minutesPerMark * 60)
        return (0..<layout.markCount).map { index in
            let from = countdownStart.addingTimeInterval(TimeInterval(index) * span)
            let to = min(end, from.addingTimeInterval(span))
            guard to > from else { return .gap }
            let covered = counted.reduce(0.0) { total, piece in
                let start = max(piece.start, from), finish = min(piece.end, to)
                return finish > start ? total + finish.timeIntervalSince(start) : total
            }
            return covered >= to.timeIntervalSince(from) - tolerance ? .lit : .gap
        }
    }

    /// Placed times are sums of doubles; a millisecond is far below any mark.
    static let tolerance: TimeInterval = 0.001

    /// The union of `intervals`, so overlapping stretches are never counted twice.
    static func merged(_ intervals: [DateInterval]) -> [DateInterval] {
        var result: [DateInterval] = []
        for piece in intervals.sorted(by: { $0.start < $1.start }) {
            if let last = result.last, piece.start <= last.end {
                result[result.count - 1] = DateInterval(start: last.start, end: max(last.end, piece.end))
            } else {
                result.append(piece)
            }
        }
        return result
    }
}

/// A finished session's receipt: its final frame (F1 design §5.8, §5.7's ended state, §4.6's finish).
public struct ReceiptModel: Sendable, Equatable {
    public enum Ending: Sendable, Hashable {
        /// It reached its planned end with the app watching.
        case onTime
        /// It reached its planned end while Maple was closed: shown once, when the member next opens Maple. The finish
        /// plays only within 10 minutes of the end; otherwise the final frame shows still.
        case endedAway(playsFinish: Bool)
        /// End early, or Release all apps: no gold, and "Ended at 18 of 50m".
        case endedEarly
        /// Locked's emergency release: §5.7's ended state.
        case emergency
        /// It ran to its end but nothing counted (a plain timer, after bedtime, over the cap): a white finish.
        case countedNothing
        /// Its selection couldn't count (R3).
        case notQualifying
    }

    /// One "How did it go?" answer.
    public struct Choice: Sendable, Hashable {
        public let reflection: Reflection
        public let title: String
        public let isSelected: Bool
    }

    /// The finish plays only if the member sees it within this long of the end (§4.6).
    public static let finishWindow: TimeInterval = 10 * 60
    /// An end the app noticed later than this after the planned end happened while Maple was closed.
    public static let awayAfter: TimeInterval = 60

    public let ending: Ending
    /// The finish (§4.6) plays now: within 10 minutes of the end, never after an emergency release.
    public let playsFinish: Bool
    /// Counted marks sweep gold: a session that reached its end and counted something (F1-18). Anything else is white.
    public let isGold: Bool
    public let countedSeconds: Int
    /// Under the header's title: "Apps open again", or "Plain timer".
    public let subtitle: String
    /// "Ended at 18 of 50m", over the numeral after an early end.
    public let note: String?
    /// "50m": counted minutes, or the minutes focused when the session couldn't count.
    public let numeral: String
    public let numeralParts: [NumeralPart]
    /// "saved · 2h 10m today".
    public let caption: String
    public let leafLine: String?
    /// An hours leaf opened: the centre leaf grows and the numeral shrinks beneath it (§4.3).
    public let leafOpened: Bool
    /// "Locked the whole time · 1 break".
    public let breakdown: String?
    /// The emergency release's "Session ended. It won't count as finished."
    public let endedLine: String?
    public let layout: DialLayout
    public let marks: [MarkState]
    /// The receipt dial's VoiceOver label (§4.9): "50 minutes saved. 2 hours, 10 minutes today."
    public let dialLabel: String
    /// "How did it go?"; nil after an emergency release.
    public let reflectionPrompt: String?
    public let choices: [Choice]
    /// "Again · 50m"; nil after an emergency release. Locked's Again is a hold, and it follows start readiness.
    public let again: String?

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - session: The ended session.
    ///   - credit: Its credit (`FocusSessionStore.credit(for:)`); nil when its source isn't credited.
    ///   - unlocks: Leaves its credit opened (`FocusSessionStore.sessionUnlocks`).
    ///   - heldUntilMorning: The one opened leaf is held until morning (F1-12).
    ///   - next: The next hours leaf after this session's credit, for "Field maple · 1h 10m to go".
    ///   - todaySeconds: Seconds saved on the session's Maple day, this session included.
    ///   - reflection: The answer to "How did it go?" so far.
    ///   - now: Trusted time.
    public init(
        session: SessionRecord, credit: SessionCredit?, unlocks: [LeafUnlock], heldUntilMorning: Bool, next: LeafProgress?,
        todaySeconds: Int, reflection: Reflection?, now: Date, locale: Locale = .current, calendar: Calendar = .current
    ) {
        let plan = session.plan
        let counts = plan.canCount
        let counted = max(0, credit?.seconds ?? 0)
        let start = session.countdownStart
        let endedAt = max(start, session.endedAt ?? min(now, session.plannedEnd))
        let focused = Int(endedAt.timeIntervalSince(start) / 60)

        let ending: Ending
        switch session.endReason {
        case .emergencyRelease?:
            ending = .emergency
        case .endedEarly?, .releaseAll?:
            ending = .endedEarly
        case .completed?, nil:
            if plan.kind == .blocking, !counts {
                ending = .notQualifying
            } else if counted == 0 {
                ending = .countedNothing
            } else if let end = session.end, end.placed.timeIntervalSince(session.plannedEnd) > Self.awayAfter {
                ending = .endedAway(playsFinish: now.timeIntervalSince(endedAt) <= Self.finishWindow)
            } else {
                ending = .onTime
            }
        }
        self.ending = ending
        switch ending {
        case .emergency: playsFinish = false
        case .endedAway(let plays): playsFinish = plays
        default: playsFinish = now.timeIntervalSince(endedAt) <= Self.finishWindow
        }
        switch ending {
        case .onTime, .endedAway: isGold = counted > 0
        default: isGold = false
        }
        countedSeconds = counted
        subtitle = plan.kind == .plainTimer ? "Plain timer" : "Apps open again"
        if ending == .endedEarly {
            let at = focused < 60 ? "\(focused)" : FocusTimeText.length(minutes: focused)
            note = "Ended at \(at) of \(FocusTimeText.length(minutes: plan.plannedMinutes))"
        } else {
            note = nil
        }

        let shown = counts ? counted / 60 : focused
        numeral = FocusTimeText.length(minutes: shown)
        numeralParts = HomeFormat.durationParts(minutes: shown)
        if ending == .emergency {
            caption = FocusCopy.Emergency.endedCaption(countedSeconds: counted)
        } else if plan.kind == .plainTimer {
            caption = "focused · not counted toward leaves"
        } else if !counts {
            caption = "Not counted · add an app to count"
        } else {
            caption = todaySeconds >= 60 ? "saved · \(HomeFormat.duration(minutes: todaySeconds / 60)) today" : "saved · none yet today"
        }
        leafLine = Self.leafLine(counts: counts, ending: ending, unlocks: unlocks, held: heldUntilMorning, next: next)
        leafOpened = unlocks.contains { RewardCatalog.shared.reward(forSpecies: $0.speciesID)?.categoryID == .hoursSaved }
        breakdown = counts && ending != .emergency
            ? Self.breakdown(session, stretches: credit?.stretches ?? [], counted: counted, locale: locale, calendar: calendar)
            : nil
        endedLine = ending == .emergency ? FocusCopy.Emergency.endedLine : nil

        layout = DialLayout(plannedMinutes: plan.plannedMinutes)
        if plan.kind == .plainTimer {
            // A plain timer counts nothing, but its marks light wherever it ran (§5.8).
            let ran = endedAt > start ? [CreditStretch(DateInterval(start: start, end: endedAt), nil)] : []
            marks = ReceiptMarks.marks(layout: layout, countdownStart: start, stretches: ran)
        } else {
            marks = ReceiptMarks.marks(layout: layout, countdownStart: start, stretches: credit?.stretches ?? [])
        }

        let spokenShown = HomeFormat.spokenDuration(minutes: shown, locale: locale)
        if counts {
            let today = todaySeconds >= 60
                ? "\(HomeFormat.spokenDuration(minutes: todaySeconds / 60, locale: locale)) today." : "None yet today."
            dialLabel = "\(spokenShown) saved. \(today)"
        } else {
            dialLabel = "\(spokenShown) focused. Not counted toward leaves."
        }

        if ending == .emergency {
            reflectionPrompt = nil
            choices = []
            again = nil
        } else {
            reflectionPrompt = "How did it go?"
            let answers: [(Reflection, String)] = [(.allDone, "All done"), (.partly, "Partly"), (.notYet, "Not yet")]
            choices = answers.map { Choice(reflection: $0.0, title: $0.1, isSelected: $0.0 == reflection) }
            again = "Again · \(FocusTimeText.length(minutes: plan.plannedMinutes))"
        }
    }

    // MARK: Private

    private static func leafLine(counts: Bool, ending: Ending, unlocks: [LeafUnlock], held: Bool, next: LeafProgress?) -> String? {
        guard counts else { return nil }
        if unlocks.count >= 2 { return SessionForecast.openedLine(count: unlocks.count) }
        if let only = unlocks.first {
            let name = LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: only.speciesID)?.displayName ?? only.speciesID
            return SessionForecast.openedLine(leaf: name, heldUntilMorning: held)
        }
        guard ending != .emergency, let next, next.category == .hoursSaved, next.state == .locked, next.remaining > 0,
              let name = LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: next.speciesID)?.displayName else { return nil }
        return SessionForecast.leafLine(leaf: name, secondsToGo: Int((next.remaining * 3600).rounded()))
    }

    /// One line: lost proof first; otherwise the uncounted rule with the most time, or "Locked the whole time".
    private static func breakdown(
        _ session: SessionRecord, stretches: [CreditStretch], counted: Int, locale: Locale, calendar: Calendar
    ) -> String {
        if session.lostAt != nil {
            let checkpoint = session.lastCheckpoint ?? session.countdownStart
            return "Couldn't confirm the block after \(HomeFormat.clock(HomeFormat.clockTime(of: checkpoint, calendar: calendar), locale: locale))"
        }
        let breaks = session.breaks.count
        func withBreaks(_ line: String) -> String {
            breaks == 0 ? line : "\(line) · \(breaks) \(breaks == 1 ? "break" : "breaks")"
        }
        var seconds: [CreditRule: TimeInterval] = [:]
        for stretch in stretches {
            if let rule = stretch.rule { seconds[rule, default: 0] += stretch.interval.duration }
        }
        let named: [CreditRule] = [.override, .unconfirmed, .afterBedtime, .beforeMorning, .dailyCap, .overlap]
        guard let rule = named.filter({ seconds[$0, default: 0] >= 1 }).max(by: { seconds[$0, default: 0] < seconds[$1, default: 0] })
        else { return withBreaks("Locked the whole time") }

        if counted == 0 {
            switch rule {
            case .afterBedtime, .beforeMorning: return "After bedtime · this didn't count"
            case .dailyCap: return "Over today's \(HoursCredit.dailyCap / 3600)h · this didn't add"
            case .override: return "Unlocked the whole time · this didn't count"
            default: return "\(CreditWords.reason(rule)) · this didn't count"
            }
        }
        let amount = HomeFormat.duration(minutes: max(1, Int((seconds[rule, default: 0] / 60).rounded())))
        let kept = HomeFormat.duration(minutes: counted / 60)
        switch rule {
        case .override: return withBreaks("\(kept) locked · \(amount) unlocked, not counted")
        case .afterBedtime: return withBreaks("\(kept) counted · \(amount) after bedtime")
        case .beforeMorning: return withBreaks("\(kept) counted · \(amount) before morning")
        case .dailyCap: return withBreaks("\(kept) counted · \(amount) over today's \(HoursCredit.dailyCap / 3600)h")
        case .overlap: return withBreaks("\(kept) counted · \(amount) overlapped another session")
        default: return withBreaks("\(kept) counted · \(amount) unconfirmed")
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// Saved today (F1 design §5.9, focus spec §3.3): the day's total, and each session's counted time with the reasons for
/// any time that didn't count. Seconds are display credit, so the total matches Home's numeral while a session runs.
public struct SavedTodayModel: Sendable, Equatable {
    public struct Row: Sendable, Hashable, Identifiable {
        public let id: UUID
        /// "Study · 14:00–15:10 · 1h 5m"; a session that counted nothing leaves its duration out.
        public let title: String
        /// Counted seconds, plus a running session's provisional time.
        public let countedSeconds: Int
        /// The greyed lines, in the order the time happened: "Unlocked 5 min", "After bedtime".
        public let reasons: [String]
        public let isRunning: Bool
    }

    public static let title = "Saved today"
    public static let emptyText = "Nothing saved yet today."
    /// The definition (focus spec §3.3), shown on first use and behind the info button.
    public static var definition: String { RewardCategoryInfo(.hoursSaved).definition }
    /// "How we count", one sentence a line. Phone breaks are F2, so F1 leaves them out.
    public static let howWeCount = [
        "Counts only while your chosen apps are locked.", "Sleep doesn't count.", "Unlocks don't count.", "Overlaps count once.",
        "Up to 6 hours count each day.",
    ]

    public let rows: [Row]
    public let totalSeconds: Int
    /// "2h 10m".
    public let total: String
    /// "Nothing saved yet today." when there are no rows.
    public var emptyLine: String? { rows.isEmpty ? Self.emptyText : nil }

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - credits: Credit for every open session (`HoursCredit.credit` over all of them), so caps and overlaps are
    ///     already applied.
    ///   - sessions: The replayed sessions those credits came from.
    ///   - day: The Maple day to show.
    ///   - now: Trusted time (`FocusSessionStore.now`): a running session's time since its last checkpoint is
    ///     provisional, not a reason.
    public init(credits: [SessionCredit], sessions: [SessionRecord], day: LocalDay, now: Date, calendar: Calendar, locale: Locale) {
        var byID: [UUID: SessionRecord] = [:]
        for session in sessions where byID[session.id] == nil { byID[session.id] = session }
        let todays = credits.filter { $0.day == day }
        let countedToday = todays.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.seconds }
        func clock(_ date: Date) -> String {
            HomeFormat.clock(HomeFormat.clockTime(of: date, calendar: calendar), locale: locale)
        }

        var found: [(start: Date, row: Row)] = []
        for credit in todays {
            guard let session = byID[credit.id], !session.isHidden else { continue }
            let running = session.end == nil
            let end = max(session.countdownStart, session.endedAt ?? min(now, session.plannedEnd))
            let provisional = running
                ? HoursCredit.provisionalSeconds(for: session, now: now, roomLeftToday: HoursCredit.dailyCap - countedToday) : 0
            let counted = credit.seconds + provisional
            // A start that never got going (a block that couldn't be written) is no session to list.
            guard counted > 0 || end.timeIntervalSince(session.countdownStart) >= 60 else { continue }

            var order: [CreditRule] = []
            var seconds: [CreditRule: TimeInterval] = [:]
            for stretch in credit.stretches {
                guard let rule = stretch.rule else { continue }
                // A running session's time since its last checkpoint is provisional: it isn't a reason.
                if running, session.lostAt == nil, rule == .unconfirmed, stretch.interval.end >= end.addingTimeInterval(-1) { continue }
                if seconds[rule] == nil { order.append(rule) }
                seconds[rule, default: 0] += stretch.interval.duration
            }
            let reasons = order.filter { seconds[$0, default: 0] >= 1 }
                .map { CreditWords.line($0, seconds: Int(seconds[$0, default: 0].rounded())) }
            let span = "\(session.plan.presetName) · \(clock(session.countdownStart))–\(clock(end))"
            let title = counted >= 60 ? "\(span) · \(HomeFormat.duration(minutes: counted / 60))" : span
            found.append((start: session.countdownStart,
                          row: Row(id: session.id, title: title, countedSeconds: counted, reasons: reasons, isRunning: running)))
        }
        rows = found.sorted { $0.start < $1.start }.map { $0.row }
        totalSeconds = rows.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.countedSeconds }
        total = HomeFormat.duration(minutes: totalSeconds / 60)
    }
}
```

`MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Focus/StreakWeek.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

/// The streak sheet (F1 design §5.15, §3.4): the current run, the best run, the rest-day rule, and this week as 7 dots.
/// Finished days are tinted. Rest days, misses and days still to come are all neutral, so the week never counts rest
/// days down. Today is pending until a session finishes.
public struct StreakWeek: Sendable, Equatable {
    public enum Dot: Sendable, Hashable {
        /// A focus day: season tint.
        case finished
        /// A rest day, a miss, or a day still to come.
        case neutral
        /// Today, before a session finishes.
        case pending
    }

    /// "12 days".
    public let title: String
    /// "Best: 21 days", then "Up to 2 rest days in any 7 days" (F1-13; the design's "2 a week" predates it).
    public let lines: [String]
    /// This week's 7 days, from the calendar's first weekday (P8).
    public let days: [LocalDay]
    public let dots: [Dot]
    /// The week for VoiceOver: "3 finished days this week".
    public let weekLabel: String

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - focusDays: Days with a finished session (`FocusBook.focusDays`).
    ///   - today: The Maple day now.
    ///   - calendar: The collection's calendar; its `firstWeekday` starts the week.
    ///   - current: The current run (`CollectionStore.currentRun(at:)`).
    ///   - best: The best run (`FocusBook.bestRun`).
    public init(focusDays: [(day: LocalDay, zone: String)], today: LocalDay, calendar: Calendar, current: Int, best: Int) {
        let finished = Set(focusDays.map { $0.day }.filter { $0 <= today })
        let noon = today.startDate(in: calendar).addingTimeInterval(12 * 3600)
        let offset = (calendar.component(.weekday, from: noon) - calendar.firstWeekday + 7) % 7
        let first = today.adding(days: -offset, calendar: calendar)
        let week = (0..<7).map { first.adding(days: $0, calendar: calendar) }
        days = week
        dots = week.map { day in
            if finished.contains(day) { return .finished }
            return day == today ? .pending : .neutral
        }
        title = Self.dayCount(max(0, current))
        lines = [
            "Best: \(Self.dayCount(max(best, current, 0)))",
            "Up to \(FocusRuns.restDays) rest days in any \(FocusRuns.restWindow) days",
        ]
        let count = dots.filter { $0 == .finished }.count
        switch count {
        case 0: weekLabel = "No finished days yet this week"
        case 1: weekLabel = "1 finished day this week"
        default: weekLabel = "\(count) finished days this week"
        }
    }

    private static func dayCount(_ count: Int) -> String {
        count == 1 ? "1 day" : "\(count) days"
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation

/// The break dial (F1 design §5.5): one rest mark per 10 seconds of the break, going out one by one, clockwise from 12
/// o'clock, as the break runs down.
public struct BreakDialLayout: Sendable, Equatable {
    public static let secondsPerMark = 10

    /// The break's real length: its planned 5 minutes, or less when it was cut short at the session's planned end.
    public let breakSeconds: Int
    public let markCount: Int

    public init(breakSeconds: Int) {
        self.breakSeconds = max(1, breakSeconds)
        markCount = (self.breakSeconds + Self.secondsPerMark - 1) / Self.secondsPerMark
    }

    /// Mark `index` of `markCount` sits at index / markCount of a full turn, clockwise from 12 o'clock.
    public func angle(ofMark index: Int) -> Double {
        2 * .pi * Double(index) / Double(markCount)
    }

    /// With `left` seconds of break to go: one `.rest` mark per 10 seconds still left (rounded up), ending the turn; the
    /// marks before them have gone out (`.off`).
    public func marks(left: TimeInterval) -> [MarkState] {
        let remaining = min(markCount, max(0, Int((max(0, left) / Double(Self.secondsPerMark) - 1e-9).rounded(.up))))
        let gone = markCount - remaining
        return (0..<markCount).map { $0 < gone ? .off : .rest }
    }
}
```
