```swift
// The Focus dial (F1 design §4): every mark state; the dial through a session (start, running, the last minute, the
// leaf opening, dimmed, a plain timer, the break, Locked's hold, the emergency release, Needs Screen Time and the
// receipt); the lengths; the centre leaf's two tones and edge; Increase Contrast; the seasons; the smallest size;
// and Dynamic Type for the centre. All on the real #05070D background.
//
//   Scripts/snapshot.sh Scripts/snapshot/FocusScenes.swift [output-dir]       (macOS: Mac type sizes)
//   SIMULATOR="iPhone 17" Scripts/snapshot-ios.sh Scripts/snapshot/FocusScenes.swift [output-dir] [filter]
//
// macOS has no Dynamic Type, so judge focus-dial-centre-type with snapshot-ios.sh. The Live Activity is checked in the
// simulator (P9), and the Focus screens themselves with the launch arguments in docs/debug-launch-arguments.md.
// Compiled together with MapleCore + MapleDesign; not part of the app.
import Foundation
import SwiftUI

@MainActor
func snapshotScenes() -> [SnapshotScene] {
    dialScenes() + leafScenes()
}

// MARK: - The dial

@MainActor
private func dialScenes() -> [SnapshotScene] {
    let fifty = DialLayout(plannedMinutes: 50)
    let saved = DialFill(before: 0.42)
    let counting = DialFill(before: 0.42, session: 0.3)
    let opened = DialFill(before: 0.42, session: 0.58, opened: 1)
    let gaps: [MarkState] = (0..<50).map { (22..<27).contains($0) ? .gap : .lit }
    let running = DialFrame.running(layout: fifty, elapsed: 18.4 * 60, leafMinute: 35, fill: counting)
    let receiptGaps = DialFrame.receipt(marks: gaps, isGold: true, fill: DialFill(before: 0.42, session: 0.38))
    return [
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-mark-states", size: CGSize(width: 402, height: 560)) { MarkStateSheet() },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-mark-states-contrast", size: CGSize(width: 402, height: 560)) {
            MarkStateSheet().environment(\.theme, .mapleIncreasedContrast)
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-start") {
            DialPage(title: "Start · Study 50m", frame: .preview(layout: fifty, leafMinute: 35, fill: saved),
                     numeral: "50m", caption: "turn to set the length")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-lengths", size: CGSize(width: 402, height: 520)) { LengthsSheet() },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-running") {
            DialPage(title: "Running · minute 18 of 50", frame: running, numeral: "32m", caption: "left of 50m")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-running-last-minute") {
            DialPage(title: "The last minute",
                     frame: .running(layout: fifty, elapsed: 49.5 * 60, leafMinute: 35, fill: DialFill(before: 0.42, session: 0.55)),
                     numeral: "0:30", caption: "left of 50m")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-running-opened") {
            DialPage(title: "The leaf has opened · minute 36",
                     frame: .running(layout: fifty, elapsed: 36 * 60, leafMinute: 35, fill: opened),
                     numeral: "14m", caption: "left of 50m")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-running-dimmed") {
            DialPage(title: "Dimmed after 30 seconds", frame: running.dimmed(true), numeral: "32m", caption: "left of 50m")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-plain-timer") {
            DialPage(title: "Plain timer",
                     frame: .running(layout: fifty, elapsed: 18.4 * 60, leafMinute: nil, fill: DialFill()),
                     showsLeaf: false, numeral: "32m", caption: "left of 50m")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-break") {
            DialPage(title: "Break", frame: .breakTime(BreakDialLayout(breakSeconds: 300), left: 190),
                     showsLeaf: false, numeral: "4m", caption: "left of your break")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-hold-start") {
            DialPage(title: "Locked · holding to start",
                     frame: .hold(progress: 0.5, base: .preview(layout: fifty, leafMinute: 35, fill: saved)),
                     numeral: "50m", caption: "Study")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-emergency") {
            DialPage(title: "Emergency release", frame: .hold(progress: 0.6), showsLeaf: false,
                     numeral: "4s", caption: "keep holding")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-off") {
            DialPage(title: "Needs Screen Time", frame: .off(layout: fifty), numeral: "50m", caption: nil)
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-receipt") {
            DialPage(title: "Receipt · a leaf opened",
                     frame: .receipt(marks: Array(repeating: .lit, count: 50), isGold: true, fill: opened),
                     numeral: "50m", caption: "saved · 2h 10m today", grow: 1)
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-receipt-gaps") {
            DialPage(title: "Receipt · 5m unlocked", frame: receiptGaps, numeral: "45m", caption: "saved · 2h 10m today")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-running-contrast") {
            DialPage(title: "Running · Increase Contrast", frame: running, numeral: "32m", caption: "left of 50m")
                .environment(\.theme, .mapleIncreasedContrast)
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-receipt-gaps-contrast") {
            DialPage(title: "Receipt · Increase Contrast", frame: receiptGaps, numeral: "45m", caption: "saved · 2h 10m today")
                .environment(\.theme, .mapleIncreasedContrast)
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-seasons", size: CGSize(width: 402, height: 480)) { SeasonsSheet(frame: running) },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-smallest") {
            DialPage(title: "Smallest · 220pt", frame: running, numeral: "32m", caption: "left of 50m",
                     diameter: MinuteDialMetrics.minimumDiameter)
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-dial-centre-type", size: CGSize(width: 402, height: 1080)) { CentreTypeSheet() },
    ]
}

// MARK: - The centre leaf

@MainActor
private func leafScenes() -> [SnapshotScene] {
    [
        SnapshotScene("focus-leaf-tones", size: CGSize(width: 402, height: 420)) { LeafTonesSheet() },
        SnapshotScene("focus-leaf-tones-large", size: CGSize(width: 402, height: 300)) { LargeLeafSheet() },
    ]
}

// MARK: - Pages

/// The dial with its centre, as the Focus screens compose it, with the Field maple as the next leaf.
private struct SceneDial: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    let frame: DialFrame
    var showsLeaf = true
    let numeral: String
    let caption: String?
    var grow: Double = 0
    var diameter: CGFloat = 300

    var body: some View {
        let leaf = showsLeaf ? LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: "campestre").map { DialLeaf(species: $0, fill: frame.fill) } : nil
        MinuteDial(frame: frame, diameter: diameter, theme: theme) {
            DialCentre(leaf: leaf, numeral: DialCentre.numeralParts(numeral), caption: caption, diameter: diameter)
                .grown(grow)
        }
    }
}

/// One dial on the black page, labelled above.
private struct DialPage: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    let title: String
    let frame: DialFrame
    var showsLeaf = true
    let numeral: String
    let caption: String?
    var grow: Double = 0
    var diameter: CGFloat = 300

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 48) {
            Text(title)
                .font(MapleFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
            SceneDial(frame: frame, showsLeaf: showsLeaf, numeral: numeral, caption: caption, grow: grow, diameter: diameter)
        }
        .padding(.top, 140)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .background(theme.colors.background)
    }
}

/// Every mark state on its own dial (§4.2).
private struct MarkStateSheet: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme

    private var tiles: [(name: String, frame: DialFrame)] {
        func uniform(_ state: MarkState, brightness: Double = 1) -> DialFrame {
            DialFrame(marks: Array(repeating: state, count: 50), currentBrightness: brightness)
        }
        return [
            ("plan", uniform(.plan)), ("ahead", uniform(.ahead)), ("lit", uniform(.lit)),
            ("current at 55%", uniform(.current, brightness: 0.55)), ("current at 100%", uniform(.current)),
            ("rest", uniform(.rest)), ("gap", uniform(.gap)), ("hold", uniform(.hold)), ("off", uniform(.off)),
        ]
    }

    var body: some View {
        let tiles = self.tiles
        Grid(horizontalSpacing: 16, verticalSpacing: 24) {
            ForEach(0..<3, id: \.self) { row in
                GridRow {
                    ForEach(0..<3, id: \.self) { column in
                        let tile = tiles[row * 3 + column]
                        VStack(spacing: 8) {
                            MinuteDial(frame: tile.frame, diameter: 108, theme: theme)
                            Text(tile.name)
                                .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(.top, 48)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .background(theme.colors.background)
    }
}

/// 20 minutes (one mark a minute, no dot: the leaf is out of reach), 1h 30m (45 marks of 2 minutes), 2h 5m (42 of
/// 3 minutes) and 3h (60).
private struct LengthsSheet: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme

    var body: some View {
        let lengths = [20, 90, 125, 180]
        Grid(horizontalSpacing: 24, verticalSpacing: 32) {
            ForEach(0..<2, id: \.self) { row in
                GridRow {
                    ForEach(0..<2, id: \.self) { column in
                        let minutes = lengths[row * 2 + column]
                        let layout = DialLayout(plannedMinutes: minutes)
                        SceneDial(frame: .preview(layout: layout, leafMinute: 35, fill: DialFill(before: 0.42)),
                                  numeral: FocusTimeText.length(minutes: minutes), caption: "\(layout.markCount) marks",
                                  diameter: 160)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(.top, 60)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .background(theme.colors.background)
    }
}

/// The running dial in each season's tint: the current mark, the dot and the bloom.
private struct SeasonsSheet: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    let frame: DialFrame

    var body: some View {
        Grid(horizontalSpacing: 24, verticalSpacing: 24) {
            ForEach(0..<2, id: \.self) { row in
                GridRow {
                    ForEach(0..<2, id: \.self) { column in
                        let season = Season.allCases[row * 2 + column]
                        VStack(spacing: 8) {
                            SceneDial(frame: frame, numeral: "32m", caption: "left of 50m", diameter: 160)
                            Text(season.rawValue)
                                .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                        }
                        .environment(\.season, season)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(.top, 40)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .background(theme.colors.background)
    }
}

/// The centre at Large, at xxLarge, and at AX5, which is capped at xxLarge (§5.17), with the widest numeral.
private struct CentreTypeSheet: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme

    var body: some View {
        let rows: [(String, DynamicTypeSize)] = [
            ("Large", .large), ("xxLarge", .xxLarge), ("AX5 · capped at xxLarge", .accessibility5),
        ]
        let frame = DialFrame.running(
            layout: DialLayout(plannedMinutes: 120), elapsed: 30 * 60, leafMinute: 100, fill: DialFill(before: 0.3, session: 0.1)
        )
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            ForEach(0..<rows.count, id: \.self) { index in
                VStack(spacing: 4) {
                    Text(rows[index].0)
                        .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                    SceneDial(frame: frame, numeral: "1h 30m", caption: "left of 2h", diameter: 300)
                        .environment(\.dynamicTypeSize, rows[index].1)
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(.top, 24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .background(theme.colors.background)
    }
}

/// The centre leaf's tones for four species: saved before only, saved plus this session, this session only,
/// nearly full (with the edge), and opened.
private struct LeafTonesSheet: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    private let fills: [(String, DialFill)] = [
        ("saved", DialFill(before: 0.4)),
        ("+ session", DialFill(before: 0.4, session: 0.3)),
        ("session", DialFill(session: 0.5)),
        ("nearly", DialFill(before: 0.5, session: 0.45)),
        ("opened", DialFill(before: 0.5, session: 0.5, opened: 1)),
    ]
    private let leaves = ["campestre", "palmatum", "rubrum", "saccharum"].compactMap { LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: $0) }

    var body: some View {
        Grid(horizontalSpacing: 12, verticalSpacing: 16) {
            GridRow {
                ForEach(0..<fills.count, id: \.self) { column in
                    Text(fills[column].0)
                        .font(MapleFont.micro)
                        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                }
            }
            ForEach(leaves) { leaf in
                GridRow {
                    ForEach(0..<fills.count, id: \.self) { column in
                        DialLeaf(species: leaf, fill: fills[column].1)
                            .frame(width: 64, height: 64)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(.top, 32)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .background(theme.colors.background)
    }
}

/// The Field maple at 170pt: two tones with the edge, and opened with its dark veins and glow.
private struct LargeLeafSheet: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 24) {
            if let field = LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: "campestre") {
                DialLeaf(species: field, fill: DialFill(before: 0.42, session: 0.3))
                    .frame(width: 170, height: 170)
                DialLeaf(species: field, fill: DialFill(before: 0.42, session: 0.58, opened: 1))
                    .frame(width: 170, height: 170)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(theme.colors.background)
    }
}

### Task 7: Dial motion and holds

This task adds everything on the dial that moves or responds to a touch (F1 design §4.5–§4.7, §4.9, F1-22):
- turning the dial to set the length, with VoiceOver adjust;
- the finish, as pure frames at a time `t`, drawn over the dial and its centre;
- a hold's progress as a pure value, and `HoldButton`, which cancels and drains when interrupted and has a named accessibility action that starts a visible, cancellable countdown.

Task 6's `MinuteDial`, `DialFrame` and `DialCentre` are the base.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **Signatures beyond the skeleton.** `HoldButton` takes two extra parameters with defaults, so the skeleton's call `HoldButton(title:duration:accessibilityName:progress:) { … }` still compiles:
  - `frozenProgress: Double? = nil`: MapleDesign can't see the app's DEBUG options, so the app passes `DemoLaunchOptions.current.holdAt` here (DEBUG only);
  - `onTap: (() -> Void)? = nil`: a press released within 0.3 s, for §5.2's "Hold to start. Locked ends early only by emergency release." hint.

  `.dialTurning` also takes `onTurn: (() -> Void)? = nil`, for the start screen's "turn to set the length" hint (§4.5). Cost if wrong: the callers in Tasks 9 and 12 drop an argument.
- **Copy the design doesn't give.** These strings live in MapleCore, as a new `FocusCopy` extension:
  - the named action: "Start countdown";
  - its cancel action: "Cancel countdown";
  - the button's label while the countdown runs: "Cancel · 8s";
  - the start dial's VoiceOver label, "Session length", which is §4.9's own word.

  The countdown's spoken value reuses `FocusTimeText.spokenRemaining` ("8 seconds left"). Cost if wrong: the strings change in one file.
- **Interruptions:**
  - VoiceOver's double-tap (the default action) also starts or cancels the countdown, so one double-tap is enough.
  - A touch during a countdown cancels it.
  - VoiceOver focus leaving the button cancels a running countdown (Review Focus 3).
  - After a scene-phase change or a second finger, every touch is ignored until all fingers lift, so a finger still down can't restart the hold.
  - A touch the system cancels (a scroll or a sheet taking it) drains the hold like any other interruption.
- **The drain rate.** A hold drains at the rate it filled, as the skeleton says, not in the mockup's 350 ms. Pressing again mid-drain carries on from where the drain had got to.
- **Turning.**
  - Turning is incremental: each 30° moves the length one step from its current value, so turning back right after hitting 20m or 3h works at once.
  - Touches within 15% of the dial's side from its centre are ignored.
  - The haptic plays only when the length actually changes.
- **The finish's timings** (§4.6 is silent on the shape):
  - The sweep is the mockup's: each mark rises to full gold in the first quarter of its 0.9 s, then fades back to its receipt state. The dial at rest shows the receipt's own marks, with no lasting gold on them.
  - A white finish sweeps every mark, and its ring is white too.
  - The numeral fades in over 0.6 s (the mockup's 0.5 s, raised to the 0.6 s minimum).
  - The soft impact haptic's time is 0.15 s, as the ring sets off.
  - There is no bloom pulse: §4.6 names only the glow.
  - The finish settles at 1.7 s, when the glow's pulse ends, so the 30 fps timeline runs past §4.8's "1.5 seconds": §4.6's timings (sweep, grow, ripple and fades) govern.
- **Reduce Motion.** There is no sweep, ripple, glow pulse or rise, and the leaf is at its final size from t = 0. The numeral, the leaf line and Done and Again still cross-fade in on the same timings.
- **The finish's drawing APIs.**
  - `MinuteDial.finishing(_:)` draws the sweep (2.6 units wide, the mockup's stroke) and the 1.5pt ring.
  - `DialCentre.finishing(_:)` applies the leaf's growth, the glow pulse and the numeral's fade.
  - Task 13 composes both, and fades the leaf line and the buttons with `lineOpacity`/`lineRise` and `actionsOpacity`/`actionsRise`.

**Files:**
- Create: `MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Focus/FocusCopy+Dial.swift` (the hold and dial strings)
- Create: `MapleKit/Sources/MapleDesign/Focus/DialTurning.swift`
- Create: `MapleKit/Sources/MapleDesign/Focus/FinishTimeline.swift`
- Create: `MapleKit/Sources/MapleDesign/Focus/HoldProgress.swift`
- Create: `MapleKit/Sources/MapleDesign/Focus/HoldButton.swift`
- Modify: `MapleKit/Sources/MapleDesign/Focus/MinuteDial.swift` (a stored `finish`, and the finish layer in `body`)
- Modify: `Scripts/snapshot/FocusScenes.swift` (the motion scenes)
- Test: `MapleKit/Tests/MapleDesignTests/DialMotionTests.swift`
- Test: `MapleKit/Tests/MapleDesignTests/DialMotionDrawingTests.swift`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - from Task 6: `MinuteDial(frame:diameter:theme:centre:)`, `MinuteDialGeometry` (`scale`, `diameter`, `path(index:count:state:)`), `DialFrame` (`marks`, `gold`, `fill`, `.receipt(marks:isGold:fill:)`, `.hold(progress:layout:base:)`, `.preview(layout:leafMinute:fill:)`), `DialFill`, `DialCentre` (its internal `grow`, `glowScale`, `glowOpacity`, `numeralOpacity` and `numeralRise`, and `grown(_:)`), `DialLeaf(species:fill:)` and `Theme.Dial` (`gold`);
  - from Task 4: `FocusCopy`, a MapleCore type this task extends; it must be a type (`enum` or `struct`) that can take static members in an extension;
  - from F1a: `MarkState`, `DialLayout.stepped(_:by:)`, `DialLayout.degreesPerStep`, `FocusTimeText.spokenLength(minutes:locale:)` and `.spokenRemaining(_:locale:)`;
  - existing: `RevealEasing.cubicBezier` and `.easeInOut`, `Theme`, `MapleFont`, `MoonlightButtonStyle` (`.moonlight`) and `TextLink`.
- Produces:
  - `FocusCopy.dialLengthLabel`, `.holdCountdownAction`, `.holdCancelAction` and `.holdCountdownTitle(secondsLeft:)`;
  - `View.dialTurning(minutes: Binding<Int>, enabled: Bool, onTurn: (() -> Void)? = nil)`, with the internal `DialTurnTracker`;
  - `FinishFrame`:
    - `tone` (`.gold`, `.white`) and `sweep`;
    - `leafGrow`, `glowScale` and `glowOpacity`;
    - `rippleScale` and `rippleOpacity`;
    - `numeralOpacity`, `numeralRise`, `lineOpacity`, `lineRise`, `actionsOpacity` and `actionsRise`;
  - `FinishTimeline.frame(at:counted:leafOpened:reduceMotion:)`, `.settledTime(markCount:reduceMotion:)`, `.tone(counted:)`, and the timing constants (`sweepStagger`, `sweepDuration`, `sweepPeak`, `sweepStroke`, `leafGrowDuration`, `rippleStart`, `rippleDuration`, `glowStart`, `glowDuration`, `lineStart`, `actionsStart`, `fadeDuration`, `hapticTime`);
  - `MinuteDial.finishing(_ finish: FinishFrame?) -> MinuteDial` and `DialCentre.finishing(_ finish: FinishFrame) -> DialCentre`;
  - `HoldProgress(duration:)`:
    - statics: `progress(heldFor:duration:)` and `drained(from:releasedFor:duration:)`;
    - reading: `value(at:)`, `phase(at:)` (`.idle`, `.filling`, `.draining`, `.complete`), `isFilled(at:)`, `secondsLeft(at:)`, `isFilling`, `isCountdown` and `isComplete`;
    - changing: `press(at:)`, `startCountdown(at:)`, `release(at:)`, `finish()` and `reset()`;
  - `HoldButton(title:duration:accessibilityName:progress:frozenProgress:onTap:onComplete:)`.

/// Turning the dial (F1 design §4.5): 30° of turn is one 5-minute step.
@Suite("Dial turning")
struct DialTurnTrackerTests {
    private let centre = CGPoint(x: 100, y: 100)

    /// The point `degrees` clockwise from 12 o'clock, 80 points out.
    private func point(_ degrees: Double) -> CGPoint {
        let radians = degrees * .pi / 180
        return CGPoint(x: 100 + 80 * sin(radians), y: 100 - 80 * cos(radians))
    }

    @Test("Angles run clockwise from 12 o'clock")
    func angles() {
        #expect(abs(DialTurnTracker.angle(of: CGPoint(x: 100, y: 0), around: centre)) < 1e-9)
        #expect(abs(DialTurnTracker.angle(of: CGPoint(x: 200, y: 100), around: centre) - 90) < 1e-9)
        #expect(abs(DialTurnTracker.angle(of: CGPoint(x: 100, y: 200), around: centre) - 180) < 1e-9)
        #expect(abs(DialTurnTracker.angle(of: CGPoint(x: 0, y: 100), around: centre) - 270) < 1e-9)
    }

    @Test("Each 30° is a step: clockwise lengthens, anticlockwise shortens, and what's left over carries")
    func steps() {
        var tracker = DialTurnTracker()
        #expect(tracker.move(to: point(29), from: point(0), around: centre, deadZone: 20) == 0)
        #expect(tracker.move(to: point(31), from: point(0), around: centre, deadZone: 20) == 1)
        #expect(abs(tracker.pending - 1) < 1e-6)
        #expect(tracker.move(to: point(91), from: point(0), around: centre, deadZone: 20) == 2)
        #expect(tracker.move(to: point(1), from: point(0), around: centre, deadZone: 20) == -2)
        #expect(abs(tracker.pending - -29) < 1e-6)
        tracker.end()
        #expect(tracker.lastAngle == nil && tracker.pending == 0)
        // Exactly 30° is a whole step.
        #expect(tracker.move(to: point(30), from: point(0), around: centre, deadZone: 20) == 1)
    }

    @Test("Crossing 12 o'clock turns the short way round")
    func crossingTwelve() {
        var tracker = DialTurnTracker()
        #expect(tracker.move(to: point(10), from: point(350), around: centre, deadZone: 20) == 0)
        #expect(abs(tracker.pending - 20) < 1e-6)
        #expect(tracker.move(to: point(20), from: point(350), around: centre, deadZone: 20) == 1)
        #expect(tracker.move(to: point(340), from: point(350), around: centre, deadZone: 20) == -1)
    }

    @Test("Touches near the centre are ignored, and a new touch starts from where it lands")
    func deadZone() {
        var tracker = DialTurnTracker()
        #expect(tracker.move(to: CGPoint(x: 105, y: 95), from: CGPoint(x: 100, y: 100), around: centre, deadZone: 20) == 0)
        #expect(tracker.lastAngle == nil)

        tracker.end()

        #expect(tracker.move(to: point(232), from: point(200), around: centre, deadZone: 20) == 1)
    }

/// The finish (F1 design §4.6) as frames at a time `t`.
@Suite("Finish timeline")
struct FinishTimelineTests {
    private let all = Array(repeating: true, count: 50)
    private let samples = stride(from: -0.5, through: 3.0, by: 0.01).map { $0 }

    private func frame(_ t: Double, counted: [Bool]? = nil, leaf: Bool = true, reduceMotion: Bool = false) -> FinishFrame {
        FinishTimeline.frame(at: t, counted: counted ?? all, leafOpened: leaf, reduceMotion: reduceMotion)
    }

    @Test("Counted marks sweep gold one after another, 14 ms apart, each over 0.9 s and peaking a quarter of the way in")
    func sweepOrder() throws {
        let stagger = FinishTimeline.sweepStagger
        #expect(frame(0).tone == .gold)
        let tenth = frame(10 * stagger + 0.001)
        #expect(tenth.sweep[10] > 0 && tenth.sweep[11] == 0 && tenth.sweep[9] > tenth.sweep[10])
        let peak = FinishTimeline.sweepDuration * FinishTimeline.sweepPeak
        #expect(abs(frame(peak).sweep[0] - 1) < 1e-6)
        #expect(frame(0.89).sweep[0] > 0 && frame(0.9).sweep[0] == 0)
        #expect(frame(49 * stagger - 0.001).sweep[49] == 0 && frame(49 * stagger + 0.001).sweep[49] > 0)
        // Each mark rises, then fades back to the receipt's mark.
        let mark = samples.map { frame($0).sweep[20] }
        let top = try #require(mark.indices.max { mark[$0] < mark[$1] })
        #expect((1..<top).allSatisfy { mark[$0] >= mark[$0 - 1] })
        #expect((top + 1..<mark.count).allSatisfy { mark[$0] <= mark[$0 - 1] })
        #expect(frame(3).sweep.allSatisfy { $0 == 0 })
    }

    @Test("Marks that didn't count stay out of a gold sweep")
    func gapsStayOut() {
        let counted = (0..<50).map { !(22..<27).contains($0) }
        #expect(samples.allSatisfy { frame($0, counted: counted).tone == .gold })
        #expect(samples.allSatisfy { frame($0, counted: counted).sweep[22..<27].allSatisfy { $0 == 0 } })
        #expect(frame(23 * FinishTimeline.sweepStagger + 0.1, counted: counted).sweep[27] > 0)
    }

    @Test("A session that counted nothing finishes in white, sweeping every mark")
    func white() {
        let none = Array(repeating: false, count: 50)
        #expect(frame(0.5, counted: none).tone == .white)
        #expect((0..<50).allSatisfy { frame(Double($0) * FinishTimeline.sweepStagger + 0.1, counted: none).sweep[$0] > 0 })
        #expect(FinishTimeline.tone(counted: []) == .white)
    }

    @Test("Reduce Motion: no sweep, ripple, pulse or rise; the leaf is at its final size at once and the words cross-fade")
    func reduceMotion() {
        let still = samples.allSatisfy { t in
            let f = frame(t, reduceMotion: true)
            return f.sweep.allSatisfy { $0 == 0 } && f.rippleOpacity == 0 && f.glowScale == 1 && f.glowOpacity == 1
                && f.numeralRise == 0 && f.lineRise == 0 && f.actionsRise == 0

        #expect(still)
        #expect(frame(0, reduceMotion: true).leafGrow == 1)
        #expect(frame(0, leaf: false, reduceMotion: true).leafGrow == 0)
        #expect(frame(0.3, reduceMotion: true).lineOpacity == 0 && frame(0.7, reduceMotion: true).lineOpacity > 0)
        #expect(FinishTimeline.settledTime(markCount: 50, reduceMotion: true) == 1.2)
    }

    func leafGrows() {

        #expect(grow.allSatisfy { $0 >= 0 && $0 <= 1 })
        #expect(zip(grow, grow.dropFirst()).allSatisfy { $0 <= $1 })
        #expect(frame(FinishTimeline.leafGrowDuration).leafGrow == 1)
        #expect(frame(0.4).leafGrow > 0.5, "an ease-out runs ahead of a straight line")
        #expect(samples.allSatisfy { frame($0, leaf: false).leafGrow == 0 })
    }

    @Test("The ring ripples out over 1.5 s from 0.15 s, and the glow pulses once")

/// A hold's progress (F1 design §4.7, F1-22): it fills while pressed, drains at the same rate when let go, and can be
/// filled by a countdown instead.
@Suite("Hold progress")
struct HoldProgressTests {
    private func after(_ seconds: Double) -> Date {
        Date(timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate: seconds)
    }

    @Test("Progress is the share of the hold's length held, from 0 to 1, and drains at the same rate")
    func progress() {
        #expect(HoldProgress.progress(heldFor: 0.75, duration: 1.5) == 0.5)
        #expect(HoldProgress.progress(heldFor: 3, duration: 1.5) == 1)
        #expect(HoldProgress.progress(heldFor: -1, duration: 1.5) == 0)
        #expect(HoldProgress.progress(heldFor: .nan, duration: 10) == 0)
        #expect(HoldProgress.drained(from: 0.5, releasedFor: 0.375, duration: 1.5) == 0.25)
        #expect(HoldProgress.drained(from: 0.5, releasedFor: 5, duration: 1.5) == 0)
    }

    @Test("Letting go early drains at the rate it filled, and never completes")
    func drains() {
        var hold = HoldProgress(duration: 1.5)
        hold.press(at: after(0))
        #expect(hold.value(at: after(0.75)) == 0.5)
        #expect(hold.phase(at: after(0.75)) == .filling && hold.isFilling)
        hold.release(at: after(0.75))
        #expect(abs(hold.value(at: after(1.125)) - 0.25) < 1e-9)
        #expect(hold.value(at: after(1.5)) == 0)
        #expect(hold.phase(at: after(1.0)) == .draining)
        #expect(hold.phase(at: after(2)) == .idle)
        #expect(!hold.isFilled(at: after(10)) && !hold.isComplete)
    }

    @Test("Pressing again mid-drain carries on from where the drain had got to")
    func resumes() {
        var hold = HoldProgress(duration: 10)
        hold.press(at: after(0))
        hold.release(at: after(6))
        hold.press(at: after(8))
        #expect(abs(hold.value(at: after(8)) - 0.4) < 1e-9)
        #expect(!hold.isFilled(at: after(13.9)))
        #expect(hold.isFilled(at: after(14)))
        #expect(hold.phase(at: after(14)) == .complete)
    }

    @Test("A countdown fills over the same length, shows whole seconds left, and cancels into a drain")
    func countdown() {
        var hold = HoldProgress(duration: 10)
        hold.startCountdown(at: after(0))
        #expect(hold.isCountdown && hold.isFilling)
        #expect(hold.secondsLeft(at: after(0)) == 10)
        #expect(hold.secondsLeft(at: after(0.2)) == 10)
        #expect(hold.secondsLeft(at: after(9.5)) == 1)
        #expect(hold.isFilled(at: after(10)))
        var cancelled = HoldProgress(duration: 10)
        cancelled.startCountdown(at: after(0))
        cancelled.release(at: after(4))
        #expect(!cancelled.isCountdown && cancelled.phase(at: after(5)) == .draining)
        #expect(cancelled.value(at: after(8)) == 0)
    }

    @Test("Once finished the hold stays full and ignores presses, releases and countdowns until it is reset")
    func finish() {
        var hold = HoldProgress(duration: 1.5)
        hold.press(at: after(0))
        hold.finish()
        #expect(hold.isComplete && hold.value(at: after(100)) == 1 && hold.phase(at: after(100)) == .complete)
        hold.press(at: after(2))
        hold.release(at: after(2.1))
        hold.startCountdown(at: after(3))
        #expect(hold.isComplete && !hold.isCountdown && hold.value(at: after(4)) == 1)
        hold.reset()
        #expect(!hold.isComplete && hold.value(at: after(5)) == 0 && hold.phase(at: after(5)) == .idle)
    }

    @Test("A release without a press does nothing, and a second press doesn't restart the fill")
    func idempotent() {
        var hold = HoldProgress(duration: 3)
        hold.release(at: after(1))
        #expect(hold.phase(at: after(1)) == .idle)
        hold.press(at: after(0))
        hold.press(at: after(1))
        #expect(abs(hold.value(at: after(1.5)) - 0.5) < 1e-9)
    }
}

/// The dial's and the holds' own words (F1 design §4.9, F1-22).
extension FocusCopy {
    /// The start dial's VoiceOver label: it reads "Session length, 50 minutes".
    public static let dialLengthLabel = "Session length"
    /// A hold's named accessibility action: it starts a visible countdown as long as the hold.
    public static let holdCountdownAction = "Start countdown"
    /// The same action while the countdown runs.
    public static let holdCancelAction = "Cancel countdown"

    /// The hold button's label while its countdown runs: "Cancel · 8s".
    public static func holdCountdownTitle(secondsLeft: Int) -> String {
        "Cancel · \(max(1, secondsLeft))s"

import Foundation

/// A press-and-hold's progress as a pure value (F1 design §4.7, F1-22). It fills over the hold's length while
/// pressed and drains back at the same rate when let go early. It can instead be filled by a countdown, which is
/// what the hold's named accessibility action starts. `HoldButton` keeps one in its state and samples it on a
/// timer; tests drive it with plain dates.
nonisolated public struct HoldProgress: Sendable, Equatable {
    public enum Phase: Sendable, Equatable {
        /// Empty and still.
        case idle
        /// Pressed, or counting down.
        case filling
        /// Let go or interrupted before it filled: draining at the rate it filled.
        case draining
        /// Full: the hold has done its job.
        case complete
    }

    private enum Motion: Sendable, Equatable { case still, filling, draining }

    /// Rounding slack, so a fill that reaches 1 through sums of fractions still counts as full.
    private static let slack = 1e-9

    /// The hold's length in seconds: 1.5 to start Locked, 3 to end Steady early, 10 for an emergency release.
    public let duration: TimeInterval
    /// The progress when the current fill or drain began.
    private var level: Double = 0
    private var since = Date(timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate: 0)
    private var motion = Motion.still
    /// The fill is a countdown started by the accessibility action, not a press.
    public private(set) var isCountdown = false
    /// The hold filled and `finish()` was called: it stays full until `reset()`.
    public private(set) var isComplete = false

    public init(duration: TimeInterval) {
        self.duration = duration.isFinite && duration > 0 ? duration : 1
    }

    /// The share of a `duration`-long hold that `seconds` of holding fills, 0…1.
    public static func progress(heldFor seconds: TimeInterval, duration: TimeInterval) -> Double {
        guard !seconds.isNaN else { return 0 }
        guard duration > 0 else { return seconds > 0 ? 1 : 0 }
        return min(1, max(0, seconds / duration))
    }

    /// What is left of `level` after `seconds` let go: it drains at the rate a hold fills.
    public static func drained(from level: Double, releasedFor seconds: TimeInterval, duration: TimeInterval) -> Double {
        max(0, min(1, level) - progress(heldFor: seconds, duration: duration))
    }

    /// The progress at `date`, 0…1.
    public func value(at date: Date) -> Double {
        if isComplete { return 1 }
        let elapsed = date.timeIntervalSince(since)
        switch motion {
        case .still: return level
        case .filling: return min(1, level + Self.progress(heldFor: elapsed, duration: duration))
        case .draining: return Self.drained(from: level, releasedFor: elapsed, duration: duration)
        }
    }

    /// Pressed or counting down, and not yet finished.
    public var isFilling: Bool { motion == .filling && !isComplete }

    /// Whether a fill has reached the end at `date` (the button then calls `finish()` and completes).
    public func isFilled(at date: Date) -> Bool {
        isFilling && value(at: date) >= 1 - Self.slack
    }

    public func phase(at date: Date) -> Phase {
        if isComplete { return .complete }
        switch motion {
        case .still: return .idle
        case .filling: return value(at: date) >= 1 - Self.slack ? .complete : .filling
        case .draining: return value(at: date) > 0 ? .draining : .idle
        }
    }

    /// Whole seconds until the fill completes, rounded up (the countdown's "8s"); the whole length when not filling.
    public func secondsLeft(at date: Date) -> Int {
        let remaining = isFilling ? (1 - value(at: date)) * duration : duration
        return max(0, Int((remaining - Self.slack).rounded(.up)))
    }

    /// A finger goes down: it fills from wherever it is, so a hold pressed again mid-drain carries on from there.
    public mutating func press(at date: Date) {
        fill(from: date, countdown: false)
    }

    /// The named accessibility action: a countdown fills it over the same length, as if held.
    public mutating func startCountdown(at date: Date) {
        fill(from: date, countdown: true)
    }

    /// Let go, interrupted or cancelled: it drains from wherever it is. Never completes.
    public mutating func release(at date: Date) {
        guard !isComplete, motion == .filling else { return }
        level = value(at: date)
        since = date
        motion = .draining
        isCountdown = false
    }

    /// The hold filled: it stays full and ignores everything until `reset()`.
    public mutating func finish() {
        level = 1
        motion = .still
        isCountdown = false
        isComplete = true
    }

    public mutating func reset() {
        self = HoldProgress(duration: duration)
    }

    private mutating func fill(from date: Date, countdown: Bool) {
        guard !isComplete else { return }
        level = value(at: date)
        since = date
        motion = .filling
        isCountdown = countdown
    }
}
```

`MapleKit/Sources/MapleDesign/Focus/FinishTimeline.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import MapleCore
import SwiftUI

/// One moment of the finish (F1 design §4.6), as plain numbers: what the dial, its centre and the lines under it
/// draw `t` seconds after the finish begins.
nonisolated public struct FinishFrame: Sendable, Equatable {
    /// Gold when the session counted something; white when it counted nothing (F1-18).
    public enum Tone: Sendable, Equatable {
        case gold
        case white
    }

    public var tone: Tone
    /// Per mark, 0…1: how strongly the sweep shows over it. Marks that didn't count stay 0 in a gold finish.
    public var sweep: [Double]
    /// 0…1: the opened leaf growing into the centre (`DialCentre.grown(_:)`); 0 when no leaf opened.
    public var leafGrow: Double
    /// The leaf's glow pulsing once: its scale (1 → 1.25 → 1) and strength (1, dipping to 0.75, back to 1).
    public var glowScale: Double
    public var glowOpacity: Double
    /// The ring rippling out from the marks: its scale of the dial (0.55 → 1.3) and its opacity (0.7 → 0).
    public var rippleScale: Double
    public var rippleOpacity: Double
    /// The receipt's numeral fading in, rising this many points into place.
    public var numeralOpacity: Double
    public var numeralRise: Double
    /// The leaf line, then Done and Again, fading in from below (points still to rise).
    public var lineOpacity: Double
    public var lineRise: Double
    public var actionsOpacity: Double
    public var actionsRise: Double
}

/// The finish as a pure function of time (F1 design §4.6). It plays once, when the session ends, and only if the
/// member sees it within 10 minutes (`ReceiptModel.ending`).
/// - The counted marks sweep gold one after another, 14 ms apart and 0.9 s each: each rises to full in its first
///   quarter and fades back to the receipt's mark. Marks that didn't count stay gaps. A session that counted
///   nothing sweeps every mark white.
/// - An opened leaf grows into the centre over 0.8 s, with an ease-out and no overshoot.
/// - The leaf's glow pulses once, and a ring ripples out from the marks (1.5 s from 0.15 s).
/// - The numeral fades in at once, the leaf line at 0.4 s, and Done and Again at 0.6 s, each over 0.6 s.
/// - A soft impact haptic plays at `hapticTime`.
///
/// Under Reduce Motion there is no sweep, ripple, pulse or rise. The leaf is at its final size at once, and the
/// words cross-fade in on the same timings.
///
/// ```swift
/// TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1 / 30, paused: elapsed > FinishTimeline.settledTime(markCount: n, reduceMotion: rm))) { context in
///     let finish = FinishTimeline.frame(at: context.date.timeIntervalSince(shownAt), counted: dial.gold,
///                                       leafOpened: dial.fill.opened > 0, reduceMotion: rm)
///     MinuteDial(frame: dial, diameter: d, theme: theme) { DialCentre(…).finishing(finish) }
///         .finishing(finish)
/// }
/// ```
/// Pass `DialFrame.receipt(…).gold` as `counted`. It is all false when the receipt isn't gold, and that makes the
/// finish white. A still frame (`-MapleDemoFinishAt`, or a finish seen too late to play) is `frame(at:)` at that
/// time, or at `settledTime(markCount:reduceMotion:)`.
nonisolated public enum FinishTimeline {
    public static let sweepStagger: TimeInterval = 0.014
    public static let sweepDuration: TimeInterval = 0.9
    /// Where in its 0.9 s each mark's sweep is at full strength.
    public static let sweepPeak = 0.25
    /// The sweep's stroke on the dial's 200-unit box, along each mark's own length.
    public static let sweepStroke = 2.6
    public static let leafGrowDuration: TimeInterval = 0.8
    public static let rippleStart: TimeInterval = 0.15
    public static let rippleDuration: TimeInterval = 1.5
    public static let glowStart: TimeInterval = 0.1
    public static let glowDuration: TimeInterval = 1.6
    public static let lineStart: TimeInterval = 0.4
    public static let actionsStart: TimeInterval = 0.6
    /// Every fade-in lasts this long: nothing moves faster than `gentle` except press feedback (spec §1).
    public static let fadeDuration: TimeInterval = 0.6
    /// When the soft impact haptic plays: as the ring sets off.
    public static let hapticTime: TimeInterval = 0.15

    /// Gold when any mark counted, white when none did.
    public static func tone(counted: [Bool]) -> FinishFrame.Tone {
        counted.contains(true) ? .gold : .white
    }

    /// When everything has come to rest for a dial of `markCount` marks: nothing moves after this.
    public static func settledTime(markCount: Int, reduceMotion: Bool) -> TimeInterval {
        if reduceMotion { return actionsStart + fadeDuration }
        let sweep = Double(max(0, markCount - 1)) * sweepStagger + sweepDuration
        return max(sweep, rippleStart + rippleDuration, glowStart + glowDuration, leafGrowDuration, actionsStart + fadeDuration)
    }

    /// The finish `t` seconds in. Times before 0 are the first frame; NaN and times past the end are the last.
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - counted: One entry per mark: whether it counted (`DialFrame.gold`).
    ///   - leafOpened: A leaf opened in this session, so it grows into the centre.
    public static func frame(at t: Double, counted: [Bool], leafOpened: Bool, reduceMotion: Bool) -> FinishFrame {
        let time = t.isNaN ? .infinity : t
        let tone = tone(counted: counted)
        let sweeping = tone == .white ? counted.map { _ in true } : counted
        let sweep: [Double] = sweeping.enumerated().map { index, sweeps in
            reduceMotion || !sweeps ? 0 : sweepOpacity(time - Double(index) * sweepStagger)
        }
        let grow: Double
        if !leafOpened || time < 0 {
            grow = 0
        } else {
            grow = reduceMotion ? 1 : easeOut(progress(time, from: 0, to: leafGrowDuration))
        }
        let pulse = reduceMotion
            ? (scale: 1.0, opacity: 1.0)
            : glow(progress(time, from: glowStart, to: glowStart + glowDuration))
        let ripple = easeOut(progress(time, from: rippleStart, to: rippleStart + rippleDuration))
        let rippling = !reduceMotion && time >= rippleStart && time < rippleStart + rippleDuration
        let numeral = easeOut(progress(time, from: 0, to: fadeDuration))
        let line = easeOut(progress(time, from: lineStart, to: lineStart + fadeDuration))
        let actions = easeOut(progress(time, from: actionsStart, to: actionsStart + fadeDuration))
        let rise = reduceMotion ? 0.0 : 1.0
        return FinishFrame(
            tone: tone, sweep: sweep, leafGrow: grow, glowScale: pulse.scale, glowOpacity: pulse.opacity,
            rippleScale: 0.55 + 0.75 * ripple, rippleOpacity: rippling ? 0.7 * (1 - ripple) : 0,
            numeralOpacity: numeral, numeralRise: 8 * (1 - numeral) * rise,
            lineOpacity: line, lineRise: 10 * (1 - line) * rise,
            actionsOpacity: actions, actionsRise: 10 * (1 - actions) * rise
        )
    }

    // MARK: Curves

    /// The finish's ease-out, `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)`: quick to start, settling gently, never past 1.
    static func easeOut(_ x: Double) -> Double {
        RevealEasing.cubicBezier(x, 0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)
    }

    /// One mark's sweep `local` seconds after it starts: up to full in the first quarter, back to nothing by 0.9 s.
    static func sweepOpacity(_ local: TimeInterval) -> Double {
        guard local > 0, local < sweepDuration else { return 0 }
        let peak = sweepDuration * sweepPeak
        if local < peak { return easeOut(local / peak) }
        return 1 - easeOut((local - peak) / (sweepDuration - peak))
    }

    /// The glow's pulse `through` (0…1) its 1.6 s: out to 1.25 by 45%, back by the end; its strength dips to 0.75
    /// at 70%.
    static func glow(_ through: Double) -> (scale: Double, opacity: Double) {
        guard through > 0, through < 1 else { return (1, 1) }
        let scale = through < 0.45
            ? 1 + 0.25 * RevealEasing.easeInOut(through / 0.45)
            : 1.25 - 0.25 * RevealEasing.easeInOut((through - 0.45) / 0.55)
        let opacity: Double
        if through < 0.45 {
            opacity = 1
        } else if through < 0.7 {
            opacity = 1 - 0.25 * RevealEasing.easeInOut((through - 0.45) / 0.25)
        } else {
            opacity = 0.75 + 0.25 * RevealEasing.easeInOut((through - 0.7) / 0.3)
        }
        return (scale, opacity)
    }

    /// 0…1 through the window `start…end`.
    static func progress(_ t: TimeInterval, from start: TimeInterval, to end: TimeInterval) -> Double {
        guard !t.isNaN else { return 1 }
        guard end > start else { return t >= end ? 1 : 0 }
        return min(1, max(0, (t - start) / (end - start)))
    }
}

import MapleCore
import SwiftUI

extension View {
    /// Turning the dial sets the session's length (F1 design §4.5): each 30° of turn is 5 minutes, so a full turn is
    /// an hour, within 20 minutes to 3 hours. Each step plays the `.selection` haptic. VoiceOver reads the dial as
    /// one adjustable element, "Session length, 50 minutes", which swipes up or down by 5 minutes (§4.9).
    ///
    /// ```swift
    /// MinuteDial(frame: .preview(layout: DialLayout(plannedMinutes: minutes), leafMinute: model.leafMinute),
    ///            diameter: diameter, theme: theme) { … }
    ///     .dialTurning(minutes: $minutes, enabled: !isMinimisedSession) { hasTurned = true }
    /// ```
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - minutes: This session's length. Turning changes only it; holding a chip edits the preset.
    ///   - enabled: False while the start screen can't turn the dial (`StartScreenModel.canTurn`, e.g. locking). It then can't be turned but still reads "Session length, 50 minutes"; a caller that needs another reading labels it after this modifier.
    ///   - onTurn: Called after each step, by touch or by VoiceOver: the start screen's hint goes once the dial has
    ///     turned.
    public func dialTurning(minutes: Binding<Int>, enabled: Bool, onTurn: (() -> Void)? = nil) -> some View {
        modifier(DialTurningModifier(minutes: minutes, enabled: enabled, onTurn: onTurn))
    }
}

private struct DialTurningModifier: ViewModifier {
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @Binding var minutes: Int
    let enabled: Bool
    let onTurn: (() -> Void)?
    @State private var tracker = DialTurnTracker()
    @State private var size = CGSize.zero
    @State private var steps = 0

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        if enabled {
            content
                .contentShape(Circle())
                .onGeometryChange(for: CGSize.self) { proxy in
                    proxy.size
                } action: { newSize in
                    size = newSize
                }
                .gesture(
                    DragGesture(minimumDistance: 2)
                        .onChanged { value in
                            let centre = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: size.height / 2)
                            let turned = tracker.move(
                                to: value.location, from: value.startLocation, around: centre,
                                deadZone: min(size.width, size.height) * DialTurnTracker.deadZoneFraction
                            )
                            if turned != 0 { step(by: turned) }
                        }
                        .onEnded { _ in tracker.end() }
                )
                .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: steps)
                .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
                .accessibilityLabel(Text(FocusCopy.dialLengthLabel))
                .accessibilityValue(Text(FocusTimeText.spokenLength(minutes: minutes, locale: locale)))
                .accessibilityAdjustableAction { direction in
                    switch direction {
                    case .increment: step(by: 1)
                    case .decrement: step(by: -1)
                    @unknown default: break
                    }
                }
        } else {
            // Not turnable (the start is locking): still one element reading "Session length, 50 minutes" (§4.9).
            content
                .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
                .accessibilityLabel(Text(FocusCopy.dialLengthLabel))
                .accessibilityValue(Text(FocusTimeText.spokenLength(minutes: minutes, locale: locale)))
        }
    }

    /// Moves the length by `count` steps from where it is. Clamped at 20 minutes and 3 hours; a step that changes
    /// nothing plays no haptic.
    private func step(by count: Int) {
        let next = DialLayout.stepped(minutes, by: count)
        guard next != minutes else { return }
        minutes = next
        steps += 1
        onTurn?()
    }
}

/// Turns a touch moving around the dial's centre into whole 5-minute steps, from the length as it is now (so
/// turning back right after a limit works at once). It is pure, so the arithmetic is tested without a gesture.
nonisolated struct DialTurnTracker: Sendable, Equatable {
    /// Touches nearer the centre than this share of the dial's side are ignored, because their angle swings wildly.
    static let deadZoneFraction: CGFloat = 0.15

    /// The touch's last angle in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock; nil between touches.
    private(set) var lastAngle: Double?
    /// Degrees turned that haven't made a whole step yet.
    private(set) var pending: Double = 0

    /// Degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock (0..<360) of `point` around `centre`, with y pointing down.
    static func angle(of point: CGPoint, around centre: CGPoint) -> Double {
        let degrees = atan2(Double(point.x - centre.x), Double(centre.y - point.y)) * 180 / .pi
        return degrees < 0 ? degrees + 360 : degrees
    }

    /// Feeds the touch at `point` (it began at `start`) and returns the whole steps it completes, positive
    /// clockwise. Turning across 12 o'clock goes the short way round.
    mutating func move(to point: CGPoint, from start: CGPoint, around centre: CGPoint, deadZone: CGFloat) -> Int {
        guard hypot(point.x - centre.x, point.y - centre.y) > deadZone else { return 0 }
        let angle = Self.angle(of: point, around: centre)
        if lastAngle == nil, hypot(start.x - centre.x, start.y - centre.y) > deadZone {
            lastAngle = Self.angle(of: start, around: centre)
        }
        guard let last = lastAngle else {
            lastAngle = angle
            return 0
        }
        var delta = angle - last
        if delta > 180 {
            delta -= 360
        } else if delta < -180 {
            delta += 360
        }
        lastAngle = angle
        pending += delta
        // A hair of slack, so exactly 30° makes a whole step through floating point.
        let steps = Int(((pending + (pending >= 0 ? 1e-6 : -1e-6)) / DialLayout.degreesPerStep).rounded(.towardZero))
        pending -= Double(steps) * DialLayout.degreesPerStep
        return steps
    }

    /// The touch lifted: the next one starts afresh.
    mutating func end() {
        lastAngle = nil
        pending = 0
    }
}

private func pixels(of view: some View, size: CGSize) throws -> [UInt8] {
    let width = Int(size.width), height = Int(size.height)

        ) else { return false }
        context.draw(image, in: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: width, height: height))
        return true
    }
    try #require(drawn)
    return pixels
}

Append to `MapleKit/Sources/MapleDesign/Focus/FinishTimeline.swift`:
```swift
// MARK: - Drawing

extension MinuteDial {
    /// The dial with the finish over its marks: each swept mark in gold (or white) at its strength, and the ring
    /// rippling out. Nil draws the dial as it is.
    public func finishing(_ finish: FinishFrame?) -> MinuteDial {
        var dial = self
        dial.finish = finish
        return dial
    }
}

extension DialCentre {
    /// The centre at a moment of the finish: the leaf growing in with its glow pulsing, and the numeral fading in.
    public func finishing(_ finish: FinishFrame) -> DialCentre {
        var centre = grown(finish.leafGrow)
        centre.glowScale = finish.glowScale
        centre.glowOpacity = finish.glowOpacity
        centre.numeralOpacity = finish.numeralOpacity
        centre.numeralRise = finish.numeralRise
        return centre
    }
}

/// The finish over the dial's marks (F1 design §4.6): every swept mark stroked again in the finish's tone at its
/// sweep strength, 2.6 units wide, and a 1.5pt ring at the dial's edge that scales out as it fades. Transform and
/// opacity only.
struct FinishLayer: View {
    let finish: FinishFrame
    let marks: [MarkState]
    let geometry: MinuteDialGeometry
    let theme: Theme

    var body: some View {
        let colour = finish.tone == .gold ? theme.dial.gold : theme.colors.textPrimary
        let style = StrokeStyle(lineWidth: CGFloat(FinishTimeline.sweepStroke) * geometry.scale, lineCap: .round)
        let strokes: [(path: Path, opacity: Double)] = marks.indices.compactMap { index in
            let opacity = index < finish.sweep.count ? finish.sweep[index] : 0
            guard opacity > 0 else { return nil }
            return (geometry.path(index: index, count: marks.count, state: marks[index]), opacity)
        }
        ZStack {
            Canvas { context, _ in
                for stroke in strokes {
                    var layer = context
                    layer.opacity = stroke.opacity
                    layer.stroke(stroke.path, with: .color(colour), style: style)
                }
            }
            Circle()
                .stroke(colour, lineWidth: 1.5)
                .scaleEffect(finish.rippleScale)
                .opacity(finish.rippleOpacity)
        }
        .frame(width: geometry.diameter, height: geometry.diameter)
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

import MapleCore
import SwiftUI

/// A press-and-hold button (F1 design §4.7, §5.2, §5.6, §5.7; F1-22): Locked's "Hold to start · 50m", Steady's
/// "Hold to end" and the emergency release's "Hold to release". The moonlight fill rises from the leading edge
/// over the dark glass while it is held, and drains back at the same rate if it is let go early. `onComplete` runs
/// once, when it fills.
///
/// - **Interruptions cancel and drain, and never complete:** the app leaving the foreground (a call, the Lock
///   Screen), a second finger, or VoiceOver focus moving away from a running countdown. After a scene change or a
///   second finger, touches are ignored until every finger lifts.
/// - **Accessibility (F1-22):** it reads as one button with `accessibilityName`. Its named action "Start countdown",
///   and VoiceOver's double-tap, fill it as a visible countdown of the same length ("Cancel · 8s", "8 seconds left").
///   The same action, a double-tap or a touch cancels it.
/// - `progress` mirrors the fill, so the screen can show it on the dial's marks (`DialFrame.hold(progress:base:)`).
///   Set it back to 0 to use a completed button again.
///
/// ```swift
/// #if DEBUG
/// let frozen = DemoLaunchOptions.current.holdAt   // -MapleDemoHoldAt
/// #else
/// let frozen: Double? = nil
/// #endif
/// HoldButton(title: model.capsuleTitle, duration: 1.5, accessibilityName: "Hold to start, Locked 50 minutes",
///            progress: $holdProgress, frozenProgress: frozen, onTap: { showsHoldHint = true }) {
///     start()
/// }
/// ```
public struct HoldButton: View {
    /// A press released sooner than this is a plain tap (`onTap`).
    public static let tapLimit: TimeInterval = 0.3

    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.scenePhase) private var scenePhase
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @AccessibilityFocusState private var isFocused: Bool

    @Binding private var progress: Double
    @State private var hold: HoldProgress
    @State private var now = Date()
    @State private var touches: Set<SpatialEventCollection.Event.ID> = []
    @State private var ignoresTouches = false
    @State private var pressedAt: Date?
    @State private var ticker: Task<Void, Never>?
    @GestureState private var isTouching = false

    private let title: String
    private let duration: TimeInterval
    private let accessibilityName: String
    private let frozenProgress: Double?
    private let onTap: (() -> Void)?
    private let onComplete: () -> Void

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - title: The label ("Hold to start · 50m").
    ///   - duration: Seconds to hold: 1.5, 3 or 10.
    ///   - accessibilityName: What VoiceOver reads (§4.9: "Hold to start, Locked 50 minutes").
    ///   - progress: The fill, 0…1, written as it changes.
    ///   - frozenProgress: A fixed fill that ignores touches: DEBUG still frames (`-MapleDemoHoldAt`), passed by the app.
    ///   - onTap: A press let go within `tapLimit` (Locked's hint, §5.2).
    ///   - onComplete: The hold filled.
    public init(
        title: String, duration: TimeInterval, accessibilityName: String, progress: Binding<Double>,
        frozenProgress: Double? = nil, onTap: (() -> Void)? = nil, onComplete: @escaping () -> Void
    ) {
        self.title = title
        self.duration = duration
        self.accessibilityName = accessibilityName
        self._progress = progress
        self.frozenProgress = frozenProgress
        self.onTap = onTap
        self.onComplete = onComplete
        self._hold = State(initialValue: HoldProgress(duration: duration))
    }

    public var body: some View {
        let shown = frozenProgress.map { min(1, max(0, $0)) } ?? hold.value(at: now)
        let counting = hold.isCountdown && hold.isFilling
        let label = counting ? FocusCopy.holdCountdownTitle(secondsLeft: hold.secondsLeft(at: now)) : title
        ZStack {
            Capsule(style: .continuous)
                .fill(theme.colors.surface2.opacity(0.72))
            labelText(label, colour: theme.colors.textPrimary)
            ZStack {
                Capsule(style: .continuous)
                    .fill(LinearGradient(
                        colors: [theme.colors.primaryFillTop, theme.colors.primaryFillBottom],
                        startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom
                    ))
                labelText(label, colour: theme.colors.primaryLabel)
            }
            .mask {
                Rectangle()
                    .scaleEffect(x: max(shown, 0.001), y: 1, anchor: .leading)
                    .opacity(shown > 0 ? 1 : 0)
            }
        }
        .overlay {
            Capsule(style: .continuous)
                .strokeBorder(theme.colors.primaryBorderBottom, lineWidth: theme.elevation.hairlineWidth)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 52)
        .contentShape(Capsule(style: .continuous))
        .gesture(touchGesture, including: frozenProgress == nil ? .all : .subviews)
        .onChange(of: scenePhase) { _, phase in
            if phase != .active { interrupt() }
        }
        .onChange(of: isTouching) { _, touching in
            // A gesture the system cancels (a scroll view or a sheet taking the touch) never calls onEnded: treat it
            // as an interruption, so the hold drains and never completes.
            guard !touching, !touches.isEmpty else { return }
            touches.removeAll()
            interrupt()
        }
        .onChange(of: isFocused) { _, focused in
            if !focused, hold.isCountdown { interrupt() }
        }
        .onChange(of: progress) { _, value in
            if value == 0, hold.isComplete { hold.reset() }
        }
        .onChange(of: duration) { _, value in
            hold = HoldProgress(duration: value)
        }
        .onAppear {
            if let frozenProgress { progress = frozenProgress }
        }
        .onChange(of: frozenProgress) { _, value in
            if let value { progress = value }
        }
        .onDisappear {
            ticker?.cancel()
            ticker = nil
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(Text(accessibilityName))
        .accessibilityValue(Text(counting ? FocusTimeText.spokenRemaining(Double(hold.secondsLeft(at: now)), locale: locale) : ""))
        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton)
        .accessibilityFocused($isFocused)
        .accessibilityAction { toggleCountdown() }
        .accessibilityAction(named: Text(counting ? FocusCopy.holdCancelAction : FocusCopy.holdCountdownAction)) {
            toggleCountdown()
        }
    }

    private func labelText(_ text: String, colour: Color) -> some View {
        Text(text)
            .font(MapleFont.buttonLabel)
            .foregroundStyle(colour)
            .lineLimit(dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize ? 2 : 1)
            .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.lg)
            .padding(.vertical, theme.spacing.sm)
    }

    // MARK: Touches

    /// Every finger on the button, so a second one is noticed.
    private var touchGesture: some Gesture {
        SpatialEventGesture()
            .updating($isTouching) { _, touching, _ in touching = true }
            .onChanged { events in track(events) }
            .onEnded { events in
                track(events)
                touchesEnded()
            }
    }

    private func track(_ events: SpatialEventCollection) {
        for event in events {
            if event.phase == .active {
                touches.insert(event.id)
            } else {
                touches.remove(event.id)
            }
        }
        if touches.count > 1 {
            // A second finger lets go of the hold.
            interrupt()
        } else if touches.isEmpty {
            touchesEnded()
        } else if !ignoresTouches, hold.isCountdown, hold.isFilling {
            // A touch while the countdown runs cancels it.
            interrupt()
        } else if !ignoresTouches, !hold.isFilling {
            press()
        }
    }

    private func touchesEnded() {
        touches.removeAll()
        if ignoresTouches {
            ignoresTouches = false
            return
        }
        guard hold.isFilling, !hold.isCountdown else { return }
        let date = Date()
        if completeIfFilled(at: date) { return }
        let tapped = pressedAt.map { date.timeIntervalSince($0) < Self.tapLimit } ?? false
        hold.release(at: date)
        pressedAt = nil
        run()
        if tapped { onTap?() }
    }

    private func press() {
        guard frozenProgress == nil, !hold.isComplete else { return }
        let date = Date()
        hold.press(at: date)
        pressedAt = date
        run()
    }

    /// The hold or countdown is cut short: it drains and never completes, and touches still down are ignored until
    /// every finger lifts.
    private func interrupt() {
        ignoresTouches = !touches.isEmpty
        guard hold.isFilling else { return }
        hold.release(at: Date())
        pressedAt = nil
        run()
    }

    // MARK: Accessibility

    /// The named action and VoiceOver's double-tap: start the countdown, or cancel the one that is running.
    private func toggleCountdown() {
        guard frozenProgress == nil, !hold.isComplete else { return }
        if hold.isCountdown, hold.isFilling {
            interrupt()
        } else {
            hold.startCountdown(at: Date())
            pressedAt = nil
            run()
        }
    }

    // MARK: Time

    /// Completes the hold once, if it has filled by `date`.
    private func completeIfFilled(at date: Date) -> Bool {
        guard hold.isFilled(at: date) else { return false }
        hold.finish()
        now = date
        progress = 1
        ticker?.cancel()
        ticker = nil
        onComplete()
        return true
    }

    /// Samples the hold 30 times a second while it fills or drains, and stops once it is still.
    private func run() {
        now = Date()
        progress = hold.value(at: now)
        guard ticker == nil else { return }
        ticker = Task {
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.0 / 30))
                let date = Date()
                if completeIfFilled(at: date) { return }
                now = date
                progress = hold.value(at: date)
                if hold.phase(at: date) == .idle {
                    ticker = nil
                    return
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Motion: the finish and the holds

/// The finish frozen at 0.3 s, 0.9 s and 1.6 s with a leaf opened, then with gaps, in white, and under Reduce Motion,
/// and the hold buttons frozen as `-MapleDemoHoldAt` freezes them.
@MainActor
private func motionScenes() -> [SnapshotScene] {
    let lit = Array(repeating: MarkState.lit, count: 50)
    let gaps: [MarkState] = (0..<50).map { (22..<27).contains($0) ? .gap : .lit }
    let opened = DialFill(before: 0.42, session: 0.58, opened: 1)
    var scenes: [SnapshotScene] = []
    for time in [0.3, 0.9, 1.6] {
        scenes.append(SnapshotScene("focus-finish-\(time)s") {
            FinishPage(marks: lit, isGold: true, fill: opened, time: time, reduceMotion: false, numeral: "50m")
        })
    }
    scenes += [
        SnapshotScene("focus-finish-gaps-0.9s") {
            FinishPage(marks: gaps, isGold: true, fill: DialFill(before: 0.42, session: 0.38), time: 0.9,
                       reduceMotion: false, numeral: "45m")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-finish-white-0.6s") {
            FinishPage(marks: lit, isGold: false, fill: DialFill(before: 0.42), time: 0.6, reduceMotion: false,
                       numeral: "50m")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-finish-reduce-motion-0.5s") {
            FinishPage(marks: lit, isGold: true, fill: opened, time: 0.5, reduceMotion: true, numeral: "50m")
        },
        SnapshotScene("focus-hold-buttons", size: CGSize(width: 402, height: 700)) { HoldSheet() },
    ]
    return scenes
}

/// The receipt's dial, centre, leaf line and buttons at one moment of the finish.
private struct FinishPage: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    let marks: [MarkState]
    let isGold: Bool
    let fill: DialFill
    let time: Double
    let reduceMotion: Bool
    let numeral: String

    var body: some View {
        let dial = DialFrame.receipt(marks: marks, isGold: isGold, fill: fill)
        let finish = FinishTimeline.frame(at: time, counted: dial.gold, leafOpened: fill.opened > 0, reduceMotion: reduceMotion)
        let leaf = LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: "campestre").map { DialLeaf(species: $0, fill: fill) }
        VStack(spacing: 28) {
            Text("Finish at \(String(format: "%.1f", time)) s\(reduceMotion ? " · Reduce Motion" : "")")
                .font(MapleFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
            MinuteDial(frame: dial, diameter: 300, theme: theme) {
                DialCentre(leaf: leaf, numeral: DialCentre.numeralParts(numeral), caption: "saved · 2h 10m today",
                           diameter: 300)
                    .finishing(finish)
            }
            .finishing(finish)
            Text(fill.opened > 0 ? "Field maple is yours · it opens after this session" : "Field maple · 1h 10m to go")
                .font(MapleFont.callout)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                .opacity(finish.lineOpacity)
                .offset(y: finish.lineRise)
            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                Button("Done") {}
                    .buttonStyle(.moonlight)
                TextLink("Again · 50m", chevron: false) {}
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 24)
            .opacity(finish.actionsOpacity)
            .offset(y: finish.actionsRise)
        }
        .padding(.top, 100)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .background(theme.colors.background)
    }
}

/// Locked's start dial filling as the hold does, and the hold buttons frozen empty, at 40%, full, and the
/// emergency release at 60%.
private struct HoldSheet: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme

    var body: some View {
        let fifty = DialLayout(plannedMinutes: 50)
        VStack(spacing: 24) {
            MinuteDial(frame: .hold(progress: 0.4, base: .preview(layout: fifty, leafMinute: 35)), diameter: 220, theme: theme)
            ForEach([0.0, 0.4, 1.0], id: \.self) { progress in
                HoldButton(
                    title: "Hold to start · 50m", duration: 1.5, accessibilityName: "Hold to start, Locked 50 minutes",
                    progress: .constant(progress), frozenProgress: progress
                ) {}
            }
            HoldButton(
                title: "Hold to release", duration: 10, accessibilityName: "Hold to release",
                progress: .constant(0.6), frozenProgress: 0.6
            ) {}
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 24)
        .padding(.top, 60)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .background(theme.colors.background)
    }
}

### Task 8: The Focus tab, the Rest retirement, and wiring

The Rest tab goes (ruling P2) and the Focus tab takes its place: Home · Focus · Herbarium. The Focus stores reach the environment, the session store is kept current by `.focusUpkeep()`, and `FocusView` routes from the store's state to five destinations that Tasks 9–13 fill in (each is a labelled placeholder until then). The sleep schedule becomes a Settings row whose editor opens as a sheet over the Profile sheet. `Scripts/shoot.sh` is created here, because every later UI task screenshots with it.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **Two pure MapleCore types hold the decisions** (P3): `FocusRoute` (which screen the tab shows) and `FocusRefresh` (when the store refreshes while a session runs). The skeleton's File Structure doesn't list them. Cost if wrong: two small files to fold into another type.
- **`FocusRoute.settling`, a route that draws nothing.** It covers the moment before the store's first replay, and the moment between a session's planned end and the refresh that ends it. So a killed app reopened after the end goes straight to the receipt, and never shows a running dial at 0:00 or a flash of the start screen (Review Focus 1, 2). An unreadable ledger (the store's unknown state) also stays blank, rather than showing a start screen that couldn't record. Cost if wrong: a blank Focus tab in that rare state.
- **`FocusTabState`** (app, `@Observable`) holds the tab's per-launch choices, so Tasks 9–15 read and write one object in the environment instead of threading bindings through `FocusView`:
  - the selected preset and the turned length;
  - the intention;
  - whether the dial has been turned this launch;
  - minimised;
  - the plain-timer choice;
  - the receipt on screen;
  - the sheet.
  Nothing in it is saved. Cost if wrong: "turn to set the length" shows again on each launch until the dial is turned.
- **The receipt is held on screen once it shows** (`FocusTabState.shownReceipt`), so Task 13 can set `settings.lastReceiptSeen` as it appears without the route flipping away. It is cleared when a new session starts, and by Task 13's Done.
- **`FocusTabSheet`** is the Focus tab's one sheet router (blocking, preset, intention, saved, streak). In this task it presents labelled placeholder sheets, which Tasks 14 and 15 replace.
- **`EnvironmentValues.focusStores: FocusStores?`.** `FocusStores` is a struct, not an `@Observable` class, so `.environment(_:)` can't carry it. Screens reach `FocusStores.start(_:intention:settings:)` (Task 3) through this entry.
- **A Focus request closes Home's sheet or cover**, so a request made from inside one (such as Settings in the Profile sheet) shows the Focus tab.
- **Where the sleep schedule row sits.** "Sleep schedule ›" is the second row of Settings' first group, after Hemisphere and before Sleep goal. Its value is tonight's span ("23:00 → 07:00"), and VoiceOver reads it in words ("Bed at 23:00, wake-up at 07:00").
- **The editor's post-save reveal gets no host.** `ScheduleEditor`'s `onSave` hands back the First-steps leaf only on the very first schedule save ever, and onboarding makes that save. So Settings ignores what `onSave` returns. A first save made from Settings (possible only in a DEBUG demo of an unplanted collection) leaves that leaf waiting on Home, as "Open your new leaf". Cost if wrong: in that demo, the reveal starts from Home instead of at once.
- **`-MapleDemoPresent schedule…` moves to Settings.** `schedule`, `schedule:bedtime|wake` and `schedule:everyday|weekdays|weekends` now open the Profile sheet on Settings (`App/DemoPresenter.swift`), and Settings opens the editor a second later, once per launch (`SleepDemo.takeScheduleEditor()`).
- **The tab icon** is SF `timer`, always drawn into a template bitmap, as the Rest tab's moon was (P10). The bar can't swap in another variant when the tab is selected.
- **Home's `.sleepSounds` opens nothing.** Sleep sounds ship in F2, so `NowState` never offers the action in F1.
- **`Scripts/shoot.sh` targets the simulator by UDID,** not `booted`. Another worktree may have a second simulator booted, and `booted` would pick one of them arbitrarily. Exit codes: 0 saved, 1 build failed, 2 a simulator step failed, 64 wrong usage.
- **The surviving Rest copy keeps its tests.** `RestDialTests` is deleted (P2), but its tests of copy that is still used (`inBed`, `windDownOption`, `spokenSchedule`, `editorSummary`, `bedsideLine`, `phoneDown`) move to a new `SleepCopyTests`. `span` gains a test for the Settings row.
- **Path correction.** Settings lives at `App/Features/Settings/SettingsView.swift`, not `App/Features/Profile/`.
- **Focus demo arguments act only on the Focus tab.** `-MapleDemoFocus minimised`, `-MapleDemoPreset`, `-MapleDemoIntention` and the Focus `-MapleDemoPresent` values act only with `-MapleDemoTab focus`. They go through `FocusDemoPresenter`, following the convention that feature-level values act on their own tab.
- **Placeholder words are temporary.** "Focus start", "Running session" and the like disappear as Tasks 9–15 replace each placeholder, so none of them reaches a release.

    private func running(breakAfter: Double? = nil) throws -> SessionRecord {
        let script = SessionScript(start: start, plan: FocusFixtures.plan(minutes: 50, breakMinutes: 5))
        script.after(5, .shieldApplied)

    }

    }
