`App/Features/Focus/FocusHeroPage.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign

/// A Focus screen built around the dial (F1 design §4.1, §5.1, §5.3, §5.17): the "Focus" header, the dial at its
/// fitted size, what sits under it, and the screen's one primary action.
///
/// - The dial keeps its preferred size (`MinuteDialMetrics.preferredDiameter(forWidth:)`, about 75% of the width)
///   while everything fits above the floating tab bar, and gives up size down to `MinuteDialMetrics.minimumDiameter`
///   as text grows (`HeroFit`). It is never scaled with `scaleEffect`. Nothing scrolls at default text sizes.
/// - At accessibility sizes, or when even the smallest dial leaves no room, the page scrolls and the primary is
///   pinned just above the tab bar.
///
/// ```swift
/// FocusHeroPage { diameter in
///     MinuteDial(frame: frame, diameter: diameter, theme: theme) { … }
/// } below: {
///     PresetChips(selectedID: preset.id) { choose($0) }
/// } primary: {
///     Button(lines.capsuleTitle) { start() }.buttonStyle(.moonlight)
/// }
/// ```
struct FocusHeroPage<Dial: View, Below: View, Primary: View>: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @State private var measured = FocusHeroMeasurements()

    private let hasPrimary: Bool
    private let dial: (CGFloat) -> Dial
    private let below: Below
    private let primary: Primary

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - hasPrimary: False when the screen's action sits inside `below` (Needs Screen Time's card): nothing is
    ///     pinned, and `primary` isn't shown.
    ///   - dial: The dial at the diameter it is given.
    init(
        hasPrimary: Bool = true, @ViewBuilder dial: @escaping (CGFloat) -> Dial, @ViewBuilder below: () -> Below,
        @ViewBuilder primary: () -> Primary
    ) {
        self.hasPrimary = hasPrimary
        self.dial = dial
        self.below = below()
        self.primary = primary()
    }

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { proxy in
            let visible = proxy.size.height
            // §5.17: at accessibility sizes the page is a ScrollView with the primary pinned, whatever fits.
            let pinnedBySize = hasPrimary && dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize
            let fit = HeroFit(
                preferred: MinuteDialMetrics.preferredDiameter(forWidth: proxy.size.width),
                minimum: MinuteDialMetrics.minimumDiameter, visible: visible,
                content: measured.content(gaps: theme.spacing.lg + theme.spacing.xl),
                // A pinned primary takes no room in the flow.
                action: hasPrimary && !pinnedBySize
                    ? (measured.primary ?? HeroFit.estimatedActionHeight) + primaryBottomGap - HeroFit.minimumBottomGap : 0
            )
            let pins = hasPrimary && (pinnedBySize || fit.pinsAction)
            ScrollView {
                page(diameter: fit.heroHeight, pins: pins)
                    // While everything fits, the page fills the first screen so its gaps spread. Once the primary is
                    // pinned the page keeps its natural height, and only real overflow scrolls under the pinned bar.
                    .frame(minHeight: pins ? nil : visible)
            }
            .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
            .safeAreaBar(edge: .bottom) {
                if pins {
                    primarySlot
                        .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.homeMargin)
                        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.sm)
                        .padding(.bottom, HeroFit.minimumBottomGap)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func page(diameter: CGFloat, pins: Bool) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            header
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self) { $0.size.height } action: { measured.header = $0 }
            Spacer(minLength: theme.spacing.lg)
            dial(diameter)
                .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
            below
                // Always at its natural height, so squeezing the page never feeds back into the dial's size.
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self) { $0.size.height } action: { measured.below = $0 }
            Spacer(minLength: theme.spacing.xl)
            if hasPrimary, !pins {
                primarySlot
                    .padding(.bottom, primaryBottomGap)
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.homeMargin)
    }

    private var primarySlot: some View {
        primary
            .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self) { $0.size.height } action: { measured.primary = $0 }
    }

    /// Space under an unpinned primary: about where Home's capsule sits above the tab bar (spec §3.1).
    private var primaryBottomGap: CGFloat { theme.spacing.xl }

    private var header: some View {
        Text(FocusStartLines.title)
            .font(MapleFont.screenTitle)
            .tracking(-0.3)
            .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44, alignment: .leading)
            .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
    }
}

/// The heights `FocusHeroPage` measures. None depends on the dial's size, so fitting it settles in one pass.
private struct FocusHeroMeasurements: Equatable {
    var header: CGFloat?
    var below: CGFloat?
    var primary: CGFloat?

    /// Everything in the page besides the dial and the primary: the header, what sits under the dial, and the
    /// spacers' minimums (`gaps`). Nil until measured.
    func content(gaps: CGFloat) -> CGFloat? {
        guard let header, let below else { return nil }
        return header + below + gaps
    }
}
```

`App/Features/Focus/PresetChips.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// The start screen's preset chips (F1 design §4.5, §5.1, §5.13, §5.17): one per preset, then "+" for a new preset
/// while there is room for one (at most 6). A chip sets the session to its preset and the preset's length.
///
/// - At default sizes the chips sit in one centred row, which scrolls sideways once it can't fit (more than 5
///   presets). At accessibility sizes they wrap with `ChipFlow`, and "+" reads "New preset".
/// - A chip shows its preset's name only, and the dial's numeral shows the length. VoiceOver reads "Study, 50 minutes".
/// - "+" opens the preset editor for a new preset (`FocusTabSheet.preset(nil)`). Holding a chip edits its preset: Task
///   15 adds `.editsPresetOnHold { tab.sheet = .preset(preset.id) }` after each preset's `Chip`.
struct PresetChips: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(FocusTabState.self) private var tab
    @Environment(PresetStore.self) private var presets

    /// The preset the start screen shows.
    let selectedID: UUID?
    let select: (FocusPreset) -> Void

    var body: some View {
        if dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize {
            ChipFlow(spacing: theme.spacing.xs, lineSpacing: 0, alignment: .center) { chips }
        } else {
            ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
                HStack(spacing: theme.spacing.xs) { chips }
                ScrollView(.horizontal) {
                    HStack(spacing: theme.spacing.xs) { chips }
                }
                .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
            }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var chips: some View {
        ForEach(presets.presets) { preset in
            Chip(preset.name, isSelected: preset.id == selectedID) { select(preset) }
                .accessibilityLabel(FocusStartLines.chipLabel(preset, locale: locale))
        }
        if presets.canAdd {
            Chip(FocusStartLines.addChipTitle(isAccessibilitySize: dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize), isSelected: false) {
                tab.sheet = .preset(nil)
            }
            .frame(minWidth: theme.spacing.minimumHitTarget)
            .accessibilityLabel(FocusCopy.newPreset)
        }
    }
}
```

`App/Features/Focus/FocusStartView.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// The Focus tab's start screen (F1 design §5.1, §5.2, §4.5, §5.17), and its "Session running, minimised" state.
///
/// - **Choosing:** the dial previews the length in plan marks, with the leaf dot where the next hours leaf would open
///   and that leaf in the centre; turning it sets this session's length. Under it are the preset chips, "What's this
///   for?", the Blocking line and the counts line, then the primary capsule.
/// - **Locked** starts with a 1.5-second hold, whose progress fills the dial's marks. A plain tap shows "Hold to start.
///   Locked ends early only by emergency release." for 4 seconds in the counts line's place (§5.2).
/// - **After Start** the capsule reads "Locking 6 apps…" until the store has read the block back. The session's own
///   screen then takes over (`FocusView`, with a soft haptic). A block that can't be applied offers the plain timer
///   (`PlainTimerReason.lockFailed`); a start the ledger can't record says so.
/// - **A plain timer** (`PlainTimerReason.chosen`, from Needs Screen Time) replaces the Blocking line with "Plain timer
///   · apps aren't locked", and shows no leaf and no counts line.
/// - **Minimised** (`minimised`): the dial is live and can't be turned, the chips and lines are hidden, and the capsule
///   reads "Return to session".
///
/// Every word comes from `StartScreenModel` (`FocusStores.startScreen`) and `FocusStartLines`. The first start ever
/// asks for notification permission once it has started, if iOS hasn't asked yet (F1-23).
struct FocusStartView: View {
    /// The running session, shown minimised; nil to choose and start one.
    var minimised: UUID? = nil

    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.season) private var season
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(\.focusStores) private var focusStores
    @Environment(FocusTabState.self) private var tab
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions
    @Environment(PresetStore.self) private var presets
    @Environment(AppSetStore.self) private var appSets
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @Environment(AppSettings.self) private var settings
    @Environment(NotificationScheduler.self) private var reminders

    /// The Locked hold's fill, shown on the dial's marks while it is held.
    @State private var holdProgress = 0.0
    /// When the plain-tap hint appeared; it goes after `FocusCopy.holdHintSeconds`.
    @State private var hintShownAt: Date?
    /// A start the ledger couldn't record, until the next start or chip.
    @State private var notice: String?

    var body: some View {
        // Once a minute, so the phase, the window and the counts line follow the clock.
        TimelineView(.everyMinute) { _ in
            if let focusStores, let preset = selectedPreset {
                screen(focusStores, preset: preset, now: sessions.now)
            }
        }
        .task(id: hintShownAt) { await hideHint() }
    }

    // MARK: Screen

    private func screen(_ stores: FocusStores, preset: FocusPreset, now: Date) -> some View {
        let running = runningSession
        let model = stores.startScreen(
            preset: running.flatMap { presets.preset(id: $0.plan.presetID) } ?? preset,
            minutes: running?.plan.plannedMinutes ?? tab.minutes ?? preset.minutes, at: now, collection: collection,
            settings: settings, stage: running != nil ? .running : sessions.isStarting ? .locking : .choosing,
            hasTurned: tab.hasTurnedDial, locale: locale
        )
        let lines = FocusStartLines(model: model, mode: mode, showsHoldHint: hintShownAt != nil, notice: notice, locale: locale)
        // A plain timer, chosen or running, can't count toward a leaf, so none is drawn.
        let showsLeaf = lines.showsLeaf && running?.plan.kind != .plainTimer
        let leaf = showsLeaf ? stores.nextHoursLeaf(at: now, collection: collection) : nil
        return FocusHeroPage { diameter in
            dial(model, lines: lines, leaf: leaf, session: running, diameter: diameter)
        } below: {
            details(model, lines: lines, session: running)
        } primary: {
            primary(model, lines: lines)
        }
    }

    // MARK: Dial

    @ViewBuilder
    private func dial(
        _ model: StartScreenModel, lines: FocusStartLines, leaf: LeafProgress?, session: SessionRecord?, diameter: CGFloat
    ) -> some View {
        let species = leaf.flatMap { LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: $0.speciesID) }
        // The rung as the counters have it: the softer gold for what was saved before.
        let fill = leaf.map { DialFill(rung: $0, sessionHours: 0) } ?? DialFill()
        if let session {
            // Minimised: live, once a second, on the store's trusted time.
            TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)) { _ in
                let now = sessions.now
                let planned = session.plan.plannedMinutes
                let left = max(0, session.plannedEnd.timeIntervalSince(now))
                MinuteDial(
                    frame: .running(layout: DialLayout(plannedMinutes: planned), elapsed: now.timeIntervalSince(session.countdownStart),
                                    leafMinute: nil, fill: fill),
                    diameter: diameter, theme: theme
                ) {
                    DialCentre(leaf: species.map { DialLeaf(species: $0, fill: fill) },
                               numeral: DialCentre.numeralParts(FocusTimeText.remaining(left)),
                               caption: FocusStartLines.minimisedCaption(plannedMinutes: planned), diameter: diameter)
                }
                .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
                .accessibilityLabel(FocusStartLines.minimisedDialLabel(secondsLeft: left, plannedMinutes: planned, locale: locale))
            }
        } else {
            let layout = DialLayout(plannedMinutes: model.minutes)
            let preview = DialFrame.preview(layout: layout, leafMinute: lines.leafMinute, fill: fill)
            // While Locked's hold is pressed, its progress fills the marks clockwise (§4.7).
            MinuteDial(frame: holdProgress > 0 ? .hold(progress: holdProgress, layout: layout, base: preview) : preview,
                       diameter: diameter, theme: theme) {
                DialCentre(leaf: species.map { DialLeaf(species: $0, fill: fill) },
                           numeral: DialCentre.numeralParts(model.lengthText), caption: model.caption, diameter: diameter)
            }
            .dialTurning(minutes: length(of: model.preset), enabled: model.canTurn) {
                tab.hasTurnedDial = true
            }
        }
    }

    /// This session's length: the dial's turn, or the preset's own. Turning changes only this session (§4.5).
    private func length(of preset: FocusPreset) -> Binding<Int> {
        Binding(get: { tab.minutes ?? preset.minutes }, set: { tab.minutes = $0 })
    }

    // MARK: Under the dial

    private func details(_ model: StartScreenModel, lines: FocusStartLines, session: SessionRecord?) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            if dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize {
                timeLine(model, session: session)
            }
            if model.showsDetails {
                PresetChips(selectedID: model.preset.id) { choose($0) }
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.md)
                intentionLine
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xs)
                if let plainLine = lines.plainLine {
                    Text(plainLine)
                        .font(MapleFont.callout)
                        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: theme.spacing.minimumHitTarget, alignment: .leading)
                } else {
                    blockingLine(model.blockingLine)
                }
                if let detail = lines.detailLine {
                    detailLine(detail, marksLeaf: lines.marksLeaf)
                        .transition(.opacity)
                }
            }
        }
        .mapleAnimation(theme.motion.gentle, value: lines.detailLine)
    }

    /// §5.17: the centre numeral caps at xxLarge, so at accessibility sizes the time is repeated under the dial.
    private func timeLine(_ model: StartScreenModel, session: SessionRecord?) -> some View {
        Group {
            if let session {
                TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)) { _ in
                    Text(FocusTimeText.remaining(max(0, session.plannedEnd.timeIntervalSince(sessions.now))))
                }
            } else {
                Text(model.lengthText)
            }
        }
        .font(MapleFont.headline)
        .monospacedDigit()
        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.sm)
        // The dial already reads the time to VoiceOver.
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    /// "What's this for?", or the intention once written (§5.16), over a dashed rule; it opens intention entry.
    private var intentionLine: some View {
        let intention = tab.intention.flatMap { RecentIntentions.normalized($0) }
        return Button { tab.sheet = .intention } label: {
            Text(intention ?? FocusCopy.intentionPrompt)
                .font(MapleFont.callout)
                .foregroundStyle(intention == nil ? theme.colors.textSecondary : theme.colors.textPrimary)
                .lineLimit(dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize ? 3 : 1)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .padding(.vertical, theme.spacing.sm)
                .overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
                    DashedRule()
                        .stroke(theme.colors.borderHighlight, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1, dash: [3, 3]))
                        .frame(height: 1)
                }
                .frame(minHeight: theme.spacing.minimumHitTarget)
                .contentShape(Rectangle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    /// "Blocking 6 apps · Steady ›" (§5.1, §5.2), and every prompt in its place; it opens the Blocking sheet.
    private func blockingLine(_ line: SelectionText.BlockingLine) -> some View {
        Button { tab.sheet = .blocking } label: {
            blockingText(line)
                .font(MapleFont.callout)
                .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: theme.spacing.minimumHitTarget, alignment: .leading)
                .contentShape(Rectangle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(line.spoken)
    }

    /// What is blocked in `textPrimary`; the strictness and the chevron in `textSecondary`, with Locked's lock.
    private func blockingText(_ line: SelectionText.BlockingLine) -> Text {
        let parts = FocusStartLines.blockingParts(line)
        let lock = parts.showsLock ? Text(Image(systemName: "lock.fill")) : Text(verbatim: "")
        let rest = Text("\(Text(verbatim: parts.separator ?? ""))\(lock)\(Text(verbatim: parts.trailing))")
        return Text("\(Text(verbatim: parts.main).foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary))\(rest.foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary))")
    }

    /// The counts line, the hint, a notice or the failed lock's prompt. A line naming the leaf has the dot's mark.
    private func detailLine(_ text: String, marksLeaf: Bool) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 7) {
            if marksLeaf {
                Circle()
                    .fill(theme.colors.seasonTint(season))
                    .frame(width: 6, height: 6)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            Text(text)
                .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xxs)
    }

    // MARK: Primary

    @ViewBuilder
    private func primary(_ model: StartScreenModel, lines: FocusStartLines) -> some View {
        switch lines.primary {
        case .start:
            Button(lines.capsuleTitle) { start(model, lines: lines) }
                .buttonStyle(.moonlight(dimmed: model.capsuleIsDimmed))
        case .holdToStart:
            HoldButton(
                title: lines.capsuleTitle, duration: FocusCopy.holdToStartSeconds,
                accessibilityName: lines.holdName ?? lines.capsuleTitle, progress: $holdProgress,
                frozenProgress: frozenHold, onTap: { hintShownAt = Date() }
            ) {
                start(model, lines: lines)
            }
        case .chooseApps:
            Button(lines.capsuleTitle) { tab.sheet = .blocking }
                .buttonStyle(.moonlight(dimmed: model.capsuleIsDimmed))
        case .locking:
            Button(lines.capsuleTitle) {}
                .buttonStyle(.moonlight)
                .disabled(true)
        case .returnToSession:
            Button(lines.capsuleTitle) { tab.isMinimised = false }
                .buttonStyle(.moonlight)
        }
    }

    /// DEBUG `-MapleDemoHoldAt`: the hold frozen part-way, for screenshots.
    private var frozenHold: Double? {
        #if DEBUG
        DemoLaunchOptions.current.holdAt
        #else
        nil
        #endif
    }

    // MARK: Actions

    private var mode: FocusStartLines.Mode {
        switch tab.plainTimer {
        case nil: .blocking
        case .chosen: .plainTimer
        case .lockFailed: .lockFailed
        }
    }

    /// The chip picked (or asked for by Home's Start), else Quick for the first session (P4), else the last used.
    private var selectedPreset: FocusPreset? {
        FocusStartLines.preset(selected: tab.selectedPresetID, presets: presets.presets, lastUsedID: presets.lastUsedID,
                               isFirstSession: !settings.hasStartedFocus)
    }

    /// The minimised session, while it still runs.
    private var runningSession: SessionRecord? {
        guard let minimised, let running = sessions.running, running.id == minimised else { return nil }
        return running
    }

    private func choose(_ preset: FocusPreset) {
        tab.selectedPresetID = preset.id
        tab.minutes = nil
        notice = nil
        // Another choice tries the block again.
        if tab.plainTimer == .lockFailed { tab.plainTimer = nil }
    }

    private func start(_ model: StartScreenModel, lines: FocusStartLines) {
        guard let focusStores, !sessions.isStarting else { return }
        let preset = model.preset
        let request = FocusSessionStore.StartRequest(
            preset: preset, minutes: model.minutes,
            appSet: lines.startsPlainTimer ? nil : preset.appSetID.flatMap { appSets.set(id: $0) },
            plainTimer: lines.startsPlainTimer, from: .focusTab
        )
        let intention = tab.intention.flatMap { RecentIntentions.normalized($0) }
        let isFirstStart = !settings.hasStartedFocus
        notice = nil
        hintShownAt = nil
        Task {
            let outcome = await focusStores.start(request, intention: intention, settings: settings)
            await settle(outcome, isFirstStart: isFirstStart)
        }
    }

    /// What follows a start. By `.started` the session's own screen has already replaced this one; the tab's state
    /// carries what is left to do.
    private func settle(_ outcome: FocusSessionStore.StartOutcome, isFirstStart: Bool) async {
        holdProgress = 0
        switch outcome {
        case .started(let id):
            tab.lastStarted = id
            tab.minutes = nil
            tab.intention = nil
            // F1-23: asked once, at the first start, if iOS hasn't asked yet; never on a demo launch.
            if isFirstStart, reminders.schedulesReminders, reminders.authorization == .notDetermined {
                await reminders.requestAuthorization()
            }
        case .alreadyRunning:
            break
        case .blockingFailed:
            tab.plainTimer = .lockFailed
        case .ledgerUnavailable, .notRecorded:
            notice = FocusStartLines.couldntStart
        }
    }

    private func hideHint() async {
        guard hintShownAt != nil else { return }
        try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(FocusCopy.holdHintSeconds))
        guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
        hintShownAt = nil
    }
}

/// A horizontal line through the middle of its frame: the intention line's dashed rule.
nonisolated private struct DashedRule: Shape {
    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        Path { path in
            path.move(to: CGPoint(x: rect.minX, y: rect.midY))
            path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.maxX, y: rect.midY))
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 10: Needs Screen Time and the plain timer

Needs Screen Time (F1 design §5.3, F1-17) replaces Task 8's placeholder. Whenever blocking isn't available, the Focus tab shows:
- the dial with its marks off;
- a card with the state's words, and "Turn on Screen Time" where Maple can ask;
- "Use a plain timer · it won't count", which opens the start screen as a plain timer (Task 9's `PlainTimerReason.chosen` mode).

A free build reads "This version of Maple can't lock apps", with no prompt anywhere. Every "Turn on Screen Time" in the app now opens this screen through `router.showFocus(.needsScreenTime)`, instead of iOS Settings, whose Maple page has no Screen Time switch. Those are Home's needs-permission row, the Herbarium's section headers and leaf detail. A session whose block is revoked mid-session keeps its own screen as a plain timer and never comes here.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **The card holds the primary and the link,** as the mockup draws it: title, line, "Turn on Screen Time" (a moonlight capsule) and the link, on a Level 1 surface under the dial. The page has no pinned primary, so at accessibility sizes it just scrolls (`FocusHeroPage(hasPrimary: false)`). Cost if wrong: layout only.
- **The dial's centre** shows the selected preset's length and name (the mockup's "50m" over "Study"). It shows the next hours leaf as it is now, except in a build that can't block, where nothing it times can count. The dial can't be turned here; the length is set on the start screen. The drawing is hidden from VoiceOver, because the card says everything. Cost if wrong: one condition.
- **At accessibility sizes the length isn't repeated under the dial here** (§5.17's line is for a dial that tells the time). This dial is decorative and hidden from VoiceOver, and the card carries the screen. Cost if wrong: one `Text`.
- **"Turn on Screen Time"** calls `FocusSessionStore.requestAuthorization()` and is disabled while the request runs. When Screen Time allows Maple, the store's probe changes and `FocusView` shows the start screen on its own. Declined reads the same, and asks again. Whether iOS shows its prompt a second time is F1-paid's on-device check (§8.3). Cost if wrong: none in F1.
- **The plain timer's choice lasts until blocking is available.** "Use a plain timer · it won't count" sets `tab.plainTimer = .chosen`. It is cleared:
  - when `canBlock` turns true (this task, in `FocusView`);
  - by any `FocusRequest.needsScreenTime` (Task 8's `apply`);
  - when a session starts (Task 8's `sessionChanged`).

  So after a plain timer's receipt, the tab comes back here while Screen Time is still off. Cost if wrong: one more tap per plain timer.
- **`turnOnPermission` takes the router, not `openURL`:** `turnOnPermission(_:speciesID:showHealthPrimer:router:)`. The three callers (Home, the Herbarium, leaf detail) drop their now-unused `@Environment(\.openURL)`.
  - Leaf detail inside the Tree view (Home's cover) is covered by Task 8: Home closes its sheet and cover on a Focus request.
  - Leaf detail inside the Herbarium's Search sheet is covered here: the Herbarium closes its sheet on a Focus request.

  Cost if wrong: three call sites.
- **Revoked mid-session needs no code here.** `FocusRoute` puts a running session on its own screen before it looks at the probe (Task 8), and the store carries a lost block on as a plain timer (F1a). This task checks it with a screenshot.
- **The demo's plain timer.** Task 2 makes `-MapleDemoScreenTime plain` a running plain timer (Screen Time declined). `FocusDemoPresenter` also sets `tab.plainTimer = .chosen` for it, so `-MapleDemoFocus idle -MapleDemoScreenTime plain` shows the plain-timer start screen. With the implied running session, the session's own screen shows as before. Cost if wrong: none.
- **No Home screenshot here.** Home's "Turn on blocking" needs `FocusStatus`, which Home passes only from Task 16. The Home and leaf-detail entry points are checked by the build, and by Task 16's screenshots.
- **New words:** none. Every string is §5.3's, through Task 4's `FocusCopy`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the model**

`MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Focus/NeedsScreenTimeModel.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// The Needs Screen Time screen as values (F1 design §5.3, F1-17): which card shows and whether it has a primary,
/// the dial's centre, and the plain timer's link. Nil while blocking is allowed, when the Focus tab shows the start
/// screen instead.
///
/// ```swift
/// if let model = NeedsScreenTimeModel(probe: sessions.probe, capability: sessions.blocking.capability, preset: preset) {
///     model.card.title      // "Lock apps with Screen Time"
///     model.card.primary    // "Turn on Screen Time", or nil where Maple can't ask
/// }
/// ```
public struct NeedsScreenTimeModel: Sendable, Equatable {
    public let state: NeedsScreenTimeState
    /// The card: its title, its line, and "Turn on Screen Time" only where Maple can ask (`FocusCopy.card`).
    public let card: FocusCopy.ScreenTimeCard
    /// The next leaf sits in the dial's centre while turning Screen Time on would let it count. A build that can't
    /// block shows none, because nothing it times can count.
    public let showsLeaf: Bool
    /// The dial's numeral: the selected preset's length, "50m".
    public let lengthText: String
    /// Under the numeral: the preset's name.
    public let caption: String
    /// "Use a plain timer · it won't count", under every card.
    public let plainTimerLink: String

    /// - Parameter preset: The preset the start screen would show (`FocusStartLines.preset(…)`).
    public init?(probe: BlockingProbe, capability: BlockingCapability, preset: FocusPreset) {
        guard let state = NeedsScreenTimeState(probe: probe, capability: capability) else { return nil }
        self.state = state
        card = FocusCopy.card(state)
        showsLeaf = state != .freeBuild
        lengthText = FocusTimeText.length(minutes: preset.minutes)
        caption = preset.name
        plainTimerLink = FocusCopy.plainTimerLink
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: The screen, and the plain timer's way in and out**

`App/Features/Focus/NeedsScreenTimeView.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// Needs Screen Time (F1 design §5.3, F1-17): the Focus tab whenever blocking isn't available, with the plain timer
/// offered instead.
///
/// - The dial with its marks off, with the selected preset's length and name in its centre, and the next leaf unless
///   this build can't block.
/// - A card with the state's title and line (`FocusCopy.card`), and "Turn on Screen Time" where Maple can ask. Under
///   them, "Use a plain timer · it won't count" opens the start screen as a plain timer (`PlainTimerReason.chosen`).
///
/// "Turn on Screen Time" asks once (`FocusSessionStore.requestAuthorization()`). When Screen Time allows Maple, the
/// store's probe changes and `FocusView` shows the start screen. Every "Turn on Screen Time" elsewhere in the app
/// (Home's needs-permission row, the Herbarium, leaf detail) comes here through `router.showFocus(.needsScreenTime)`.
/// A session that loses its block mid-session never comes here: it carries on as a plain timer on its own screen.
struct NeedsScreenTimeView: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.focusStores) private var focusStores
    @Environment(FocusTabState.self) private var tab
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions
    @Environment(PresetStore.self) private var presets
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @Environment(AppSettings.self) private var settings

    /// "Turn on Screen Time" is waiting for iOS's answer.
    @State private var isAsking = false

    var body: some View {
        if let preset, let model = NeedsScreenTimeModel(probe: sessions.probe, capability: sessions.blocking.capability, preset: preset) {
            FocusHeroPage(hasPrimary: false) { diameter in
                dial(model, preset: preset, diameter: diameter)
            } below: {
                card(model)
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.md)
            } primary: {
                EmptyView()
            }
        }
    }

    /// The preset the start screen would show.
    private var preset: FocusPreset? {
        FocusStartLines.preset(selected: tab.selectedPresetID, presets: presets.presets, lastUsedID: presets.lastUsedID,
                               isFirstSession: !settings.hasStartedFocus)
    }

    /// The dial with its marks off (§4.2 `off`): no dot and no bloom. The card says everything, so VoiceOver skips it.
    private func dial(_ model: NeedsScreenTimeModel, preset: FocusPreset, diameter: CGFloat) -> some View {
        let leaf = model.showsLeaf ? focusStores?.nextHoursLeaf(at: sessions.now, collection: collection) : nil
        let species = leaf.flatMap { LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: $0.speciesID) }
        let fill = leaf.map { DialFill(rung: $0, sessionHours: 0) } ?? DialFill()
        return MinuteDial(frame: .off(layout: DialLayout(plannedMinutes: preset.minutes)), diameter: diameter, theme: theme) {
            DialCentre(leaf: species.map { DialLeaf(species: $0, fill: fill) }, numeral: DialCentre.numeralParts(model.lengthText),
                       caption: model.caption, diameter: diameter)
        }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    private func card(_ model: NeedsScreenTimeModel) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: theme.spacing.xs) {
            Text(model.card.title)
                .font(MapleFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
            if let line = model.card.body {
                Text(line)
                    .font(MapleFont.callout)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
            }
            if let primary = model.card.primary {
                Button(primary) { turnOn() }
                    .buttonStyle(.moonlight)
                    .disabled(isAsking)
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xs)
            }
            TextLink(model.plainTimerLink, chevron: false) {
                tab.plainTimer = .chosen
            }
        }
        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .padding(theme.spacing.md)
        .surface(.level1, radius: theme.radius.tile)
    }

    private func turnOn() {
        guard !isAsking else { return }
        isAsking = true
        Task {
            _ = await sessions.requestAuthorization()
            isAsking = false
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
/// What "Turn on" does for a missing permission: Apple Health shows the primer (`HealthPrimerSheet`); Screen Time,
/// once it ships, opens Maple's page in Settings.
@MainActor
func turnOnPermission(
    _ availability: LeafAvailability, speciesID: String?, showHealthPrimer: (HealthPrimerRequest) -> Void,
    openURL: OpenURLAction
) {
    switch availability {
    case .needsAppleHealth:
        showHealthPrimer(HealthPrimerRequest(speciesID: speciesID))
    case .needsScreenTime:
        if let url = URL(string: UIApplication.openSettingsURLString) { openURL(url) }
    case .available, .dormant, .notInThisBuild:
        break
    }
}
```
with:
```swift
/// What "Turn on" does for a missing permission: Apple Health shows the primer (`HealthPrimerSheet`); Screen Time
/// opens the Focus tab's Needs Screen Time (F1 design §5.3), because Maple's page in iOS Settings has no Screen Time
/// switch. Home and the Herbarium close their sheets and covers when the Focus tab is asked for.
@MainActor
func turnOnPermission(
    _ availability: LeafAvailability, speciesID: String?, showHealthPrimer: (HealthPrimerRequest) -> Void,
    router: AppRouter
) {
    switch availability {
    case .needsAppleHealth:
        showHealthPrimer(HealthPrimerRequest(speciesID: speciesID))
    case .needsScreenTime:
        router.showFocus(.needsScreenTime)
    case .available, .dormant, .notInThisBuild:
        break
    }
}
```

### Task 11: Running session and break

The running session (F1 design §5.4) and its break (§5.5) replace Task 8's two placeholders. The screen is drawn from the store, so a killed app comes back to the same session. Its dial samples once a second from `FocusSessionStore.now`, inside the screen, never at the app root. After 30 seconds without a touch only the bloom and the marks dim. ⌄ minimises the session. The leaf opening mid-session turns the centre leaf, the dot and the bloom gold. The break counts down its rest marks and returns to the session when it runs out. The way out ("End early" or "Emergency release") opens a placeholder until Task 12.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **One view for both routes.** `FocusView` sends `.running(id)` and `.breakTime(id)` to one `RunningSessionView` (one `case` with two patterns). The view picks the break or the dial each tick from the session. So a break starting or running out keeps the screen's state (the last touch, the announced leaf), and a break that runs out while Maple is away simply shows the session on return. Cost if wrong: one `switch` case.
- **A shared layout, `SessionScreen`** (internal, App target), for this task's two screens and Tasks 12–13's (§5.7, §5.8). It holds ⌄ (or the room it takes), the two-line header, the dial, the lines and the controls.
  - The dial sits a fixed 24pt under the header, so lines and controls coming and going below it never move it (§4.6: no layout motion).
  - Its diameter is `MinuteDialMetrics.preferredDiameter(forWidth:)` (75% of the width), capped at 46% of the page's height and never under 220pt. At accessibility sizes it is 220pt and the page scrolls (§5.17).
  - Cost if wrong: one file.
- **At accessibility sizes the time is repeated under the dial,** "32m left of 50m" and "4m left of your break", in `MapleFont.headline`. This is because `DialCentre` stops growing at xxLarge (Task 6). It is hidden from VoiceOver, which already reads the dial.
- **Dimming (§4.6):**
  - The last touch is kept on the store's trusted time.
  - Any tap, a return to the foreground and the screen appearing count as touches.
  - While dimmed, a full-screen clear layer takes the first touch and only wakes the screen.
  - `DialFrame.dimmed(_:)` dims only the marks and the bloom. The header, centre, lines and buttons stay at full strength.
  - The break doesn't dim. It is short, and the member is away from the phone. §4.6 ties dimming to the running screen. Cost if wrong: one condition.
- **The centre leaf's two tones.**
  - "Before" is the rung fraction at the counters' hours minus this session's counted seconds.
  - The session's share runs up to the counters plus this session's provisional seconds (display credit), so the leaf agrees with Home's next-leaf row (Task 16).
  - Provisional time that would reach the threshold never reads "0m to go". The line stays at "1m to go" until a checkpoint opens the leaf (§4.3: only the counters unlock leaves).
  - Cost if wrong: arithmetic in one model.
- **The leaf opening mid-session** comes from `FocusSessionStore.sessionUnlocks`, filtered to hours leaves.
  - The dot stays at the minute the leaf opened, rounded up within the length. `DialFrame.running` turns the dot amber and the bloom gold.
  - The centre leaf cross-fades to gold (`DialFill(opened: 1)`), and the line reads `SessionForecast.openedLine` ("… it opens in the morning" when `RevealSchedule.isHeld`).
  - It is announced once, in §4.9's sentences: "Field maple is yours. It opens after this session." (§4.3's words; "… It opens in the morning." when held). There is no haptic: §4.6 lists none for it.
  - The dial reads §4.9's "32 minutes left of 50. Field maple at minute 35.", the length a plain minute count (a 90-minute plan reads "of 90", as Task 9's minimised dial does). Once the leaf has opened, the dial reads the time alone: the opening was announced.
- **The first session.** `AppSettings.hasStartedFocus` is already true while the first session runs, because the start sets it. So the line shows when the replay holds no other visible session and the focus book holds nothing before the session's day. Cost if wrong: the line shows once more after a reinstall, which P4 already accepts.
- **A break that runs out** in front of the member (within 2 seconds of its end, with the screen showing) plays one soft impact (`.impact(flexibility: .soft, intensity: 0.5)`, as the reveal's) and announces "Back to studying.". Back from the background it returns quietly, as §5.5 says ("a soft haptic plays if the app is open").
- **The break's suggestion rotates** through `FocusCopy.BreakTime.suggestion(secondsIntoBreak:)` (Task 4: 100 seconds each), cross-fading over `gentle`.
- **"Take a break" and "Back to studying"** call `startBreak()` and `endBreak()`. Each is disabled while its call runs. A `false` from `startBreak()` (the block couldn't be read back) leaves the session as it is, with the button still there.
- **Copy the design doesn't give,** in MapleCore:
  - ⌄'s VoiceOver label "Minimise session";
  - the break's end announcement "Back to studying." (§5.5's button words as a sentence).

  "Take a break" and "End early" are §5.4's words. Every other string is Task 4's `FocusCopy`.
- **Magic Tap** moves VoiceOver focus to the first control ("Take a break", otherwise the way out), as §4.9's "returns to the session controls".
- **The way out, until Task 12:** "End early" / "Emergency release" opens a medium sheet with a `FocusPlaceholder` naming it. Task 12 replaces exactly that block.
- **DEBUG:** `-MapleDemoFocus dimmed` sets the last touch 30 seconds back, once per launch. Every other state is the store's (Task 2).

/// The break screen (F1 design §5.5, §4.9).
@Suite("Break screen")
struct BreakScreenModelTests {
    private static let start = at(2026, 10, 23, 14)

    /// A 50-minute Study with its 5-minute break; the block confirmed at 14:00:05, the break taken `minute` minutes in.
    private func record(breakAt minute: Double = 18, seconds: Int = 300, _ more: (SessionScript) -> Void = { _ in }) throws -> SessionRecord {
        let script = SessionScript(start: Self.start, plan: FocusFixtures.plan(minutes: 50, breakMinutes: 5))
        script.after(5, .shieldApplied)
        script.after(minute * 60, .breakStarted(seconds: seconds))
        more(script)
        return try #require(script.record)
    }

    private func model(_ session: SessionRecord, after seconds: TimeInterval) -> BreakScreenModel? {
        let breakStart = session.breaks.last?.start ?? session.countdownStart
        return BreakScreenModel(session: session, now: breakStart.addingTimeInterval(seconds), intention: "Chemistry ch. 4",
                                locale: enGB, calendar: utc)
    }

    @Test("A minute into the break: 4m left of your break, and back to studying at 14:23")
    func breakTime() throws {
        let screen = try #require(model(try record(), after: 60))
        #expect(BreakScreenModel.endedAnnouncement == "Back to studying.")
        #expect(screen.subtitle == "Study · Chemistry ch. 4")
        #expect(screen.remaining == "4m")
        #expect(screen.timeLine == "4m left of your break")
        #expect(screen.breakSeconds == 300)
        #expect(screen.backLine == "The break counts. Back to studying at 14:23.")
        #expect(screen.spoken == "4 minutes of break left. Back to studying at 14:23.")
        #expect(screen.endPath == .steady)
    }

    @Test("The suggestion rotates through the break, one at a time")
    func suggestion() throws {
        let session = try record()
        #expect(try #require(model(session, after: 10)).suggestion == "Stand up and stretch.")
        #expect(try #require(model(session, after: 150)).suggestion == "Look out of a window.")
        #expect(try #require(model(session, after: 250)).suggestion == "Get a glass of water.")
    }

    @Test("A break near the end is cut short at the planned end")
    func cutShort() throws {
        let session = try record(breakAt: 47, seconds: 180)
        let screen = try #require(model(session, after: 30))
        #expect(screen.breakSeconds == 180)
        #expect(screen.remaining == "3m")
        #expect(screen.backLine == "The break counts. Back to studying at 14:50.")
    }

    @Test("No break screen before the break, once it ran out, or after Back to studying")
    func noBreak() throws {
        let session = try record()
        // Before the break: a record that doesn't hold it yet.
        let unbroken = SessionScript(start: Self.start, plan: FocusFixtures.plan(minutes: 50, breakMinutes: 5))
        unbroken.after(5, .shieldApplied)
        let before = try #require(unbroken.record)
        #expect(BreakScreenModel(session: before, now: before.countdownStart.addingTimeInterval(60), intention: nil,
                                 locale: enGB, calendar: utc) == nil)
        #expect(model(session, after: 300) == nil)
        let back = try record { $0.after(120, .breakEnded) }
        #expect(model(back, after: 130) == nil)
    }

    @Test("The session screen returns with a haptic only when the break runs out in front of the member")
    func ranOut() throws {
        let session = try record()
        let end = session.countdownStart.addingTimeInterval(18 * 60 + 300)
        #expect(BreakScreenModel.ranOutJustNow(session, at: end.addingTimeInterval(0.5)))
        #expect(!BreakScreenModel.ranOutJustNow(session, at: end.addingTimeInterval(-1)))
        // Back from the background long after it ran out: no haptic.
        #expect(!BreakScreenModel.ranOutJustNow(session, at: end.addingTimeInterval(10)))
        let back = try record { $0.after(120, .breakEnded) }
        #expect(!BreakScreenModel.ranOutJustNow(back, at: end.addingTimeInterval(0.5)))
        // A break cut short at the planned end ends with the session: the finish has its own haptic.
        let last = try record(breakAt: 47, seconds: 180)
        #expect(!BreakScreenModel.ranOutJustNow(last, at: last.plannedEnd.addingTimeInterval(0.5)))
    }
}

/// Dimming the running screen (F1 design §4.6).

struct FocusDimmingTests {

    func dims() {

        #expect(FocusDimming.isDimmed(idleFor: 30, voiceOver: false, increasedContrast: false))
        #expect(!FocusDimming.isDimmed(idleFor: 600, voiceOver: true, increasedContrast: false))

`species(_:rung:)`, `progressRow(…)`, `at(…)`, `utc` and `enGB` are `TestSupport.swift`'s. `SessionScript` and `FocusFixtures` are the F1a test helpers.

`MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Focus/RunningSessionModel.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// The way out of a running session, by its strictness (F1 design §5.6, §5.7, §5.12).
public enum SessionEndPath: String, Sendable, Hashable, CaseIterable {
    /// Gentle: "End session", then a 5-second breathing ring.
    case gentle
    /// Steady: a 3-second hold, then a 15-second countdown that "Keep going" still cancels.
    case steady
    /// Locked: the emergency release, a 10-second hold and one slow breath.
    case emergency

    public init(_ strictness: Strictness) {
        switch strictness {
        case .gentle: self = .gentle
        case .steady: self = .steady
        case .locked: self = .emergency
        }
    }

    /// The link under the session's controls: "End early", or "Emergency release" in Locked (§5.4).
    public var title: String {
        self == .emergency ? FocusCopy.Emergency.title : Self.endEarlyTitle
    }

    /// What the session ends with when this path completes.
    public var reason: EndReason {
        self == .emergency ? .emergencyRelease : .endedEarly
    }

    public static let endEarlyTitle = "End early"
}

/// The running screen's dimming (F1 design §4.6, §5.4): after 30 seconds without a touch only the bloom and the
/// marks dim, to 50%. Never under VoiceOver or Increase Contrast. Auto-Lock is left alone.
public enum FocusDimming {
    public static let delay: TimeInterval = 30

    public static func isDimmed(idleFor seconds: TimeInterval, voiceOver: Bool, increasedContrast: Bool) -> Bool {
        !voiceOver && !increasedContrast && seconds >= delay
    }
}

/// Everything the running session screen says and decides at one moment (F1 design §4.3, §4.9, §5.4). Pure: the
/// view samples it once a second from `FocusSessionStore.now`.
public struct RunningSessionModel: Sendable, Equatable {
    /// The next hours leaf, as the counters have it (`LeafProgress`, hours).
    public struct Leaf: Sendable, Equatable {
        public var speciesID: String
        public var name: String
        /// The rung below (`LeafProgress.floor`) and the leaf's threshold.
        public var floor: Double
        public var threshold: Double
        /// The counters' hours (`LeafProgress.current`): this session's counted seconds are already in it, its
        /// provisional time is not.
        public var current: Double

        public init(speciesID: String, name: String, floor: Double, threshold: Double, current: Double) {
            self.speciesID = speciesID
            self.name = name
            self.floor = floor
            self.threshold = threshold
            self.current = current
        }

        /// The next hours leaf in `rows` (`CollectionStore.progress(at:)`): the lowest locked hours rung, as
        /// `FocusStores.nextHoursLeaf(at:collection:)` picks it for the start screen (Task 9). Nil when every hours leaf
        /// is earned.
        public init?(next rows: [LeafProgress], catalog: LeafCatalog = .shared) {
            guard let row = rows.filter({ $0.category == .hoursSaved && $0.state == .locked })
                .min(by: { $0.threshold < $1.threshold }) else { return nil }
            self.init(speciesID: row.speciesID, name: catalog.species(id: row.speciesID)?.displayName ?? row.speciesID,
                      floor: row.floor, threshold: row.threshold, current: row.current)
        }
    }

    /// An hours leaf this session opened: a checkpoint confirmed the crossing.
    public struct Opened: Sendable, Equatable {
        public var speciesID: String
        public var name: String
        /// The session minute it opened at, where the dot turned amber.
        public var minute: Int
        /// Earned in wind-down or at night: it opens in the morning (F1-12).
        public var heldUntilMorning: Bool

        public init(speciesID: String, name: String, minute: Int, heldUntilMorning: Bool) {
            self.speciesID = speciesID
            self.name = name
            self.minute = minute
            self.heldUntilMorning = heldUntilMorning
        }
    }

    /// A line whose trailing part is drawn in the secondary colour: "Field maple" · "· 17m to go".
    public struct Line: Sendable, Equatable {
        public var lead: String
        public var trail: String?

        public init(lead: String, trail: String? = nil) {
            self.lead = lead
            self.trail = trail
        }

        /// The line as one string, for VoiceOver.
        public var text: String { trail.map { "\(lead) \($0)" } ?? lead }
    }

    /// The preset's one break (§5.4).
    public static let takeBreakTitle = "Take a break"
    /// ⌄'s VoiceOver label: the session keeps running.
    public static let minimiseLabel = "Minimise session"

    /// "Study · Chemistry ch. 4", or the preset name alone.
    public let title: String
    /// "6 apps resting", "Apps resting", or "Plain timer · apps aren't locked" (a plain timer, or a block lost).
    public let restingLine: String
    public let secondsLeft: TimeInterval
    /// "32m"; "0:45" in the last minute (`DialCentre.numeralParts` splits it).
    public let remaining: String
    /// "left of 50m".
    public let caption: String
    /// The time repeated under the dial at accessibility sizes, where the dial's centre stops growing (§5.17):
    /// "32m left of 50m".
    public let timeLine: String
    /// The centre leaf's species: the leaf this session opened, else the next hours leaf; nil when the session
    /// can't count or no hours leaf is left.
    public let centreLeaf: String?
    /// The leaf dot's minute: the next leaf's while it is in reach, the opened leaf's once it opened; nil hides it.
    public let leafMinute: Int?
    /// The centre leaf's fill within its rung (`DialFill(before:session:opened:)`): what was saved before this
    /// session, and this session's share on top of it.
    public let fillBefore: Double
    public let fillSession: Double
    public let leafOpened: Bool
    /// "Field maple · 17m to go", or "Field maple is yours · it opens after this session"; nil when the session
    /// can't count.
    public let leafLine: Line?
    /// "You can lock your phone. Maple keeps time." in the member's first session only.
    public let firstSessionLine: String?
    /// "Take a break" while the preset's one break is unused and time is left.
    public let breakTitle: String?
    public let endPath: SessionEndPath
    /// The dial for VoiceOver (§4.9): "32 minutes left of 50. Field maple at minute 35.", the length a plain minute
    /// count ("of 90"). The time alone once the leaf has opened, for a plain timer, or with no dot.
    public let spoken: String
    /// Announced once when the leaf opens (a milestone, §4.9): "Field maple is yours. It opens after this session."
    public let leafAnnouncement: String?

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - leaf: The next hours leaf (`Leaf(next:)`); nil when there is none.
    ///   - opened: Hours leaves this session opened (`opened(_:session:...)`), oldest first.
    ///   - countedSeconds: This session's counted seconds (`FocusSessionStore.credit(for:)?.seconds`).
    ///   - displaySeconds: Counted plus provisional (`FocusSessionStore.countedSoFar(_:)`).
    ///   - roomLeftToday: Seconds of today's 6 hours still free, display credit included.
    public init(
        session: SessionRecord, now: Date, intention: String?, leaf: Leaf?, opened: [Opened], countedSeconds: Int,
        displaySeconds: Int, roomLeftToday: Int, isFirstSession: Bool, locale: Locale
    ) {
        let plan = session.plan
        title = FocusCopy.sessionTitle(presetName: plan.presetName, intention: intention)
        let isPlain = plan.kind == .plainTimer || session.lostAt != nil
        restingLine = SelectionText.restingLine(plan.selection, isPlainTimer: isPlain)
        let left = session.secondsLeft(at: now)
        secondsLeft = left
        remaining = FocusTimeText.remaining(left)
        let length = FocusTimeText.length(minutes: plan.plannedMinutes)
        caption = "left of \(length)"
        timeLine = "\(remaining) left of \(length)"
        firstSessionLine = isFirstSession ? FocusCopy.firstSessionLine : nil
        breakTitle = plan.breakSeconds > 0 && !session.breakUsed && left > 0 ? Self.takeBreakTitle : nil
        endPath = SessionEndPath(plan.strictness)

        let canCount = plan.canCount && !isPlain
        let counted = max(0, countedSeconds)
        let provisional = max(0, displaySeconds - counted)
        var minute: Int?
        var before = 0.0
        var share = 0.0
        var centre: String?
        var line: Line?
        var dotSentence: String?
        var announcement: String?
        if let first = opened.first {
            centre = first.speciesID
            minute = first.minute
            before = 1
            let text = opened.count == 1
                ? SessionForecast.openedLine(leaf: first.name, heldUntilMorning: first.heldUntilMorning)
                : SessionForecast.openedLine(count: opened.count)
            line = Line(lead: text)
            // The line's words in §4.9's sentences: "Field maple is yours. It opens after this session."
            announcement = text.components(separatedBy: " · ")
                .map { String($0.prefix(1)).uppercased() + String($0.dropFirst()) }
                .joined(separator: ". ") + "."
        } else if let leaf, canCount {
            centre = leaf.speciesID
            before = Self.rungFraction(leaf.current - Double(counted) / 3600, leaf)
            share = Self.rungFraction(leaf.current + Double(provisional) / 3600, leaf) - before
            // Provisional time that covers the rest waits for a checkpoint: never "0m to go" for a leaf not yet open.
            let toGo = max(1, Int(((leaf.threshold - leaf.current) * 3600).rounded()) - provisional)
            minute = SessionForecast(
                start: session.countdownStart, plannedSeconds: plan.plannedSeconds, window: plan.window, now: now,
                canCount: true, secondsToLeaf: toGo, leafName: leaf.name, roomLeftToday: roomLeftToday, firstEver: false
            ).leafMinute
            let full = SessionForecast.leafLine(leaf: leaf.name, secondsToGo: toGo)
            line = Line(lead: leaf.name, trail: String(full.dropFirst(leaf.name.count + 1)))
            if let minute { dotSentence = "\(leaf.name) at minute \(minute)." }
        }
        centreLeaf = centre
        leafMinute = minute
        fillBefore = before
        fillSession = max(0, share)
        leafOpened = !opened.isEmpty
        leafLine = line
        leafAnnouncement = announcement

        // §4.9: the length is a plain minute count ("of 90"); the leaf sentence only while the dot is ahead.
        spoken = "\(FocusTimeText.spokenRemaining(left, locale: locale)) of \(plan.plannedMinutes)." + (dotSentence.map { " \($0)" } ?? "")
    }

    /// The hours leaves among `unlocks` (`FocusSessionStore.sessionUnlocks`), each at the session minute it opened
    /// (rounded up, within the planned length), oldest first. `held` says whether a leaf is held until morning
    /// (`RevealSchedule.isHeld`).
    public static func opened(
        _ unlocks: [LeafUnlock], session: SessionRecord, held: (LeafUnlock) -> Bool, catalog: RewardCatalog = .shared,
        leaves: LeafCatalog = .shared
    ) -> [Opened] {
        unlocks
            .filter { catalog.reward(forSpecies: $0.speciesID)?.categoryID == .hoursSaved }
            .sorted { $0.date < $1.date }
            .map { unlock in
                let seconds = unlock.date.timeIntervalSince(session.countdownStart)
                let minute = min(session.plan.plannedMinutes, max(1, Int((seconds / 60 - 1e-9).rounded(.up))))
                return Opened(speciesID: unlock.speciesID, name: leaves.species(id: unlock.speciesID)?.displayName ?? unlock.speciesID,
                              minute: minute, heldUntilMorning: held(unlock))
            }
    }

    /// Whether `session` is the member's first: no other session in the replay, and the focus book holds nothing
    /// from before the session's Maple day. (`AppSettings.hasStartedFocus` is already true by now: the start sets
    /// it.)
    public static func isFirstSession(_ session: SessionRecord, among sessions: [SessionRecord], book: FocusBook) -> Bool {
        guard sessions.allSatisfy({ $0.id == session.id || $0.isHidden }) else { return false }
        return book.baseline == .zero && book.days.allSatisfy { $0.day >= session.plan.day }
    }

    /// `hours` within the leaf's rung, 0...1, as `LeafProgress.rungFraction` reads it.
    static func rungFraction(_ hours: Double, _ leaf: Leaf) -> Double {
        let span = leaf.threshold - leaf.floor
        guard span > 0 else { return hours >= leaf.threshold ? 1 : 0 }
        return min(1, max(0, (hours - leaf.floor) / span))
    }
}

/// The break screen at one moment (F1 design §5.5): the session's one locked break, inside its planned length.
public struct BreakScreenModel: Sendable, Equatable {
    /// Announced when the break runs out while the screen is open (a milestone, §4.9): "Back to studying."
    public static let endedAnnouncement = "\(FocusCopy.BreakTime.backToStudying)."

    /// "Study · Chemistry ch. 4" under the header ("Break · apps stay locked", `FocusCopy.BreakTime.header`).
    public let subtitle: String
    public let secondsLeft: TimeInterval
    /// The break's real length, cut short at the planned end: one rest mark per 10 seconds of it
    /// (`BreakDialLayout(breakSeconds:)`).
    public let breakSeconds: Int
    /// "4m"; "0:45" in the last minute.
    public let remaining: String
    /// "4m left of your break" under the dial at accessibility sizes.
    public let timeLine: String
    /// One thing to do away from the phone, rotating through the break.
    public let suggestion: String
    /// "The break counts. Back to studying at 14:28."
    public let backLine: String
    /// "4 minutes of break left. Back to studying at 14:28."
    public let spoken: String
    public let endPath: SessionEndPath

    /// Nil when no break is running at `now`.
    public init?(session: SessionRecord, now: Date, intention: String?, locale: Locale, calendar: Calendar) {
        guard let left = session.breakSecondsLeft(at: now), let current = session.breaks.last,
              let backAt = session.breakEnd(at: now) else { return nil }
        subtitle = FocusCopy.sessionTitle(presetName: session.plan.presetName, intention: intention)
        secondsLeft = left
        breakSeconds = max(1, Int(backAt.timeIntervalSince(current.start).rounded()))
        remaining = FocusTimeText.remaining(left)
        timeLine = "\(remaining) \(FocusCopy.BreakTime.caption)"
        suggestion = FocusCopy.BreakTime.suggestion(secondsIntoBreak: now.timeIntervalSince(current.start))
        backLine = FocusCopy.BreakTime.line(backAt: backAt, locale: locale, calendar: calendar)
        spoken = FocusCopy.BreakTime.dialLabel(secondsLeft: left, backAt: backAt, locale: locale, calendar: calendar)
        endPath = SessionEndPath(session.plan.strictness)
    }

    /// The break ran out on its own (not "Back to studying") in the last 2 seconds, before the planned end: the
    /// session screen comes back with a soft haptic only when the member is there to feel it. A break that ran out
    /// while Maple was away returns to the session quietly.
    public static func ranOutJustNow(_ session: SessionRecord, at now: Date) -> Bool {
        guard let last = session.breaks.last, last.end == nil else { return false }
        let until = min(last.plannedEnd, session.plannedEnd)
        return until < session.plannedEnd && now >= until && now.timeIntervalSince(until) < 2
    }
}

`App/Features/Focus/SessionScreen.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign

/// The layout every Focus session screen shares (F1 design §5.4–§5.8): ⌄ (or the room it takes), the two-line
/// header, the dial at a fixed distance under it, the lines under the dial, and the controls at the foot.
///
/// - The dial is about 75% of the width (`MinuteDialMetrics.preferredDiameter(forWidth:)`), never more than 46% of
///   the height, and never under 220pt. At accessibility sizes it is 220pt and the page scrolls (§5.17).
/// - The dial sits at a fixed offset from the header, so lines and controls appearing or going under it never move
///   it (no layout motion, §4.6).
/// - The dial's bloom reaches past its frame and is never clipped.
struct SessionScreen<Dial: View, Lines: View, Controls: View>: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize

    private let title: String
    private let subtitle: String?
    private let onMinimise: (() -> Void)?
    private let dial: (CGFloat) -> Dial
    private let lines: Lines
    private let controls: Controls

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - title: "Study · Chemistry ch. 4", "Break · apps stay locked", "Emergency release".
    ///   - subtitle: "6 apps resting", "Study · Chemistry ch. 4", "Study · Locked", "Apps open again".
    ///   - onMinimise: ⌄; nil leaves its room empty (the receipt and the emergency release have none).
    ///   - dial: The dial, given its diameter.
    init(
        title: String, subtitle: String?, onMinimise: (() -> Void)? = nil,
        @ViewBuilder dial: @escaping (CGFloat) -> Dial, @ViewBuilder lines: () -> Lines,
        @ViewBuilder controls: () -> Controls
    ) {
        self.title = title
        self.subtitle = subtitle
        self.onMinimise = onMinimise
        self.dial = dial
        self.lines = lines()
        self.controls = controls()
    }

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { proxy in
            ScrollView {
                VStack(spacing: 0) {
                    topBar
                    header
                        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xxs)
                    dial(Self.diameter(for: proxy.size, accessibility: dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize))
                        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.lg)
                    VStack(spacing: theme.spacing.xs) {
                        lines
                    }
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.lg)
                    Spacer(minLength: theme.spacing.lg)
                    VStack(spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
                        controls
                    }
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.homeMargin)
                .padding(.bottom, theme.spacing.md)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: proxy.size.height)
            }
            .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
            .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
            .scrollClipDisabled()
        }
    }

    private var topBar: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            if let onMinimise {
                Button(RunningSessionModel.minimiseLabel, systemImage: "chevron.down", action: onMinimise)
                    .buttonStyle(.iconCircle)
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .frame(height: theme.spacing.minimumHitTarget)
    }

    private var header: some View {
        VStack(spacing: theme.spacing.xxs) {
            Text(title)
                .font(MapleFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
            if let subtitle {
                Text(subtitle)
                    .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
            }
        }
        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
    }

    /// The dial's diameter in a page of `size`.
    static func diameter(for size: CGSize, accessibility: Bool) -> CGFloat {
        guard !accessibility else { return MinuteDialMetrics.minimumDiameter }
        let fitted = min(MinuteDialMetrics.preferredDiameter(forWidth: size.width), (size.height * 0.46).rounded(.down))
        return max(MinuteDialMetrics.minimumDiameter, fitted)
    }
}

`App/Features/Focus/BreakView.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign

/// The break (F1 design §5.5): "Break · apps stay locked" over the session's title; the dial switched to the break,
/// one rest mark per 10 seconds going out one by one under the cool bloom, with "4m" over "left of your break"; one
/// thing to do away from the phone; "The break counts. Back to studying at 14:28."; "Back to studying"; and the
/// session's own way out. `RunningSessionView` draws it once a second while the break runs. Apps stay locked and the
/// break counts (O5). The break doesn't dim: it is short, and the member is away from the phone.
struct BreakView: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize

    let model: BreakScreenModel
    /// "Back to studying" is on its way to the store: a second tap does nothing.
    let isEndingBreak: Bool
    let onMinimise: () -> Void
    let onBackToStudying: () -> Void
    let onEndPath: () -> Void
    /// Where Magic Tap moves VoiceOver: the first control (§4.9).
    let controlsFocused: AccessibilityFocusState<Bool>.Binding

    var body: some View {
        SessionScreen(title: FocusCopy.BreakTime.header, subtitle: model.subtitle, onMinimise: onMinimise) { diameter in
            MinuteDial(
                frame: .breakTime(BreakDialLayout(breakSeconds: model.breakSeconds), left: model.secondsLeft),
                diameter: diameter, theme: theme
            ) {
                DialCentre(leaf: nil, numeral: DialCentre.numeralParts(model.remaining), caption: FocusCopy.BreakTime.caption,
                           diameter: diameter)
            }
            .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
            .accessibilityLabel(Text(model.spoken))
        } lines: {
            if dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize {
                // The dial's centre stops growing at xxLarge, so the time is repeated where it can grow (§5.17).
                Text(model.timeLine)
                    .font(MapleFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            Text(model.suggestion)
                .font(MapleFont.callout)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                .contentTransition(.opacity)
                .mapleAnimation(theme.motion.gentle, value: model.suggestion)
            Text(model.backLine)
                .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
        } controls: {
            Button(FocusCopy.BreakTime.backToStudying, action: onBackToStudying)
                .buttonStyle(.glassCapsule)
                .disabled(isEndingBreak)
                .accessibilityFocused(controlsFocused)
            TextLink(model.endPath.title, chevron: false, action: onEndPath)
        }
    }
}
```
