`App/Features/Focus/RunningSessionView.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// The running session (F1 design §5.4) and its break (§5.5), drawn from the store, so a killed app comes back to the
/// same session. One view for both routes (`FocusRoute.running` and `.breakTime`), so a break starting or running out
/// keeps the screen's state; the break's own layout is `BreakView`.
///
/// - The dial samples once a second from `FocusSessionStore.now` (`TimelineView(.periodic)`): here, never at the app
///   root (P6).
/// - After 30 seconds without a touch only the bloom and the marks dim, to 50% (§4.6), never under VoiceOver or
///   Increase Contrast. While dimmed, the first touch only wakes the screen. Auto-Lock is left alone.
/// - ⌄ minimises the session, which keeps running (`FocusTabState.isMinimised`).
/// - The leaf opening and the break running out are announced once each (§4.9). A break that runs out in front of
///   the member also plays a soft haptic; one that ran out while Maple was away returns to the session quietly.
/// - Magic Tap moves VoiceOver to the session's controls.
struct RunningSessionView: View {
    let sessionID: UUID

    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @Environment(\.scenePhase) private var scenePhase
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(\.accessibilityVoiceOverEnabled) private var voiceOver
    @Environment(\.colorSchemeContrast) private var contrast
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions
    @Environment(SessionNotesStore.self) private var notes
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @Environment(FocusTabState.self) private var tab

    /// The last touch, on the store's trusted time: the screen dims 30 seconds after it.
    @State private var lastTouch: Date?
    @State private var isTakingBreak = false
    @State private var isEndingBreak = false
    /// The leaf whose opening was announced, so it is announced once.
    @State private var announcedLeaf: String?
    /// Bumped when the break runs out in front of the member: one soft haptic.
    @State private var breakRanOut = 0
    @AccessibilityFocusState private var controlsFocused: Bool
    // The way out (Task 12 replaces this with End early and the emergency release).
    @State private var showsEndPath = false

    init(sessionID: UUID) {
        self.sessionID = sessionID
    }

    var body: some View {
        sessionScreen
            // Task 12 replaces this with End early and the emergency release.
            .sheet(isPresented: $showsEndPath) {
                FocusPlaceholder(endPath.title)
                    .presentationDetents([.medium])
                    .presentationBackground(theme.colors.surface2)
            }
    }

    // MARK: The screen

    /// The running session this screen shows; nil in the moment after it ends, before the route moves on.
    private var session: SessionRecord? {
        sessions.running.flatMap { $0.id == sessionID ? $0 : nil }
    }

    private var endPath: SessionEndPath {
        SessionEndPath(session?.plan.strictness ?? .steady)
    }

    /// The break while one runs, otherwise the running dial, sampled once a second.
    private var sessionScreen: some View {
        let session = self.session
        return TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)) { _ in
            if let session {
                screen(session, now: sessions.now)
            } else {
                Color.clear
            }
        }
        .onAppear(perform: appeared)
        .onChange(of: scenePhase) { _, phase in
            // Coming back to Maple counts as a touch.
            if phase == .active { wake() }
        }
        .sensoryFeedback(.impact(flexibility: .soft, intensity: 0.5), trigger: breakRanOut)
        .accessibilityAction(.magicTap) { controlsFocused = true }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func screen(_ session: SessionRecord, now: Date) -> some View {
        let inBreak = session.isInBreak(at: now)
        Group {
            if inBreak, let model = BreakScreenModel(
                session: session, now: now, intention: notes.intention(for: session.id), locale: locale,
                calendar: collection.context.calendar
            ) {
                BreakView(
                    model: model, isEndingBreak: isEndingBreak, onMinimise: minimise, onBackToStudying: backToStudying,
                    onEndPath: takeEndPath, controlsFocused: $controlsFocused
                )
            } else {
                running(model(session, now: now), session: session, now: now)
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: inBreak) { wasInBreak, isInBreak in
            guard wasInBreak, !isInBreak, BreakScreenModel.ranOutJustNow(session, at: now) else { return }
            breakRanOut += 1
            AccessibilityNotification.Announcement(BreakScreenModel.endedAnnouncement).post()
        }
    }

    private func running(_ model: RunningSessionModel, session: SessionRecord, now: Date) -> some View {
        let dimmed = FocusDimming.isDimmed(
            idleFor: now.timeIntervalSince(lastTouch ?? now), voiceOver: voiceOver, increasedContrast: contrast == .increased
        )
        return SessionScreen(title: model.title, subtitle: model.restingLine, onMinimise: minimise) { diameter in
            dial(model, session: session, now: now, diameter: diameter, dimmed: dimmed)
        } lines: {
            if dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize {
                // The dial's centre stops growing at xxLarge, so the time is repeated where it can grow (§5.17).
                Text(model.timeLine)
                    .font(MapleFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            if let line = model.leafLine {
                Text(leafText(line))
                    .font(MapleFont.callout)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .contentTransition(.opacity)
                    .mapleAnimation(theme.motion.gentle, value: model.leafOpened)
                    .accessibilityLabel(Text(line.text))
            }
            if let first = model.firstSessionLine {
                Text(first)
                    .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
            }
        } controls: {
            if let breakTitle = model.breakTitle {
                Button(breakTitle, action: takeBreak)
                    .buttonStyle(.glassCapsule)
                    .disabled(isTakingBreak)
                    .accessibilityFocused($controlsFocused)
                TextLink(model.endPath.title, chevron: false, action: takeEndPath)
            } else {
                TextLink(model.endPath.title, chevron: false, action: takeEndPath)
                    .accessibilityFocused($controlsFocused)
            }
        }
        .overlay {
            if dimmed {
                // While dimmed, the first touch only wakes the screen (§4.6).
                Color.clear
                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
                    .onTapGesture(perform: wake)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
        }
        .simultaneousGesture(TapGesture().onEnded(wake))
        .onChange(of: model.leafAnnouncement) { _, text in
            announceLeaf(text, leaf: model.centreLeaf)
        }
    }

    /// The live dial: the passed minutes lit, the current mark tinted, the leaf dot, and in the centre the leaf, the
    /// time left and "left of 50m". VoiceOver reads it as one element (§4.9).
    private func dial(
        _ model: RunningSessionModel, session: SessionRecord, now: Date, diameter: CGFloat, dimmed: Bool
    ) -> some View {
        let layout = DialLayout(plannedMinutes: session.plan.plannedMinutes)
        let fill = DialFill(before: model.fillBefore, session: model.fillSession, opened: model.leafOpened ? 1 : 0)
        let frame = DialFrame.running(
            layout: layout, elapsed: now.timeIntervalSince(session.countdownStart), leafMinute: model.leafMinute, fill: fill
        )
        let leaf = model.centreLeaf.flatMap { LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: $0) }
        return MinuteDial(frame: frame.dimmed(dimmed), diameter: diameter, theme: theme) {
            DialCentre(
                leaf: leaf.map { DialLeaf(species: $0, fill: fill) }, numeral: DialCentre.numeralParts(model.remaining),
                caption: model.caption, diameter: diameter
            )
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(Text(model.spoken))
    }

    /// "Field maple" in the primary colour, "· 17m to go" in the secondary.
    private func leafText(_ line: RunningSessionModel.Line) -> AttributedString {
        var text = AttributedString(line.lead)
        if let trail = line.trail {
            var rest = AttributedString(" \(trail)")
            rest.foregroundColor = theme.colors.textSecondary
            text.append(rest)
        }
        return text
    }

    // MARK: The model

    private func model(_ session: SessionRecord, now: Date) -> RunningSessionModel {
        let schedule = collection.schedule
        let calendar = collection.context.calendar
        let opened = RunningSessionModel.opened(sessions.sessionUnlocks, session: session) { unlock in
            RevealSchedule.isHeld(unlock, at: now, schedule: schedule, calendar: calendar)
        }
        return RunningSessionModel(
            session: session, now: now, intention: notes.intention(for: session.id),
            leaf: RunningSessionModel.Leaf(next: collection.progress(at: now)), opened: opened,
            countedSeconds: sessions.credit(for: session.id)?.seconds ?? 0, displaySeconds: sessions.countedSoFar(session.id),
            roomLeftToday: max(0, HoursCredit.dailyCap - sessions.displayCredit(at: now).today),
            isFirstSession: RunningSessionModel.isFirstSession(session, among: sessions.sessions, book: collection.focus),
            locale: locale
        )
    }

    // MARK: Actions

    private func appeared() {
        wake()
        #if DEBUG
        applyDemo()
        #endif
    }

    private func wake() {
        lastTouch = sessions.now
    }

    private func minimise() {
        tab.isMinimised = true
    }

    private func takeBreak() {
        wake()
        guard !isTakingBreak else { return }
        isTakingBreak = true
        Task {
            // False when the block couldn't be read back first: the session carries on, and the button stays.
            _ = await sessions.startBreak()
            isTakingBreak = false
        }
    }

    private func backToStudying() {
        guard !isEndingBreak else { return }
        isEndingBreak = true
        Task {
            await sessions.endBreak()
            isEndingBreak = false
        }
    }

    private func takeEndPath() {
        wake()
        showsEndPath = true
    }

    /// The leaf's opening, announced once (a milestone, §4.9).
    private func announceLeaf(_ text: String?, leaf: String?) {
        guard let text, let leaf, announcedLeaf != leaf else { return }
        announcedLeaf = leaf
        AccessibilityNotification.Announcement(text).post()
    }

    #if DEBUG
    /// Applied once per launch, so a demo's state doesn't come back after the member changes it.
    private static var demoApplied = false

    /// `-MapleDemoFocus dimmed`: the screen as it is 30 seconds after the last touch.
    private func applyDemo() {
        guard !Self.demoApplied else { return }
        Self.demoApplied = true
        let options = DemoLaunchOptions.current
        if options.focus == .dimmed {
            lastTouch = sessions.now.addingTimeInterval(-FocusDimming.delay)
        }
    }
    #endif
}
```

### Task 12: End early and emergency release

The way out of a running session replaces Task 11's placeholder sheet.
- **End early (Gentle, Steady, F1 design §5.6)** is a sheet over the session: "End this session?", the minutes saved so far, and the primary "Keep going".
  - Steady holds "Hold to end" for 3 seconds, then runs a quiet "Ending in 15s" that "Keep going" still cancels, and offers "Take a 5-minute break instead" while the break is unused.
  - Gentle's "End session" starts a 5-second breathing ring.
- **Locked's emergency release (§5.7)** is a full screen. A 10-second hold fills the dial's marks, the release happens as the hold completes, then comes one slow breath, then the ended state.
- Holds cancel when Maple leaves the foreground.
- Settings' "Release all apps" goes through the same way out during a session (§5.12), through `FocusReleaseRouter`, which Task 17 calls.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **The sheet only decides; the screen ends the session.**
  - When the countdown reaches zero the sheet closes, and its `onDismiss` ends the session. So the receipt never appears under a sheet.
  - Swiping the sheet away is "Keep going", at every stage.
  - Cost if wrong: one callback.
- **Leaving the foreground cancels the countdown as well as the hold.** §5.7 says holds cancel; a countdown the member can no longer see or cancel shouldn't end the session behind their back. Back in Maple, the sheet asks again. Cost if wrong: one `onChange`.
- **Steady's countdown is quiet:** the title counts down once a second, with no haptic. Nothing is announced (§4.9: milestones only); the title reads "Ending in 9 seconds" to VoiceOver (`spokenTitle`, my words).
- **Gentle's ring** is an 88pt circle in the dial's rest colour.
  - It swells once over its 5 seconds (scale 0.88 → 1 → 0.88) as its opacity rises and falls: transform and opacity only.
  - Under Reduce Motion it doesn't scale, and only the opacity changes.
  - "End session" is a glass capsule under the moonlit "Keep going".
- **"Take a 5-minute break instead"** closes the sheet and starts the break. The store cuts it short at the planned end (F1-11), as §5.6 says.
- **The emergency release takes the session screen's place,** with the tab bar hidden, because §5.7 calls it "a full screen".
  - There is no ⌄: "Keep going" is the way back.
  - The hold's dial is Task 6's `DialFrame.hold(progress:)`, filled from the button's progress.
- **The breath:**
  - The release happens the moment the hold completes (`end(.emergencyRelease)`).
  - The breath starts at once from that moment, and carries on from the session's end on the receipt route (Task 13), so a relaunch mid-breath lands on the right moment and a later look opens on the ended state.
  - The cool bloom swells 0.8 → 1.25 → 0.8 over the 8 seconds, the mockup's keyframes, while its opacity rises from 0.5 to 1 and back. This view draws that bloom itself (the frame's bloom is hidden), because the bloom must scale.
  - Under Reduce Motion there is no swell, only the opacity.
- **The ended state:**
  - Its numeral and caption follow Task 5's receipt rule for this ending: the counted minutes ("18m", "saved · they stay yours"), or the minutes focused with "not counted toward leaves" when the session couldn't count.
  - Its dial shows the receipt's marks.
  - Its line and "Done" fade in over 0.6 s. "Done" keeps its place through the breath, so nothing moves.
  - "Session ended. It won't count as finished." is announced once.
- **Release all apps (§5.12):**
  - `FocusReleaseRouter` refreshes the store first, so a session that has just reached its end isn't sent through a way out.
  - With no session running it calls `releaseAll()` at once and returns true.
  - During a session it sends `FocusRequest.releaseAll` and returns false. The Focus tab un-minimises, and the session screen opens its way out, chosen by `SessionEndPath(strictness)`.
  - There is no app test target, so the router's logic stays this thin. Its choice of path is `SessionEndPath`'s, which `ReleaseAllPathTests` holds.
  - Completing a Gentle or Steady way out calls `releaseAll()`, which ends the session as `.releaseAll` (unverified, R4) while it clears every store. So the ledger records why the member ended it.
  - Completing Locked's emergency release ends the session as `.emergencyRelease` ("each use is logged as `sessionEnded(emergencyRelease)`"), then clears every store.
  - "Keep going" leaves everything as it was.
  - If the request arrives when nothing is running, `FocusView` releases at once.
  - Cost if wrong: which `EndReason` the ledger shows for a release-all.
- **Copy:** every string is Task 4's `FocusCopy.EndEarly`, `FocusCopy.Emergency`, `keepGoing` and `done`. The only additions are the two VoiceOver readings, both my words:
  - "Ending in 15 seconds" / "Ending in 1 second";
  - the hold dial's "4 seconds, keep holding".
- **DEBUG still frames:**
  - `-MapleDemoFocus endEarly` and `-MapleDemoEndCountdown <s>` open the sheet. The countdown is frozen at that many seconds and never ends the session.
  - `-MapleDemoHoldAt` freezes the "Hold to end" and "Hold to release" fills (`HoldButton(frozenProgress:)`), and the dial follows.
  - `-MapleDemoFocus emergency` opens the release. Adding `-MapleDemoFinishAt <s>` freezes its breath that many seconds in, while the demo's session keeps running behind it.
  - All of these are read inside `#if DEBUG`.

```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// End early, for Gentle and Steady (F1 design §5.6): a sheet over the session. Copy and timings are `FocusCopy.EndEarly`'s.
public struct EndEarlyModel: Sendable, Equatable {
    public enum Stage: Sendable, Equatable {
        /// "End this session?", with the way out still to take.
        case asking
        /// The way out was taken: the session ends when this many seconds have passed (Steady's quiet 15, Gentle's
        /// 5-second ring). "Keep going" still cancels.
        case ending(secondsLeft: Int)
    }

    public let path: SessionEndPath
    public let stage: Stage
    /// "End this session?", or "Ending in 15s" once the countdown runs.
    public let title: String
    /// The title for VoiceOver: "Ending in 15 seconds".
    public let spokenTitle: String
    /// "18 minutes saved so far. They stay yours either way.", or "This session isn't counting toward leaves."
    public let body: String
    /// The primary, "Keep going", at every stage.
    public let keepGoingTitle: String
    /// Steady while asking: "Hold to end".
    public let holdTitle: String?
    /// Gentle while asking: "End session".
    public let endTitle: String?
    /// Steady while asking and while the preset's break is unused: "Take a 5-minute break instead".
    public let breakInsteadTitle: String?
    /// Gentle's ring, 0...1 of its 5 seconds; nil when it isn't running.
    public let ringProgress: Double?

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - path: `.gentle` or `.steady` (Locked's way out is `EmergencyReleaseModel`).
    ///   - countedSeconds: This session's counted seconds so far (`FocusSessionStore.countedSoFar(_:)`).
    ///   - breakAvailable: The preset has a break, it is unused, and time is left.
    public init(path: SessionEndPath, countedSeconds: Int, breakAvailable: Bool, stage: Stage) {
        self.path = path
        self.stage = stage
        body = FocusCopy.EndEarly.savedLine(countedSeconds: countedSeconds)
        keepGoingTitle = FocusCopy.keepGoing
        switch stage {
        case .asking:
            title = FocusCopy.EndEarly.title
            spokenTitle = title
            holdTitle = path == .steady ? FocusCopy.EndEarly.holdToEnd : nil
            endTitle = path == .gentle ? FocusCopy.EndEarly.gentleEnd : nil
            breakInsteadTitle = path == .steady && breakAvailable ? FocusCopy.EndEarly.takeBreakInstead : nil
            ringProgress = nil
        case .ending(let left):
            let seconds = max(0, left)
            title = FocusCopy.EndEarly.endingIn(seconds: seconds)
            spokenTitle = "Ending in \(seconds) \(seconds == 1 ? "second" : "seconds")"
            holdTitle = nil
            endTitle = nil
            breakInsteadTitle = nil
            let ring = Self.countdown(for: .gentle)
            ringProgress = path == .gentle ? min(1, max(0, Double(ring - seconds) / Double(ring))) : nil
        }
    }

    /// How long the countdown runs once the way out is taken: Steady's 15 seconds, Gentle's 5.
    public static func countdown(for path: SessionEndPath) -> Int {
        path == .gentle ? Int(FocusCopy.EndEarly.gentleBreathSeconds) : FocusCopy.EndEarly.countdownSeconds
    }

    /// The whole seconds left of a countdown that ends at `endsAt`, rounded up: "Ending in 15s" first.
    public static func secondsLeft(until endsAt: Date, now: Date) -> Int {
        max(0, Int((endsAt.timeIntervalSince(now) - 1e-9).rounded(.up)))
    }

    /// Gentle's ring breathes once over its 5 seconds: a transform only, none under Reduce Motion.
    public static func ringScale(progress: Double, reduceMotion: Bool) -> Double {
        guard !reduceMotion else { return 1 }
        let p = min(1, max(0, progress))
        return 0.88 + 0.12 * sin(.pi * p)
    }
}

/// Locked's emergency release (F1 design §5.7, F1-1): a 10-second hold, the release as the hold completes, one slow
/// breath (4 seconds in, 4 out), then the ended state. Always there, with no allowance. Copy and timings are
/// `FocusCopy.Emergency`'s. The ended state's numeral and caption follow `ReceiptModel`'s rule for this ending.
public struct EmergencyReleaseModel: Sendable, Equatable {
    public enum Stage: Sendable, Equatable {
        /// The hold, `progress` 0...1 of its 10 seconds.
        case hold(progress: Double)
        /// Released: this many seconds into the breath; from 8 seconds, the ended state.
        case released(seconds: Double)
    }

    /// What the dial's centre shows.
    public enum Centre: Sendable, Equatable {
        /// "10s" over "hold to release" (or "keep holding").
        case countdown(numeral: String, caption: String)
        /// "Breathe in", then "and out".
        case breath(String)
        /// "18m" over "saved · they stay yours": the receipt's own numeral and caption for this ending (§5.7).
        case ended(numeral: String, caption: String)
    }

    /// The breath, in and out.
    public static var breathSeconds: TimeInterval { 2 * FocusCopy.Emergency.breathSeconds }
    /// The ended state's line and Done fade in over this (§4.6: fade-ins last at least 0.6 s).
    public static let endedFade: TimeInterval = 0.6

    /// "Emergency release".
    public let title: String
    /// "Study · Locked".
    public let subtitle: String
    public let centre: Centre
    /// The dial for VoiceOver while holding and breathing: "4 seconds, keep holding", "Breathe in". Nil once ended
    /// (the receipt's `dialLabel` reads it).
    public let spoken: String?
    /// While holding: "Ends this session now. Your 18 minutes stay yours, but it won't count as finished."; once
    /// ended: "Session ended. It won't count as finished."; nil during the breath.
    public let body: String?
    /// "Hold to release", while holding.
    public let holdTitle: String?
    /// "Keep going", while holding.
    public let keepGoingTitle: String?
    /// "Done", once ended.
    public let doneTitle: String?
    /// The ended state's numeral, line and Done, fading in: 0 during the hold and the breath.
    public let endedOpacity: Double
    /// The cool bloom's swell during the breath (a transform; 1 under Reduce Motion) and its strength.
    public let bloomScale: Double
    public let bloomOpacity: Double

    public var isEnded: Bool { if case .ended = centre { true } else { false } }
    public var isBreathing: Bool { if case .breath = centre { true } else { false } }

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - countedSeconds: The session's counted seconds (`FocusSessionStore.countedSoFar(_:)`).
    ///   - focusedSeconds: From the countdown's start to the release: the ended numeral when the session couldn't
    ///     count.
    ///   - canCount: The session could count (`FocusPlan.canCount`).
    public init(
        presetName: String, countedSeconds: Int, focusedSeconds: Int, canCount: Bool, stage: Stage, reduceMotion: Bool
    ) {
        title = FocusCopy.Emergency.title
        subtitle = FocusCopy.Emergency.subtitle(presetName: presetName)
        switch stage {
        case .hold(let raw):
            let progress = raw.isFinite ? min(1, max(0, raw)) : 0
            let numeral = FocusCopy.Emergency.secondsLeft(FocusCopy.Emergency.holdSeconds * (1 - progress))
            let caption = progress > 0 ? FocusCopy.Emergency.keepHolding : FocusCopy.Emergency.holdCaption
            centre = .countdown(numeral: numeral, caption: caption)
            let seconds = max(0, Int((FocusCopy.Emergency.holdSeconds * (1 - progress) - 1e-9).rounded(.up)))
            spoken = "\(seconds) \(seconds == 1 ? "second" : "seconds"), \(caption)"
            body = FocusCopy.Emergency.body(countedSeconds: countedSeconds)
            holdTitle = FocusCopy.Emergency.holdToRelease
            keepGoingTitle = FocusCopy.keepGoing
            doneTitle = nil
            endedOpacity = 0
            bloomScale = 1
            bloomOpacity = 1
        case .released(let raw):
            let t = raw.isFinite ? max(0, raw) : 0
            holdTitle = nil
            keepGoingTitle = nil
            if t < Self.breathSeconds {
                let words = t < FocusCopy.Emergency.breathSeconds ? FocusCopy.Emergency.breatheIn : FocusCopy.Emergency.breatheOut
                centre = .breath(words)
                spoken = words
                body = nil
                doneTitle = nil
                endedOpacity = 0
                // One swell over the breath: 0.8 → 1.25 at the turn → 0.8, as the mockup's keyframes.
                let wave = sin(.pi * t / Self.breathSeconds)
                bloomScale = reduceMotion ? 1 : 0.8 + 0.45 * wave
                bloomOpacity = 0.5 + 0.5 * wave
            } else {
                // As the receipt reads it: the counted minutes, or the minutes focused when nothing could count.
                let shown = canCount ? max(0, countedSeconds) / 60 : max(0, focusedSeconds) / 60
                centre = .ended(numeral: FocusTimeText.length(minutes: shown),
                                caption: FocusCopy.Emergency.endedCaption(countedSeconds: countedSeconds))
                spoken = nil
                body = FocusCopy.Emergency.endedLine
                doneTitle = FocusCopy.done
                endedOpacity = min(1, (t - Self.breathSeconds) / Self.endedFade)
                bloomScale = 1
                bloomOpacity = 0.5
            }
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: The routing helper**

`App/Features/Focus/FocusReleaseRouter.swift`:
```swift
import MapleCore
import MapleServices

/// Settings' "Release all apps", once its confirmation ("Release all apps? Every app Maple is resting opens again
/// now.", `FocusCopy.ReleaseAll`) is accepted (F1 design §5.12). Task 17's Settings row calls it.
///
/// - With no session running it clears every store now (`FocusSessionStore.releaseAll()`; on F1 builds, the preview
///   stores) and returns true.
/// - During a session it goes through that strictness level's own way out first and returns false: the Focus tab
///   opens on End early (Gentle, Steady) or the emergency release (Locked), through `FocusRequest.releaseAll`.
///   Completing it ends the session and clears every store; "Keep going" leaves everything as it was.
///
/// The store refreshes first, so a session that has just reached its planned end isn't sent through a way out.
@MainActor struct FocusReleaseRouter {
    let router: AppRouter

    /// - Returns: True when every store was cleared now; false when the session's way out was opened instead.
    @discardableResult func releaseAll(from sessions: FocusSessionStore) async -> Bool {
        await sessions.refresh()
        guard let running = sessions.running, !running.isEnded else {
            await sessions.releaseAll()
            return true
        }
        router.showFocus(.releaseAll)
        return false
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: End early**

`App/Features/Focus/EndEarlySheet.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// End early, for Gentle and Steady (F1 design §5.6): a sheet over the running session.
///
/// - "End this session?", the minutes saved so far (counted seconds, with this session's provisional time), and the
///   primary "Keep going", which cancels at every stage, as swiping the sheet away does.
/// - Steady: "Hold to end" for 3 seconds, then a quiet 15-second countdown, "Ending in 15s". "Take a 5-minute break
///   instead" is offered while the preset's break is unused; it is cut short at the planned end.
/// - Gentle: "End session" starts a 5-second breathing ring (a transform and an opacity only).
/// - Leaving the foreground cancels the hold (`HoldButton`) and the countdown alike.
///
/// The sheet only decides. `onEnd` runs when the countdown reaches zero; the session screen ends the session once
/// the sheet has gone, so the receipt never appears under a sheet.
struct EndEarlySheet: View {
    let session: SessionRecord
    /// `.gentle` or `.steady`.
    let path: SessionEndPath
    let onKeepGoing: () -> Void
    let onBreakInstead: () -> Void
    let onEnd: () -> Void

    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.scenePhase) private var scenePhase
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions

    /// When the countdown ends, on the store's trusted time; nil while asking.
    @State private var endsAt: Date?
    @State private var holdProgress = 0.0

    init(
        session: SessionRecord, path: SessionEndPath, onKeepGoing: @escaping () -> Void,
        onBreakInstead: @escaping () -> Void, onEnd: @escaping () -> Void
    ) {
        self.session = session
        self.path = path
        self.onKeepGoing = onKeepGoing
        self.onBreakInstead = onBreakInstead
        self.onEnd = onEnd
    }

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: path == .gentle ? 1.0 / 30 : 0.25, paused: endsAt == nil)) { _ in
            let now = sessions.now
            content(model(at: now), ring: ring(at: now))
        }
        .presentationDetents(dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize ? [.large] : [.medium])
        .presentationDragIndicator(.visible)
        .presentationBackground(theme.colors.surface2)
        .onChange(of: scenePhase) { _, phase in
            // Holds and countdowns cancel when Maple leaves the foreground (§5.7).
            if phase != .active { cancelCountdown() }
        }
        .task(id: endsAt) {
            guard let endsAt, frozenCountdown == nil else { return }
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(max(0, endsAt.timeIntervalSince(sessions.now))))
            guard !Task.isCancelled, self.endsAt == endsAt else { return }
            onEnd()
        }
    }

    private func content(_ model: EndEarlyModel, ring: Double?) -> some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: theme.spacing.md) {
                Text(model.title)
                    .font(MapleFont.sectionTitle)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .accessibilityLabel(Text(model.spokenTitle))
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                Text(model.body)
                    .font(MapleFont.callout)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                if let ring {
                    breathingRing(ring)
                }
                VStack(spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
                    Button(model.keepGoingTitle, action: keepGoing)
                        .buttonStyle(.moonlight)
                    if let hold = model.holdTitle {
                        HoldButton(
                            title: hold, duration: FocusCopy.EndEarly.holdSeconds, accessibilityName: hold,
                            progress: $holdProgress, frozenProgress: frozenHold, onComplete: startCountdown
                        )
                    }
                    if let end = model.endTitle {
                        Button(end, action: startCountdown)
                            .buttonStyle(.glassCapsule)
                    }
                    if let instead = model.breakInsteadTitle {
                        TextLink(instead, chevron: false, action: onBreakInstead)
                    }
                }
                .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xs)
            }
            .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.homeMargin)
            .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xl)
            .padding(.bottom, theme.spacing.md)
        }
        .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
    }

    /// Gentle's ring: one slow swell over its 5 seconds.
    private func breathingRing(_ progress: Double) -> some View {
        Circle()
            .stroke(theme.dial.rest, lineWidth: 2)
            .frame(width: 88, height: 88)
            .scaleEffect(EndEarlyModel.ringScale(progress: progress, reduceMotion: reduceMotion))
            .opacity(0.55 + 0.45 * sin(.pi * min(1, max(0, progress))))
            .padding(theme.spacing.xs)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    // MARK: State

    private func model(at now: Date) -> EndEarlyModel {
        let stage: EndEarlyModel.Stage
        if let frozen = frozenCountdown {
            stage = .ending(secondsLeft: frozen)
        } else if let endsAt {
            stage = .ending(secondsLeft: EndEarlyModel.secondsLeft(until: endsAt, now: now))
        } else {
            stage = .asking
        }
        let breakAvailable = session.plan.breakSeconds > 0 && !session.breakUsed && session.secondsLeft(at: now) > 0
        return EndEarlyModel(path: path, countedSeconds: sessions.countedSoFar(session.id), breakAvailable: breakAvailable,
                             stage: stage)
    }

    /// Gentle's ring, 0…1 through its 5 seconds, smoothly; nil for Steady and while asking.
    private func ring(at now: Date) -> Double? {
        guard path == .gentle else { return nil }
        if let frozen = frozenCountdown {
            return EndEarlyModel(path: .gentle, countedSeconds: 0, breakAvailable: false, stage: .ending(secondsLeft: frozen))
                .ringProgress
        }
        guard let endsAt else { return nil }
        let length = Double(EndEarlyModel.countdown(for: .gentle))
        return 1 - min(1, max(0, endsAt.timeIntervalSince(now) / length))
    }

    // MARK: Actions

    private func startCountdown() {
        guard endsAt == nil else { return }
        let seconds = EndEarlyModel.countdown(for: path)
        endsAt = sessions.now.addingTimeInterval(TimeInterval(seconds))
    }

    private func cancelCountdown() {
        endsAt = nil
        holdProgress = 0
    }

    private func keepGoing() {
        cancelCountdown()
        onKeepGoing()
    }

    // MARK: DEBUG still frames

    /// `-MapleDemoEndCountdown <s>`: the countdown frozen at that many seconds; it never ends the session.
    private var frozenCountdown: Int? {
        #if DEBUG
        return DemoLaunchOptions.current.endCountdown
        #else
        return nil
        #endif
    }

    /// `-MapleDemoHoldAt 0…1`: "Hold to end" frozen at that fill.
    private var frozenHold: Double? {
        #if DEBUG
        return DemoLaunchOptions.current.holdAt
        #else
        return nil
        #endif
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: The emergency release**

`App/Features/Focus/EmergencyReleaseView.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// Locked's emergency release (F1 design §5.7, F1-1): a full screen, with the tab bar tucked away.
///
/// - **Holding:** "Emergency release" over "Study · Locked". The dial is in the hold state, its marks filling
///   clockwise as "Hold to release" is held for 10 seconds, with "10s" over "hold to release" in the centre
///   ("keep holding" while pressed). Letting go early drains it, and leaving the foreground cancels it
///   (`HoldButton`). "Keep going" goes back to the session. There is no limit and no allowance.
/// - **Released:** the release happens when the hold completes, so the breath can't trap anyone. Then "Breathe in"
///   for 4 seconds and "and out" for 4, while the cool bloom swells and settles (a transform and an opacity), then
///   the ended state: "18m", "saved · they stay yours", "Session ended. It won't count as finished." and "Done".
///
/// The session screen shows the hold. Once the store has ended the session, the receipt route shows the released
/// stage from the session's end, so the breath carries on across the change and a later look opens on the ended
/// state.
struct EmergencyReleaseView: View {
    enum Stage: Hashable {
        /// The session runs: the 10-second hold.
        case holding
        /// Released at `endedAt` (trusted time): the breath, then the ended state.
        case released(endedAt: Date)
    }

    let session: SessionRecord
    let stage: Stage
    /// The receipt, once the session has ended: the ended dial's marks and its VoiceOver reading.
    let receipt: ReceiptModel?
    /// DEBUG still frames: this many seconds into the breath, frozen.
    let frozenSeconds: Double?
    let onKeepGoing: () -> Void
    let onRelease: () -> Void
    let onDone: () -> Void

    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions

    @State private var holdProgress = 0.0
    /// The breath and the ended state's fade are over: the timeline stops.
    @State private var isSettled = false
    @State private var announcedEnd = false

    /// The breath, then the ended state's fade.
    private static var settledAfter: TimeInterval { EmergencyReleaseModel.breathSeconds + EmergencyReleaseModel.endedFade }

    init(
        session: SessionRecord, stage: Stage, receipt: ReceiptModel? = nil, frozenSeconds: Double? = nil,
        onKeepGoing: @escaping () -> Void = {}, onRelease: @escaping () -> Void = {}, onDone: @escaping () -> Void = {}
    ) {
        self.session = session
        self.stage = stage
        self.receipt = receipt
        self.frozenSeconds = frozenSeconds
        self.onKeepGoing = onKeepGoing
        self.onRelease = onRelease
        self.onDone = onDone
    }

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            switch stage {
            case .holding:
                screen(model(.hold(progress: holdProgress)))
            case .released(let endedAt):
                TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 30, paused: isSettled || frozenSeconds != nil)) { _ in
                    let seconds = frozenSeconds ?? sessions.now.timeIntervalSince(endedAt)
                    screen(model(.released(seconds: seconds)))
                }
            }
        }
        .toolbarVisibility(.hidden, for: .tabBar)
        .task(id: stage) { await settle() }
    }

    private func screen(_ model: EmergencyReleaseModel) -> some View {
        SessionScreen(title: model.title, subtitle: model.subtitle) { diameter in
            dial(model, diameter: diameter)
        } lines: {
            if let body = model.body {
                Text(body)
                    .font(MapleFont.callout)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .opacity(model.isEnded ? model.endedOpacity : 1)
            }
        } controls: {
            if let hold = model.holdTitle {
                HoldButton(
                    title: hold, duration: FocusCopy.Emergency.holdSeconds, accessibilityName: hold,
                    progress: $holdProgress, frozenProgress: frozenHold, onComplete: onRelease
                )
            }
            if let keepGoing = model.keepGoingTitle {
                TextLink(keepGoing, chevron: false, action: onKeepGoing)
            }
            if case .released = stage {
                // Done holds its place through the breath, so nothing moves when it fades in.
                Button(FocusCopy.done, action: onDone)
                    .buttonStyle(.moonlight)
                    .opacity(model.endedOpacity)
                    .allowsHitTesting(model.isEnded)
                    .accessibilityHidden(!model.isEnded)
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: model.isEnded) { _, ended in
            guard ended, !announcedEnd else { return }
            announcedEnd = true
            // The session ending is a milestone (§4.9).
            AccessibilityNotification.Announcement(FocusCopy.Emergency.endedLine).post()
        }
    }

    /// The hold's dial, the breath's (every mark held, the bloom swelling), and the ended state's (the receipt's
    /// marks), cross-fading as the ended state comes in. VoiceOver reads it as one element.
    private func dial(_ model: EmergencyReleaseModel, diameter: CGFloat) -> some View {
        let side = diameter * MinuteDialMetrics.bloomScale
        let held = model.holdTitle != nil ? holdProgress : 1
        return ZStack {
            Circle()
                .fill(RadialGradient(
                    colors: [theme.dial.restBloom, theme.dial.restBloom.opacity(0)], center: .center,
                    startRadius: 0, endRadius: side / 2
                ))
                .frame(width: side, height: side)
                .scaleEffect(model.bloomScale)
                .opacity(model.bloomOpacity)
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
            if model.endedOpacity < 1 {
                MinuteDial(frame: holdFrame(progress: held), diameter: diameter, theme: theme) {
                    centre(model, diameter: diameter)
                }
                .opacity(1 - model.endedOpacity)
            }
            if case .ended(let numeral, let caption) = model.centre {
                MinuteDial(frame: endedFrame, diameter: diameter, theme: theme) {
                    DialCentre(leaf: nil, numeral: DialCentre.numeralParts(numeral), caption: caption, diameter: diameter)
                }
                .opacity(model.endedOpacity)
            }
        }
        .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(Text(model.spoken ?? receipt?.dialLabel ?? endedReading(model)))
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func centre(_ model: EmergencyReleaseModel, diameter: CGFloat) -> some View {
        switch model.centre {
        case .countdown(let numeral, let caption):
            DialCentre(leaf: nil, numeral: DialCentre.numeralParts(numeral), caption: caption, diameter: diameter)
        case .breath(let words):
            DialCentre(leaf: nil, numeral: [.value(words)], caption: nil, diameter: diameter)
        case .ended:
            DialCentre(leaf: nil, numeral: [.value(FocusCopy.Emergency.breatheOut)], caption: nil, diameter: diameter)
        }
    }

    /// The hold's marks, filling clockwise; the bloom is drawn here instead, so the breath can swell it.
    private func holdFrame(progress: Double) -> DialFrame {
        var frame = DialFrame.hold(progress: progress)
        frame.bloom = .hidden
        return frame
    }

    /// The marks as the session counted them: the receipt's, or worked out from the credit while the receipt isn't
    /// there yet (the hold's last moment, and DEBUG still frames).
    private var endedFrame: DialFrame {
        let marks = receipt?.marks ?? ReceiptMarks.marks(
            layout: DialLayout(plannedMinutes: session.plan.plannedMinutes), countdownStart: session.countdownStart,
            stretches: sessions.credit(for: session.id)?.stretches ?? []
        )
        var frame = DialFrame.receipt(marks: marks, isGold: false, fill: DialFill())
        frame.bloom = .hidden
        return frame
    }

    private func endedReading(_ model: EmergencyReleaseModel) -> String {
        guard case .ended(let numeral, let caption) = model.centre else { return model.title }
        return "\(numeral), \(caption)"
    }

    private func model(_ stage: EmergencyReleaseModel.Stage) -> EmergencyReleaseModel {
        let end = session.endedAt ?? sessions.now
        return EmergencyReleaseModel(
            presetName: session.plan.presetName, countedSeconds: sessions.countedSoFar(session.id),
            focusedSeconds: Int(max(0, end.timeIntervalSince(session.countdownStart))), canCount: session.plan.canCount,
            stage: stage, reduceMotion: reduceMotion
        )
    }

    /// Stops the timeline once the breath and the fade are over.
    private func settle() async {
        guard case .released(let endedAt) = stage, frozenSeconds == nil else { return }
        isSettled = false
        let left = Self.settledAfter - sessions.now.timeIntervalSince(endedAt)
        if left > 0 { try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(left)) }
        guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
        isSettled = true
    }

    /// `-MapleDemoHoldAt 0…1`: "Hold to release" frozen at that fill, and the dial with it.
    private var frozenHold: Double? {
        #if DEBUG
        return DemoLaunchOptions.current.holdAt
        #else
        return nil
        #endif
    }
}
```

```swift
    @AccessibilityFocusState private var controlsFocused: Bool
    /// End early's sheet over the session (Gentle, Steady, §5.6).
    @State private var showsEndEarly = false
    /// Locked's emergency release, in this screen's place (§5.7).
    @State private var showsEmergency = false
    /// When the emergency hold completed, on trusted time: the breath starts at once, before the store has ended the
    /// session and the receipt has taken over.
    @State private var releasedAt: Date?
    /// The sheet's countdown reached zero: the session ends once the sheet has gone.
    @State private var endsWhenDismissed = false
    /// Settings' "Release all apps" came this way: completing the way out also clears every store (§5.12).
    @State private var releasesAll = false

    init(sessionID: UUID) {
        self.sessionID = sessionID
    }

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if showsEmergency, let session {
                EmergencyReleaseView(
                    session: session, stage: emergencyStage, frozenSeconds: frozenBreath,
                    onKeepGoing: keepGoing, onRelease: release
                )
            } else {
                sessionScreen
            }
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: $showsEndEarly, onDismiss: endEarlyDismissed) {
            if let session {
                EndEarlySheet(
                    session: session, path: endPath,
                    onKeepGoing: { showsEndEarly = false },
                    onBreakInstead: breakInstead,
                    onEnd: {
                        endsWhenDismissed = true
                        showsEndEarly = false
                    }
                )
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: tab.releasesAll, initial: true) { _, asked in
            // Settings' "Release all apps" during this session (`FocusReleaseRouter`).
            guard asked else { return }
            tab.releasesAll = false
            releasesAll = true
            takeEndPath()
        }
    }

    /// The release's stage: the hold, or the breath from the moment the hold completed.
    private var emergencyStage: EmergencyReleaseView.Stage {
        if let frozenBreath { return .released(endedAt: sessions.now.addingTimeInterval(-frozenBreath)) }
        return releasedAt.map { .released(endedAt: $0) } ?? .holding
    }

    /// DEBUG still frames: `-MapleDemoFinishAt <s>` with `-MapleDemoFocus emergency` freezes the release's breath that
    /// many seconds in, while the demo's session keeps running behind it.
    private var frozenBreath: Double? {
        #if DEBUG
        let options = DemoLaunchOptions.current
        return options.focus == .emergency ? options.finishAt : nil
        #else
        return nil
        #endif
    }
```

Second, replace
```swift

```

```swift
    /// "End early" or "Emergency release", by the session's strictness.
    private func takeEndPath() {
        wake()
        switch endPath {
        case .emergency: showsEmergency = true
        case .gentle, .steady: showsEndEarly = true
        }
    }

    /// The sheet has gone: the session ends if its countdown reached zero; otherwise the member kept going.
    private func endEarlyDismissed() {
        wake()
        guard endsWhenDismissed else {
            releasesAll = false
            return
        }
        endsWhenDismissed = false
        let clearsAll = releasesAll
        releasesAll = false
        Task {
            // Through Release all apps the store ends the session as `.releaseAll` while it clears every store (R4).
            if clearsAll {
                await sessions.releaseAll()
            } else {
                await sessions.end(.endedEarly)
            }
        }
    }

    /// "Take a 5-minute break instead": the sheet closes and the break starts, cut short at the planned end.
    private func breakInstead() {
        releasesAll = false
        showsEndEarly = false
        takeBreak()
    }

    /// The emergency release's "Keep going": back to the session, nothing changed.
    private func keepGoing() {
        releasesAll = false
        showsEmergency = false
        wake()
    }

    /// The 10-second hold completed: the release happens now, so the breath can't trap anyone (§5.7). Each use is
    /// logged as `sessionEnded(emergencyRelease)`; through Release all apps every store is cleared after it.
    private func release() {
        guard releasedAt == nil else { return }
        releasedAt = sessions.now
        let clearsAll = releasesAll
        releasesAll = false
        Task {
            await sessions.end(.emergencyRelease)
            if clearsAll { await sessions.releaseAll() }
        }
    }
```

### Task 13: The receipt

The session's final frame (F1 design §5.8) replaces Task 8's receipt placeholder.
- The finish plays once, and only within 10 minutes of the end; later, the final frame shows still.
- The receipt shows "50m" over "saved · 2h 10m today" (tapping it opens Saved today), the leaf line, the breakdown, an optional "How did it go?", Done, and "Again · 50m". Again follows start readiness, with a hold for Locked.
- An emergency release shows §5.7's breath and ended state instead.
- Each receipt is shown once (P5). A notification tap shows it again.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **The receipt is decided once, at `shownAt`.** `shownAt` is the trusted time when it first appears. `ReceiptModel` is built with `now: shownAt`, so `playsFinish`, the ending and the leaf lines don't change while the member reads them, even across the 10-minute mark. Cost if wrong: none visible.
- **Shown once (P5):**
  - The first look sets `AppSettings.lastReceiptSeen` to this session, but only when it is the receipt `ReceiptPicker.pending` would pick. So opening an older receipt from its notification never hides a newer, unseen one.
  - Task 8's `FocusTabState.shownReceipt` keeps it on screen until Done.
  - Cost if wrong: one condition.
- **Which leaves this session opened** (`ReceiptFlow.unlocks`):
  - the store's `sessionUnlocks`, only while the store's `lastEnded` is this session;
  - plus every Focus-category leaf (hours, sessions finished, focus streak) the collection dated inside the session, so a relaunch after the end still names it.

  Held until morning is `RevealSchedule.isHeld` at `shownAt`, for a single leaf.
- **"Saved today"** is the focus book's seconds on the session's own Maple day (`collection.focus.seconds(on: plan.day)`), so yesterday's receipt reads yesterday's total.
- **The centre leaf** (`ReceiptFlow.centreLeaf`):
  - The hours leaf this session opened, grown and gold (`DialFill(opened: 1)`, which also makes the bloom gold).
  - Otherwise the next hours leaf (Task 9's `FocusStores.nextHoursLeaf(at:collection:)`, at `shownAt`), filled with `DialFill(rung:sessionHours:)` (Task 6), which splits it into what was saved before and this session's share.
  - None for a plain timer or a selection that can't count.
- **"Ended at 18 of 50m"** sits just above the dial, over the counted time, in the secondary footnote style.
- **Tapping the numeral opens Saved today:**
  - The whole dial is the target, because the numeral is the dial's centre.
  - VoiceOver reads the dial as one button: `dialLabel`, the hint "Opens Saved today", and an action that opens it.
  - It sets `tab.sheet = .saved`, which Task 14's `FocusTabSheetContent` shows.
  - The hint is my words, the same as Task 14's later `FocusSheetCopy.savedTodayHint`; Task 14 points `ReceiptView` at that constant and removes this one.
- **Again (F1-20):**
  - Readiness is Task 9's `FocusStores.startScreen(preset:minutes:at:collection:settings:locale:).readiness` for the session's preset at its planned length, at `sessions.now`: the very model the start screen and Home read, so the three never disagree.
  - Again is hidden while `focusStores` is missing, as it is in a bare preview.
  - `.ready(needsHold: false)`: a text link that starts at once (`FocusStores.start`, `from: .again`).
  - `.ready(needsHold: true)`: a `HoldButton` of 1.5 s, named "Hold to start, Locked 50 minutes".
  - `.needsStartScreen`: the link opens the start screen with the preset, the length and the intention selected.
  - A start the store refuses opens the start screen the same way. After `.blockingFailed`, `tab.plainTimer = .lockFailed`, so the start screen offers the plain timer (§5.1).
  - The label stays "Again · 50m" for the hold as well: those are the design's words, and the hold is the gesture.
  - Again is hidden when the preset has been deleted.
  - Cost if wrong: the hold's label.
- **The reflection carries forward:**
  - A chip calls `FocusSessionStore.reflect(_:on:)`. F1a's `reflections` and `SessionNotesStore.entries(reflections:)` put "Partly" and "Not yet" first among the next start's chips, and drop "All done".
  - Again's own intention follows the same rule (`ReceiptFlow.againIntention`).
  - There is no un-select, because the ledger only appends.
- **The finish:**
  - A `TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1/30))` runs only while it plays (§4.8: 30 fps), and stops at `FinishTimeline.settledTime`.
  - The soft impact plays at `FinishTimeline.hapticTime`, and the dial's reading is announced once as it starts (the session ending is a milestone, §4.9).
  - The leaf line and breakdown fade in with `lineOpacity`/`lineRise`; "How did it go?", Done and Again with `actionsOpacity`/`actionsRise`.
  - A receipt that doesn't play shows `FinishTimeline`'s settled frame.
- **An emergency release's receipt** is `EmergencyReleaseView` (Task 12) in its released stage, from the session's end: the breath if it is still under way, otherwise the ended state with "Done".
- **A notification tap** reaches the receipt through Task 8's `FocusRequest.receipt(id)`, which sets `shownReceipt`. Task 17's `RootView` (from `NotificationRouter.tappedReceipt`) sends it, so nothing here listens for notifications.
- **DEBUG:**
  - `-MapleDemoFinishAt <s>` freezes the finish (or an emergency receipt's breath) that many seconds in.
  - `-MapleDemoHoldAt` freezes Locked's Again.
  - Both are read inside `#if DEBUG`.

```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// What the receipt does around `ReceiptModel` (F1 design §5.8, F1-20): which leaves this session opened, Again by
/// start readiness, and the intention Again carries forward.
public enum ReceiptFlow {
    /// What "Again · 50m" does, from the start readiness of the session's preset at its planned length, now.
    public enum Again: Sendable, Equatable {
        /// One tap starts it.
        case start
        /// Locked: Again is a hold, like every Locked start (§5.2).
        case hold
        /// The start screen has something to say first: Again opens it with the preset and length selected.
        case openStartScreen
    }

    /// The leaf in the receipt dial's centre (§4.3).
    public struct CentreLeaf: Sendable, Equatable {
        public let speciesID: String
        /// This session opened it: it grows into the centre, gold. Otherwise it is the next hours leaf, filled with
        /// what was saved before and during the session.
        public let opened: Bool

        public init(speciesID: String, opened: Bool) {
            self.speciesID = speciesID
            self.opened = opened
        }
    }

    /// The numeral's VoiceOver hint: tapping it opens Saved today (§5.8).
    public static let savedTodayHint = "Opens Saved today"

    /// The hours leaf this session opened, else the next hours leaf (`next`, after this session's credit); nil when
    /// the session couldn't count (a plain timer, a selection that doesn't qualify) or no hours leaf is left.
    public static func centreLeaf(
        unlocks: [LeafUnlock], next: LeafProgress?, canCount: Bool, catalog: RewardCatalog = .shared
    ) -> CentreLeaf? {
        guard canCount else { return nil }
        if let opened = unlocks.first(where: { catalog.reward(forSpecies: $0.speciesID)?.categoryID == .hoursSaved }) {
            return CentreLeaf(speciesID: opened.speciesID, opened: true)
        }
        guard let next, next.category == .hoursSaved, next.state == .locked else { return nil }
        return CentreLeaf(speciesID: next.speciesID, opened: false)
    }

    public static func again(_ readiness: StartReadiness) -> Again {
        switch readiness {
        case .ready(let needsHold): needsHold ? .hold : .start
        case .needsStartScreen: .openStartScreen
        }
    }

    /// The intention Again starts with: this session's, unless the member said "All done" (§5.8: the reflection
    /// carries forward).
    public static func againIntention(_ intention: String?, reflection: Reflection?) -> String? {
        guard reflection != .allDone else { return nil }
        return intention.flatMap { RecentIntentions.normalized($0) }
    }

    /// The Focus leaves this session opened, for `ReceiptModel(unlocks:)`, oldest first. The store's
    /// `sessionUnlocks` count only when they belong to this session (`storeSession`, the store's `lastEnded`), and any
    /// Focus leaf the collection dated inside the session is added, so a relaunch after the end still names it.
    public static func unlocks(
        store: [LeafUnlock], storeSession: UUID?, collection: [LeafUnlock], session: SessionRecord,
        catalog: RewardCatalog = .shared
    ) -> [LeafUnlock] {
        let focus: Set<RewardCategoryID> = [.hoursSaved, .sessionsFinished, .focusStreak]
        let until = (session.endedAt ?? session.plannedEnd).addingTimeInterval(1)
        let dated = collection.filter { unlock in
            guard let category = catalog.reward(forSpecies: unlock.speciesID)?.categoryID else { return false }
            return focus.contains(category) && unlock.date >= session.countdownStart && unlock.date <= until
        }
        var seen = Set<String>()
        let own = storeSession == session.id ? store : []
        return (own + dated).filter { seen.insert($0.speciesID).inserted }.sorted { $0.date < $1.date }
    }

    /// The one opened leaf waits for the morning (F1-12): it was earned in wind-down or at night and is still
    /// unopened. False for none or several, which read without it.
    public static func heldUntilMorning(
        _ unlocks: [LeafUnlock], schedule: WeeklySleepSchedule, calendar: Calendar, at date: Date
    ) -> Bool {
        guard unlocks.count == 1, let only = unlocks.first else { return false }
        return RevealSchedule.isHeld(only, at: date, schedule: schedule, calendar: calendar)
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// The session's final frame (F1 design §5.8): "Study · Chemistry ch. 4" over "Apps open again", with no ⌄.
///
/// - **The finish (§4.6)** plays once, when the receipt first shows, and only within 10 minutes of the end
///   (`ReceiptModel.playsFinish`, decided once at `shownAt`): the counted marks sweep gold (or every mark white when
///   nothing counted), an opened leaf grows into the centre, the glow pulses, a ring ripples out, the numeral, the
///   leaf line, then Done and Again fade in, and a soft impact plays. Later, the final frame shows still.
/// - "50m" over "saved · 2h 10m today"; tapping the dial (its numeral) opens Saved today.
/// - The leaf line, the breakdown, "How did it go?" (All done · Partly · Not yet), Done, and "Again · 50m", which
///   follows start readiness: one tap, a hold in Locked, or the start screen when it has something to say.
/// - An emergency release shows §5.7's breath and ended state instead (`EmergencyReleaseView`).
/// - Shown once: the first look marks it seen (`AppSettings.lastReceiptSeen`); the tab keeps it on screen until Done
///   (`FocusTabState.shownReceipt`). A notification tap shows it again (`FocusRequest.receipt`).
struct ReceiptView: View {
    let sessionID: UUID

    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.focusStores) private var focusStores
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions
    @Environment(PresetStore.self) private var presets
    @Environment(AppSetStore.self) private var appSets
    @Environment(SessionNotesStore.self) private var notes
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @Environment(AppSettings.self) private var settings
    @Environment(FocusTabState.self) private var tab

    /// When the receipt first showed, on trusted time: the finish and the leaf lines are decided at this moment.
    @State private var shownAt: Date?
    /// The finish's first frame, on the wall clock that drives the timeline.
    @State private var finishStart = Date()
    /// The finish has come to rest: the timeline stops.
    @State private var isSettled = false
    @State private var finishImpact = 0
    @State private var againProgress = 0.0
    @State private var isStarting = false

    init(sessionID: UUID) {
        self.sessionID = sessionID
    }

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if let session, let shownAt {
                receipt(session, shownAt: shownAt)
            } else {
                Color.clear
            }
        }
        .onAppear(perform: appeared)
        .sensoryFeedback(.impact(flexibility: .soft, intensity: 0.5), trigger: finishImpact)
    }

    private var session: SessionRecord? {
        sessions.sessions.first { $0.id == sessionID }
    }

    // MARK: The receipt

    @ViewBuilder
    private func receipt(_ session: SessionRecord, shownAt: Date) -> some View {
        let unlocks = ReceiptFlow.unlocks(
            store: sessions.sessionUnlocks, storeSession: sessions.lastEnded?.id, collection: collection.unlocks,
            session: session
        )
        let next = focusStores?.nextHoursLeaf(at: shownAt, collection: collection)
        let model = ReceiptModel(
            session: session, credit: sessions.credit(for: session.id), unlocks: unlocks,
            heldUntilMorning: ReceiptFlow.heldUntilMorning(
                unlocks, schedule: collection.schedule, calendar: collection.context.calendar, at: shownAt
            ),
            next: next, todaySeconds: collection.focus.seconds(on: session.plan.day), reflection: session.reflection,
            now: shownAt, locale: locale, calendar: collection.context.calendar
        )
        if model.ending == .emergency {
            EmergencyReleaseView(
                session: session, stage: .released(endedAt: session.endedAt ?? shownAt), receipt: model,
                frozenSeconds: frozenFinish, onDone: done
            )
        } else {
            let centre = ReceiptFlow.centreLeaf(unlocks: unlocks, next: next, canCount: session.plan.canCount)
            let fill = centreFill(centre, next: next, countedSeconds: model.countedSeconds)
            let frame = DialFrame.receipt(marks: model.marks, isGold: model.isGold, fill: fill)
            let plays = model.playsFinish && frozenFinish == nil
            TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 30, paused: !plays || isSettled)) { context in
                let time = frozenFinish ?? (plays
                    ? context.date.timeIntervalSince(finishStart)
                    : FinishTimeline.settledTime(markCount: frame.marks.count, reduceMotion: reduceMotion))
                let finish = FinishTimeline.frame(
                    at: time, counted: frame.gold, leafOpened: fill.opened > 0, reduceMotion: reduceMotion
                )
                screen(model, session: session, frame: frame, centre: centre, finish: finish)
            }
            .task(id: plays) { await playFinish(plays, markCount: frame.marks.count, announcing: model.dialLabel) }
        }
    }

    private func screen(
        _ model: ReceiptModel, session: SessionRecord, frame: DialFrame, centre: ReceiptFlow.CentreLeaf?,
        finish: FinishFrame
    ) -> some View {
        let title = FocusCopy.sessionTitle(presetName: session.plan.presetName, intention: notes.intention(for: session.id))
        return SessionScreen(title: title, subtitle: model.subtitle) { diameter in
            VStack(spacing: theme.spacing.xs) {
                if let note = model.note {
                    // "Ended at 18 of 50m", over the counted time.
                    Text(note)
                        .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                }
                dial(model, frame: frame, centre: centre, finish: finish, diameter: diameter)
            }
        } lines: {
            if let leafLine = model.leafLine {
                Text(leafLine)
                    .font(MapleFont.callout)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .opacity(finish.lineOpacity)
                    .offset(y: finish.lineRise)
            }
            if let breakdown = model.breakdown {
                Text(breakdown)
                    .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                    .opacity(finish.lineOpacity)
                    .offset(y: finish.lineRise)
            }
            if let prompt = model.reflectionPrompt {
                reflection(prompt, choices: model.choices)
                    .opacity(finish.actionsOpacity)
                    .offset(y: finish.actionsRise)
            }
        } controls: {
            Button(FocusCopy.done, action: done)
                .buttonStyle(.moonlight)
                .opacity(finish.actionsOpacity)
                .offset(y: finish.actionsRise)
            if let again = model.again {
                againControl(again, session: session)
                    .opacity(finish.actionsOpacity)
                    .offset(y: finish.actionsRise)
            }
        }
    }

    /// The dial as the session counted it, with the finish over it. Tapping it (its numeral) opens Saved today.
    private func dial(
        _ model: ReceiptModel, frame: DialFrame, centre: ReceiptFlow.CentreLeaf?, finish: FinishFrame, diameter: CGFloat
    ) -> some View {
        let leaf = centre.flatMap { LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: $0.speciesID) }
        return MinuteDial(frame: frame, diameter: diameter, theme: theme) {
            DialCentre(
                leaf: leaf.map { DialLeaf(species: $0, fill: frame.fill) }, numeral: model.numeralParts,
                caption: model.caption, diameter: diameter
            )
            .finishing(finish)
        }
        .finishing(finish)
        .contentShape(Circle())
        .onTapGesture(perform: openSavedToday)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(Text(model.dialLabel))
        .accessibilityHint(Text(ReceiptFlow.savedTodayHint))
        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton)
        .accessibilityAction(perform: openSavedToday)
    }

    /// "How did it go?" with one tap: All done · Partly · Not yet. "Partly" and "Not yet" put the intention first
    /// among the next start's chips; "All done" drops it (§5.8, through `FocusSessionStore.reflections`).
    private func reflection(_ prompt: String, choices: [ReceiptModel.Choice]) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: theme.spacing.xs) {
            Text(prompt)
                .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
            ChipFlow(spacing: theme.spacing.xs, lineSpacing: theme.spacing.xs, alignment: .center) {
                ForEach(choices, id: \.reflection) { choice in
                    Chip(choice.title, isSelected: choice.isSelected) {
                        reflect(choice.reflection)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.sm)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
    }

    /// "Again · 50m": one tap when the start screen has nothing to say, a 1.5-second hold in Locked (§5.2), and
    /// otherwise the start screen with the preset and length selected (F1-20). Hidden when the preset is gone.
    @ViewBuilder
    private func againControl(_ title: String, session: SessionRecord) -> some View {
        if let preset = presets.preset(id: session.plan.presetID), let readiness = againReadiness(preset, session: session) {
            switch ReceiptFlow.again(readiness) {
            case .hold:
                HoldButton(
                    title: title, duration: FocusCopy.holdToStartSeconds,
                    accessibilityName: FocusCopy.holdToStartName(minutes: session.plan.plannedMinutes, locale: locale),
                    progress: $againProgress, frozenProgress: frozenHold
                ) {
                    startAgain(preset, session: session)
                }
            case .start:
                TextLink(title, chevron: false) { startAgain(preset, session: session) }
                    .disabled(isStarting)
            case .openStartScreen:
                TextLink(title, chevron: false) { openStartScreen(preset, session: session, lockFailed: false) }
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: Inputs

    /// The centre leaf's fill: gold once this session opened it; otherwise the next leaf's rung, split into what
    /// was saved before and this session's counted share.
    private func centreFill(_ centre: ReceiptFlow.CentreLeaf?, next: LeafProgress?, countedSeconds: Int) -> DialFill {
        guard let centre else { return DialFill() }
        if centre.opened { return DialFill(before: 1, session: 0, opened: 1) }
        guard let next else { return DialFill() }
        return DialFill(rung: next, sessionHours: Double(countedSeconds) / 3600)
    }

    /// The start readiness of the session's preset at its planned length, now (F1-20): Task 9's start-screen model,
    /// the one the start screen and Home read.
    private func againReadiness(_ preset: FocusPreset, session: SessionRecord) -> StartReadiness? {
        focusStores?.startScreen(
            preset: preset, minutes: session.plan.plannedMinutes, at: sessions.now, collection: collection,
            settings: settings, locale: locale
        ).readiness
    }

    // MARK: Actions

    private func appeared() {
        guard shownAt == nil else { return }
        // A receipt the store no longer holds (an old notification): nothing to show, so the tab moves on.
        guard session != nil else {
            tab.shownReceipt = nil
            return
        }
        let now = sessions.now
        shownAt = now
        finishStart = .now
        // Shown once (P5): mark it seen only when it is the receipt the tab would pick, so opening an older one from
        // its notification doesn't hide a newer one.
        if ReceiptPicker.pending(sessions.sessions, seen: settings.lastReceiptSeen, now: now)?.id == sessionID {
            settings.lastReceiptSeen = sessionID
        }
    }

    /// The finish's haptic as the ring sets off, the session's end announced, and the timeline stopped once
    /// everything has come to rest.
    private func playFinish(_ plays: Bool, markCount: Int, announcing reading: String) async {
        guard plays else { return }
        // The session ending is a milestone (§4.9).
        AccessibilityNotification.Announcement(reading).post()
        try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(FinishTimeline.hapticTime))
        guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
        finishImpact += 1
        let rest = FinishTimeline.settledTime(markCount: markCount, reduceMotion: reduceMotion) - FinishTimeline.hapticTime
        try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(max(0, rest)))
        guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
        isSettled = true
    }

    private func openSavedToday() {
        tab.sheet = .saved
    }

    private func reflect(_ reflection: Reflection) {
        Task { await sessions.reflect(reflection, on: sessionID) }
    }

    /// Done: the tab moves on to the start screen.
    private func done() {
        tab.shownReceipt = nil
    }

    /// Again, straight away: the same preset and length, with the intention unless the member said "All done". A
    /// start the store refuses opens the start screen with the preset selected, where Start says why.
    private func startAgain(_ preset: FocusPreset, session: SessionRecord) {
        guard !isStarting, let focusStores else { return }
        isStarting = true
        let intention = ReceiptFlow.againIntention(notes.intention(for: session.id), reflection: session.reflection)
        let appSet = preset.appSetID.flatMap { appSets.set(id: $0) }
        let request = FocusSessionStore.StartRequest(
            preset: preset, minutes: session.plan.plannedMinutes, appSet: appSet, from: .again
        )
        Task {
            let outcome = await focusStores.start(request, intention: intention, settings: settings)
            isStarting = false
            switch outcome {
            case .started, .alreadyRunning:
                // The new session's screen takes over (`FocusView` clears the receipt as it starts).
                break
            case .blockingFailed:
                openStartScreen(preset, session: session, lockFailed: true)
            case .ledgerUnavailable, .notRecorded:
                openStartScreen(preset, session: session, lockFailed: false)
            }
        }
    }

    /// The start screen, with Again's preset, length and intention selected.
    private func openStartScreen(_ preset: FocusPreset, session: SessionRecord, lockFailed: Bool) {
        tab.selectedPresetID = preset.id
        tab.minutes = session.plan.plannedMinutes
        tab.intention = ReceiptFlow.againIntention(notes.intention(for: session.id), reflection: session.reflection)
        if lockFailed { tab.plainTimer = .lockFailed }
        againProgress = 0
        done()
    }

    // MARK: DEBUG still frames

    /// `-MapleDemoFinishAt <s>`: the finish (or an emergency release's breath) frozen that many seconds in.
    private var frozenFinish: Double? {
        #if DEBUG
        return DemoLaunchOptions.current.finishAt
        #else
        return nil
        #endif
    }

    /// `-MapleDemoHoldAt 0…1`: Locked's Again frozen at that fill.
    private var frozenHold: Double? {
        #if DEBUG
        return DemoLaunchOptions.current.holdAt
        #else
        return nil
        #endif
    }
}
```

In `App/Features/Focus/FocusView.swift` (Task 8), replace
```swift
        case .receipt(let id):
            // Task 13: ReceiptView.
            FocusPlaceholder("Receipt", detail: session(id)?.plan.presetName)
```
with
```swift
        case .receipt(let id):
            ReceiptView(sessionID: id)
                .id(id)
```
`.id(id)` gives each receipt its own `shownAt`, so a notification tap that swaps one receipt for another starts it afresh. `FocusView.session(_:)` may now be unused; leave it, because Swift doesn't warn about an unused private method and Task 9 may read it.

### Task 14: Saved today, the streak sheet and the header streak

Saved today (§5.9, focus spec §3.3) and the streak sheet (§5.15) become real sheets, and Home's header streak becomes the Focus streak: a drawn amber Field maple with the current run, hidden under 2 (§5.10), which opens the streak sheet. On the Focus tab both sheets come up through Task 8's `FocusTabState.sheet` (the receipt's numeral sets `.saved`); on Home through two new `HomeSheet` cases, from the header and from the numeral.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **The streak's mark is the Field maple (`campestre`), drawn with `LeafView` in reward amber,** blades and stalk only at 16pt (outline and veins too at the sheet's 36pt), as the Home mockup draws it. `StreakLeaf.color` is the `reward` token's value as a `LeafColor`, so the stalk takes amber's own darker tone; a test pins the two together. Cost if wrong: one constant and one species id.
- **The header shows the run only once Focus ships** (`collection.context.features.focus`), so demo and live launches without F1 keep an empty header. Cost if wrong: none; under 2 it is hidden anyway.
- **VoiceOver for the header streak and the sheet's title stays in `HomeSpeech`** (MapleDesign, nonisolated, already documented as "what VoiceOver says on Home, the Tree view and the Streak sheet"): `HomeSpeech.streak(days:)` replaces `streak(nights:)` and reads "Focus streak, 12 days". Everything else new goes in a new MapleCore `FocusSheetCopy` (P3), which Task 15 extends. Cost if wrong: one function moves.
- **Home's numeral opens Saved today only while it shows today's saved time** (`NowState.Content.savedToday`). "41h saved in all" and "saved yesterday" would open a sheet about something else. Cost if wrong: one condition.
- **On Home, the demo values are Home's own:** `-MapleDemoPresent saved` and `-MapleDemoPresent streak` open Home's sheets on the Home tab (`HomeView.applyDemoPresentation`, whose doc comment already lists `streak`). With `-MapleDemoTab focus`, Task 8's `FocusDemoPresenter` opens the same sheets over the Focus tab. Cost if wrong: none.
- **Copy the design doesn't give,** in the same voice: "How we count" (the heading over Task 5's `SavedTodayModel.howWeCount` lines) and "Opens Saved today" (the numeral's VoiceOver hint). Every other line on both sheets is Task 5's: `SavedTodayModel.title`, its `emptyLine` ("Nothing saved yet today."), `StreakWeek.title`, `lines` and `weekLabel` ("3 finished days this week", read for the dots).
- **How we count shows one sentence a line,** as Task 5 gives them, in `footnote` secondary. Cost if wrong: layout only.
- **The week's dots:** finished days are filled season tint, rest days and misses are the same neutral fill (`track`), and today is an open `textSecondary` ring until it ends. Each dot has its weekday initial under it, starting on the calendar's first weekday (P8). Cost if wrong: drawing only.
- **Saved today's detents are `.medium` and `.large`** (`.large` only at accessibility sizes), and the streak sheet's are `.medium` (`.large` at accessibility sizes), with the drag indicator, as `RarityExplainerSheet` does.
