- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the copy, the leaf and the header**

`MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Focus/FocusSheetCopy.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// The words on the Focus sheets that no screen model owns (F1 design §5.9, §5.13–§5.16): Saved today and the streak
/// sheet here (their other lines are `SavedTodayModel`'s and `StreakWeek`'s); the preset editor, the Blocking sheet
/// and intention entry with Task 15. Pure, so every line is tested. Sentence case, no "!", and never "fail", "quit",
/// "streak lost" or "rest days left".
public enum FocusSheetCopy {
    // MARK: Saved today (§5.9, focus spec §3.3)

    /// VoiceOver's hint on a numeral that opens Saved today (Home's, the receipt's).
    public static let savedTodayHint = "Opens Saved today"
    /// The heading over `SavedTodayModel.howWeCount`.
    public static let howWeCountTitle = "How we count"

    // MARK: Streak sheet (§5.15)

    /// The weekday under each of the week's 7 dots, from the calendar's first weekday (ruling P8): "M T W T F S S"
    /// in en-GB, "S M T W T F S" in en-US. `StreakWeek.days` starts on the same weekday.
    public static func weekdayInitials(calendar: Calendar) -> [String] {
        let symbols = calendar.veryShortStandaloneWeekdaySymbols
        guard symbols.count == 7 else { return Array(repeating: "", count: 7) }
        let first = min(max(calendar.firstWeekday, 1), 7) - 1
        return (0..<7).map { symbols[(first + $0) % 7] }
    }
}
```

`MapleKit/Sources/MapleDesign/Home/StreakLeaf.swift`:
```swift
import MapleCore
import SwiftUI

/// The Focus streak's mark (F1 design §5.10, §5.15): a Field maple drawn in reward amber, never an SF Symbol. A run is
/// earned, so amber belongs here (spec §1.3). Blades and stalk only by default, so it reads at Home's 16pt; VoiceOver
/// hears the streak beside it, not the leaf.
///
/// ```swift
/// StreakLeaf().frame(width: 16, height: 16)                  // Home's header
/// StreakLeaf(detailed: true).frame(width: 36, height: 36)    // the streak sheet
/// ```
public struct StreakLeaf: View {
    /// The `reward` token's amber (`Theme.Colors.reward`, 0xE8A35C) as a leaf colour, so the stalk takes amber's own
    /// darker tone (`LeafColor.veinColor`).
    nonisolated public static let color = LeafColor(0xE8A35C)
    /// The Field maple, the leaf the Focus screens show.
    nonisolated public static let speciesID = "campestre"

    private let detail: LeafStyle.Detail

    /// - Parameter detailed: Outline and veins too, for a leaf of 36pt or more.
    public init(detailed: Bool = false) {
        detail = detailed ? .full : .fillOnly
    }

    public var body: some View {
        if let species = LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: Self.speciesID) ?? LeafCatalog.shared.species.first {
            LeafView(species, style: LeafStyle(fill: Self.color, detail: detail))
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
    }
}
```

`App/Features/Focus/SavedTodaySheet.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// Saved today (F1 design §5.9, focus spec §3.3): today's counted time, then each session's counted stretch with the
/// time beside it that didn't count, greyed, and why ("Unlocked 5 min", "After bedtime", "Over today's 6h",
/// "Couldn't confirm the block"), then how counting works. Opened from Home's numeral and the receipt's.
///
/// Today is the Maple day whose awake window holds the session store's trusted now, and each session's credit is the
/// store's own (`credit(for:)`), so caps and overlaps count as they do everywhere else. `.medium`, lifting to
/// `.large`; `.large` at accessibility sizes.
struct SavedTodaySheet: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions

    var body: some View {
        // Once a minute, so a running session's row keeps up between the store's 15-second refreshes.
        TimelineView(.everyMinute) { _ in
            page(model())
        }
        .presentationDetents(dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize ? [.large] : [.medium, .large])
        .presentationBackground(theme.colors.surface2)
        .presentationDragIndicator(.visible)
    }

    private func model() -> SavedTodayModel {
        let now = sessions.now
        let today = collection.snapshot.focusWindow(at: now, context: collection.context).day
        let todays = sessions.sessions.filter { $0.plan.day == today }
        return SavedTodayModel(
            credits: todays.compactMap { sessions.credit(for: $0.id) }, sessions: todays, day: today, now: now,
            calendar: collection.context.calendar, locale: locale
        )
    }

    private func page(_ model: SavedTodayModel) -> some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                Text(SavedTodayModel.title)
                    .font(MapleFont.sectionTitle)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                if let empty = model.emptyLine {
                    Text(empty)
                        .font(MapleFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xs)
                } else {
                    StatNumber(model.total, size: .stat)
                        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xs)
                    ProfileListGroup {
                        ForEach(model.rows) { row in
                            SavedTodayRow(title: row.title, reasons: row.reasons)
                        }
                    }
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.md)
                }
                Text(FocusSheetCopy.howWeCountTitle)
                    .font(MapleFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.lg)
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.xxs) {
                    ForEach(SavedTodayModel.howWeCount, id: \.self) { line in
                        Text(line)
                            .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                            .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                            .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                    }
                }
                .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xxs)
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
            .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xl)
            .padding(.bottom, theme.spacing.lg)
        }
        .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
    }
}

/// One session's counted stretch, with the time that didn't count under it in secondary, and why. One VoiceOver
/// element per session.
private struct SavedTodayRow: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    let title: String
    let reasons: [String]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.xxs) {
            Text(title)
                .font(MapleFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
            ForEach(Array(reasons.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { _, reason in
                Text(reason)
                    .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
            }
        }
        .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
        .padding(.vertical, theme.spacing.sm)
        .frame(minHeight: theme.spacing.row)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
    }
}
```

`App/Features/Focus/StreakSheet.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// The Focus streak (F1 design §5.15), from Home's header: the current run in amber beside its leaf, the best run and
/// the rest-day rule, then this week as 7 dots from the calendar's first weekday (ruling P8). Finished days are season
/// tint; rest days and misses look alike, in a neutral fill; today is an open ring until it ends. It never counts the
/// rest days left. `.medium`; `.large` at accessibility sizes.
struct StreakSheet: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.mapleClock) private var clock
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var numeralSize: CGFloat = 34
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var leafSize: CGFloat = 36
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var dotSize: CGFloat = 20

    var body: some View {
        // Home's own clock, so the sheet and the header agree; once a minute, so today turns over while it is open.
        TimelineView(.everyMinute) { timeline in
            let now = clock.date(forTimeline: timeline.date)
            page(week(at: now), current: collection.currentRun(at: now))
        }
        .presentationDetents(dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize ? [.large] : [.medium])
        .presentationBackground(theme.colors.surface2)
        .presentationDragIndicator(.visible)
    }

    private func week(at now: Date) -> StreakWeek {
        let context = collection.context
        return StreakWeek(
            focusDays: collection.focus.focusDays, today: collection.snapshot.focusWindow(at: now, context: context).day,
            calendar: context.calendar, current: collection.currentRun(at: now), best: collection.focus.bestRun
        )
    }

    private func page(_ week: StreakWeek, current: Int) -> some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
                    StreakLeaf(detailed: true)
                        .frame(width: min(leafSize, 56), height: min(leafSize, 56))
                    Text(week.title)
                        .font(MapleFont.numeral(size: min(numeralSize, 56)))
                        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.reward)
                        .lineLimit(1)
                        .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)
                }
                .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
                .accessibilityLabel(HomeSpeech.streak(days: current))
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                VStack(spacing: theme.spacing.xxs) {
                    ForEach(Array(week.lines.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { _, line in
                        Text(line)
                            .font(MapleFont.callout)
                            .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                            .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                            .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                    }
                }
                .padding(.top, theme.spacing.sm)
                dots(week)
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.lg)
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
            .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xl)
            .padding(.bottom, theme.spacing.lg)
        }
        .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
    }

    /// The week: one dot per day with its weekday initial, and one sentence for VoiceOver.
    private func dots(_ week: StreakWeek) -> some View {
        let initials = FocusSheetCopy.weekdayInitials(calendar: collection.context.calendar)
        // Seven dots and their gaps fit a phone's width at every text size.
        let size = min(dotSize, 32)
        return HStack(spacing: 0) {
            ForEach(Array(week.dots.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, dot in
                VStack(spacing: theme.spacing.xxs) {
                    StreakDot(dot: dot)
                        .frame(width: size, height: size)
                    Text(initials.indices.contains(index) ? initials[index] : "")
                        .font(MapleFont.micro)
                        .foregroundStyle(dot == .pending ? theme.colors.textPrimary : theme.colors.textSecondary)
                        .dynamicTypeSize(...DynamicTypeSize.accessibility1)
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            }
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(week.weekLabel)
    }
}

/// One day of the week: finished in season tint, rest days and misses alike in a neutral fill, today an open ring.
private struct StreakDot: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.season) private var season
    let dot: StreakWeek.Dot

    var body: some View {
        switch dot {
        case .finished: Circle().fill(theme.colors.seasonTint(season))
        case .neutral: Circle().fill(theme.colors.track)
        case .pending: Circle().strokeBorder(theme.colors.textSecondary, lineWidth: 1.5)
        }
    }
}
```

import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign

/// The Focus tab's sheets (`FocusTabState.sheet`, F1 design §5.9, §5.13–§5.16), shown by `FocusView`. Each sheet sets
/// its own detents and `surface2` background (spec §2.3). Task 15 builds the Blocking sheet, the preset editor and
/// intention entry; until then they are placeholders.
struct FocusTabSheetContent: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    let sheet: FocusTabSheet

    var body: some View {
        switch sheet {
        case .saved:
            SavedTodaySheet()
        case .streak:
            StreakSheet()
        case .blocking, .preset, .intention:
            FocusPlaceholder(sheet.title)
                .presentationDetents([.medium])
                .presentationBackground(theme.colors.surface2)
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 15: Preset editor, Blocking sheet and intention entry

The Focus tab's last three sheets replace Task 8's placeholders: the preset editor (§5.13), the Blocking sheet with a DEBUG fake picker (§5.14), and intention entry (§5.16). Their rules live in three pure MapleCore models with tests: `PresetDraft` (strictness through `FocusPreset.changeStrictness`, at most 6 presets, the last one kept), `BlockingSheetModel` (the counter, never empty over full, the 50-app limit) and `IntentionDraft` (60 characters, Return saves, clearing removes). Holding a preset chip opens its editor, and "+" opens a new one.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **Strictness is measured from the preset as saved.** Each tap on a level runs `changeStrictness(to:on:calendar:)` on the saved preset, not on the draft, so Locked → Gentle → Steady before saving reads "Steady starts tomorrow", never "Gentle". A new preset takes any level at once: nothing looser can wait. Cost if wrong: one function.
- **The verb row shows the start button's own words** ("Start study", "Start a quick session", …, "Start focus", from `FocusVerb.startTitle`), under the label "Start button". Cost if wrong: one label.
- **Length is a minus/plus stepper** (20 minutes to 3 hours in 5-minute steps, VoiceOver adjustable), not a second dial. The dial on the start screen still turns. Cost if wrong: the editor gets a dial later.
- **The Apps row only chooses which list the preset blocks** (Distractions, Study apps, Bedtime), with that list's counter under it. A list's contents are edited in the Blocking sheet, from the start screen's Blocking line. In the Blocking sheet, choosing another list also makes it this preset's list on Save. Switching lists there shows the other list as saved and drops the unsaved changes to the first. Cost if wrong: one more route.
- **Never empty over full:** Save is off while an empty selection would replace a list that holds something, with the line "Choose at least one app, site or category. This list stays as it was." `AppSetStore.save`'s `.wouldEmpty` maps to the same line. An unchanged list is never re-saved, so an expired list's "Some apps need choosing again" stays until something is chosen again. Over 50 apps across every list, Save is off: "Up to 50 apps can rest at once. Choose a category to cover more." An "Only these" list that won't count (§3.6 R3) can still be saved, with "Only these counts with 20 or fewer apps and sites, and no categories."
- **The picker by capability:** the preview blocker (DEBUG demo and sandbox launches) shows `FakeAppPicker`. Every other build shows F1-17's words, "This version of Maple can't lock apps.", where F1-paid's Apple picker will go. A DEBUG live launch can't block either, so it never writes fake selections into the member's files.
- **The fake picker's selection is JSON** (`PickerChoice`: ticked sample ids, sorted, so an unchanged choice is the same bytes). A list it didn't write, such as a seeded demo list, shows as the first samples of each kind its summary counts, plus one "N other apps" row for apps beyond the 12 samples, so the counter always matches the start screen. One "45 more sample apps" row reaches the 50-app limit.
- **Holding a chip:** a 0.5-second press with a soft haptic opens the editor, and letting go then also selects the chip, which is harmless. VoiceOver gets a named action, "Edit preset". F1-22's countdown is for holds that commit (start, release). Opening an editor commits nothing, so the action opens it at once.
- **Deleting asks first** (a confirmation dialog: "Delete this preset?", "The time it saved stays yours.", "Delete preset" or "Cancel"). The row and the button are never red (spec §1, principle 8). A deleted preset that was selected falls back to the last used.
- **Intention entry is a short sheet that fits its content** (`.height` detent, measured), focused on appear, so it sits above the keyboard. A chip saves itself and closes. A clear button (`xmark`) empties the field. Return saves, and swiping the sheet down keeps what was saved before.
- **DEBUG frozen frame:** `-MapleDemoPresent preset -MapleDemoStrictness <level>` (with `-MapleDemoTab focus`) opens the editor as it looks just after choosing `<level>` on a Locked copy of the preset, unsaved. `steady` shows "Steady starts tomorrow", `gentle` shows "Gentle starts tomorrow", and `locked` shows Locked chosen with nothing to save. Nothing is written to the store.
- **A preset with no list** (`appSetID == nil`, which the start screen reads as "Choose apps to block") shows no list chosen in the editor, with "No apps chosen yet". The Blocking sheet opens it on Distractions, and Save makes Distractions its list. Cost if wrong: one fallback.
- **Words Task 4 already owns are reused, not redeclared:** `FocusCopy.newPreset` (the new editor's title, as "+" reads), `FocusCopy.chooseApps` (the Blocking sheet's title, as the no-list capsule reads), `FocusCopy.intentionPrompt`, `FocusCopy.strictnessName(_:)`, `strictnessLine(_:)` and `pendingLine(_:)`, and `SelectionText.counter(_:totalTokens:)` ("6 apps · 1 site", "No apps chosen yet", with "Up to 50 apps can rest at once" near the limit).
- **Copy the design doesn't give,** in the same voice, all in `FocusSheetCopy`: "Edit preset" (the title, and the chip's VoiceOver action); the labels "Name", "Start button", "Length", "Break", "Apps", "Strictness"; "No break", "One 5-minute break" and "Apps stay locked, and the break counts."; "Shorter", "Longer"; "Delete preset", "Delete this preset?", "The time it saved stays yours."; "This couldn't be saved. Try again in a moment."; "App list" and "Which apps rest" (VoiceOver labels); "Block these" and "Only these" (the design's own); the three lines above; "Clear"; "Save", "Close", "Cancel".
- **Detents:** the editor and the Blocking sheet are `.large` (focus spec §5.2, §5.3), with Close at the top and Save pinned at the bottom, as `ScheduleEditor` is.

import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import MapleCore

@Suite("Preset editor")
struct PresetDraftTests {
    private let today = LocalDay(year: 2026, month: 10, day: 23)
    private var tomorrow: LocalDay { today.adding(days: 1, calendar: utc) }

    private func study(_ strictness: Strictness = .steady) -> FocusPreset {
        FocusPreset(name: "Study", verb: .study, minutes: 50, hasBreak: true, appSetID: nil, strictness: strictness)
    }

    @Test("A tighter level applies now; a looser one waits for tomorrow, measured from the saved preset")
    func strictness() {
        var draft = PresetDraft(editing: study(.steady), presetCount: 4, today: today)
        draft.choose(.locked, calendar: utc)
        #expect(draft.chosenStrictness == .locked)
        #expect(draft.preset.strictness(on: today) == .locked)
        #expect(draft.pendingLine == nil)
        #expect(draft.canSave)
        draft.choose(.gentle, calendar: utc)
        #expect(draft.chosenStrictness == .gentle)
        // Not Locked today: Locked was never saved, so the change runs from the saved Steady.
        #expect(draft.preset.strictness(on: today) == .steady)
        #expect(draft.preset.strictness(on: tomorrow) == .gentle)
        #expect(draft.pendingLine == FocusCopy.pendingLine(.gentle))
        draft.choose(.steady, calendar: utc)
        #expect(draft.pendingLine == nil)
        #expect(!draft.canSave)
    }

    @Test("Locked to Steady reads Steady starts tomorrow")
    func steadyStartsTomorrow() {
        var draft = PresetDraft(editing: study(.locked), presetCount: 4, today: today)
        draft.choose(.steady, calendar: utc)
        #expect(draft.pendingLine == "Steady starts tomorrow")
        #expect(draft.preset.strictness(on: today) == .locked)
        #expect(draft.chosenStrictness == .steady)
        #expect(draft.canSave)
    }

    @Test("A saved change waiting for tomorrow shows when the editor opens, and not once it has begun")
    func savedPending() {
        var waiting = study(.locked)
        waiting.pendingStrictness = .steady
        waiting.pendingFrom = tomorrow
        let opened = PresetDraft(editing: waiting, presetCount: 4, today: today)
        #expect(opened.pendingLine == "Steady starts tomorrow")
        #expect(opened.chosenStrictness == .steady)
        let begun = PresetDraft(editing: waiting, presetCount: 4, today: tomorrow)
        #expect(begun.pendingLine == nil)
        #expect(begun.chosenStrictness == .steady)
    }

    @Test("A new preset: unnamed, Start focus, 50 minutes, no break, Steady; any level at once")
    func newPreset() {
        var draft = PresetDraft(newOn: nil, presetCount: 4, today: today)
        #expect(draft.isNew && draft.title == "New preset")
        #expect(draft.verb == .focus && draft.minutes == 50 && !draft.hasBreak && draft.chosenStrictness == .steady)
        draft.choose(.gentle, calendar: utc)
        #expect(draft.preset.strictness(on: today) == .gentle)
        #expect(draft.pendingLine == nil)
        #expect(!draft.canSave)
        draft.name = "Essay"
        #expect(draft.canSave)
        #expect(!draft.canDelete)
        var seventh = PresetDraft(newOn: nil, presetCount: FocusPreset.maximumCount, today: today)
        seventh.name = "Seventh"
        #expect(!seventh.canSave)
    }

    @Test("The last preset can't be deleted")
    func delete() {
        #expect(!PresetDraft(editing: study(), presetCount: 1, today: today).canDelete)
        #expect(PresetDraft(editing: study(), presetCount: 2, today: today).canDelete)
        #expect(PresetDraft(editing: study(), presetCount: 2, today: today).title == "Edit preset")
    }

    @Test("Names keep 24 characters and can't be blank; lengths step by 5 between 20 minutes and 3 hours")
    func fields() {
        var draft = PresetDraft(editing: study(), presetCount: 4, today: today)
        draft.name = "Deep work, the long kind of session"
        #expect(draft.name == "Deep work, the long kind")
        draft.name = "   "
        #expect(!draft.canSave)
        draft.name = "Study"
        #expect(!draft.canSave)
        draft.lengthen()
        #expect(draft.minutes == 55 && draft.lengthText == "55m" && draft.canSave)
        for _ in 0..<20 { draft.shorten() }
        #expect(draft.minutes == 20 && !draft.canShorten && draft.canLengthen)
        for _ in 0..<40 { draft.lengthen() }
        #expect(draft.minutes == 180 && !draft.canLengthen && draft.lengthText == "3h")

        draft.verb = .reading
        draft.appSetID = UUID()
        #expect(!draft.preset.hasBreak && draft.preset.verb == .reading && draft.preset.appSetID != nil)
    }
}

struct BlockingSheetModelTests {
    private let six = SelectionSummary(mode: .blockThese, apps: 6, sites: 1, categories: 0)
    private let empty = SelectionSummary(mode: .blockThese, apps: 0, sites: 0, categories: 0)

    @Test("The counter counts this list with every other list in place")
    func counter() {
        let model = BlockingSheetModel(draft: six, saved: empty, others: [empty, empty])
        #expect(model.totalTokens == 6)
        #expect(model.counter == SelectionText.counter(six, totalTokens: 6))
        #expect(model.problem == nil && model.problemLine == nil && model.note == nil && model.canSave)
        #expect(BlockingSheetModel(draft: empty, saved: empty, others: []).counter.text == "No apps chosen yet")
    }

    @Test("An empty selection never replaces a full one")
    func neverEmptyOverFull() {
        let model = BlockingSheetModel(draft: empty, saved: six, others: [])
        #expect(model.problem == .wouldEmpty)
        #expect(!model.canSave)
        #expect(model.problemLine == "Choose at least one app, site or category. This list stays as it was.")
        // Empty over empty replaces nothing.
        #expect(BlockingSheetModel(draft: empty, saved: empty, others: []).canSave)
    }

    @Test("No more than 50 apps rest across every list")
    func tokenLimit() {
        let others = [SelectionSummary(mode: .blockThese, apps: 45, sites: 0, categories: 0)]
        let over = BlockingSheetModel(draft: six, saved: empty, others: others)
        #expect(over.totalTokens == 51)
        #expect(over.problem == .overLimit && !over.canSave)
        #expect(over.problemLine == "Up to 50 apps can rest at once. Choose a category to cover more.")
        // The problem's line takes the place of the counter's limit note, so the limit is said once.
        #expect(over.note == over.problemLine)
        let five = SelectionSummary(mode: .blockThese, apps: 5, sites: 0, categories: 0)
        let atLimit = BlockingSheetModel(draft: five, saved: empty, others: others)
        #expect(atLimit.totalTokens == 50 && atLimit.problem == nil && atLimit.canSave)
        #expect(atLimit.note == SelectionText.counter(five, totalTokens: 50).limitNote)
        #expect(atLimit.note != nil)
        let sites = SelectionSummary(mode: .blockThese, apps: 0, sites: 51, categories: 0)
        #expect(BlockingSheetModel(draft: sites, saved: empty, others: []).problem == .overLimit)
    }

    @Test("Only these with a category, or over 20, saves and says it won't count")
    func onlyThese() {
        let category = SelectionSummary(mode: .onlyThese, apps: 6, sites: 0, categories: 1)
        let model = BlockingSheetModel(draft: category, saved: empty, others: [])
        #expect(model.problem == .onlyTheseWontCount && model.canSave)
        #expect(model.problemLine == "Only these counts with 20 or fewer apps and sites, and no categories.")
        let wide = SelectionSummary(mode: .onlyThese, apps: 21, sites: 0, categories: 0)
        #expect(BlockingSheetModel(draft: wide, saved: empty, others: []).problem == .onlyTheseWontCount)
        let small = SelectionSummary(mode: .onlyThese, apps: 6, sites: 0, categories: 0)
        #expect(BlockingSheetModel(draft: small, saved: empty, others: []).problem == nil)
    }

import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// The words on the Focus sheets that no screen model owns (F1 design §5.9, §5.13–§5.16, focus spec §3.3): Saved
/// today, the streak sheet, the preset editor, the Blocking sheet and intention entry. Pure, so every line is tested.
/// Sentence case, no "!", and never "fail", "quit", "streak lost" or "rest days left".
public enum FocusSheetCopy {
    // MARK: Shared

    public static let save = "Save"
    public static let close = "Close"
    public static let cancel = "Cancel"

    // MARK: Saved today (§5.9, focus spec §3.3)

    /// VoiceOver's hint on a numeral that opens Saved today (Home's, the receipt's).
    public static let savedTodayHint = "Opens Saved today"
    public static let howWeCountTitle = "How we count"

    // MARK: Streak sheet (§5.15)

    /// The weekday under each of the week's 7 dots, from the calendar's first weekday (ruling P8): "M T W T F S S"
    /// in en-GB, "S M T W T F S" in en-US.
    public static func weekdayInitials(calendar: Calendar) -> [String] {
        let symbols = calendar.veryShortStandaloneWeekdaySymbols
        guard symbols.count == 7 else { return Array(repeating: "", count: 7) }
        let first = min(max(calendar.firstWeekday, 1), 7) - 1
        return (0..<7).map { symbols[(first + $0) % 7] }
    }

    // MARK: Preset editor (§5.13)

    public static let editPresetTitle = "Edit preset"
    /// VoiceOver's action on a preset chip, the same as holding it.
    public static let editPreset = "Edit preset"
    public static let nameTitle = "Name"
    /// The verb row; its choices are the start button's own words ("Start a quick session").
    public static let verbTitle = "Start button"
    public static let lengthTitle = "Length"
    public static let shorter = "Shorter"
    public static let longer = "Longer"
    public static let breakTitle = "Break"
    public static let breakNote = "Apps stay locked, and the break counts."
    public static let appsTitle = "Apps"
    public static let strictnessTitle = "Strictness"
    public static let deletePreset = "Delete preset"
    public static let deleteQuestion = "Delete this preset?"
    public static let deleteNote = "The time it saved stays yours."
    public static let couldNotSave = "This couldn't be saved. Try again in a moment."

    /// None, or one 5-minute locked break inside the session (§5.5).
    public static func breakOption(_ hasBreak: Bool) -> String {
        hasBreak ? "One 5-minute break" : "No break"
    }

    // MARK: Blocking sheet (§5.14)

    /// VoiceOver's label for the named lists.
    public static let listsLabel = "App list"
    /// VoiceOver's label for Block these · Only these.
    public static let modeLabel = "Which apps rest"
    public static let nothingChosen = "Nothing chosen yet"
    public static let needsChoosingAgain = "Some apps need choosing again"
    public static let keepOneChosen = "Choose at least one app, site or category. This list stays as it was."
    public static let overLimit = "Up to 50 apps can rest at once. Choose a category to cover more."
    public static let onlyTheseNote = "Only these counts with 20 or fewer apps and sites, and no categories."
    public static let footer = "Calls and apps on iOS's Always Allowed list stay open."
    /// Where the app picker goes in a build that can't block (F1-17's words).
    public static let pickerUnavailable = "This version of Maple can't lock apps."

    public static func modeTitle(_ mode: SelectionSummary.Mode) -> String {
        switch mode {
        case .blockThese: "Block these"
        case .onlyThese: "Only these"
        }
    }

    // MARK: Intention entry (§5.16)

    /// VoiceOver's label for the field's clear button.
    public static let clearIntention = "Clear"
}

import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// The preset editor's working copy (F1 design §5.13): what Save stores, and the rules the editor shows.
///
/// - An existing preset's strictness changes through `FocusPreset.changeStrictness`, run each time on the preset as
///   saved: a tighter level applies now, and a looser one from the next day ("Steady starts tomorrow"), however many
///   levels were tried before saving.
/// - A new preset takes any level at once: there is nothing looser to wait for.
/// - At most 6 presets, a name to save, and the last preset can't be deleted.
public struct PresetDraft: Sendable, Equatable {
    public private(set) var preset: FocusPreset
    public let isNew: Bool
    /// The Maple day the editor is open on, from which a looser level waits a day.
    public let today: LocalDay
    private let saved: FocusPreset?
    private let presetCount: Int

    /// Editing a saved preset; `presetCount` is how many presets the member has.
    public init(editing preset: FocusPreset, presetCount: Int, today: LocalDay) {
        self.preset = preset
        isNew = false
        self.today = today
        saved = preset
        self.presetCount = presetCount
    }

    /// A new preset, from "+": unnamed, "Start focus", 50 minutes, no break, Steady, on `appSetID`.
    public init(newOn appSetID: UUID?, presetCount: Int, today: LocalDay) {
        preset = FocusPreset(name: "", verb: .focus, minutes: 50, hasBreak: false, appSetID: appSetID)
        isNew = true
        self.today = today
        saved = nil
        self.presetCount = presetCount
    }

    public var title: String {
        isNew ? FocusCopy.newPreset : FocusSheetCopy.editPresetTitle
    }

    /// The name as typed, kept to 24 characters.
    public var name: String {
        get { preset.name }
        set { preset.name = String(newValue.prefix(FocusPreset.nameLimit)) }
    }

    public var verb: FocusVerb {
        get { preset.verb }
        set { preset.verb = newValue }
    }

    public var minutes: Int { preset.minutes }

    /// "50m", "1h 30m".
    public var lengthText: String { FocusTimeText.length(minutes: preset.minutes) }

    public var canShorten: Bool { preset.minutes > DialLayout.minimumMinutes }

    public var canLengthen: Bool { preset.minutes < DialLayout.maximumMinutes }

    /// 5 minutes shorter, never under 20.
    public mutating func shorten() {
        preset.minutes = DialLayout.stepped(preset.minutes, by: -1)
    }

    /// 5 minutes longer, never over 3 hours.
    public mutating func lengthen() {
        preset.minutes = DialLayout.stepped(preset.minutes, by: 1)
    }

    public var hasBreak: Bool {
        get { preset.hasBreak }
        set { preset.hasBreak = newValue }
    }

    public var appSetID: UUID? {
        get { preset.appSetID }
        set { preset.appSetID = newValue }
    }

    /// The level the member picked: today's, or the looser one waiting for tomorrow.
    public var chosenStrictness: Strictness {
        preset.pendingStrictness ?? preset.strictness
    }

    public mutating func choose(_ strictness: Strictness, calendar: Calendar) {
        guard let saved else {
            preset.strictness = strictness
            preset.pendingStrictness = nil
            preset.pendingFrom = nil
            return
        }
        var changed = saved
        changed.changeStrictness(to: strictness, on: today, calendar: calendar)
        preset.strictness = changed.strictness
        preset.pendingStrictness = changed.pendingStrictness
        preset.pendingFrom = changed.pendingFrom
    }

    /// "Steady starts tomorrow" while a looser level waits for the next day; nil otherwise.
    public var pendingLine: String? {
        guard let pending = preset.pendingStrictness, let from = preset.pendingFrom, from > today else { return nil }
        return FocusCopy.pendingLine(pending)
    }

    /// A saved preset, and never the last one.
    public var canDelete: Bool { !isNew && presetCount > 1 }

    /// A name; for a new preset, room for it (at most 6); for a saved one, something changed.
    public var canSave: Bool {
        guard FocusPreset.normalizedName(preset.name) != nil else { return false }
        return isNew ? presetCount < FocusPreset.maximumCount : preset != saved
    }
}

`MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Focus/BlockingSheetModel.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// The Blocking sheet's rules for one app list (F1 design §5.14, §3.6 R3): the counter, what's wrong with the draft,
/// and whether Save may store it. An empty selection never replaces a full one, and no more than 50 app or 50 web
/// tokens rest across every list (above that iOS silently blocks nothing).
public struct BlockingSheetModel: Sendable, Equatable {
    public enum Problem: Sendable, Equatable {
        /// Empty, over a list that holds something: Save is off.
        case wouldEmpty
        /// More than 50 apps, or 50 sites, across every list: Save is off.
        case overLimit
        /// "Only these" with a category, or with more than 20 apps and sites: it saves, but won't count.
        case onlyTheseWontCount
    }

    public let draft: SelectionSummary
    /// The larger of apps and sites across every list, with this draft in place of the list as saved.
    public let totalTokens: Int
    public let problem: Problem?

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - saved: This list as saved.
    ///   - others: Every other list, as saved.
    public init(draft: SelectionSummary, saved: SelectionSummary, others: [SelectionSummary]) {
        self.draft = draft
        let apps = others.reduce(draft.apps) { $0 + $1.apps }
        let sites = others.reduce(draft.sites) { $0 + $1.sites }
        totalTokens = max(apps, sites)
        if draft.isEmpty, !saved.isEmpty {
            problem = .wouldEmpty
        } else if apps > SelectionSummary.tokenLimit || sites > SelectionSummary.tokenLimit {
            problem = .overLimit
        } else if draft.mode == .onlyThese, !draft.qualifies {
            problem = .onlyTheseWontCount
        } else {
            problem = nil
        }
    }

    /// Task 4's counter for the draft: "6 apps · 1 site" or "No apps chosen yet", with "Up to 50 apps can rest at
    /// once" near the limit.
    public var counter: SelectionText.Counter {
        SelectionText.counter(draft, totalTokens: totalTokens)
    }

    public var problemLine: String? {
        switch problem {
        case .wouldEmpty: FocusSheetCopy.keepOneChosen
        case .overLimit: FocusSheetCopy.overLimit
        case .onlyTheseWontCount: FocusSheetCopy.onlyTheseNote
        case nil: nil
        }
    }

    /// The line under the counter: the problem's, which also covers the limit when over it, else the counter's own
    /// limit note.
    public var note: String? { problemLine ?? counter.limitNote }

    public var canSave: Bool { problem != .wouldEmpty && problem != .overLimit }
}

import Foundation

/// "What's this for?" as it is typed (F1 design §5.16): at most 60 characters, Return saves it trimmed, and a cleared
/// field removes the intention.
public struct IntentionDraft: Sendable, Equatable {
    public private(set) var text: String

    public init(_ intention: String?) {
        text = String((intention ?? "").prefix(RecentIntentions.maximumLength))
    }

    /// The field after typing: its first 60 characters.
    public mutating func type(_ typed: String) {
        text = String(typed.prefix(RecentIntentions.maximumLength))
    }

    /// What Return saves: trimmed, or nil (no intention) for a blank field.
    public var saved: String? { RecentIntentions.normalized(text) }

    public var isCleared: Bool { saved == nil }
}

#if DEBUG
import Foundation
import MapleCore

/// DEBUG only: what the fake app picker offers, and how it stores a choice (F1 design §5.14). An `AppSet` keeps this
/// choice's JSON as its opaque selection; F1-paid's Apple picker keeps its own selection there instead.
nonisolated public struct PickerChoice: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    nonisolated public enum Kind: String, Codable, Sendable, CaseIterable {
        case app, site, category

        public var title: String {
            switch self {
            case .app: "Apps"
            case .site: "Sites"
            case .category: "Categories"
            }
        }
    }

    nonisolated public struct Sample: Sendable, Hashable, Identifiable {
        public let id: String
        public let name: String
        public let kind: Kind
    }

    /// 12 apps, 3 sites and 3 categories, in the order the picker lists them.
    public static let samples: [Sample] = [
        Sample(id: "app.shorts", name: "Short videos", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "app.photos", name: "Photo feed", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "app.chat", name: "Group chat", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "app.streaming", name: "Video streaming", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "app.forum", name: "Forum", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "app.puzzle", name: "Puzzle game", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "app.battle", name: "Battle game", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "app.shopping", name: "Shopping", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "app.news", name: "News", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "app.music", name: "Music", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "app.messages", name: "Messages", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "app.maps", name: "Maps", kind: .app),
        Sample(id: "site.video", name: "video.example", kind: .site),
        Sample(id: "site.social", name: "social.example", kind: .site),
        Sample(id: "site.news", name: "news.example", kind: .site),
        Sample(id: "category.social", name: "Social", kind: .category),
        Sample(id: "category.games", name: "Games", kind: .category),
        Sample(id: "category.entertainment", name: "Entertainment", kind: .category),
    ]

    /// The one row that counts as this many apps, to try the 50-app limit.
    public static let bulkApps = 45
    public static let bulkTitle = "45 more sample apps"

    /// "12 other apps": apps a stored list counts beyond the samples.
    public static func othersTitle(_ count: Int) -> String {
        "\(count) other \(count == 1 ? "app" : "apps")"
    }

    public var picked: Set<String>
    public var bulk: Bool
    /// Apps a stored list counts that the samples can't show (a seeded demo list of 24), as one row until unticked.
    public var otherApps: Int

    public init(picked: Set<String> = [], bulk: Bool = false, otherApps: Int = 0) {
        self.picked = picked
        self.bulk = bulk
        self.otherApps = otherApps
    }

    /// A stored choice; or, for a selection the picker didn't write (a seeded demo list), the first samples of each
    /// kind its summary counts, so the counter matches the list.
    public init(data: Data, summary: SelectionSummary) {
        if let stored = try? JSONDecoder().decode(PickerChoice.self, from: data) {
            self = stored
            return
        }
        let apps = Self.samples.filter { $0.kind == .app }
        let sites = Self.samples.filter { $0.kind == .site }
        let categories = Self.samples.filter { $0.kind == .category }
        picked = Set(apps.prefix(max(0, summary.apps)).map(\.id) + sites.prefix(max(0, summary.sites)).map(\.id)
            + categories.prefix(max(0, summary.categories)).map(\.id))
        bulk = false
        otherApps = max(0, summary.apps - apps.count)
    }

    public func summary(mode: SelectionSummary.Mode) -> SelectionSummary {
        func count(_ kind: Kind) -> Int { Self.samples.filter { $0.kind == kind && picked.contains($0.id) }.count }
        return SelectionSummary(
            mode: mode, apps: count(.app) + (bulk ? Self.bulkApps : 0) + otherApps, sites: count(.site),
            categories: count(.category)
        )
    }

    /// The opaque selection: this choice as JSON, ids sorted, so an unchanged choice is the same bytes.
    public var data: Data {
        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        encoder.outputFormatting = [.sortedKeys]
        return (try? encoder.encode(self)) ?? Data()
    }

    public mutating func toggle(_ id: String) {
        if picked.contains(id) { picked.remove(id) } else { picked.insert(id) }
    }

    // MARK: Codable (ids as a sorted array, so the bytes are stable)

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case picked, bulk, otherApps
    }

    public init(from decoder: any Decoder) throws {
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        picked = Set(try c.decode([String].self, forKey: .picked))
        bulk = try c.decode(Bool.self, forKey: .bulk)
        otherApps = try c.decode(Int.self, forKey: .otherApps)
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: any Encoder) throws {
        var c = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try c.encode(picked.sorted(), forKey: .picked)
        try c.encode(bulk, forKey: .bulk)
        try c.encode(otherApps, forKey: .otherApps)
    }
}
#endif

```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// The preset editor (F1 design §5.13), from holding a chip or from "+": the name (up to 24 characters), the start
/// button's words, the length (the dial's 20 minutes to 3 hours, in 5-minute steps), the break, the app list and the
/// strictness, each level with its honest line. A tighter level applies now and a looser one from the next day,
/// with the line "Steady starts tomorrow" (`PresetDraft`). Delete is the last row, and the last preset has none.
/// `.large`, with Close at the top and Save pinned at the bottom, as `ScheduleEditor` is.
struct PresetEditor: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @Environment(\.mapleClock) private var clock
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @Environment(PresetStore.self) private var presets
    @Environment(AppSetStore.self) private var appSets

    @State private var draft: PresetDraft
    @State private var asksToDelete = false
    @State private var failure: String?
    private let onSaved: (UUID) -> Void
    private let onDeleted: (UUID) -> Void

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - onSaved: The preset saved or added, for the start screen to select.
    ///   - onDeleted: The preset deleted, for the start screen to stop selecting.
    init(draft: PresetDraft, onSaved: @escaping (UUID) -> Void, onDeleted: @escaping (UUID) -> Void) {
        _draft = State(initialValue: draft)
        self.onSaved = onSaved
        self.onDeleted = onDeleted
    }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                header
                fields
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.md)
                strictness
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.lg)
                if draft.canDelete {
                    deleteRow
                        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.lg)
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
            .padding(.top, theme.spacing.lg)
            .padding(.bottom, theme.spacing.lg)
            .mapleAnimation(theme.motion.gentle, value: draft.pendingLine)
            // Selected chips and segments sit on `surface2`, the sheet's own fill: lifted, they show.
            .environment(\.theme, theme.onSheet)
        }
        .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
        .scrollDismissesKeyboard(.interactively)
        .safeAreaBar(edge: .bottom) {
            VStack(spacing: theme.spacing.xs) {
                if let failure {
                    Text(failure)
                        .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                }
                Button(FocusSheetCopy.save, action: save)
                    .buttonStyle(.moonlight(dimmed: isQuietHours))
                    .disabled(!draft.canSave)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
            .padding(.vertical, theme.spacing.xs)
        }
        .presentationDetents([.large])
        .presentationBackground(theme.colors.surface2)
        .confirmationDialog(FocusSheetCopy.deleteQuestion, isPresented: $asksToDelete, titleVisibility: .visible) {
            Button(FocusSheetCopy.deletePreset, role: .destructive, action: delete)
            Button(FocusSheetCopy.cancel, role: .cancel) {}
        } message: {
            Text(FocusSheetCopy.deleteNote)
        }
    }

    // MARK: Parts

    private var header: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
            Text(draft.title)
                .font(MapleFont.sectionTitle)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            Button(FocusSheetCopy.close, systemImage: "xmark") { dismiss() }
                .buttonStyle(.iconCircle)
        }
        // The close circle's 44pt hit area overhangs the margin, so the glyph lines up with the content edge.
        .padding(.trailing, -4)
    }

    private var fields: some View {
        ProfileListGroup {
            ProfileSettingRow(FocusSheetCopy.nameTitle, stacked: true) {
                TextField(FocusSheetCopy.nameTitle, text: $draft.name)
                    .font(MapleFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .textInputAutocapitalization(.sentences)
                    .submitLabel(.done)
            }
            ProfileSettingRow(FocusSheetCopy.verbTitle, stacked: true, controlIsLabelled: false) {
                ChipFlow(spacing: theme.spacing.xs, lineSpacing: 0) {
                    ForEach(FocusVerb.allCases, id: \.self) { verb in
                        Chip(verb.startTitle, isSelected: draft.verb == verb) { draft.verb = verb }
                    }
                }
            }
            ProfileSettingRow(FocusSheetCopy.lengthTitle) {
                lengthStepper
            }
            ProfileSettingRow(
                FocusSheetCopy.breakTitle, detail: draft.hasBreak ? Text(FocusSheetCopy.breakNote) : nil, stacked: true,
                controlIsLabelled: false
            ) {
                breakChoice
            }
            ProfileSettingRow(FocusSheetCopy.appsTitle, detail: Text(appsLine), stacked: true, controlIsLabelled: false) {
                ChipFlow(spacing: theme.spacing.xs, lineSpacing: 0) {
                    ForEach(appSets.sets) { set in
                        Chip(set.name, isSelected: chosenSetID == set.id) { draft.appSetID = set.id }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Minus and plus around the length ("50m"), in 5-minute steps; one adjustable element for VoiceOver.
    private var lengthStepper: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            Button(FocusSheetCopy.shorter, systemImage: "minus") { draft.shorten() }
                .buttonStyle(.iconCircle)
                .disabled(!draft.canShorten)
            Text(draft.lengthText)
                .font(MapleFont.headline.monospacedDigit())
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                .contentTransition(.numericText())
                .mapleAnimation(theme.motion.gentle, value: draft.minutes)
                .frame(minWidth: 72)
                .lineLimit(1)
            Button(FocusSheetCopy.longer, systemImage: "plus") { draft.lengthen() }
                .buttonStyle(.iconCircle)
                .disabled(!draft.canLengthen)
        }
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: draft.minutes)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(Text(FocusSheetCopy.lengthTitle))
        .accessibilityValue(Text(FocusTimeText.spokenLength(minutes: draft.minutes, locale: locale)))
        .accessibilityAdjustableAction { direction in
            switch direction {
            case .increment: draft.lengthen()
            case .decrement: draft.shorten()
            @unknown default: break
            }
        }
    }

    /// No break · One 5-minute break: a capsule, or wrapping chips at accessibility sizes, where two segments can't
    /// hold their words.
    @ViewBuilder
    private var breakChoice: some View {
        if dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize {
            ChipFlow(spacing: theme.spacing.xs, lineSpacing: 0) {
                ForEach([false, true], id: \.self) { option in
                    Chip(FocusSheetCopy.breakOption(option), isSelected: draft.hasBreak == option) { draft.hasBreak = option }
                }
            }
        } else {
            SegmentedCapsule(selection: $draft.hasBreak, options: [false, true], size: .regular, fillsWidth: true) {
                FocusSheetCopy.breakOption($0)
            }
        }
    }

    /// Gentle, Steady and Locked, each with its honest line; "Steady starts tomorrow" under them while a looser
    /// level waits.
    private var strictness: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.xs) {
            Text(FocusSheetCopy.strictnessTitle)
                .font(MapleFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
            ProfileListGroup {
                ForEach(Strictness.allCases, id: \.self) { level in
                    StrictnessRow(level: level, isChosen: draft.chosenStrictness == level) {
                        draft.choose(level, calendar: collection.context.calendar)
                    }
                }
            }
            .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: draft.chosenStrictness)
            if let pending = draft.pendingLine {
                Text(pending)
                    .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                    .transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
    }

    private var deleteRow: some View {
        ProfileListGroup {
            Button(role: .destructive) {
                asksToDelete = true
            } label: {
                // Never red (spec §1, principle 8): the dialog says what it does.
                Text(FocusSheetCopy.deletePreset)
                    .font(MapleFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                    .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
                    .padding(.vertical, theme.spacing.sm)
                    .frame(minHeight: theme.spacing.row)
                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
            }
            .buttonStyle(.profileRow)
        }
    }

    /// The list the preset blocks; nil for a preset without one, which the start screen reads as "Choose apps to block".
    private var chosenSetID: UUID? { draft.appSetID }

    /// That list's counter ("6 apps · 1 site", "No apps chosen yet"), or "Some apps need choosing again".
    private var appsLine: String {
        let none = SelectionSummary(mode: .blockThese, apps: 0, sites: 0, categories: 0)
        guard let set = chosenSetID.flatMap({ appSets.set(id: $0) }) else {
            return SelectionText.counter(none, totalTokens: appSets.totalTokens).text
        }
        if set.tokensExpired { return FocusSheetCopy.needsChoosingAgain }
        return SelectionText.counter(set.summary, totalTokens: appSets.totalTokens).text
    }

    /// The primary capsule's dimmed variant from the evening on (D11).
    private var isQuietHours: Bool {
        switch collection.phase(at: clock.now()) {
        case .evening, .windDown, .night: true
        case .morning, .day: false
        }
    }

    // MARK: Actions

    private func save() {
        guard presets.isAvailable || presets.reloadIfUnavailable() else {
            failure = FocusSheetCopy.couldNotSave
            return
        }
        if draft.isNew {
            guard presets.add(draft.preset) else {
                failure = FocusSheetCopy.couldNotSave
                return
            }
        } else {
            // A reload can replace the defaults shown before the first unlock with the member's own presets.
            guard presets.preset(id: draft.preset.id) != nil else {
                failure = FocusSheetCopy.couldNotSave
                return
            }
            presets.update(draft.preset)
        }
        onSaved(draft.preset.id)
        dismiss()
    }

    private func delete() {
        let id = draft.preset.id
        guard presets.delete(id: id) else {
            failure = FocusSheetCopy.couldNotSave
            return
        }
        onDeleted(id)
        dismiss()
    }
}

/// One strictness level: a drawn radio, the name (Locked with its lock), and its honest line. Selecting it is one tap.
private struct StrictnessRow: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    let level: Strictness
    let isChosen: Bool
    let choose: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: choose) {
            HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
                SelectionMark(isOn: isChosen)
                    .padding(.top, 1)
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.xxs) {
                    HStack(spacing: theme.spacing.xxs) {
                        Text(FocusCopy.strictnessName(level))
                            .font(MapleFont.body)
                            .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                        if level == .locked {
                            Image(systemName: "lock.fill")
                                .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                                .accessibilityHidden(true)
                        }
                    }
                    Text(FocusCopy.strictnessLine(level))
                        .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                        .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
            .padding(.vertical, theme.spacing.sm)
            .frame(minHeight: theme.spacing.row)
            .contentShape(Rectangle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(.profileRow)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isChosen ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

/// A drawn radio or checkbox. Spec §6.8 allows no checkmark symbol, so a choice is a filled shape inside its ring.
struct SelectionMark: View {
    enum Kind {
        case circle, square
    }

    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var size: CGFloat = 20
    let isOn: Bool
    var kind: Kind = .circle

    var body: some View {
        let side = min(size, 28)
        let stroke = isOn ? theme.colors.textPrimary : theme.colors.textSecondary
        Group {
            switch kind {
            case .circle:
                ZStack {
                    Circle().strokeBorder(stroke, lineWidth: 1.5)
                    if isOn { Circle().fill(theme.colors.textPrimary).padding(side * 0.25) }
                }
            case .square:
                ZStack {
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 5, style: .continuous).strokeBorder(stroke, lineWidth: 1.5)
                    if isOn {
                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 2.5, style: .continuous)
                            .fill(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                            .padding(side * 0.25)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .frame(width: side, height: side)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

extension View {
    /// Holding a preset chip opens its editor (F1 design §4.5, §5.13): a half-second press with a soft haptic, and the
    /// same as a VoiceOver action, "Edit preset". Letting go afterwards still selects the chip.
    ///
    /// ```swift
    /// Chip(preset.name, isSelected: isSelected) { select(preset) }
    ///     .editsPresetOnHold { tab.sheet = .preset(preset.id) }
    /// ```
    func editsPresetOnHold(_ edit: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        modifier(PresetChipHold(edit: edit))
    }
}

private struct PresetChipHold: ViewModifier {
    @State private var holds = 0
    let edit: () -> Void

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .simultaneousGesture(
                LongPressGesture(minimumDuration: 0.5).onEnded { _ in
                    holds += 1
                    edit()
                }
            )
            .sensoryFeedback(.impact(flexibility: .soft, intensity: 0.5), trigger: holds)
            .accessibilityAction(named: Text(FocusSheetCopy.editPreset), edit)
    }
}

#if DEBUG
extension PresetEditor {
    /// DEBUG only: `-MapleDemoPresent preset -MapleDemoStrictness <level>` opens the editor as it looks just after
    /// choosing `<level>` on a Locked copy of the preset, unsaved, so a looser level shows "Steady starts tomorrow".
    /// Nothing is written to the store. Nil for any other launch.
    static func demoDraft(for preset: FocusPreset, presetCount: Int, today: LocalDay, calendar: Calendar) -> PresetDraft? {
        let options = DemoLaunchOptions.current
        guard options.focusSheet == .preset, let level = options.strictness else { return nil }
        var locked = preset
        locked.strictness = .locked
        locked.pendingStrictness = nil
        locked.pendingFrom = nil
        var draft = PresetDraft(editing: locked, presetCount: presetCount, today: today)
        draft.choose(level, calendar: calendar)
        return draft
    }
}
#endif

`App/Features/Focus/BlockingSheet.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// The Blocking sheet (F1 design §5.14), from the start screen's Blocking line and its "Choose apps" capsule: which list
/// this preset blocks (Distractions, Study apps or Bedtime), "Block these" or "Only these", the picker, the counter and
/// the footer. An empty selection is never saved over a full one, and no more than 50 apps rest across every list
/// (`BlockingSheetModel`, `AppSetStore.save`). Choosing another list also makes it the preset's on Save.
///
/// F1 has no real picker: launches on the DEBUG preview blocker show `FakeAppPicker`; every other build says it can't
/// lock apps, where F1-paid puts Apple's picker. `.large`, with the counter and Save pinned at the bottom.
struct BlockingSheet: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @Environment(\.mapleClock) private var clock
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions
    @Environment(PresetStore.self) private var presets
    @Environment(AppSetStore.self) private var appSets

    private let preset: FocusPreset
    @State private var setID: UUID
    @State private var mode: SelectionSummary.Mode
    #if DEBUG
    @State private var choice: PickerChoice
    #endif
    @State private var failure: String?

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - preset: The preset whose list this edits.
    ///   - sets: The lists as saved, to open on the preset's own.
    init(preset: FocusPreset, sets: [AppSet]) {
        self.preset = preset
        let set = sets.first { $0.id == preset.appSetID } ?? sets.first { $0.id == AppSet.distractionsID } ?? sets.first
        _setID = State(initialValue: set?.id ?? AppSet.distractionsID)
        _mode = State(initialValue: set?.summary.mode ?? .blockThese)
        #if DEBUG
        _choice = State(initialValue: set.map { PickerChoice(data: $0.selection, summary: $0.summary) } ?? PickerChoice())
        #endif
    }

    var body: some View {
        let model = model
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                header
                lists
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.md)
                SegmentedCapsule(selection: $mode, options: [.blockThese, .onlyThese], size: .regular, fillsWidth: true) {
                    FocusSheetCopy.modeTitle($0)
                }
                .accessibilityLabel(Text(FocusSheetCopy.modeLabel))
                .padding(.top, theme.spacing.sm)
                if saved?.tokensExpired == true {
                    Text(FocusSheetCopy.needsChoosingAgain)
                        .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xs)
                }
                picker
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.lg)
                Text(FocusSheetCopy.footer)
                    .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.md)
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
            .padding(.top, theme.spacing.lg)
            .padding(.bottom, theme.spacing.lg)
            // Selected chips and the segment thumb sit on `surface2`, the sheet's own fill: lifted, they show.
            .environment(\.theme, theme.onSheet)
        }
        .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
        .safeAreaBar(edge: .bottom) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.xxs) {
                Text(model.counter.text)
                    .font(MapleFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .contentTransition(.numericText())
                if let line = failure ?? model.note {
                    Text(line)
                        .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                        .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                }
                Button(FocusSheetCopy.save, action: save)
                    .buttonStyle(.moonlight(dimmed: isQuietHours))
                    .disabled(!model.canSave)
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xs)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
            .padding(.vertical, theme.spacing.xs)
        }
        .presentationDetents([.large])
        .presentationBackground(theme.colors.surface2)
        .onChange(of: setID) { load() }
        .onChange(of: mode) { failure = nil }
    }

    // MARK: Parts

    private var header: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
            Text(FocusCopy.chooseApps)
                .font(MapleFont.sectionTitle)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            Button(FocusSheetCopy.close, systemImage: "xmark") { dismiss() }
                .buttonStyle(.iconCircle)
        }
        .padding(.trailing, -4)
    }

    /// Distractions · Study apps · Bedtime.
    private var lists: some View {
        ChipFlow(spacing: theme.spacing.xs, lineSpacing: 0) {
            ForEach(appSets.sets) { set in
                Chip(set.name, isSelected: set.id == setID) { setID = set.id }
            }
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityLabel(Text(FocusSheetCopy.listsLabel))
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var picker: some View {
        #if DEBUG
        if usesFakePicker {
            FakeAppPicker(choice: $choice)
        } else {
            unavailable
        }
        #else
        unavailable
        #endif
    }

    /// F1-paid: Apple's picker takes this place when the blocker is `.screenTime`.
    private var unavailable: some View {
        Text(FocusSheetCopy.pickerUnavailable)
            .font(MapleFont.body)
            .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
            .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
    }

    // MARK: The draft

    private var saved: AppSet? { appSets.set(id: setID) }

    /// The DEBUG preview blocker comes with the fake picker; nothing else in F1 can pick apps.
    private var usesFakePicker: Bool {
        #if DEBUG
        return sessions.blocking.capability == .preview
        #else
        return false
        #endif
    }

    /// What Save would store: the picker's choice in the chosen mode, or, with no picker, the list as saved in it.
    private var draft: SelectionSummary {
        #if DEBUG
        if usesFakePicker { return choice.summary(mode: mode) }
        #endif
        let summary = saved?.summary ?? SelectionSummary(mode: mode, apps: 0, sites: 0, categories: 0)
        return SelectionSummary(mode: mode, apps: summary.apps, sites: summary.sites, categories: summary.categories)
    }

    private var draftData: Data {
        #if DEBUG
        if usesFakePicker { return choice.data }
        #endif
        return saved?.selection ?? Data()
    }

    private var model: BlockingSheetModel {
        BlockingSheetModel(
            draft: draft, saved: saved?.summary ?? SelectionSummary(mode: .blockThese, apps: 0, sites: 0, categories: 0),
            others: appSets.sets.filter { $0.id != setID }.map(\.summary)
        )
    }

    /// The primary capsule's dimmed variant from the evening on (D11).
    private var isQuietHours: Bool {
        switch collection.phase(at: clock.now()) {
        case .evening, .windDown, .night: true
        case .morning, .day: false
        }
    }

    // MARK: Actions

    /// Shows another list as it is saved; changes to the one before are dropped.
    private func load() {
        failure = nil
        guard let set = appSets.set(id: setID) else { return }
        mode = set.summary.mode
        #if DEBUG
        choice = PickerChoice(data: set.selection, summary: set.summary)
        #endif
    }

    private func save() {
        let listChanged = setID != preset.appSetID
        let selectionChanged = draft != saved?.summary || draftData != saved?.selection
        if selectionChanged {
            switch appSets.save(selection: draftData, summary: draft, to: setID) {
            case .saved:
                break
            case .wouldEmpty:
                failure = FocusSheetCopy.keepOneChosen
                return
            case .overTokenLimit:
                failure = FocusSheetCopy.overLimit
                return
            case .unknownSet, .unavailable:
                failure = FocusSheetCopy.couldNotSave
                return
            }
        }
        if listChanged, var updated = presets.preset(id: preset.id) {
            updated.appSetID = setID
            presets.update(updated)
        }
        dismiss()
    }
}

#if DEBUG
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// DEBUG only: F1's stand-in for Apple's app picker (F1 design §5.14). Sample apps, sites and categories with
/// checkboxes, one row worth 45 apps to try the 50-app limit, and, for a seeded list longer than the samples, one row
/// for the rest. It edits a `PickerChoice`, whose JSON the Blocking sheet stores as the list's opaque selection.
struct FakeAppPicker: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Binding var choice: PickerChoice

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.lg) {
            ForEach(PickerChoice.Kind.allCases, id: \.self) { kind in
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.xs) {
                    Text(kind.title)
                        .font(MapleFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                    ProfileListGroup {
                        ForEach(PickerChoice.samples.filter { $0.kind == kind }) { sample in
                            row(sample.name, isOn: choice.picked.contains(sample.id)) { choice.toggle(sample.id) }
                        }
                        if kind == .app {
                            row(PickerChoice.bulkTitle, isOn: choice.bulk) { choice.bulk.toggle() }
                            if choice.otherApps > 0 {
                                row(PickerChoice.othersTitle(choice.otherApps), isOn: true) { choice.otherApps = 0 }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func row(_ title: String, isOn: Bool, toggle: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: toggle) {
            HStack(spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
                SelectionMark(isOn: isOn, kind: .square)
                Text(title)
                    .font(MapleFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
            .padding(.vertical, theme.spacing.sm)
            .frame(minHeight: theme.spacing.row)
            .contentShape(Rectangle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(.profileRow)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isOn ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}
#endif

```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// Intention entry (F1 design §5.16), from the start screen's "What's this for?": one line above the keyboard (at most
/// 60 characters), with the last 3 distinct intentions as chips above it, those carried forward from "Partly" or
/// "Not yet" first (§5.8). Return saves it, a chip saves itself, and clearing the field removes the intention at once.
/// It stays the Focus tab's (`FocusTabState.intention`) until a session starts, which saves it to `session-notes.json`
/// (F1-19). A short sheet that fits what it holds.
struct IntentionEntry: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @Environment(SessionNotesStore.self) private var notes
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions
    @Binding private var intention: String?
    @State private var draft: IntentionDraft
    /// The content's measured height, which the sheet's detent follows.
    @State private var height: CGFloat = 132
    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool

    init(intention: Binding<String?>) {
        _intention = intention
        _draft = State(initialValue: IntentionDraft(intention.wrappedValue))
    }

    var body: some View {
        let chips = RecentIntentions.chips(notes.entries(reflections: sessions.reflections))
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
            if !chips.isEmpty {
                ChipFlow(spacing: theme.spacing.xs, lineSpacing: 0) {
                    ForEach(chips, id: \.self) { chip in
                        Chip(chip, isSelected: draft.saved == chip) { choose(chip) }
                    }
                }
            }
            field
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.lg)
        .padding(.bottom, theme.spacing.sm)
        .environment(\.theme, theme.onSheet)
        .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self) { $0.size.height } action: { height = $0 }
        .presentationDetents([.height(height + theme.spacing.xs)])
        .presentationBackground(theme.colors.surface2)
        .onAppear { isFocused = true }
    }

    private var field: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            TextField(FocusCopy.intentionPrompt, text: Binding {
                draft.text
            } set: { typed in
                draft.type(typed)
                if draft.isCleared { intention = nil }
            })
            .font(MapleFont.body)
            .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
            .textInputAutocapitalization(.sentences)
            .submitLabel(.done)
            .focused($isFocused)
            .onSubmit(save)
            if !draft.text.isEmpty {
                Button(FocusSheetCopy.clearIntention, systemImage: "xmark") {
                    draft.type("")
                    intention = nil
                }
                .labelStyle(.iconOnly)
                .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                .frame(minWidth: theme.spacing.minimumHitTarget, minHeight: theme.spacing.minimumHitTarget)
                .contentShape(Rectangle())
            }
        }
        .padding(.leading, theme.spacing.md)
        .frame(minHeight: theme.spacing.minimumHitTarget + theme.spacing.xs)
        .background {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: theme.radius.tile, style: .continuous)
                .fill(theme.colors.chipFill)
                .overlay {
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: theme.radius.tile, style: .continuous)
                        .strokeBorder(theme.colors.divider, lineWidth: 1)
                }
        }
    }

    /// Return: the trimmed text, or no intention for a blank field.
    private func save() {
        intention = draft.saved
        dismiss()
    }

    private func choose(_ chip: String) {
        draft.type(chip)
        save()
    }
}
```
