```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// The Focus tab's sheets (`FocusTabState.sheet`, F1 design §5.9, §5.13–§5.16), shown by `FocusView`. Each sheet sets
/// its own detents and `surface2` background (spec §2.3). They read the tab's state, which `FocusView` puts in the
/// environment outermost so its sheets see it:
/// - `.blocking`: the selected preset's app list;
/// - `.preset(id)`: that preset's editor, or a new preset's for nil. A saved preset becomes the selected one, and a
///   deleted one stops being it; either way the turned length goes, so the start screen shows the preset's own;
/// - `.intention`: the tab's "What's this for?";
/// - `.saved` and `.streak`: as from Home.
struct FocusTabSheetContent: View {
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions
    @Environment(PresetStore.self) private var presets
    @Environment(AppSetStore.self) private var appSets
    @Environment(FocusTabState.self) private var tab
    @Environment(AppSettings.self) private var settings
    let sheet: FocusTabSheet

    var body: some View {
        @Bindable var tab = tab
        switch sheet {
        case .saved:
            SavedTodaySheet()
        case .streak:
            StreakSheet()
        case .blocking:
            if let preset = selectedPreset {
                BlockingSheet(preset: preset, sets: appSets.sets)
            }
        case .preset(let id):
            if let draft = draft(for: id) {
                PresetEditor(draft: draft, onSaved: saved, onDeleted: deleted)
            }
        case .intention:
            IntentionEntry(intention: $tab.intention)
        }
    }

    /// The start screen's own preset (Task 9's `FocusStartLines.preset`): Quick for the first session (P4).
    private var selectedPreset: FocusPreset? {
        FocusStartLines.preset(selected: tab.selectedPresetID, presets: presets.presets, lastUsedID: presets.lastUsedID,
                               isFirstSession: !settings.hasStartedFocus)
    }

    /// The Maple day of the store's trusted now: the day a looser strictness waits from.
    private var today: LocalDay {
        collection.snapshot.focusWindow(at: sessions.now, context: collection.context).day
    }

    private func draft(for id: UUID?) -> PresetDraft? {
        let count = presets.presets.count
        guard let id else { return PresetDraft(newOn: AppSet.distractionsID, presetCount: count, today: today) }
        guard let preset = presets.preset(id: id) else { return nil }
        #if DEBUG
        if let frame = PresetEditor.demoDraft(for: preset, presetCount: count, today: today, calendar: collection.context.calendar) {
            return frame
        }
        #endif
        return PresetDraft(editing: preset, presetCount: count, today: today)
    }

    private func saved(_ id: UUID) {
        tab.selectedPresetID = id
        tab.minutes = nil
    }

    private func deleted(_ id: UUID) {
        if tab.selectedPresetID == id { tab.selectedPresetID = nil }
        tab.minutes = nil
    }
}

extension Theme {
    /// Segment thumbs and selected chips on a sheet: their `surface2` is the sheet's own fill, so on it they would
    /// vanish. They lift with white instead, as `ScheduleEditor`'s segments do.
    var onSheet: Theme {
        var sheet = self
        sheet.colors.surface2 = .white.opacity(0.12)
        return sheet
    }
}
```

### Task 16: Home and Herbarium

Home shows focus (F1 design §5.10): the saved numerals, Start (one tap only when the start screen has nothing to say, a hold for Locked, otherwise the Focus tab with that preset selected), a running session in every phase with a per-second timeline, "Return to session", "Turn on blocking", and a next-leaf row that reads display credit so it agrees with the dial (§4.3). The Herbarium gets the mini bar during a session; Home doesn't, because it already shows the session.

Task 4 already made `FocusStart.title` and `FocusStart.needsHold` follow readiness ("Hold to start · Locked 50m" only for `.ready(needsHold: true)`), so Home shows a `HoldButton` exactly when `needsHold` is true. A Locked preset whose start screen has something to say is a plain tap that opens the Focus tab, which asks for the hold itself.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **Home's Start has a spoken name.** The hold uses Task 4's `FocusCopy.holdToStartName(minutes:locale:)` ("Hold to start, Locked 50 minutes"); a tap reads "Start study, 50 minutes", so VoiceOver never says "50m". Cost if wrong: none.
- **After a one-tap start, Home stays.** It then shows "50m" · "left in this session" · "Return to session". A start the store refuses (`blockingFailed`, `ledgerUnavailable`, `notRecorded`) opens the Focus tab with the preset selected, where pressing Start shows the start screen's own prompt ("Couldn't lock your apps · Start as a plain timer?"). Cost if wrong: that prompt is one tap further away.
- **No plain-tap hint on Home.** The capsule already says "Hold to start". The 4-second hint is the start screen's (Task 9). Cost if wrong: a tap on Home's hold capsule shows only `HoldButton`'s own feedback.
- **The next-leaf row stops one second short of its threshold** while provisional time would pass it. It reads "1m to go" until a checkpoint unlocks the leaf, because only the counters unlock leaves (§4.3). Cost if wrong: none visible.
- **The mini bar:**
  - a full-width glass capsule pinned above the tab bar, on the Herbarium's grid only (not on a pushed leaf detail);
  - it reads "Study · 32m left", "Study · 0:45 left" in the last minute, or "Break · back at 14:28" (the Live Activity's break words, §5.11), with a `chevron.up`;
  - it shows the preset name only, never the intention, as on the Lock Screen;
  - a tap returns to the session.
  The spoken form is "Study, 32 minutes left. Return to session." These words are new. Cost if wrong: copy and visual review.
- **One timeline schedule.** Home uses `.periodic(from: <a whole minute>, by: everySecond ? 1 : 60)`, so switching the cadence never rebuilds Home's view tree (two `TimelineView` branches would reset its scroll position). The minute ticks land on whole minutes, as `.everyMinute`'s do. Cost if wrong: none.
- **Focus status runs on trusted time.** It is composed at `FocusSessionStore.now`, while `NowState`'s phase keeps using Home's clock, as it does today. Cost if wrong: none; the two agree unless the member moved the clock.

Create `MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Home/FocusStart+Spoken.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

extension FocusStart {
    /// VoiceOver's name for Home's Start (F1 design §4.9): "Hold to start, Locked 50 minutes" when it is a hold (the
    /// hold's own name, `FocusCopy.holdToStartName`), "Start study, 50 minutes" when it is a tap.
    public func spokenTitle(locale: Locale) -> String {
        if needsHold { return FocusCopy.holdToStartName(minutes: minutes, locale: locale) }
        return "\(verb.startTitle), \(FocusTimeText.spokenLength(minutes: minutes, locale: locale))"
    }
}
```

Create `MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Home/LeafProgress+Display.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

extension LeafProgress {
    /// Home's next-leaf row while a session runs (F1 design §4.3): an hours leaf with the session's provisional seconds
    /// added to its counter, as the dial reads display credit, so the two agree. Only a checkpoint unlocks a leaf,
    /// so the row stops one second short of the threshold ("1m to go", never "0m"). Other categories, a reached
    /// threshold and no session are returned unchanged.
    public func displaying(provisionalSeconds seconds: Int) -> LeafProgress {
        guard category == .hoursSaved, seconds > 0, state == .locked, current < threshold else { return self }
        let shown = min(current + Double(seconds) / 3600, threshold - 1.0 / 3600)
        guard shown > current else { return self }
        return LeafProgress(
            speciesID: speciesID, category: category, threshold: threshold, tier: tier, current: shown,
            availability: availability, state: state, estimatedDays: estimatedDays, floor: floor
        )
    }
}
```

Create `MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Focus/SessionMiniBar.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// The Herbarium's mini bar while a session runs (F1 design §5.10): the preset and its calm time left, or the break
/// and when it ends. The preset name only, as on the Lock Screen: the intention stays on the session's own screen.
public struct SessionMiniBar: Sendable, Equatable {
    /// "Study · 32m left", "Study · 0:45 left", or "Break · back at 14:28".
    public let title: String
    /// "Study, 32 minutes left. Return to session."
    public let spoken: String

    /// - Parameter now: The session store's trusted time (`FocusSessionStore.now`), so the bar agrees with the dial.
    public init(session: SessionRecord, now: Date, calendar: Calendar, locale: Locale) {
        if let breakEnd = session.breakEnd(at: now) {
            let back = HomeFormat.clock(HomeFormat.clockTime(of: breakEnd, calendar: calendar), locale: locale)
            title = "Break · back at \(back)"
            spoken = "Break, back at \(back). \(Self.returnLine)"
        } else {
            let left = session.plannedEnd.timeIntervalSince(now)
            let name = session.plan.presetName
            title = "\(name) · \(FocusTimeText.remaining(left)) left"
            spoken = "\(name), \(FocusTimeText.spokenRemaining(left, locale: locale)). \(Self.returnLine)"
        }
    }

    /// What a tap does, for VoiceOver: "Return to session.".
    static var returnLine: String { FocusCopy.returnToSession + "." }
}
```

4. Replace the whole `perform(_ action: NowState.Action)` function with the code below. Task 8 left `.startFocus` always opening the Focus tab; a ready start now begins at once:
```swift
    private func perform(_ action: NowState.Action) {
        switch action {
        case .startWindDown, .returnToWindDown:
            cover = .windDown
        case .openReveals:
            presentingRevealWithoutSlide { cover = .reveal(nil) }
        case .startFocus(let start):
            switch start.readiness {
            case .ready(needsHold: false):
                Task { await begin(start) }
            case .ready(needsHold: true):
                // Locked never starts with one tap (F1 design §5.2): its capsule is a hold, which begins it itself.
                break
            case .needsStartScreen:
                // The start screen has something to say first (F1-20).
                router.showFocus(.selectPreset(start.presetID))
            }
        case .returnToSession:
            router.showFocus(.returnToSession)
        case .turnOnBlocking:
            router.showFocus(.needsScreenTime)
        }
    }
```

5. Add these under `// MARK: Actions`, after `perform(_ action: NowState.SecondaryAction)`:
```swift
    /// Home's one-tap start (a completed hold for Locked): the preset as Start shows it, started from Home. A start
    /// the store refuses opens the Focus tab with that preset, where the start screen says why.
    private func begin(_ start: FocusStart) async {
        defer { holdProgress = 0 }
        guard let focusStores, let preset = focusStores.presets.preset(id: start.presetID) else {
            router.showFocus(.selectPreset(start.presetID))
            return
        }
        let appSet = preset.appSetID.flatMap { focusStores.appSets.set(id: $0) }
        let request = FocusSessionStore.StartRequest(preset: preset, minutes: start.minutes, appSet: appSet, from: .home)
        switch await focusStores.start(request, intention: nil, settings: settings) {
        case .started:
            break    // Home now shows the session: "50m" · "left in this session" · "Return to session".
        case .alreadyRunning:
            router.showFocus(.returnToSession)
        case .ledgerUnavailable, .blockingFailed, .notRecorded:
            router.showFocus(.selectPreset(start.presetID))
        }
    }

    /// A start is on its way: Start waits for it (the store refuses a second one anyway).
    private var isStarting: Bool { focusStores?.sessions.isStarting ?? false }

    /// Today's focus on the session store's trusted time, once Focus ships; nil before, when Home ignores it.
    private func focusStatus() -> FocusStatus? {
        guard collection.context.features.focus, let focusStores else { return nil }
        return focusStores.status(at: focusStores.sessions.now, collection: collection, settings: settings)
    }

    /// A running session's provisional seconds (display credit less what is counted), which the next-leaf row adds so
    /// it agrees with the dial (F1 design §4.3).
    private func provisionalSeconds() -> Int {
        guard collection.context.features.focus, let sessions = focusStores?.sessions, sessions.running != nil else { return 0 }
        return max(0, sessions.displayCredit(at: sessions.now).total - collection.focus.totalSeconds)
    }

    /// DEBUG `-MapleDemoHoldAt 0…1`: the hold's fill frozen for a screenshot (Task 7's `frozenProgress`); nil otherwise.
    private static let frozenHold: Double? = {
        #if DEBUG
        DemoLaunchOptions.current.holdAt
        #else
        nil
        #endif
    }()

    /// The whole minute `date` falls in.
    private static func minuteStart(of date: Date) -> Date {
        Date(timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate: (date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate / 60).rounded(.down) * 60)
    }

- [ ] **Step 8: The Herbarium's mini bar**

Create `App/Features/Herbarium/FocusMiniBar.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// The running session on the Herbarium (F1 design §5.10): "Study · 32m left", or "Break · back at 14:28", one tap
/// from the session's screen. Only the Herbarium has it, because Home already shows the session. Its time ticks
/// every second on the store's trusted time, so it agrees with the dial; with no session it draws nothing.
struct FocusMiniBar: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @Environment(\.focusStores) private var focusStores
    @Environment(AppRouter.self) private var router
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    /// The ticks run from here, so the schedule stays the same across redraws.
    @State private var ticksFrom = Date()

    var body: some View {
        if let sessions = focusStores?.sessions, let running = sessions.running {
            TimelineView(.periodic(from: ticksFrom, by: 1)) { _ in
                let bar = SessionMiniBar(session: running, now: sessions.now, calendar: collection.context.calendar, locale: locale)
                Button {
                    router.showFocus(.returnToSession)
                } label: {
                    HStack(spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
                        Text(bar.title)
                            .monospacedDigit()
                            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                        Image(systemName: "chevron.up")
                            .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                            .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                            .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    }
                }
                .buttonStyle(.glassCapsule)
                .accessibilityLabel(bar.spoken)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.gridMargin)
            .padding(.bottom, theme.spacing.xs)
            .transition(.opacity)
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 17: Settings and notifications

Settings gains the F1 rows (F1 design §5.12): "Session end", "Daily study reminder" with a time kept to the Day phase, and "Release all apps", which asks first. The reminders follow the session store (§6):
- `ReminderUpkeep` passes the running session and the latest start, on the store's trusted time, and never reschedules before the store's first replay.
- A notification-center delegate shows no banner while Maple is in front, and a tap on a session's end opens its receipt.
- The primer names a session's end.
- `-MapleDemoNotify sessionEnd` posts one.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **The replay gate.**
  - `ReminderInputs.plan(…sessions:…)` returns nil while `FocusSessionStore.isLedgerReadable` is false, and `ReminderUpkeep` then reschedules nothing.
  - `ledgerReadable` is part of the upkeep's inputs, so the first replay triggers the first reschedule.
  - While the ledger can't be read, the requests already pending stay as they are.
  - Cost if wrong: a schedule change made before the first unlock after a restart reaches the reminders only once the ledger can be read.
- **Trusted time throughout.**
  - The plan is built at `sessions.now`.
  - `NotificationScheduler.reschedule(plan:now:)` filters, and computes a session end's `.after(fireDate − now)`, at that same moment instead of its own wall clock. Before this, a clock set forward would have dropped a running session's end.
  - Wind-down and the study reminder keep their wall-clock triggers.
  - Cost if wrong: with a wrong clock, the 7-day horizon is off by the same amount.
- **The study reminder's window** (`StudyReminderWindow`):
  - the times in the Day phase on all seven days of the member's week: from the latest Day start to the minute before the earliest Evening start;
  - the standard schedule gives 10:00–20:14, and 16:00 is suggested (§6);
  - the wheel is kept to the window, and "Save" is disabled outside it;
  - a time saved earlier that a schedule change has put outside the window stays saved, and the row says so; `ReminderPlan` already skips the days it doesn't fit.
  - Cost if wrong: with a very different weekend, fewer times are offered than a weekday alone would allow.
- **Turning the study reminder on opens its time sheet.**
  - "Save" turns the reminder on, and closing the sheet leaves it off.
  - Before iOS has been asked, the primer opens once the time sheet has gone, as turning on wind-down does.
  - "Change time" appears under the row once a time is saved.
  - Cost if wrong: one sheet more than a plain switch.
- **Gating.**
  - "Session end" and "Daily study reminder" show only once Focus ships (`features.focus`).
  - "Release all apps" also needs a build that can block (`blocking.capability.canBlock`), so a free build never shows it.
  - Before the flip, Settings is unchanged. Cost if wrong: none.
- **"Release all apps":**
  - It is its own group under the reminders.
  - Its confirmation has no destructive role: nothing is lost, so it stays calm.
  - After a release with no session running, the row's line reads "Every app is open again." and VoiceOver announces it.
  - Cost if wrong: copy review.
- **No foreground banner for any kind.** `willPresent` presents nothing for all three kinds: a session's end has its receipt on screen, and wind-down and the study reminder never showed in the foreground before (there was no delegate). Cost if wrong: none.
- **Tap routing.**
  - The delegate (`NotificationDelegate`, nonisolated, set in `MapleApp.init` before launch finishes) hands the tapped identifier to `NotificationRouter` on the main actor.
  - `NotificationRouter.tappedReceipt` holds the session, and `RootView` turns it into `router.showFocus(.receipt(id))` once the tabs are up. That covers a cold launch from the tap, and a first run still in onboarding.
  - Wind-down and the study reminder only open Maple.
  - Limitation: a sheet that the Herbarium tab presented stays above the Focus tab. Home's sheets close (Task 8). Cost if wrong: one swipe.
- **The primer copy changes unconditionally.** It is §6's line, and F1b ships with the flip. Cost if wrong: a pre-flip build's primer mentions sessions.
- **New copy** (in `FocusSettingsCopy`):
  - "When a session ends, with its length."
  - "Once a day, at a time you choose."
  - "At 16:00, unless a session has already started that day."
  - "21:00 is outside your day now. Choose a time from 10:00 to 20:14."
  - "Your sleep schedule leaves no daytime for it."
  - "Change time"
  - "Any time from 10:00 to 20:14."
  - "Save"
  - "Close"
  - "If an app stays locked after a session ends, this opens it."
  - "Every app is open again."
- **New DEBUG arguments:**
  - `-MapleDemoNotify sessionEnd`;
  - `-MapleDemoNotifyTap sessionEnd`, which acts as a tap two seconds after launch;
  - `-MapleDemoSettingsOpen end|studyTime|releaseAll`;
  - `-MapleDemoStudyReminder HH:MM`, for demo launches only.

  So Settings can open scrolled to its end, `ProfilePage` reads a new `profilePageScrollAnchor` environment value. It is nil, and so unchanged, everywhere except DEBUG's Settings.

```swift
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import MapleCore

@Suite("Study reminder window")
struct StudyReminderWindowTests {
    /// Monday 2026-10-12, so the seven days run Monday to Sunday.
    private let monday = at(2026, 10, 12, 9)

    /// The phase at `hour:minute` on the day `offset` days after Monday.
    private func phase(_ hour: Int, _ minute: Int, dayOffset offset: Int, _ weekly: WeeklySleepSchedule) -> NowPhase {
        let day = LocalDay(monday, calendar: utc).adding(days: offset, calendar: utc).startDate(in: utc)
        let date = utc.date(bySettingHour: hour, minute: minute, second: 0, of: day)!
        return NowPhase.resolve(date: date, weekly: weekly, calendar: utc)
    }

    @Test("The standard day runs 10:00 to 20:15, so 10:00 to 20:14 can be chosen; 16:00 is suggested")
    func standard() throws {
        let window = try #require(StudyReminderWindow(weekly: .standard, around: monday, calendar: utc))
        #expect(window.earliest == ClockTime(hour: 10))
        #expect(window.latest == ClockTime(hour: 20, minute: 14))
        #expect(window.contains(ClockTime(hour: 16)))
        #expect(window.contains(ClockTime(hour: 10)))
        #expect(window.contains(ClockTime(hour: 20, minute: 14)))
        #expect(!window.contains(ClockTime(hour: 9, minute: 59)))
        #expect(!window.contains(ClockTime(hour: 20, minute: 15)))
        #expect(!window.contains(ClockTime(hour: 21)))
        #expect(StudyReminderWindow.suggested == ClockTime(hour: 16))
        #expect(window.suggestion == ClockTime(hour: 16))
    }

    @Test("A later weekend: only the times in the Day phase on all seven days")
    func weekend() throws {
        let late = SleepSchedule(bedtime: ClockTime(hour: 0, minute: 30), wake: ClockTime(hour: 9), windDownMinutes: 60)
        let weekly = WeeklySleepSchedule(weekday: .standard, weekend: late)
        let window = try #require(StudyReminderWindow(weekly: weekly, around: monday, calendar: utc))
        #expect(window.earliest == ClockTime(hour: 12))
        #expect(window.latest == ClockTime(hour: 20, minute: 14))
        // The phases agree, day by day: both ends are in the Day phase every day.
        for offset in 0..<7 {
            #expect(phase(12, 0, dayOffset: offset, weekly) == .day)
            #expect(phase(20, 14, dayOffset: offset, weekly) == .day)
        }
        // Just outside: 11:59 is still Saturday's morning, and 20:15 is Monday's evening.
        #expect(phase(11, 59, dayOffset: 5, weekly) == .morning)
        #expect(phase(20, 15, dayOffset: 0, weekly) == .evening)
        #expect(window.suggestion == ClockTime(hour: 16))
    }

    @Test("A schedule with no daytime has no window; a time outside one moves to its nearest edge")
    func edges() throws {
        // Wake 15:00, wind-down from 17:15: the Evening starts at 15:15, before the Day could.
        let short = SleepSchedule(bedtime: ClockTime(hour: 18), wake: ClockTime(hour: 15), windDownMinutes: 45)
        #expect(StudyReminderWindow(weekly: .everyNight(short), around: monday, calendar: utc) == nil)
        let window = try #require(StudyReminderWindow(weekly: .standard, around: monday, calendar: utc))
        #expect(window.nearest(to: ClockTime(hour: 8)) == ClockTime(hour: 10))
        #expect(window.nearest(to: ClockTime(hour: 22)) == ClockTime(hour: 20, minute: 14))
        #expect(window.nearest(to: ClockTime(hour: 13, minute: 5)) == ClockTime(hour: 13, minute: 5))
    }
}
```

import Foundation
import MapleStorage
import Testing
@testable import MapleCore
@testable import MapleServices

/// A session store on a manual clock over a planted collection, with the schedule and settings the plan reads.
@MainActor
private final class InputsHarness {
    let time = ManualFocusTime(wall: at(2026, 10, 12, 14))
    let collection: CollectionStore
    let schedule: ScheduleStore
    let settings: AppSettings
    let sessions: FocusSessionStore

    let six = AppSet(id: AppSet.distractionsID, name: "Distractions", selection: Data("six".utf8),
                     summary: SelectionSummary(mode: .blockThese, apps: 6, sites: 0, categories: 0))

    init() {
        collection = CollectionStore(storage: JSONStorage(.memory), context: testContext, now: at(2026, 10, 1, 9))
        collection.raise(.firstLeaf, to: 1, at: at(2026, 10, 1, 9))
        collection.openReveals(at: at(2026, 10, 1, 9, 5))
        schedule = ScheduleStore(storage: JSONStorage(.memory), collection: collection)
        settings = AppSettings(storage: JSONStorage(.memory), regionCode: "GB")
        let ledger = MemoryLedgerStore()
        let blocking = PreviewBlockingService(authorization: .allowed)
        let writer = LedgerWriter(store: ledger, time: time, deviceID: UUID(), writer: .app, source: blocking.source)
        sessions = FocusSessionStore(ledger: ledger, writer: writer, blocking: blocking, collection: collection,
                                     credited: [.live, .preview], liveActivity: NoLiveActivityController(), appBuild: "test")
    }

    func plan() -> ReminderPlan? {
        ReminderInputs.plan(collection: collection, schedule: schedule, settings: settings, windDownOpenedAt: nil,
                            sessions: sessions, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_GB"))
    }

    /// Starts Study for `minutes`; nil if the store refused.
    func start(minutes: Int = 50) async -> UUID? {
        let preset = FocusPreset.defaults(appSetID: AppSet.distractionsID)[0]
        let request = FocusSessionStore.StartRequest(preset: preset, minutes: minutes, appSet: six, from: .focusTab)
        guard case .started(let id) = await sessions.start(request) else { return nil }
        return id
    }
}

@Suite("Reminder inputs from the session store")
@MainActor
struct ReminderSessionInputsTests {
    @Test("Nothing is planned before the store's first replay, so a pending end is never removed")
    func waitsForReplay() async throws {
        let h = InputsHarness()
        #expect(!h.sessions.isLedgerReadable)
        #expect(h.plan() == nil)
        await h.sessions.refresh()
        let plan = try #require(h.plan())
        #expect(plan.requests.contains { $0.kind == .windDown })
        #expect(!plan.requests.contains { $0.kind == .sessionEnd })
    }

    @Test("A running session's end is planned at its planned end, named by its id")
    func sessionEnd() async throws {
        let h = InputsHarness()
        await h.sessions.refresh()
        let id = try #require(await h.start())
        let end = try #require(h.plan()?.requests.first { $0.kind == .sessionEnd })
        #expect(end.id == ReminderKind.sessionEndIdentifier(for: id))
        #expect(end.fireDate == at(2026, 10, 12, 14, 50))
        #expect(end.isAbsolute)
        #expect(end.title == "Session done")
        #expect(end.body == "Study, 50 minutes")
    }

    @Test("The plan runs on trusted time: a clock set forward keeps the end planned, after its real time left")
    func trustedTime() async throws {
        let h = InputsHarness()
        await h.sessions.refresh()
        let id = try #require(await h.start())
        // Ten minutes on, the member sets the clock to 16:00.
        h.time.advance(10 * 60)
        h.time.setWall(at(2026, 10, 12, 16))
        await h.sessions.refresh()
        #expect(h.sessions.now == at(2026, 10, 12, 14, 10))
        let plan = try #require(h.plan())
        let end = try #require(plan.requests.first { $0.kind == .sessionEnd })
        #expect(end.id == ReminderKind.sessionEndIdentifier(for: id))
        #expect(end.fireDate == at(2026, 10, 12, 14, 50))

        // The scheduler's own clock says 16:00; at the store's time the end is 40 minutes away.
        let center = FakeNotificationCenter()
        let scheduler = NotificationScheduler(center: center, clock: .fixed(at(2026, 10, 12, 16)))
        await scheduler.reschedule(plan: plan, now: h.sessions.now)
        let pending = try #require(center.pending[ReminderKind.sessionEndIdentifier(for: id)])
        #expect(pending.trigger == .after(40 * 60))
    }

    @Test("Ending the session, or releasing every app, takes its end out of the plan")
    func endedSession() async throws {
        let h = InputsHarness()
        await h.sessions.refresh()
        _ = try #require(await h.start())
        await h.sessions.end(.endedEarly)
        let afterEnd = try #require(h.plan())
        #expect(!afterEnd.requests.contains { $0.kind == .sessionEnd })

        let released = InputsHarness()
        await released.sessions.refresh()
        _ = try #require(await released.start())
        await released.sessions.releaseAll()
        let afterRelease = try #require(released.plan())
        #expect(!afterRelease.requests.contains { $0.kind == .sessionEnd })
    }

    @Test("The study reminder skips the day a session started")
    func studySkipsStartedDay() async throws {
        let h = InputsHarness()
        h.settings.studyReminderTime = ClockTime(hour: 16)
        await h.sessions.refresh()
        let before = try #require(h.plan()).requests.filter { $0.kind == .studyReminder }
        #expect(before.first?.fireDate == at(2026, 10, 12, 16))
        _ = try #require(await h.start())
        #expect(h.sessions.lastSessionStart == at(2026, 10, 12, 14))
        let after = try #require(h.plan()).requests.filter { $0.kind == .studyReminder }
        #expect(after.first?.fireDate == at(2026, 10, 13, 16))
    }
}

    func trustedNow() async throws {
        let center = FakeNotificationCenter()
        // The member has set the clock an hour forward; the session store's trusted time is still `now`.

    /// A running session's end reminder: "maple.reminder.sessionEnd.<the session's id, lowercased>".

    public static func session(inSessionEndIdentifier identifier: String) -> UUID? {

Create `MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Notifications/StudyReminderWindow.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

/// The times the daily study reminder can be set to (F1 design §6: "it must fall in the Day phase"): the times in the
/// Day phase on every day of the member's week, so the reminder comes each day it is wanted. That is from the week's
/// latest Day start to the minute before its earliest Evening start, on the wall clock.
///
/// With the standard schedule (bed 23:00, wake 07:00, 45 minutes of wind-down) the Day phase runs 10:00–20:15, so
/// 10:00 to 20:14 can be chosen. 16:00 is suggested.
///
/// ```swift
/// let window = StudyReminderWindow(weekly: schedule.weekly, around: now, calendar: calendar)
/// window?.contains(ClockTime(hour: 21))    // false: "21:00 is outside your day now"
/// window?.suggestion                       // 16:00, or the nearest time that fits
/// ```
public struct StudyReminderWindow: Sendable, Hashable {
    /// The time offered when the reminder is first turned on (§6).
    public static let suggested = ClockTime(hour: 16)

    /// The earliest time that can be chosen.
    public let earliest: ClockTime
    /// The latest time that can be chosen.
    public let latest: ClockTime

    /// The window over the seven days from `date`'s day, which hold one of each weekday. Nil when the schedule leaves no
    /// time in the Day phase on all of them.
    public init?(weekly: WeeklySleepSchedule, around date: Date, calendar: Calendar) {
        let phases = PhaseWindows(weekly: weekly)
        let first = LocalDay(date, calendar: calendar)
        var earliest = 0
        var latest = 24 * 60 - 1
        for offset in 0..<7 {
            let day = first.adding(days: offset, calendar: calendar)
            let windows = phases.day(day, calendar: calendar)
            guard windows.dayStart < windows.evening else { return nil }
            earliest = max(earliest, Self.minute(of: windows.dayStart, on: day, calendar: calendar))
            // The Evening starts at `evening`: the last whole minute before it.
            latest = min(latest, Self.minute(of: windows.evening, on: day, calendar: calendar) - 1)
        }
        guard earliest <= latest else { return nil }
        self.earliest = ClockTime(hour: earliest / 60, minute: earliest % 60)
        self.latest = ClockTime(hour: latest / 60, minute: latest % 60)
    }

    public func contains(_ time: ClockTime) -> Bool {
        earliest <= time && time <= latest
    }

    /// `time`, or the window's nearest edge when it falls outside.
    public func nearest(to time: ClockTime) -> ClockTime {
        min(max(time, earliest), latest)
    }

    /// What the time sheet opens on when nothing is saved: 16:00, or the nearest time that fits.
    public var suggestion: ClockTime {
        nearest(to: Self.suggested)
    }

    /// `date` as wall-clock minutes from the start of `day`, rounded up to a whole minute. It is above 1,439 on the next
    /// calendar day, and below 0 on the one before.
    private static func minute(of date: Date, on day: LocalDay, calendar: Calendar) -> Int {
        let parts = calendar.dateComponents([.hour, .minute, .second, .nanosecond], from: date)
        let days = LocalDay(date, calendar: calendar).ordinal - day.ordinal
        let whole = days * 24 * 60 + (parts.hour ?? 0) * 60 + (parts.minute ?? 0)
        return (parts.second ?? 0) > 0 || (parts.nanosecond ?? 0) > 0 ? whole + 1 : whole
    }
}
```

import Foundation

/// Settings' Focus rows (F1 design §5.12, §6): the session-end switch, the daily study reminder and its time sheet, and
/// "Release all apps". The release's own title and its confirmation are `FocusCopy.ReleaseAll`.
public enum FocusSettingsCopy {
    public static let sessionEndTitle = "Session end"
    public static let sessionEndDetail = "When a session ends, with its length."

    public static let studyTitle = "Daily study reminder"
    /// Under the switch while it is off.
    public static let studyOff = "Once a day, at a time you choose."

    /// "At 16:00, unless a session has already started that day."
    public static func studyOn(_ time: ClockTime, locale: Locale) -> String {
        "At \(HomeFormat.clock(time, locale: locale)), unless a session has already started that day."
    }

    /// A saved time that a schedule change has put outside the Day phase: "21:00 is outside your day now. Choose a time
    /// from 10:00 to 20:14."
    public static func studyOutsideDay(_ time: ClockTime, window: StudyReminderWindow, locale: Locale) -> String {
        "\(HomeFormat.clock(time, locale: locale)) is outside your day now. "
            + "Choose a time from \(HomeFormat.clock(window.earliest, locale: locale)) to \(HomeFormat.clock(window.latest, locale: locale))."
    }

    /// The schedule leaves no time in the Day phase every day.
    public static let studyNoDaytime = "Your sleep schedule leaves no daytime for it."
    public static let studyChangeTime = "Change time"

    /// The time sheet's line: "Any time from 10:00 to 20:14."
    public static func studyRange(_ window: StudyReminderWindow, locale: Locale) -> String {
        "Any time from \(HomeFormat.clock(window.earliest, locale: locale)) to \(HomeFormat.clock(window.latest, locale: locale))."
    }

    public static let save = "Save"
    public static let close = "Close"

    /// Under "Release all apps".
    public static let releaseAllDetail = "If an app stays locked after a session ends, this opens it."
    /// The same line once every app has been released from Settings, also announced to VoiceOver.
    public static let releaseAllDone = "Every app is open again."
}

      /// Makes Maple's pending requests exactly the plan's: removes the ones it no longer has, adds (or replaces)
      /// the rest, and clears delivered ones that no longer hold. Only the next 7 days are ever pending, and nothing
      /// while iOS doesn't allow Maple to notify. Requests other apps' code made are never touched.
      /// - Parameter now: The moment the plan was made for: `FocusSessionStore.now` (trusted time), so a session's end
      ///   fires after its real time left even when the clock has been moved. Nil uses the scheduler's own clock.
      public func reschedule(plan: ReminderPlan, now: Date? = nil) async {
          let previous = work
          let task = Task { [weak self] in
              await previous?.value
              await self?.apply(plan, now: now)
          }
          work = task
          await task.value
      }
  ```

Create `App/Features/Notifications/NotificationRouter.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import Observation
import UserNotifications
import MapleCore

/// What a tapped notification asks Maple to show (F1 design §6). Tapping a session's end opens that session's
/// receipt: `tappedReceipt` is set here, and `RootView` hands it to the Focus tab as `FocusRequest.receipt(_:)` once
/// the tabs are up, a tap that launched Maple included. Tapping wind-down or the study reminder just opens Maple.
@Observable
final class NotificationRouter {
    /// The session whose end notification was tapped, until `RootView` takes it.
    var tappedReceipt: UUID?

    /// The notification with this identifier was tapped.
    func opened(_ identifier: String) {
        guard let session = ReminderKind.session(inSessionEndIdentifier: identifier) else { return }
        tappedReceipt = session
    }
}

/// Maple's notification-center delegate. `MapleApp.init` sets it before launch finishes, so a tap that launched the
/// app still arrives. iOS may call it off the main thread, so it is nonisolated, and it hands only the tapped
/// identifier, a string, to the main actor.
///
/// - While Maple is in front it presents none of Maple's notifications: a session's end has its receipt on screen,
///   and wind-down and the study reminder never showed in the foreground before either.
/// - A tap on the notification itself (not a dismissal) goes to `opened`, which `MapleApp` points at
///   `NotificationRouter.opened(_:)`.
///
/// If the compiler reports that a method's signature doesn't match the protocol's, copy the requirement's exact
/// signature from `UNUserNotificationCenterDelegate` (Jump to Definition) and keep the method's body.
nonisolated final class NotificationDelegate: NSObject, UNUserNotificationCenterDelegate {
    private let opened: @MainActor @Sendable (String) -> Void

    init(opened: @escaping @MainActor @Sendable (String) -> Void) {
        self.opened = opened
        super.init()
    }

    func userNotificationCenter(
        _ center: UNUserNotificationCenter, willPresent notification: UNNotification,
        withCompletionHandler completionHandler: @escaping (UNNotificationPresentationOptions) -> Void
    ) {
        completionHandler([])
    }

    func userNotificationCenter(
        _ center: UNUserNotificationCenter, didReceive response: UNNotificationResponse,
        withCompletionHandler completionHandler: @escaping () -> Void
    ) {
        if response.actionIdentifier == UNNotificationDefaultActionIdentifier {
            let identifier = response.notification.request.identifier
            let opened = self.opened
            Task { @MainActor in opened(identifier) }
        }
        completionHandler()
    }
}
```

Replace the whole of `App/Features/Notifications/ReminderUpkeep.swift` with:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import UIKit
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// Keeps Maple's reminders in step with the member's day and their sessions (F1 design §6). It reschedules
/// (`NotificationScheduler.reschedule(plan:now:)`) on every foreground, and whenever the plan's inputs change:
/// - a schedule save, a reminder switch or the study time;
/// - wind-down mode opening, and iOS's permission answer;
/// - a session starting or ending, and the session store's first replay;
/// - a time-zone or clock change.
///
/// The plan runs on the session store's trusted time (`FocusSessionStore.now`), so a clock moved forward never drops a
/// session's end. Nothing is rescheduled until the store's first replay: before it, the store doesn't know whether a
/// session runs, and a plan without one would remove a pending end notification.
struct ReminderUpkeep: ViewModifier {
    @Environment(\.scenePhase) private var scenePhase
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @Environment(NotificationScheduler.self) private var reminders
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @Environment(ScheduleStore.self) private var schedule
    @Environment(AppSettings.self) private var settings
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions
    private let bedside = BedsideLog.shared

    #if DEBUG
    @Environment(NotificationRouter.self) private var notifications
    @State private var showsDemoStep = ReminderDemo.showsPrimerStep
    #endif

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .task(id: scenePhase) {
                guard scenePhase == .active else { return }
                await reminders.refreshAuthorization()
                await reschedule()
            }
            .onChange(of: inputs) {
                Task { await reschedule() }
            }
            .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: .NSSystemTimeZoneDidChange)) { _ in
                Task { await reschedule() }
            }
            .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: UIApplication.significantTimeChangeNotification)) { _ in
                Task { await reschedule() }
            }
            #if DEBUG
            .task {
                await ReminderDemo.postIfRequested(
                    reminders: reminders, schedule: schedule, collection: collection, sessions: sessions, locale: locale
                )
            }
            .task { await ReminderDemo.tapIfRequested(notifications: notifications, sessions: sessions) }
            .fullScreenCover(isPresented: $showsDemoStep) {
                NotificationsPrimerStep { showsDemoStep = false }
            }
            #endif
    }

    /// Everything the plan reads, so a change to any of it reschedules.
    private var inputs: ReminderInputsState {
        ReminderInputsState(
            schedule: schedule.weekly, savedAt: schedule.savedAt, nightSchedule: collection.schedule,
            settings: settings.reminders, windDownOpenedAt: bedside.session.startedAt, authorization: reminders.authorization,
            ledgerReadable: sessions.isLedgerReadable, runningSession: sessions.reminderSession,
            lastSessionStart: sessions.lastSessionStart
        )
    }

    private func reschedule() async {
        // Nil until the session store's first replay (`ReminderInputs.plan(…sessions:…)`).
        guard let plan = ReminderInputs.plan(
            collection: collection, schedule: schedule, settings: settings, windDownOpenedAt: bedside.session.startedAt,
            sessions: sessions, locale: locale
        ) else { return }
        await reminders.reschedule(plan: plan, now: sessions.now)
    }
}

/// What `ReminderPlan` is built from, compared to decide when to reschedule.
private struct ReminderInputsState: Equatable {
    var schedule: WeeklySleepSchedule
    var savedAt: Date?
    var nightSchedule: WeeklySleepSchedule
    var settings: ReminderSettings
    var windDownOpenedAt: Date?
    var authorization: ReminderAuthorization
    /// The session store has replayed its ledger: the first replay schedules the first plan.
    var ledgerReadable: Bool
    var runningSession: ReminderPlan.RunningSession?
    var lastSessionStart: Date?
}

extension View {
    /// Keeps the reminders scheduled (`ReminderUpkeep`). Apply it once, at the root.
    func reminderUpkeep() -> some View {
        modifier(ReminderUpkeep())
    }
}

```swift
#if DEBUG
import Foundation
import MapleCore
import MapleServices

/// DEBUG only: reminder states for simulator screenshots (docs/debug-launch-arguments.md).
///
/// - `-MapleDemoNotify windDown|sessionEnd` posts that reminder, with its real words, 5 seconds after launch (asking
///   iOS first if it hasn't been asked). `sessionEnd` is named by the demo's running or last session. Maple presents
///   none of its notifications while it is open (`NotificationDelegate`), so open another app (or lock the screen) to
///   see the banner.
/// - `-MapleDemoNotifyTap sessionEnd` acts, 2 seconds after launch, as if the last ended session's end notification had
///   been tapped: the Focus tab opens on its receipt (`NotificationRouter`).
/// - `-MapleDemoNotifyPrimer step` opens the first run's reminders step full screen; `sheet` opens the primer
///   from Settings (with `-MapleDemoPresent profile -MapleDemoProfile settings`).
/// - `-MapleDemoNotifyStatus allowed|denied|notDetermined` shows Settings as if iOS had answered that way
///   (`NotificationScheduler.launch()` reads it); nothing is scheduled on a demo launch.
@MainActor
enum ReminderDemo {
    static let delay: TimeInterval = 5
    /// How long after launch `-MapleDemoNotifyTap` taps: the tabs and the first replay are up by then.
    static let tapDelay: TimeInterval = 2

    private static var defaults: UserDefaults { .standard }

    static var requestedKind: ReminderKind? {
        switch defaults.string(forKey: "MapleDemoNotify")?.lowercased() {
        case "winddown": .windDown
        case "sessionend": .sessionEnd
        default: nil
        }
    }

    static var tapsSessionEnd: Bool { defaults.string(forKey: "MapleDemoNotifyTap")?.lowercased() == "sessionend" }
    static var showsPrimerStep: Bool { defaults.string(forKey: "MapleDemoNotifyPrimer")?.lowercased() == "step" }
    static var showsPrimerSheet: Bool { defaults.string(forKey: "MapleDemoNotifyPrimer")?.lowercased() == "sheet" }

    static func postIfRequested(
        reminders: NotificationScheduler, schedule: ScheduleStore, collection: CollectionStore, sessions: FocusSessionStore,
        locale: Locale
    ) async {
        guard let kind = requestedKind else { return }
        let calendar = collection.context.calendar
        let now = Date()
        let request: ReminderRequest
        switch kind {
        case .windDown:
            let night = UpcomingNight.nights(for: schedule.weekly, around: now, count: 1, calendar: calendar)
                .first { $0.bedtime > now }
            request = ReminderRequest(
                id: kind.identifierPrefix + "demo", kind: kind, fireDate: now.addingTimeInterval(delay), calendar: calendar,
                title: ReminderCopy.windDownTitle,
                body: ReminderCopy.windDownBody(bedtime: night?.bedtime ?? now, calendar: calendar, locale: locale),
                threadID: kind.threadID, interruption: .active, playsSound: true
            )
        case .sessionEnd:
            if !sessions.isLedgerReadable { await sessions.refresh() }
            // The demo's session, so a tap on the banner opens its receipt; Study, 50 minutes when there is none.
            let session = sessions.running ?? sessions.lastEnded ?? sessions.sessions.last
            let isPlainTimer = session?.plan.kind == .plainTimer
            request = ReminderRequest(
                id: session.map { ReminderKind.sessionEndIdentifier(for: $0.id) } ?? kind.identifierPrefix + "demo",
                kind: kind, fireDate: now.addingTimeInterval(delay), calendar: calendar,
                title: isPlainTimer ? ReminderCopy.timerDoneTitle : ReminderCopy.sessionDoneTitle,
                body: ReminderCopy.sessionEndBody(
                    presetName: session?.plan.presetName ?? "Study", minutes: session?.plan.plannedMinutes ?? 50,
                    isPlainTimer: isPlainTimer
                ),
                threadID: kind.threadID, interruption: .active, playsSound: true, isAbsolute: true
            )
        case .studyReminder:
            return                                  // `requestedKind` names wind-down and a session's end only
        }
        await reminders.postDemo(request, after: delay)
    }

    /// `-MapleDemoNotifyTap sessionEnd`: the last ended session's end notification, tapped.
    static func tapIfRequested(notifications: NotificationRouter, sessions: FocusSessionStore) async {
        guard tapsSessionEnd else { return }
        try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(tapDelay))
        if !sessions.isLedgerReadable { await sessions.refresh() }
        guard let session = sessions.lastEnded ?? sessions.sessions.last(where: { $0.end != nil }) else { return }
        notifications.opened(ReminderKind.sessionEndIdentifier(for: session.id))
    }
}
#endif

```swift
#if DEBUG
import Foundation
import MapleCore
import MapleServices

/// DEBUG only: Settings' Focus rows for simulator screenshots (docs/debug-launch-arguments.md). Pair it with
/// `-MapleDemoPresent profile -MapleDemoProfile settings`, and `-MapleDemoShip f1` for the Focus rows.
///
/// - `-MapleDemoSettingsOpen end` opens Settings scrolled to its end. `studyTime` also opens the daily study
///   reminder's time sheet, and `releaseAll` the "Release all apps?" confirmation, a second after the page appears.
/// - `-MapleDemoStudyReminder HH:MM` shows the study reminder saved at that time. It works on demo launches only, whose
///   settings live in memory.
@MainActor
enum SettingsDemo {
    enum Opening: String {
        case end
        case studyTime = "studytime"
        case releaseAll = "releaseall"
    }

    static var opening: Opening? {
        UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "MapleDemoSettingsOpen").flatMap { Opening(rawValue: $0.lowercased()) }
    }

    /// The Focus rows sit at the page's end.
    static var scrollsToEnd: Bool { opening != nil }

    static var studyReminder: ClockTime? {
        guard DemoLaunchOptions.current.isActive,
              let text = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "MapleDemoStudyReminder")
        else { return nil }
        let fields = text.split(separator: ":").compactMap { Int($0) }
        guard fields.count == 2, (0..<24).contains(fields[0]), (0..<60).contains(fields[1]) else { return nil }
        return ClockTime(hour: fields[0], minute: fields[1])
    }
}
#endif

Create `App/Features/Settings/StudyReminderSheet.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// The daily study reminder's time (F1 design §5.12, §6). A wheel kept to the times in the Day phase on every day of
/// the member's week (`StudyReminderWindow`), opening on the saved time or 16:00. "Save" turns the reminder on at that
/// time; closing the sheet changes nothing. It is a sheet over the Profile sheet, as the schedule editor is.
struct StudyReminderSheet: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(\.mapleClock) private var clock
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @State private var time: ClockTime
    @State private var detent: PresentationDetent = .medium
    private let window: StudyReminderWindow
    private let onSave: (ClockTime) -> Void

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - initial: The saved time, or `StudyReminderWindow.suggested`. A time outside the window moves to its nearest
    ///     edge.
    ///   - onSave: Called with the chosen time, just before the sheet closes.
    init(window: StudyReminderWindow, initial: ClockTime, onSave: @escaping (ClockTime) -> Void) {
        self.window = window
        self.onSave = onSave
        _time = State(initialValue: window.nearest(to: initial))
    }

    var body: some View {
        let calendar = collection.context.calendar
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                header
                Text(FocusSettingsCopy.studyRange(window, locale: locale))
                    .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                    .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xs)
                DatePicker(
                    FocusSettingsCopy.studyTitle, selection: selection(calendar),
                    in: Self.date(for: window.earliest, calendar: calendar)...Self.date(for: window.latest, calendar: calendar),
                    displayedComponents: .hourAndMinute
                )
                .datePickerStyle(.wheel)
                .labelsHidden()
                // The wheel reads the member's calendar, as the time it saves does.
                .environment(\.calendar, calendar)
                .environment(\.timeZone, calendar.timeZone)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .padding(.top, theme.spacing.sm)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
            .padding(.top, theme.spacing.lg)
            .padding(.bottom, theme.spacing.lg)
        }
        .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
        .safeAreaBar(edge: .bottom) {
            Button(FocusSettingsCopy.save) {
                onSave(time)
                dismiss()
            }
            .buttonStyle(.moonlight(dimmed: isQuietHours))
            .disabled(!window.contains(time))
            .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
            .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xs)
            .padding(.bottom, theme.spacing.xs)
        }
        .presentationDetents([.medium, .large], selection: $detent)
        .presentationBackground(theme.colors.surface2)
        .onAppear {
            // At accessibility sizes the wheel alone fills a medium sheet, so it opens tall.
            if dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize { detent = .large }
        }
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
            Text(FocusSettingsCopy.studyTitle)
                .font(MapleFont.sectionTitle)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            Button(FocusSettingsCopy.close, systemImage: "xmark") { dismiss() }
                .buttonStyle(.iconCircle)
        }
        // The close circle's 44pt hit area overhangs the margin, so the glyph lines up with the content edge.
        .padding(.trailing, -4)
    }

    /// Evening, wind-down and night dim the primary, as they do everywhere (spec §7.3).
    private var isQuietHours: Bool {
        switch collection.phase(at: clock.now()) {
        case .evening, .windDown, .night: true
        case .morning, .day: false
        }
    }

    private func selection(_ calendar: Calendar) -> Binding<Date> {
        Binding {
            Self.date(for: time, calendar: calendar)
        } set: { date in
            time = window.nearest(to: HomeFormat.clockTime(of: date, calendar: calendar))
        }
    }

    /// `time` on a fixed reference day, for the wheel.
    private static func date(for time: ClockTime, calendar: Calendar) -> Date {
        let reference = calendar.date(from: DateComponents(year: 2001, month: 1, day: 1)) ?? Date(timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate: 0)
        return calendar.date(bySettingHour: time.hour, minute: time.minute, second: 0, of: reference) ?? reference
    }
}

Replace the whole of `App/Features/Settings/RemindersSettingsGroup.swift` with:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import UIKit
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// Settings › reminders (spec §8.7, F1 design §5.12 and §6) as one Level-1 group, saved at once through `AppSettings`
/// and rescheduled by `ReminderUpkeep`: wind-down and, once Focus ships, a session's end and the daily study reminder.
///
/// A switch shows on only when its reminder will really come: iOS must allow Maple's notifications. Until iOS has
/// been asked, a status line says nothing is sent, and "Allow reminders" (or turning a switch on) opens the
/// primer. Once the member has said no, the switches rest off and "Turn on in Settings" opens Maple's notification
/// settings in the Settings app.
///
/// Turning the study reminder on opens its time first (16:00 suggested), kept to the Day phase on every day of the
/// member's week (`StudyReminderWindow`); closing that sheet leaves it off. Before iOS has been asked, the primer
/// follows a saved time.
struct RemindersSettingsGroup: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(\.locale) private var locale
    @Environment(\.openURL) private var openURL
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(\.mapleClock) private var clock
    @Environment(AppSettings.self) private var settings
    @Environment(NotificationScheduler.self) private var reminders
    @Environment(CollectionStore.self) private var collection
    @Environment(ScheduleStore.self) private var schedule
    @State private var sheet: RemindersSheet?
    /// A study time saved before iOS was asked: the primer opens once the time sheet has gone.
    @State private var primerFollows = false

    var body: some View {
        let window = studyWindow
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
            ProfileListGroup {
                ProfileSettingRow("Wind-down reminder", detail: Text("As wind-down begins, with your bedtime.")) {
                    ProfileToggle("Wind-down reminder", isOn: binding(\.windDownReminder))
                }
                if collection.context.features.focus {
                    ProfileSettingRow(FocusSettingsCopy.sessionEndTitle, detail: Text(FocusSettingsCopy.sessionEndDetail)) {
                        ProfileToggle(FocusSettingsCopy.sessionEndTitle, isOn: binding(\.sessionEndReminder))
                    }
                    ProfileSettingRow(FocusSettingsCopy.studyTitle, detail: Text(studyDetail(window)), link: studyLink(window)) {
                        ProfileToggle(FocusSettingsCopy.studyTitle, isOn: studyBinding(window))
                            // Nothing to turn on while the schedule leaves no daytime; a saved time can still go.
                            .disabled(window == nil && settings.studyReminderTime == nil)
                    }
                }
            }
            .disabled(reminders.authorization == .denied)
            status
        }
        // The page puts 24pt above each group; groups sit 32pt apart (spec §1 rule 10).
        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xs)
        .sheet(item: $sheet, onDismiss: sheetDismissed) { sheet in
            switch sheet {
            case .primer:
                NotificationsPrimerSheet()
            case .studyTime(let window):
                StudyReminderSheet(window: window, initial: settings.studyReminderTime ?? StudyReminderWindow.suggested) { time in
                    settings.studyReminderTime = time
                }
            }
        }
        #if DEBUG
        .task { await openForDemo() }
        #endif
    }

    /// The line under the group, and its action, while reminders can't be sent.
    @ViewBuilder private var status: some View {
        switch reminders.authorization {
        case .allowed:
            EmptyView()
        case .notDetermined:
            statusLine("Maple sends nothing until you allow it.", link: TextLink("Allow reminders") { sheet = .primer })
        case .denied:
            statusLine("Maple's notifications are off in the Settings app.", link: TextLink("Turn on in Settings") {
                if let url = URL(string: UIApplication.openNotificationSettingsURLString) { openURL(url) }
            })
        }
    }

    private func statusLine(_ text: String, link: TextLink) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            Text(text)
                .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            // The link's 44pt hit area overlaps the line's spacing rather than adding to it, as in a setting row.
            link
                .padding(.top, dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize ? 0 : -theme.spacing.xs)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
    }

    /// On when the member wants it and iOS allows it. Turning one on before iOS has been asked opens the primer.
    private func binding(_ key: ReferenceWritableKeyPath<AppSettings, Bool>) -> Binding<Bool> {
        Binding(
            get: { reminders.isAllowed && settings[keyPath: key] },
            set: { isOn in
                switch reminders.authorization {
                case .allowed:
                    settings[keyPath: key] = isOn
                case .notDetermined:
                    guard isOn else { return }
                    settings[keyPath: key] = true
                    sheet = .primer
                case .denied:
                    break
                }
            }
        )
    }

    // MARK: The daily study reminder

    /// The times the study reminder can be set to this week; nil when the schedule leaves no daytime.
    private var studyWindow: StudyReminderWindow? {
        StudyReminderWindow(weekly: schedule.weekly, around: clock.now(), calendar: collection.context.calendar)
    }

    private func studyDetail(_ window: StudyReminderWindow?) -> String {
        guard let window else { return FocusSettingsCopy.studyNoDaytime }
        guard let time = settings.studyReminderTime else { return FocusSettingsCopy.studyOff }
        return window.contains(time)
            ? FocusSettingsCopy.studyOn(time, locale: locale)
            : FocusSettingsCopy.studyOutsideDay(time, window: window, locale: locale)
    }

    /// "Change time", once a time is saved.
    private func studyLink(_ window: StudyReminderWindow?) -> TextLink? {
        guard let window, settings.studyReminderTime != nil, reminders.authorization != .denied else { return nil }
        return TextLink(FocusSettingsCopy.studyChangeTime) { sheet = .studyTime(window) }
    }

    /// On when a time is saved and iOS allows it. Turning it on opens the time sheet, whose "Save" turns it on; turning
    /// it off forgets the time.
    private func studyBinding(_ window: StudyReminderWindow?) -> Binding<Bool> {
        Binding(
            get: { reminders.isAllowed && settings.studyReminderTime != nil },
            set: { isOn in
                guard isOn else {
                    settings.studyReminderTime = nil
                    return
                }
                guard let window else { return }
                switch reminders.authorization {
                case .allowed:
                    sheet = .studyTime(window)
                case .notDetermined:
                    primerFollows = true
                    sheet = .studyTime(window)
                case .denied:
                    break
                }
            }
        )
    }

    /// After the time sheet: the primer, when a time was saved before iOS was asked.
    private func sheetDismissed() {
        guard primerFollows else { return }
        primerFollows = false
        if settings.studyReminderTime != nil, reminders.authorization == .notDetermined { sheet = .primer }
    }

    #if DEBUG
    /// `-MapleDemoStudyReminder`, then `-MapleDemoNotifyPrimer sheet` or `-MapleDemoSettingsOpen studyTime` once the
    /// page has settled.
    private func openForDemo() async {
        if let time = SettingsDemo.studyReminder { settings.studyReminderTime = time }
        let opensTime = SettingsDemo.opening == .studyTime && collection.context.features.focus
        guard ReminderDemo.showsPrimerSheet || opensTime else { return }
        try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1))
        if ReminderDemo.showsPrimerSheet {
            sheet = .primer
        } else if let window = studyWindow {
            sheet = .studyTime(window)
        }
    }
    #endif
}

/// What opens over Settings' reminders.
private enum RemindersSheet: Identifiable, Hashable {
    /// "A gentle reminder", with iOS's prompt behind it.
    case primer
    /// The daily study reminder's time.
    case studyTime(StudyReminderWindow)

    var id: String {
        switch self {
        case .primer: "primer"
        case .studyTime: "studyTime"
        }
    }
}
```

Create `App/Features/Settings/ReleaseAllSettingsGroup.swift`:
```swift
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// Settings › "Release all apps" (F1 design §5.12), for an app that stays locked by mistake. It asks first ("Release
/// all apps? Every app Maple is resting opens again now.").
/// - With no session running, every store is cleared at once (on F1 builds, the preview stores), and the row says so.
/// - During a session it goes through that strictness level's own end path on the Focus tab, so in Locked it is the
///   emergency release (`FocusReleaseRouter`, Task 12). Home closes the Profile sheet when the request arrives.
///
/// `SettingsView` shows it once Focus ships, in a build that can block.
struct ReleaseAllSettingsGroup: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(AppRouter.self) private var router
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions
    @State private var asks = false
    @State private var isReleasing = false
    /// Every app was released from here, so the row's line says so.
    @State private var released = false

    var body: some View {
        ProfileListGroup {
            Button {
                asks = true
            } label: {
                row
            }
            .buttonStyle(.profileRow)
            .disabled(isReleasing)
            // No destructive role: nothing is lost, and the words stay calm.
            .confirmationDialog(FocusCopy.ReleaseAll.question, isPresented: $asks, titleVisibility: .visible) {
                Button(FocusCopy.ReleaseAll.title) { release() }
                Button(FocusCopy.ReleaseAll.cancel, role: .cancel) {}
            } message: {
                Text(FocusCopy.ReleaseAll.body)
            }
        }
        // Groups sit 32pt apart, as the reminders do.
        .padding(.top, theme.spacing.xs)
        #if DEBUG
        .task {
            // `-MapleDemoSettingsOpen releaseAll` (SettingsDemo): the confirmation, once the page has settled.
            guard SettingsDemo.opening == .releaseAll else { return }
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1))
            asks = true
        }
        #endif
    }

    /// The title, with what it is for (or that every app is open again) under it.
    private var row: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.xs) {
            Text(FocusCopy.ReleaseAll.title)
                .font(MapleFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
            Text(released ? FocusSettingsCopy.releaseAllDone : FocusSettingsCopy.releaseAllDetail)
                .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                .contentTransition(.opacity)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
        .padding(.vertical, theme.spacing.md)
        .frame(minHeight: theme.spacing.row)
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
    }

    private func release() {
        guard !isReleasing else { return }
        isReleasing = true
        Task {
            let releasedNow = await FocusReleaseRouter(router: router).releaseAll(from: sessions)
            isReleasing = false
            // False: a session was running, and the Focus tab took over with its own way out.
            guard releasedNow else { return }
            released = true
            AccessibilityNotification.Announcement(FocusSettingsCopy.releaseAllDone).post()
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 18: The Live Activity

The running session gets its Live Activity (F1 design §5.11, §4.7, §7.7): the Lock Screen banner, the Dynamic Island's compact, minimal and expanded views, the break and plain-timer variants, and "Session complete" once the stale date passes. It has no buttons and no push. A new package library, `MapleActivity`, holds the attributes both sides share. A new extension target, `MapleWidgets`, draws them and links nothing else from MapleKit. The app's `ActivityKitController` is the real `LiveActivityController` that `FocusSessionStore` already calls after every change. So on launch and every foreground it reconnects to the running session's activity and ends any it doesn't recognise. The target wiring lands first, with a stub widget, as its own verified commit.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **The leaf travels as a sketch.** The widget can't link MapleDesign (main-actor, with resources) or MapleCore, so the app sends the next hours leaf's outline, veins and stalk as `LeafSketch`:
  - x, y byte pairs in a 0…255 square;
  - at most 240 outline points, with compound leaves thinned evenly;
  - the worst species is about 820 bytes of JSON.
  A test keeps every species under 2 KB and within 1 unit of its true box. Cost if wrong: a slightly coarser leaf on the Lock Screen.
- **The tint is a value, never gold.** `Theme.SeasonTints.leafColor(for:)` gives the standard theme's four season tints as `LeafColor` (0xRRGGBB). A test checks that they equal `Theme.maple`'s tokens. Without a tint, the leaf is text primary (`#F2F5FA`). Cost if wrong: a changed token needs this table changed too; the test fails until it is.
- **Every word is worded in MapleCore** (`FocusActivityState.lines(locale:calendar:)`), because the widget can't read MapleCore. The words, all from §5.11:
  - the Lock Screen line is "until 14:52 · Study", or "until 14:52 · Plain timer";
  - the expanded line is "Study · Chemistry ch. 4" (just "Study" without an intention);
  - during a break, both lines read "Break · back at 14:28";
  - once stale, the widget shows "Session complete" over the title.
  The clock style and time zone are the device's when the content is sent.
- **The intention cap:** the text is trimmed, and a longer one becomes its first 39 characters, trimmed, plus "…", so it is 40 at most. An empty intention means none.
- **The intention can arrive up to 15 seconds late on a session's first frame.** The store asks for the activity as the session starts, and `FocusStores.start` (Task 3) saves the intention after that. The next refresh (15 s at most, P6) sends the content again with it. Cost if wrong: the expanded view reads "Study" alone for a few seconds.
- **Asked for once per launch.** A session's activity is requested at most once per launch. One the member dismissed (or ActivityKit refused) isn't asked for again in that launch. After a relaunch it can come back, because ActivityKit forgets dismissed activities. A refusal is logged by error type, never content.
- **The upkeep rules are pure** (`LiveActivityPlan` in MapleCore, tested): end every activity still showing that isn't the running session's, including a second copy of it; reconnect to the running one and send fresh content; request one only when none shows. `LiveActivities.sync` applies the plan off the main actor (`@concurrent`), because ActivityKit's `Activity` isn't `Sendable`.
- **Ending:** when a session ends while Maple is open, its activity ends at once (`.immediate`), because the receipt is on screen. While Maple is away, the stale date (the planned end) turns it into "Session complete" until the next refresh ends it.
- **The ring fills as time passes** (`ProgressView(timerInterval:countsDown: false)`), as the dial's marks light, and is full once stale.
- **Which leaf:** the next hours leaf at the session's start (the first locked `hoursSaved` rung). A plain timer has none. Where the compact view would show a leaf, a plain timer shows the ring.
- **Demo activities bypass the demo store.** On a DEBUG demo launch, `-MapleDemoLiveActivity` shows its activity straight through the real controller, on real dates, as a new session each launch. Without it, a demo launch ends any activity an earlier launch left. The sandbox (`-MapleDemoSandbox YES`) drives the controller through its own store, as a live launch does.
- **A new DEBUG argument, `-MapleDemoLiveActivityExpand <seconds>`,** re-sends the activity with an alert that long after Maple leaves the screen, so the Dynamic Island shows its expanded view for a screenshot. Nothing can press and hold the island from the command line.
- **The minimal view can't be captured.** The system shows it only when two apps' activities compete. It is checked in code review only (P9).
- **Project settings:**
  - `MARKETING_VERSION` and `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` move to `Base.xcconfig`, because an extension's version must match its app's.
  - `COPY_PHASE_STRIP = NO` in `Base.xcconfig`, because stripping the signed extension while embedding it warns.
  - The extension's display name is "Maple", and its Info.plist lives in `Config/`.
  - It has no entitlements and no App Group.
- **DEBUG-only names contain "Demo"** (`expandForDemo`, `alertForDemo`, `LiveActivityDemo`), so `check-release.sh` would catch one that leaked into Release.
- **Screenshots** come from a new `Scripts/shoot-activity.sh`. It locks the simulator by pressing ⌘L in the Simulator app through System Events. That needs the terminal to be allowed under Accessibility; the script says so and stops with exit 3 if not.
- **New public names** (additive; no skeleton name changes):
  - `LeafSketch`;
  - `LiveActivityPlan`;
  - `FocusActivityState.Lines`, `lines(locale:calendar:)`, `described(intention:tint:leafID:)`, `capped(_:)` and `intentionLimit`;
  - `LeafGeometry.PlacedSkeleton` and `placedSkeleton`;
  - `Theme.SeasonTints.leafColor(for:)`;
  - DEBUG `FocusDemo.LiveActivity.state(options:now:session:)` and `endsAfter`.

Create `MapleKit/Sources/MapleActivity/FocusActivityAttributes.swift` (Step 20 replaces it):
```swift
import ActivityKit
import Foundation

/// The running session's Live Activity, shared by the app and the MapleWidgets extension (F1 design §5.11, §7.7).
/// This first version only carries the times, so the target wiring can be built and checked on its own; the next
/// commits give it the lines, the leaf and the tint.
public struct FocusActivityAttributes: ActivityAttributes, Sendable {
    public struct ContentState: Codable, Hashable, Sendable {
        public var start: Date
        public var end: Date

        public init(start: Date, end: Date) {
            self.start = start
            self.end = max(start, end)
        }
    }

    public var sessionID: UUID

    public init(sessionID: UUID) {
        self.sessionID = sessionID
    }
}
```

`Config/MapleWidgets.xcconfig`:
```
// MapleWidgets.xcconfig — the Live Activity extension (F1 design §5.11, §7.7). It has no entitlements and no App
// Group: everything it shows arrives in the activity's attributes and content. It inherits Base.xcconfig (bundle
// prefix, iOS 27, iPhone only, Swift 6, signing, and the version numbers, which must match the app's) from the
// project-level configuration, as the app target does.

PRODUCT_NAME = MapleWidgets
PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER = $(MAPLE_BUNDLE_ID).widgets
SKIP_INSTALL = YES

// Info.plist: generated keys, merged with Config/MapleWidgets-Info.plist for the NSExtension dictionary.
GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE = YES
INFOPLIST_FILE = Config/MapleWidgets-Info.plist

import ActivityKit

import WidgetKit

/// The running session's Live Activity (F1 design §5.11). This first version only proves the extension is wired: the
/// system timer text on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Step 27 replaces it with the real layouts.
struct FocusLiveActivity: Widget {
    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {
        ActivityConfiguration(for: FocusActivityAttributes.self) { context in
            Text(timerInterval: context.state.start...context.state.end, countsDown: true)
                .monospacedDigit()
                .padding()
        } dynamicIsland: { context in
            DynamicIsland {
                DynamicIslandExpandedRegion(.center) {
                    Text(timerInterval: context.state.start...context.state.end, countsDown: true)
                        .monospacedDigit()
                }
            } compactLeading: {
                EmptyView()
            } compactTrailing: {
                Text(timerInterval: context.state.start...context.state.end, countsDown: true)
                    .monospacedDigit()
                    .frame(width: 52)
            } minimal: {
                EmptyView()
            }
        }
    }
}
