- [ ] **Step 5: `check-release.sh` scans the extension too**

Replace the whole of `Scripts/check-release.sh` with:
```zsh
#!/bin/zsh
# Builds Maple in Release for the iPhone simulator and fails if any DEBUG-only demo or preview type made it into the
# app or into the extension it embeds (F1 design §8.4). Run from anywhere: Scripts/check-release.sh
# Exit 0: clean. Exit 1: DEBUG-only code found. Exit 2: the check could not run (no binary, a tool failed), which never
# counts as a pass.
set -euo pipefail
cd "${0:A:h}/.."
SIMULATOR="${SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17}"
DERIVED_DATA="${DERIVED_DATA:-$HOME/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/Maple-release-$(pwd -P | shasum | cut -c1-8)}"
xcodebuild build \
  -project Maple.xcodeproj -scheme Maple -configuration Release \
  -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=$SIMULATOR" \
  -derivedDataPath "$DERIVED_DATA" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet
APP="$DERIVED_DATA/Build/Products/Release-iphonesimulator/Maple.app"
# The app and the Live Activity extension: each is its own binary, with its own copy of the package code it links.
BINARIES=("$APP/Maple" "$APP/PlugIns/MapleWidgets.appex/MapleWidgets")
# Bare `Demo` covers DemoLaunchOptions, DemoData, DemoPresenter, RevealDemoOptions, HealthDemoSeeding, HerbariumDemo,
# ReminderDemo, SleepDemo, FocusDemo, FocusDemoPresenter and LiveActivityDemo. A bare `Preview` would also hit
# SharePreview and similar real names, so the preview types are named.
FORBIDDEN='PreviewBlockingService|PreviewLeafShareProvider|RecordingLiveActivityController|HealthSleepSeeder|Demo|DesignSystemView'
FOUND=""
for BINARY in "${BINARIES[@]}"; do
  [[ -f "$BINARY" ]] || { echo "No binary at $BINARY" >&2; exit 2; }
  SYMS=$(nm "$BINARY" | xcrun swift-demangle) || { echo "Could not read symbols from $BINARY" >&2; exit 2; }
  STR=$(strings - "$BINARY") || { echo "Could not read strings from $BINARY" >&2; exit 2; }
  [[ -n "$SYMS" && -n "$STR" ]] || { echo "Read no symbols or strings from $BINARY" >&2; exit 2; }
  # grep exits 1 when nothing matches (the pass); any other failure, such as a broken pattern, is an error.
  STATUS=0
  HITS=$(print -r -- "$SYMS"$'\n'"$STR" | grep -Eo "$FORBIDDEN" | sort -u) || STATUS=$?
  (( STATUS <= 1 )) || { echo "Searching $BINARY failed (exit $STATUS)" >&2; exit 2; }
  [[ -z "$HITS" ]] || FOUND+="${BINARY:t}:"$'\n'"$HITS"$'\n'
done
if [[ -n "$FOUND" ]]; then
  echo "Release build contains DEBUG-only code:"
  print -rn -- "$FOUND"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Release build has no demo or preview code (Maple and MapleWidgets)."
```
(This keeps Task 8's comment change, `RestDemo` → `SleepDemo` and `FocusDemoPresenter`, and adds `LiveActivityDemo`.)

import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// What the Live Activity shows for a running session (F1 design §5.11): display only, no buttons.
///
/// The Lock Screen and the compact view show the preset name only; the intention, capped at 40 characters, appears
/// only in the expanded view, which the member opens on purpose. The store builds this from the session; the Live
/// Activity controller then adds the intention, the season tint and the next hours leaf with `described(…)`.
public struct FocusActivityState: Sendable, Hashable {
    /// The longest intention the expanded view shows (§5.11).
    public static let intentionLimit = 40

    public var sessionID: UUID
    public var presetName: String
    public var start: Date
    public var plannedEnd: Date
    public var isPlainTimer: Bool
    /// When a running break ends ("Break · back at 14:28"); nil outside a break.
    public var breakEnd: Date?
    /// The session's intention, trimmed and capped at `intentionLimit` characters; nil when there is none.
    public private(set) var intention: String?
    /// The Lock Screen leaf's colour: the season tint as 0xRRGGBB, never gold. Nil until described.
    public private(set) var tint: LeafColor?
    /// The next hours leaf, drawn as a skeleton. Always nil for a plain timer, which shows no leaf.
    public private(set) var leafID: String?

    public init(session: SessionRecord, now: Date) {
        self.init(
            sessionID: session.id, presetName: session.plan.presetName, start: session.countdownStart,
            plannedEnd: session.plannedEnd, isPlainTimer: session.plan.kind == .plainTimer, breakEnd: session.breakEnd(at: now)
        )
    }

    public init(
        sessionID: UUID, presetName: String, start: Date, plannedEnd: Date, isPlainTimer: Bool, breakEnd: Date? = nil,
        intention: String? = nil, tint: LeafColor? = nil, leafID: String? = nil
    ) {
        self.sessionID = sessionID
        self.presetName = presetName
        self.start = start
        self.plannedEnd = plannedEnd
        self.isPlainTimer = isPlainTimer
        self.breakEnd = breakEnd
        self.intention = Self.capped(intention)
        self.tint = tint
        self.leafID = isPlainTimer ? nil : leafID
    }

    /// This state with what the store doesn't know: the session's intention, the season's tint and the next hours
    /// leaf (none for a plain timer).
    public func described(intention: String?, tint: LeafColor, leafID: String?) -> FocusActivityState {
        FocusActivityState(
            sessionID: sessionID, presetName: presetName, start: start, plannedEnd: plannedEnd, isPlainTimer: isPlainTimer,
            breakEnd: breakEnd, intention: intention, tint: tint, leafID: leafID
        )
    }

    /// `text` trimmed and capped at `intentionLimit` characters, a longer one ending in "…"; nil when empty.
    public static func capped(_ text: String?) -> String? {
        guard let text = text?.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines), !text.isEmpty else { return nil }
        guard text.count > intentionLimit else { return text }
        return String(text.prefix(intentionLimit - 1)).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) + "…"
    }

    /// The words the Live Activity shows, worked out in the app because the widget can't link MapleCore.
    public struct Lines: Sendable, Hashable {
        /// "Study", or "Plain timer".
        public var title: String
        /// Under the timer on the Lock Screen: "until 14:52 · Study"; "Break · back at 14:28" during a break.
        public var lockLine: String
        /// The expanded view's line: "Study · Chemistry ch. 4"; "Break · back at 14:28" during a break.
        public var expandedLine: String
        /// Once the planned end has passed (the activity is stale): "Session complete".
        public var complete: String
    }

    /// The lines in `locale`'s clock style ("14:52", "2:52 PM") and `calendar`'s time zone.
    public func lines(locale: Locale, calendar: Calendar) -> Lines {
        func clock(_ date: Date) -> String {
            HomeFormat.clock(HomeFormat.clockTime(of: date, calendar: calendar), locale: locale)
        }
        let title = isPlainTimer ? "Plain timer" : presetName
        let breakLine = breakEnd.map { "Break · back at \(clock($0))" }
        return Lines(
            title: title,
            lockLine: breakLine ?? "until \(clock(plannedEnd)) · \(title)",
            expandedLine: breakLine ?? ([title] + [intention].compactMap { $0 }).joined(separator: " · "),
            complete: "Session complete"
        )
    }
}

`MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Focus/LiveActivityPlan.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation

/// What to do with the Live Activities ActivityKit lists, so that exactly the running session's one shows (F1 design
/// §5.11, upkeep). Pure, so the rules are tested here; `ActivityKitController` applies the plan.
///
/// - Nothing running: every activity still showing ends.
/// - The running session's activity is found again (after a relaunch, or a kill): it is kept, and sent the new
///   content only when that content changed. Any other activity, and any second copy of it, ends.
/// - Its activity was dismissed (by the member, or ended by the system): it isn't asked for again.
/// - None yet: it is asked for, once per launch.
public struct LiveActivityPlan: Sendable, Equatable {
    /// One activity ActivityKit lists.
    public struct Listed: Sendable, Equatable {
        public var session: UUID
        /// Not ended and not dismissed.
        public var isShown: Bool

        public init(session: UUID, isShown: Bool) {
            self.session = session
            self.isShown = isShown
        }
    }

    public enum Next: Sendable, Equatable {
        /// Nothing is wanted.
        case clear
        /// The wanted activity already shows this content.
        case unchanged
        /// Send the new content to the activity at this index.
        case update(Int)
        /// The wanted session's activity was dismissed: leave it.
        case dismissed
        /// Ask ActivityKit for the wanted session's activity.
        case request
        /// This launch already asked for it, and it isn't showing.
        case notAsked
    }

    /// Indices of the listed activities to end.
    public var end: [Int]
    public var next: Next

    public init(end: [Int], next: Next) {
        self.end = end
        self.next = next
    }

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - activities: Every Maple activity ActivityKit lists, in its order.
    ///   - wanted: The running session, or nil when nothing runs.
    ///   - contentChanged: Whether the content to show differs from what this launch last sent (always true after a
    ///     relaunch, so a reconnected activity gets fresh content).
    ///   - mayRequest: Whether this launch may still ask for the wanted session's activity.
    public static func make(activities: [Listed], wanted: UUID?, contentChanged: Bool, mayRequest: Bool) -> LiveActivityPlan {
        var end: [Int] = []
        var kept: Int?
        var wasDismissed = false
        for (index, listed) in activities.enumerated() {
            if let wanted, listed.session == wanted {
                if !listed.isShown {
                    wasDismissed = true
                    continue
                }
                if kept == nil {
                    kept = index
                    continue
                }
            }
            if listed.isShown { end.append(index) }
        }
        guard wanted != nil else { return LiveActivityPlan(end: end, next: .clear) }
        if let kept { return LiveActivityPlan(end: end, next: contentChanged ? .update(kept) : .unchanged) }
        if wasDismissed { return LiveActivityPlan(end: end, next: .dismissed) }
        return LiveActivityPlan(end: end, next: mayRequest ? .request : .notAsked)
    }
}
```

`MapleKit/Sources/MapleActivity/LeafSketch.swift`:
```swift
import CoreGraphics
import Foundation

/// A small drawing of one leaf's skeleton for the Live Activity (F1 design §5.11): its outlines, veins and stalk as
/// x, y byte pairs in a 0...255 square. The widget draws the real species from it without linking the leaf
/// generator, and the whole sketch stays a few hundred bytes of the activity's 4 KB.
public struct LeafSketch: Codable, Hashable, Sendable {
    /// At most this many outline points in all, so every species fits: compound leaves are thinned evenly.
    public static let maximumOutlinePoints = 160
    /// The fewest points a thinned outline keeps.
    static let minimumOutlinePoints = 8

    /// Each blade's closed outline.
    public var outlines: [Data]
    /// Each vein, as an open line.
    public var veins: [Data]
    /// The stalk, as an open line.
    public var stalk: Data

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - outlines: Each blade's closed outline, in the leaf's own coordinates.
    ///   - veins: Each vein as a line of points, in the same coordinates.
    ///   - stalk: The stalk as a line of points.
    ///   - frame: The square the leaf is framed in (the catalogue's fitted square), mapped onto 0...255.
    public init(outlines: [[CGPoint]], veins: [[CGPoint]], stalk: [CGPoint], frame: CGRect) {
        let quantised = outlines.map { Self.deduplicated(Self.bytes($0, in: frame)) }
        self.outlines = Self.thinned(quantised).map(Self.data)
        self.veins = veins.map { Self.data(Self.bytes($0, in: frame)) }
        self.stalk = Self.data(Self.bytes(stalk, in: frame))
    }

    /// How many outline points the sketch keeps, across every blade.
    public var outlinePointCount: Int {
        outlines.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.count / 2 }
    }

    /// Each blade's outline in `rect`, ready for `Path.addLines` and `closeSubpath`.
    public func outlines(in rect: CGRect) -> [[CGPoint]] {
        outlines.map { Self.points($0, in: rect) }
    }

    /// Each vein as a line in `rect`.
    public func veins(in rect: CGRect) -> [[CGPoint]] {
        veins.map { Self.points($0, in: rect) }
    }

    /// The stalk as a line in `rect`.
    public func stalk(in rect: CGRect) -> [CGPoint] {
        Self.points(stalk, in: rect)
    }

    // MARK: Encoding

    private struct BytePoint: Hashable {
        var x: UInt8
        var y: UInt8
    }

    private static func bytes(_ points: [CGPoint], in frame: CGRect) -> [BytePoint] {
        guard frame.width > 0, frame.height > 0 else { return [] }
        return points.map { point in
            BytePoint(x: byte((point.x - frame.minX) / frame.width), y: byte((point.y - frame.minY) / frame.height))
        }
    }

    private static func byte(_ fraction: CGFloat) -> UInt8 {
        guard fraction.isFinite else { return 0 }
        return UInt8((min(max(fraction, 0), 1) * 255).rounded())
    }

    /// Drops points that land on the same byte pair as the one before.
    private static func deduplicated(_ points: [BytePoint]) -> [BytePoint] {
        var kept: [BytePoint] = []
        for point in points where point != kept.last {
            kept.append(point)
        }
        return kept
    }

    /// Thins every outline evenly so the total fits `maximumOutlinePoints`, keeping at least
    /// `minimumOutlinePoints` of each.
    private static func thinned(_ outlines: [[BytePoint]]) -> [[BytePoint]] {
        let total = outlines.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.count }
        guard total > maximumOutlinePoints else { return outlines }
        let floor = minimumOutlinePoints * outlines.count
        let spare = max(0, maximumOutlinePoints - floor)
        let extra = max(1, total - floor)
        return outlines.map { points in
            guard points.count > minimumOutlinePoints else { return points }
            let keep = min(points.count, minimumOutlinePoints + (points.count - minimumOutlinePoints) * spare / extra)
            return (0..<keep).map { points[$0 * points.count / keep] }
        }
    }

    private static func data(_ points: [BytePoint]) -> Data {
        Data(points.flatMap { [$0.x, $0.y] })
    }

    private static func points(_ data: Data, in rect: CGRect) -> [CGPoint] {
        let bytes = [UInt8](data)
        return stride(from: 0, to: bytes.count - 1, by: 2).map { index in
            CGPoint(x: rect.minX + CGFloat(bytes[index]) / 255 * rect.width,
                    y: rect.minY + CGFloat(bytes[index + 1]) / 255 * rect.height)
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import ActivityKit
import Foundation

/// The running session's Live Activity, shared by the app and the MapleWidgets extension (F1 design §5.11, §7.7).
///
/// Display only: no buttons and no push. Everything the widget draws arrives here, already worded, because the
/// extension links only this module: the copy is `FocusActivityState.lines(locale:calendar:)` in MapleCore, the leaf
/// is a `LeafSketch` of the next hours leaf, and the tint is the season's, never gold.
public struct FocusActivityAttributes: ActivityAttributes, Sendable {
    /// What changes while the session runs: its times and its lines.
    public struct ContentState: Codable, Hashable, Sendable {
        /// The countdown's start, for the ring's progress and the system timer text.
        public var start: Date
        /// The planned end, which never moves (F1-11). It is also the activity's stale date.
        public var end: Date
        /// "Study", or "Plain timer".
        public var title: String
        /// Under the timer on the Lock Screen: "until 14:52 · Study", or "Break · back at 14:28".
        public var lockLine: String
        /// The expanded view's line: "Study · Chemistry ch. 4", or "Break · back at 14:28".
        public var expandedLine: String
        /// Shown once the stale date has passed: "Session complete".
        public var completeLine: String

        public init(start: Date, end: Date, title: String, lockLine: String, expandedLine: String, completeLine: String) {
            self.start = start
            self.end = max(start, end)
            self.title = title
            self.lockLine = lockLine
            self.expandedLine = expandedLine
            self.completeLine = completeLine
        }
    }

    /// Text primary (`#F2F5FA`): the leaf's colour when no season tint was given.
    public static let neutralTint: UInt32 = 0xF2F5FA

    /// The session this activity shows; the app ends any activity whose session it doesn't recognise.
    public var sessionID: UUID
    /// The Lock Screen leaf's colour as 0xRRGGBB (sRGB): the season tint, never gold.
    public var tintRGB: UInt32
    /// The next hours leaf as a skeleton; nil for a plain timer, which shows no leaf.
    public var leaf: LeafSketch?

    public init(sessionID: UUID, tintRGB: UInt32 = FocusActivityAttributes.neutralTint, leaf: LeafSketch? = nil) {
        self.sessionID = sessionID
        self.tintRGB = tintRGB & 0xFF_FFFF
        self.leaf = leaf
    }

    /// The tint's sRGB components, 0...1, for `Color(red:green:blue:)`.
    public var tint: (red: Double, green: Double, blue: Double) {
        (Double(tintRGB >> 16 & 0xFF) / 255, Double(tintRGB >> 8 & 0xFF) / 255, Double(tintRGB & 0xFF) / 255)
    }
}

nonisolated extension LeafGeometry {
    /// A leaf's lines placed and ready to copy to a surface that can't draw `LeafView` (the Live Activity's sketch,
    /// F1 design §5.11): each blade's outline, each vein as drawn (shortened to `Stroke.veinDrawnFraction`), the
    /// stalk sampled along its curve, and the catalogue's framing square. All in placed space, as `frame` is.
    public struct PlacedSkeleton: Sendable, Equatable {
        public var outlines: [[CGPoint]]
        public var veins: [[CGPoint]]
        public var stalk: [CGPoint]
        public var frame: CGRect
    }

    /// This leaf's skeleton, placed (offset and tilted) as `LeafView` draws it.
    public var placedSkeleton: PlacedSkeleton {
        let control = Self.petioleControl(petiole)
        let stalk = (0...6).map { step -> CGPoint in
            let t = CGFloat(step) / 6
            let (a, b, c) = ((1 - t) * (1 - t), 2 * (1 - t) * t, t * t)
            return CGPoint(
                x: a * petiole.start.x + b * control.x + c * petiole.end.x,
                y: a * petiole.start.y + b * control.y + c * petiole.end.y
            )
        }
        return PlacedSkeleton(
            outlines: outlines.map { outline in outline.map { $0.applying(placement) } },
            veins: veins.map { vein in [vein.start, Self.veinDrawnEnd(vein)].map { $0.applying(placement) } },
            stalk: stalk.map { $0.applying(placement) },
            frame: frame
        )
    }
}
```

#if DEBUG
import Foundation
import MapleCore

extension FocusDemo.LiveActivity {
    /// The session a `-MapleDemoLiveActivity` launch shows, on real dates (F1 design §5.11: "Demo Live Activities use
    /// real dates"), so the system's timer text and the Lock Screen clock agree whatever `-MapleDemoPhase` says. It
    /// never touches the demo store.
    ///
    /// - `running`, `break` and `plain` are `-MapleDemoFocusAt` minutes in (18 by default; 31 for `break`, as the Focus
    ///   tab's break demo) of `-MapleDemoPreset`
    ///   (Study by default). A break started a minute ago, so it ends in 4 minutes.
    /// - `ended` reaches its planned end `endsAfter` seconds after launch, so a later screenshot reads
    ///   "Session complete".
    /// - The intention is `-MapleDemoIntention` ("" for none), or "Chemistry ch. 4".
    /// - Each launch is a new session (`session`), so an activity an earlier launch left is ended, never reused with
    ///   its old leaf and tint.
    public func state(options: DemoLaunchOptions, now: Date, session: UUID = UUID()) -> FocusActivityState {
        let presets = FocusPreset.defaults(appSetID: nil)
        let preset = presets.first { $0.verb == (options.preset ?? .study) } ?? presets[0]
        let length = TimeInterval(preset.minutes * 60)
        let intention = options.intention ?? Self.intention
        switch self {
        case .running, .breakTime, .plain:
            let minutesIn = min(max(options.focusAt ?? (self == .breakTime ? 31 : 18), 0), preset.minutes - 1)
            let start = now.addingTimeInterval(-TimeInterval(minutesIn * 60))
            return FocusActivityState(
                sessionID: session, presetName: preset.name, start: start, plannedEnd: start.addingTimeInterval(length),
                isPlainTimer: self == .plain, breakEnd: self == .breakTime ? now.addingTimeInterval(4 * 60) : nil,
                intention: intention
            )
        case .ended:
            let end = now.addingTimeInterval(Self.endsAfter)
            return FocusActivityState(
                sessionID: session, presetName: preset.name, start: end.addingTimeInterval(-length), plannedEnd: end,
                isPlainTimer: false, intention: intention
            )
        }
    }

    /// How long after launch `ended`'s activity goes stale.
    public static let endsAfter: TimeInterval = 8
    static let intention = "Chemistry ch. 4"
}
#endif
```

The extension takes MapleServices' default main-actor isolation, which is why the suite is `@MainActor`.

import ActivityKit
import MapleActivity
import SwiftUI
import WidgetKit

/// The running session's Live Activity (F1 design §5.11, §4.7): display only, with no buttons.
///
/// - Lock Screen: the next hours leaf as a skeleton in season tint (never gold), the system timer text over
///   "until 14:52 · Study", and the ring. A break reads "Break · back at 14:28"; a plain timer has no leaf.
/// - Compact: the leaf (the ring for a plain timer) and the timer text. Minimal: the ring.
/// - Expanded: the leaf, the timer text over "Study · Chemistry ch. 4" (the only place the intention shows), the ring.
/// - Once the stale date (the planned end) passes: "Session complete" and a full ring.
///
/// Every word arrives in the activity's content, already worded by MapleCore (`FocusActivityState.lines`).
struct FocusLiveActivity: Widget {
    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {
        ActivityConfiguration(for: FocusActivityAttributes.self) { context in
            LockScreenActivity(attributes: context.attributes, state: context.state, isStale: context.isStale)
                .activityBackgroundTint(ActivityPalette.card)
                .activitySystemActionForegroundColor(ActivityPalette.text)
        } dynamicIsland: { context in
            DynamicIsland {
                DynamicIslandExpandedRegion(.leading) {
                    LeadingMark(attributes: context.attributes, state: context.state, isStale: context.isStale, size: 34)
                        .padding(.leading, 4)
                }
                DynamicIslandExpandedRegion(.trailing) {
                    SessionRing(state: context.state, isStale: context.isStale)
                        .frame(width: 40, height: 40)
                        .padding(.trailing, 4)
                }
                DynamicIslandExpandedRegion(.center) {
                    TimeAndLine(state: context.state, isStale: context.isStale, line: context.state.expandedLine, timeFont: .title3)
                }
            } compactLeading: {
                LeadingMark(attributes: context.attributes, state: context.state, isStale: context.isStale, size: 20)
            } compactTrailing: {
                if context.isStale {
                    SessionRing(state: context.state, isStale: true)
                        .frame(width: 18, height: 18)
                } else {
                    Text(timerInterval: context.state.start...context.state.end, countsDown: true)
                        .font(.system(.subheadline, design: .rounded, weight: .semibold).monospacedDigit())
                        .foregroundStyle(ActivityPalette.text)
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
                        .frame(width: 52)
                }
            } minimal: {
                SessionRing(state: context.state, isStale: context.isStale)
                    .frame(width: 18, height: 18)
                    .accessibilityLabel(Text(context.isStale ? context.state.completeLine : context.state.lockLine))
            }
            .keylineTint(Color(attributes: context.attributes))
        }
    }
}

/// The Lock Screen banner: leaf, time and line, ring.
private struct LockScreenActivity: View {
    let attributes: FocusActivityAttributes
    let state: FocusActivityAttributes.ContentState
    let isStale: Bool

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            if let leaf = attributes.leaf {
                LeafMark(sketch: leaf, tint: Color(attributes: attributes))
                    .frame(width: 30, height: 30)
            }
            TimeAndLine(state: state, isStale: isStale, line: state.lockLine, timeFont: .title2)
            SessionRing(state: state, isStale: isStale)
                .frame(width: 36, height: 36)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 14)
        .padding(.vertical, 12)
    }
}

/// The system timer text (or "Session complete") over one line in secondary.
private struct TimeAndLine: View {
    let state: FocusActivityAttributes.ContentState
    let isStale: Bool
    let line: String
    let timeFont: Font.TextStyle

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 1) {
            Group {
                if isStale {
                    Text(state.completeLine)
                } else {
                    Text(timerInterval: state.start...state.end, countsDown: true)
                }
            }
            .font(.system(timeFont, design: .rounded, weight: .semibold).monospacedDigit())
            .foregroundStyle(ActivityPalette.text)
            Text(isStale ? state.title : line)
                .font(.system(.caption, design: .rounded))
                .foregroundStyle(ActivityPalette.secondary)
        }
        .lineLimit(1)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
    }
}

/// The leaf, or the ring when there is no leaf (a plain timer).
private struct LeadingMark: View {
    let attributes: FocusActivityAttributes
    let state: FocusActivityAttributes.ContentState
    let isStale: Bool
    let size: CGFloat

    var body: some View {
        if let leaf = attributes.leaf {
            LeafMark(sketch: leaf, tint: Color(attributes: attributes))
                .frame(width: size, height: size)
        } else {
            SessionRing(state: state, isStale: isStale)
                .frame(width: size * 0.9, height: size * 0.9)
        }
    }
}

/// The session's progress as the system ring, filling as time passes like the dial's marks; full once stale.
private struct SessionRing: View {
    let state: FocusActivityAttributes.ContentState
    let isStale: Bool

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if isStale {
                Circle().strokeBorder(ActivityPalette.text, lineWidth: 3)
            } else {
                ProgressView(timerInterval: state.start...state.end, countsDown: false) {
                    EmptyView()
                } currentValueLabel: {
                    EmptyView()
                }
                .progressViewStyle(.circular)
                .tint(ActivityPalette.text)
            }
        }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

/// The leaf's skeleton: outline in the tint, veins and stalk fainter, as `LeafView`'s skeleton style draws it.
private struct LeafMark: View {
    let sketch: LeafSketch
    let tint: Color

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            SketchShape(sketch: sketch, part: .stalk)
                .stroke(tint.opacity(0.6), style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1, lineCap: .round))
            SketchShape(sketch: sketch, part: .veins)
                .stroke(tint.opacity(0.4), style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 0.75, lineCap: .butt))
            SketchShape(sketch: sketch, part: .outline)
                .stroke(tint, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1, lineJoin: .round))
        }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

/// One part of a `LeafSketch` as a path in the shape's frame.
nonisolated private struct SketchShape: Shape {
    enum Part { case outline, veins, stalk }

    let sketch: LeafSketch
    let part: Part

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        Path { path in
            switch part {
            case .outline:
                for outline in sketch.outlines(in: rect) where outline.count > 2 {
                    path.addLines(outline)
                    path.closeSubpath()
                }
            case .veins:
                for vein in sketch.veins(in: rect) where vein.count > 1 {
                    path.addLines(vein)
                }
            case .stalk:
                let stalk = sketch.stalk(in: rect)
                if stalk.count > 1 { path.addLines(stalk) }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// The few colours the extension draws with. It can't read `Theme`, so these copy its values: text primary
/// `#F2F5FA`, the Lock Screen card from the mockup (`docs/design/mockups/f1-focus-screens.html`, `.lockcard`), and its
/// secondary line `#A7ADBA`.
private enum ActivityPalette {
    static let text = Color(red: 0xF2 / 255, green: 0xF5 / 255, blue: 0xFA / 255)
    static let secondary = Color(red: 0xA7 / 255, green: 0xAD / 255, blue: 0xBA / 255)
    static let card = Color(red: 40 / 255, green: 42 / 255, blue: 48 / 255).opacity(0.86)
}

extension Color {
    /// The activity's leaf tint (sRGB).
    fileprivate init(attributes: FocusActivityAttributes) {
        let tint = attributes.tint
        self.init(red: tint.red, green: tint.green, blue: tint.blue)
    }
}

`App/Features/LiveActivity/ActivityKitController.swift`:
```swift
import ActivityKit
import Foundation
import MapleActivity
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices
import os

/// The running session's Live Activity on ActivityKit (F1 design §5.11): display only, with no buttons and no push.
///
/// `FocusSessionStore` calls `reconcile(running:)` after every change, and through `refresh()` on launch, on every
/// return to the foreground and every 15 seconds while a session runs. So this is also where Maple reconnects to the
/// activity a killed app left running, and ends any activity it doesn't recognise (`LiveActivityPlan`). The
/// activity's stale date is the planned end, after which the widget reads "Session complete"; an activity never ends
/// a session itself.
///
/// - A session's activity is asked for at most once per launch, so one the member dismissed, or one ActivityKit
///   refused, isn't asked for again every refresh.
/// - Logs carry session ids and counts, never content.
final class ActivityKitController: LiveActivityController {
    private var collection: CollectionStore?
    private var notes: SessionNotesStore?
    /// What was last sent to each session's activity, so a refresh with nothing new sends nothing.
    private var sent: [UUID: FocusActivityAttributes.ContentState] = [:]
    /// Sessions this launch has asked ActivityKit for, or found dismissed.
    private var asked: Set<UUID> = []
    private let log = Logger(subsystem: "com.maanvikgupta.maple", category: "LiveActivity")

    /// Gives the controller what the store's state doesn't carry: intentions (`session-notes.json`), the season and
    /// the next hours leaf. `MapleApp` calls it once the stores exist.
    func attach(collection: CollectionStore, notes: SessionNotesStore) {
        self.collection = collection
        self.notes = notes
    }

    func reconcile(running state: FocusActivityState?) async {
        await show(state.map(described))
    }

    /// Shows exactly `state` (already described), or ends every Maple activity when it is nil.
    func show(_ state: FocusActivityState?) async {
        let wanted = state.map { state in
            LiveActivities.Wanted(attributes: attributes(for: state), content: Self.content(for: state), staleDate: state.plannedEnd)
        }
        let id = state?.sessionID
        let outcome = await LiveActivities.sync(
            wanted, lastSent: id.flatMap { sent[$0] }, mayRequest: id.map { !asked.contains($0) } ?? false
        )
        if outcome.ended > 0 { log.info("Ended \(outcome.ended, privacy: .public) Live Activities Maple didn't recognise") }
        guard let id, let wanted else {
            sent = [:]
            return
        }
        switch outcome.result {
        case .updated:
            sent[id] = wanted.content
        case .requested:
            asked.insert(id)
            sent[id] = wanted.content
        case .dismissed:
            asked.insert(id)
        case .refused(let reason):
            asked.insert(id)
            log.error("No Live Activity for session \(id, privacy: .public): \(reason, privacy: .public)")
        case .disabled:
            log.info("Live Activities are off; session \(id, privacy: .public) shows none")
        case .unchanged, .notAsked, .cleared:
            break
        }
    }

    /// The store's state with the intention, the season's tint and the next hours leaf (none for a plain timer).
    private func described(_ state: FocusActivityState) -> FocusActivityState {
        guard let collection else { return state }
        let leaf = collection.progress(at: state.start).first { $0.category == .hoursSaved && $0.state == .locked }
        return state.described(
            intention: notes?.intention(for: state.sessionID),
            tint: Theme.SeasonTints.leafColor(for: collection.season(at: state.start)),
            leafID: leaf?.speciesID
        )
    }

    private func attributes(for state: FocusActivityState) -> FocusActivityAttributes {
        let sketch = state.leafID.flatMap { LeafCatalog.shared.species(id: $0) }.map { species in
            let skeleton = LeafGeometry.of(species).placedSkeleton
            return LeafSketch(outlines: skeleton.outlines, veins: skeleton.veins, stalk: skeleton.stalk, frame: skeleton.frame)
        }
        return FocusActivityAttributes(
            sessionID: state.sessionID, tintRGB: state.tint?.rgb ?? FocusActivityAttributes.neutralTint, leaf: sketch
        )
    }

    private static func content(for state: FocusActivityState) -> FocusActivityAttributes.ContentState {
        let lines = state.lines(locale: .autoupdatingCurrent, calendar: .autoupdatingCurrent)
        return FocusActivityAttributes.ContentState(
            start: state.start, end: state.plannedEnd, title: lines.title, lockLine: lines.lockLine,
            expandedLine: lines.expandedLine, completeLine: lines.complete
        )
    }

    #if DEBUG
    /// DEBUG screenshots only (`-MapleDemoLiveActivityExpand`): sends the running activity's content again with an
    /// alert, so the Dynamic Island shows its expanded presentation for a few seconds.
    func expandForDemo() async {
        await LiveActivities.alertForDemo()
    }
    #endif
}

/// ActivityKit's side, off the main actor. `Activity` isn't `Sendable`, so it never crosses into the controller:
/// only attributes, content and outcomes do.
nonisolated enum LiveActivities {
    struct Wanted: Sendable {
        var attributes: FocusActivityAttributes
        var content: FocusActivityAttributes.ContentState
        var staleDate: Date
    }

    struct Outcome: Sendable {
        enum Result: Sendable {
            /// Nothing is wanted; every Maple activity has ended.
            case cleared
            /// The session's activity already shows this content.
            case unchanged
            case updated
            case requested
            /// The session's activity was dismissed (by the member, or ended by the system): it isn't asked for again.
            case dismissed
            /// Already asked for this launch, and not showing.
            case notAsked
            /// Live Activities are off for Maple in Settings.
            case disabled
            /// ActivityKit refused the request; the reason is the error's type, never its message.
            case refused(String)
        }

        var ended: Int
        var result: Result
    }

    /// Applies `LiveActivityPlan`: ends what it lists, then updates or requests the wanted session's activity.
    @concurrent
    static func sync(
        _ wanted: Wanted?, lastSent: FocusActivityAttributes.ContentState?, mayRequest: Bool
    ) async -> Outcome {
        let activities = Activity<FocusActivityAttributes>.activities
        let plan = LiveActivityPlan.make(
            activities: activities.map { activity in
                LiveActivityPlan.Listed(
                    session: activity.attributes.sessionID,
                    isShown: activity.activityState != .ended && activity.activityState != .dismissed
                )
            },
            wanted: wanted?.attributes.sessionID, contentChanged: lastSent != wanted?.content, mayRequest: mayRequest
        )
        for index in plan.end {
            await activities[index].end(nil, dismissalPolicy: .immediate)
        }
        let ended = plan.end.count
        guard let wanted else { return Outcome(ended: ended, result: .cleared) }
        switch plan.next {
        case .clear:
            return Outcome(ended: ended, result: .cleared)
        case .unchanged:
            return Outcome(ended: ended, result: .unchanged)
        case .update(let index):
            await activities[index].update(ActivityContent(state: wanted.content, staleDate: wanted.staleDate))
            return Outcome(ended: ended, result: .updated)
        case .dismissed:
            return Outcome(ended: ended, result: .dismissed)
        case .notAsked:
            return Outcome(ended: ended, result: .notAsked)
        case .request:
            guard ActivityAuthorizationInfo().areActivitiesEnabled else { return Outcome(ended: ended, result: .disabled) }
            do {
                _ = try Activity.request(
                    attributes: wanted.attributes,
                    content: ActivityContent(state: wanted.content, staleDate: wanted.staleDate),
                    pushType: nil
                )
                return Outcome(ended: ended, result: .requested)
            } catch {
                return Outcome(ended: ended, result: .refused(String(describing: type(of: error))))
            }
        }
    }

    #if DEBUG
    /// Re-sends each active activity's content with an alert (DEBUG screenshots of the expanded presentation).
    @concurrent
    static func alertForDemo() async {
        for activity in Activity<FocusActivityAttributes>.activities where activity.activityState == .active {
            let state = activity.content.state
            let alert = AlertConfiguration(
                title: LocalizedStringResource(String.LocalizationValue(state.title)),
                body: LocalizedStringResource(String.LocalizationValue(state.lockLine)),
                sound: .default
            )
            await activity.update(activity.content, alertConfiguration: alert)
        }
    }
    #endif
}
```

`App/Features/LiveActivity/LiveActivityDemo.swift`:
```swift
#if DEBUG
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices
import SwiftUI
import UIKit

extension View {
    /// DEBUG only, on a demo launch:
    /// - shows `-MapleDemoLiveActivity running|break|plain|ended` as a real Live Activity on real dates, straight
    ///   through `controller` (the demo store never shows one);
    /// - without it, ends any Maple activity an earlier launch left, so screenshots start clean;
    /// - with `-MapleDemoLiveActivityExpand <seconds>`, that long after Maple goes to the background, re-sends the
    ///   activity with an alert, so the Dynamic Island shows its expanded presentation for a screenshot.
    /// The sandbox's store drives the controller itself, so the sandbox is left alone.
    func liveActivityDemo(_ controller: ActivityKitController, collection: CollectionStore) -> some View {
        modifier(LiveActivityDemoRunner(controller: controller, collection: collection))
    }
}

private struct LiveActivityDemoRunner: ViewModifier {
    @Environment(\.scenePhase) private var scenePhase
    let controller: ActivityKitController
    let collection: CollectionStore
    @State private var hasShown = false

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content.task(id: scenePhase) {
            let options = DemoLaunchOptions.current
            guard options.isActive, !options.sandbox else { return }
            switch scenePhase {
            case .active where !hasShown:
                hasShown = true
                await show(options)
            case .background:
                await expandLater(options)
            default:
                break
            }
        }
    }

    private func show(_ options: DemoLaunchOptions) async {
        guard let value = options.liveActivity else {
            await controller.show(nil)
            return
        }
        let now = Date.now
        let state = value.state(options: options, now: now)
        let leaf = collection.progress(at: now).first { $0.category == .hoursSaved && $0.state == .locked }
        await controller.show(state.described(
            intention: state.intention, tint: Theme.SeasonTints.leafColor(for: collection.season(at: now)), leafID: leaf?.speciesID
        ))
    }

    private func expandLater(_ options: DemoLaunchOptions) async {
        guard options.liveActivity != nil,
              let seconds = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "MapleDemoLiveActivityExpand").flatMap(TimeInterval.init)
        else { return }
        let task = UIApplication.shared.beginBackgroundTask(withName: "LiveActivityDemoExpand", expirationHandler: nil)
        defer { UIApplication.shared.endBackgroundTask(task) }
        guard (try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(max(0, seconds)))) != nil else { return }
        await controller.expandForDemo()
    }
}
#endif
```

`Scripts/shoot-activity.sh`:
```zsh
#!/bin/zsh
# Screenshots Maple's Live Activity outside the app (F1 design §5.11): on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
#
#   Scripts/shoot-activity.sh <name> <out-dir> lock|island|expanded [--no-build] [--after <seconds>] [-- <launch arguments…>]
#
# 1. Launches Maple with the launch arguments through Scripts/shoot.sh (building first, unless --no-build). That also
#    saves <out-dir>/<name>-app.png: the app as it starts the activity.
# 2. Then, on the same "$SIMULATOR" simulator (default "iPhone 17"):
#    lock      locks it (Simulator › Device › Lock, ⌘L), waits --after seconds (default 2), saves <out-dir>/<name>.png,
#              and unlocks it again (Device › Home, ⇧⌘H);
#    island    brings Settings forward, so Maple's activity moves into the Dynamic Island, waits --after seconds
#              (default 2) and saves <out-dir>/<name>.png: the compact presentation;
#    expanded  brings Settings forward and, from --after seconds (default 2.4), saves <name>-1.png, -2.png and
#              -3.png, 0.6 s apart. Launch with -MapleDemoLiveActivityExpand 2: the activity alerts 2 s after Maple
#              leaves the screen, and the island shows its expanded presentation for a few seconds.
#
# Locking and unlocking press keys in the Simulator app, which needs this terminal to be allowed to control the
# computer (System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility). Without it the lock step stops with exit 3: lock
# the simulator by hand (⌘L in Simulator), save the screen with `xcrun simctl io <udid> screenshot <file>`, and
# unlock it (⇧⌘H).
#
# Exit 0: saved (each path is printed). 1: the build failed. 2: a simulator step failed. 3: the simulator couldn't be
# locked or unlocked. 64: wrong usage.
set -euo pipefail
cd "${0:A:h}/.."

usage() {
  print -u2 "Usage: Scripts/shoot-activity.sh <name> <out-dir> lock|island|expanded [--no-build] [--after <seconds>] [-- <launch arguments…>]"
}

fail() {
  print -u2 "shoot-activity.sh: $2"
  exit $1
}

if [[ ${1:-} == -h || ${1:-} == --help ]]; then
  usage
  exit 0
fi
(( $# >= 3 )) || { usage; exit 64; }
NAME=$1
OUT=$2
MODE=$3
shift 3
if [[ $MODE != lock && $MODE != island && $MODE != expanded ]]; then
  print -u2 "shoot-activity.sh: the mode must be lock, island or expanded, not '$MODE'"
  usage
  exit 64
fi

SHOOT_OPTIONS=()
AFTER=""
while (( $# > 0 )); do
  case $1 in
    --no-build)
      SHOOT_OPTIONS+=(--no-build)
      shift ;;
    --after)
      [[ $# -ge 2 && $2 =~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' ]] || { print -u2 "shoot-activity.sh: --after needs a number of seconds"; usage; exit 64; }
      AFTER=$2
      shift 2 ;;
    --)
      shift
      break ;;
    *)
      print -u2 "shoot-activity.sh: unknown option '$1' (launch arguments go after --)"
      usage
      exit 64 ;;
  esac
done
if [[ -z $AFTER ]]; then
  if [[ $MODE == expanded ]]; then AFTER=2.4; else AFTER=2; fi
fi

# 1. The launch, and the app's own frame. shoot.sh's exit codes (1 build, 2 simulator, 64 usage) pass through.
Scripts/shoot.sh "$NAME-app" "$OUT" "${SHOOT_OPTIONS[@]}" --wait 4 -- "$@" || exit $?

SIMULATOR="${SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17}"
UDID=$(xcrun simctl list devices available \
  | sed -nE 's/^[[:space:]]+'"$SIMULATOR"' \(([0-9A-F-]{36})\) \(.*\)[[:space:]]*$/\1/p' | head -1)
[[ -n $UDID ]] || fail 2 "no available simulator named \"$SIMULATOR\""

# Presses a key in the Simulator window that shows this device: simulator_key <key> <modifiers>.
simulator_key() {
  open -a Simulator --args -CurrentDeviceUDID "$UDID" || return 1
  sleep 1
  osascript -e 'tell application "Simulator" to activate' \
    -e "tell application \"System Events\" to keystroke \"$1\" using {$2}" > /dev/null 2>&1
}

save() {
  xcrun simctl io "$UDID" screenshot "$OUT/$1.png" > /dev/null 2>&1 || fail 2 "couldn't save $OUT/$1.png"
  print -r -- "$OUT/$1.png"
}

case $MODE in
  lock)
    simulator_key l "command down" \
      || fail 3 "couldn't lock the simulator: allow this terminal under System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility, or lock it by hand (⌘L)"
    sleep "$AFTER"
    save "$NAME"
    simulator_key h "command down, shift down" || fail 3 "couldn't unlock the simulator: press ⇧⌘H in Simulator"
    ;;
  island)
    xcrun simctl launch "$UDID" com.apple.Preferences > /dev/null || fail 2 "couldn't open Settings"
    sleep "$AFTER"
    save "$NAME"
    ;;
  expanded)
    xcrun simctl launch "$UDID" com.apple.Preferences > /dev/null || fail 2 "couldn't open Settings"
    sleep "$AFTER"
    for frame in 1 2 3; do
      save "$NAME-$frame"
      sleep 0.6
    done
    ;;
esac
```

### Task 19: Accessibility, large text and the DEBUG ledger inspector

An audit of every F1b screen against §4.9 (VoiceOver), §5.17 (large text), F1-22 (holds) and §4.6 (motion and Reduce Motion), and the fixes it finds. `-MapleDemoReduceMotion YES` is extended from the reveal to the whole app, so Focus's Reduce Motion frames can be screenshotted. Settings gains a DEBUG-only "Ledger inspector", which lists the ledger's events by kind, session, sequence and time, with no content.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **Magic Tap on the running dial moves VoiceOver to the session's first control** ("Take a break", or "End early" / "Emergency release"), through `@AccessibilityFocusState`, as Task 11 built it; this task only checks it. That is §4.9's "returns to the session controls". It never ends or pauses anything. Cost if wrong: one action.
- **`-MapleDemoReduceMotion YES` now covers the whole app.**
  - `.revealDemoMotion()` is applied once at the tabs in `RootView`, and again at the root of every sheet and cover that shows Focus content, because a presented sheet may read Reduce Motion from its own traits instead of the presenter's.
  - It still acts only on a demo launch.
  - `RevealDemoOptions` keeps its name, so the reveal and onboarding are untouched.
  - Cost if wrong: a Focus sheet animates in a Reduce Motion screenshot; Step 10's screenshots show it.
- **The ledger inspector** is DEBUG only:
  - the last group of Settings, as "Ledger inspector ›";
  - newest first, capped at the newest 500 events;
  - each row shows the kind ("shieldApplied"), the wall time, and "session 1A2B3C4D · app #12 · live";
  - never a preset name, intention, length, reason or reflection;
  - `-MapleDemoProfile ledger` opens it.
  The store hands it ready-made rows (`ledgerInspection(calendar:)`), so the app never touches ledger event types. Cost if wrong: none outside DEBUG.
- **`check-release.sh` forbids `LedgerInspect` too,** which covers `LedgerInspection` and `LedgerInspector`.
- **Audit fixes stay in the screen's own file.** A fix that needs a new string adds it to `FocusCopy` or `FocusSheetCopy`, with a test, never inline. The audit's results go in `$WS/task-19-audit.md`, a workspace note, not a repo doc.

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the rows**

`MapleKit/Sources/MapleCore/Focus/LedgerInspection.swift`:
```swift
#if DEBUG
import Foundation
import MapleFocusCore

/// DEBUG only: what Settings › Ledger inspector lists (F1 design §7.7). Every event, newest first, by its kind, its
/// session (the id's first 8 characters), its writer and sequence number, its source and its wall time. Nothing
/// else: no preset name, intention, length or reason, so the inspector shows the ledger's shape, never its content.
public enum LedgerInspection {
    public struct Row: Sendable, Hashable, Identifiable {
        /// The event's id.
        public var id: String
        /// The kind's name in the ledger file: "sessionStarted", "shieldApplied", …
        public var kind: String
        /// "session 00000000 · app #3 · live".
        public var detail: String
        /// The wall time in the calendar's time zone: "2026-10-23 14:03:05".
        public var time: String
    }

    public struct Page: Sendable, Hashable {
        /// "3 events · 1 session"; past `rowLimit`, "Showing the newest 500 of 812 events · 9 sessions".
        public var summary: String
        public var rows: [Row]
    }

    /// The most rows the inspector lists.
    public static let rowLimit = 500

    public static func page(_ events: [FocusEvent], calendar: Calendar) -> Page {
        let newestFirst = events.sorted { a, b in
            if a.stamp.wall != b.stamp.wall { return a.stamp.wall > b.stamp.wall }
            if a.seq != b.seq { return a.seq > b.seq }
            return a.id > b.id
        }
        let rows = newestFirst.prefix(rowLimit).map { event in
            Row(
                id: event.id, kind: event.kind.type,
                detail: "session \(event.sessionID.uuidString.prefix(8)) · \(event.writer.rawValue) #\(event.seq) · \(event.source.rawValue)",
                time: wallTime(event.stamp.wall, calendar: calendar)
            )
        }
        let sessions = Set(events.map(\.sessionID)).count
        let counted = "\(count(events.count, "event")) · \(count(sessions, "session"))"
        let summary = events.count > rowLimit ? "Showing the newest \(rowLimit) of \(counted)" : counted
        return Page(summary: summary, rows: Array(rows))
    }

    private static func count(_ n: Int, _ noun: String) -> String {
        n == 1 ? "1 \(noun)" : "\(n) \(noun)s"
    }

    private static func wallTime(_ date: Date, calendar: Calendar) -> String {
        let parts = calendar.dateComponents([.year, .month, .day, .hour, .minute, .second], from: date)
        func two(_ value: Int?) -> String {
            let value = value ?? 0
            return value < 10 ? "0\(value)" : "\(value)"
        }
        return "\(parts.year ?? 0)-\(two(parts.month))-\(two(parts.day)) \(two(parts.hour)):\(two(parts.minute)):\(two(parts.second))"
    }
}
#endif
```

Run the same command with `task-19-ledger-green.log`, then `tail -5` it. Expected: `** TEST SUCCEEDED **`, with 3 tests run.

Append to the end of `MapleKit/Sources/MapleServices/Focus/FocusSessionStore.swift`, after the class's closing brace. It is in this file because `ledger` is private, and a same-file extension can read it:
```swift

#if DEBUG
extension FocusSessionStore {
    /// DEBUG only (Settings › Ledger inspector): the whole ledger as the inspector's rows, newest first, with no
    /// content. Nil while the ledger can't be read. In this file because `ledger` is private.
    public func ledgerInspection(calendar: Calendar) -> LedgerInspection.Page? {
        ledger.readAll().map { LedgerInspection.page($0, calendar: calendar) }
    }

- [ ] **Step 6: The screen, its route and its Settings row**

`App/Features/Focus/LedgerInspector.swift`:
```swift
#if DEBUG
import SwiftUI
import MapleCore
import MapleDesign
import MapleServices

/// DEBUG only: Settings › Ledger inspector (F1 design §7.7). Every ledger event, newest first, by kind, session,
/// writer and sequence number, source and wall time, and no content: no preset name, intention or length
/// (`LedgerInspection`). It reads the whole ledger when it opens, and again on "Read again".
struct LedgerInspector: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    @Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions
    @State private var page: LedgerInspection.Page?
    @State private var hasRead = false

    var body: some View {
        ProfilePage("Ledger inspector") {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.xs) {
                Text(summary)
                    .font(MapleFont.callout)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
                TextLink("Read again", chevron: false) { read() }
            }
            if let page, !page.rows.isEmpty {
                ProfileListGroup {
                    ForEach(page.rows) { row in
                        LedgerEventRow(row: row)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            if !hasRead { read() }
        }
    }

    private var summary: String {
        guard hasRead else { return "Reading the ledger…" }
        return page?.summary ?? "The ledger can't be read until the iPhone is unlocked."
    }

    private func read() {
        page = sessions.ledgerInspection(calendar: .autoupdatingCurrent)
        hasRead = true
    }
}

/// One event: its kind and wall time, then its session, writer and sequence number, and source.
private struct LedgerEventRow: View {
    @Environment(\.theme) private var theme
    let row: LedgerInspection.Row

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.xxs) {
            HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline, spacing: theme.spacing.sm) {
                Text(row.kind)
                    .font(MapleFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                Text(row.time)
                    .font(MapleFont.tileMeta)
                    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
            }
            Text(row.detail)
                .font(MapleFont.footnote)
                .monospacedDigit()
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textSecondary)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, theme.spacing.listMargin)
        .padding(.vertical, theme.spacing.sm)
        .frame(minHeight: theme.spacing.row, alignment: .leading)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
    }
}
#endif
```

The checks, run from the worktree root:
```bash

grep -nE 'withAnimation|\.animation\(|mapleAnimation|\.transition\(' App/Features/Focus/*.swift App/Features/Home/*.swift MapleKit/Sources/MapleDesign/Focus/*.swift

# G4: every hold

# G5: announcements (Step 1's check)

# G6: the running screen's dimming

# G7: one element per dial

# G9: inline copy in the Focus views

```

| # | Rule | Passes when | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| G1 | Motion only moves transform and opacity (§4.6) | Read each hit's animated value. Every animated change is opacity, `scaleEffect`, `rotationEffect`, `offset`, or a colour inside a fixed-size `Canvas`. | Animate an opacity or scale on a view whose frame doesn't change. Reserve the space with a fixed `frame`, or with `.opacity(0)` instead of removing the view. Never animate `.frame`, `.font`, `.padding`, `.blur` or `.shadow`. |
| G2 | Reduce Motion (§4.6): no sweep or ripple, states cross-fade, marks step once a minute | `ReceiptView` passes it to `FinishTimeline.frame(…, reduceMotion:)`. `RunningSessionView` holds `currentBrightness` steady and lets lit marks change only on the minute. Every screen change (start, running, break, receipt, the leaf opening) cross-fades. Step 10's frames agree. | Route switches: `.transition(.opacity)` with `withAnimation(theme.motion.gentle) { … }`, which is allowed under Reduce Motion because it is a cross-fade. A continuous change under Reduce Motion: sample it once a minute before building the frame, `let shown = reduceMotion ? Date(timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate: (now.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate / 60).rounded(.down) * 60) : now`. |
| G3 | The dial uses a fitted size, never `scaleEffect` (§5.17) | Every hit is a motion value (the finish's leaf grow, ring and glow, a press) or `DialCentre`'s fixed leaf and numeral scale (Task 6: the leaf at 41% at rest), none depends on `dynamicTypeSize`, and every `MinuteDial` `diameter` is computed from the space available. | `diameter = min(proxy.size.width - 2 * theme.spacing.listMargin, maximum)` from a `GeometryReader`, or `HeroFit`'s size, passed to `MinuteDial(frame:diameter:…)`. |
| G4 | Every hold has a named action and a visible, cancellable countdown (F1-22) | Each `HoldButton` passes `accessibilityName:` from `FocusCopy` or a model ("Hold to start, Locked 50 minutes"; the Steady end and the emergency release with their own names). No `.accessibilityAction` beside it completes the hold directly. | Pass the name. Delete any action that bypasses `HoldButton`'s countdown. |
| G5 | Announcements only at milestones (§4.9) | Only the three milestone kinds post, never each minute: the leaf opening, the break ending and the session ending (Step 1 lists them). | Move or delete any other. |
| G6 | Dimming after 30 s (§4.6) | It never dims while `accessibilityVoiceOverEnabled` is on or `colorSchemeContrast == .increased`, and the first touch only wakes it. | `let mayDim = !voiceOverEnabled && contrast != .increased`. On the first tap while dimmed, wake and return before the tap reaches anything else. |
| G7 | One element per dial; decoration hidden | Each `MinuteDial` is `.accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)` with its §4.9 label. Blooms, glows and the decorative leaf beside a leaf line are `.accessibilityHidden(true)`. | Add the two modifiers. |
| G8 | The numeral caps at xxLarge; the time repeats under the dial at accessibility sizes (§5.17) | The centre numeral has `.dynamicTypeSize(...DynamicTypeSize.xxLarge)`, and each dial screen shows its time as a line under the dial when `dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize`. | Add `.dynamicTypeSize(...DynamicTypeSize.xxLarge)` to the numeral's `Text`. Under the dial: `if dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize { Text(timeLine).font(MapleFont.headline).foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textPrimary) }`, where `timeLine` is the centre's own words ("32m left of 50m"). |
| G9 | No inline copy | Only the DEBUG `LedgerInspector`, which holds no member copy, has inline strings. | Move the string to `FocusCopy` or `FocusSheetCopy`, with a test. |

### Task 20: Docs, design overrides and the flip

F1 ships. `ShippedFeatures.current` becomes `[.m1, .f1]`, test-first: a probe flip finds every test that assumed this build lacks F1, each is rewritten, the rewritten tests are watched failing, and then the flip makes them pass. The release check learns the DEBUG app picker's names. Then the docs catch up with F1b:
- `docs/design/spec.md`: the Overrides box (F1-18 gold, no overshoot, the Rest tab retired), §2's tabs, §6.7's haptics, §6.8's symbols, and the rows Tasks 8 and 14 left;
- `docs/debug-launch-arguments.md`: every argument, with a gate that every `"MapleDemo…"` literal in the code is documented;
- `docs/core-api.md`: how the Focus screens read the stores, and the Live Activity;
- `docs/architecture.md` and `docs/decisions.md`.

A final screenshot sweep re-shoots every screen the earlier tasks checked, then the build before F1, demos that no longer need `-MapleDemoShip`, and the free build exactly as a member gets it.

**Decisions in this task:**
- **Order:** the release-check pattern, then the flip, then the docs, then the sweep. The flip comes before the docs, so the docs describe what the code does; it is still the last change to Swift code in F1b (F1 design §9: "flipping `ShippedFeatures` for F1 last"). Cost if wrong: none.
- **How a test that assumed `.current` lacks F1 changes:**
  - **Rule A.** A test about something else (a layout, derived values, the free build's picker, a dormant example) pins the build it meant: `ShippedFeatures(releases: [.m1])`, a free build's `blocking: .unavailableInBuild`, or an F2 category (Phone-free mornings, `sempervirens`) as its unshipped example. It passes before and after the flip.
  - **Rule B.** A test about what this build ships expects M1 and F1. It fails before the flip and passes after.
  - Cost if wrong: a test quietly stops covering the build it was written for.
- **The free build is checked twice.**
  - `FreeBuildTests` (new) launches `MapleStores.live` after the flip: its blocking is `.unavailableInBuild` from the first frame (Task 3's factories), the three focus ladders read `.notInThisBuild`, F2's stay `.dormant`, and with Apple Health the next leaf is Silver maple (`saccharinum`, Rested nights' first rung).
  - `HealthPermissionTests` pass unchanged. They do only because Task 3 sets the capability at construction: if the probe lists them, Task 3 is missing and this task stops.
- **A new `NextLeafPicker` test pins the other build:** one that can block, without Screen Time, has no next leaf, and Home's permission row offers Red maple (`rubrum`, the first hours rung) with "Needs Screen Time". Cost if wrong: none.
- **`-MapleDemoShip f1` stays in the Focus examples and the sweep.** After the flip it no longer changes what ships, but it is still the Focus argument that seeds the Focus demo and starts the ticking Day clock; a demo with no Focus argument has empty Focus stores. `-MapleDemoShip m1` shows the build before F1.
- **§6.8 also gains `chevron.up`,** which Task 16's Herbarium session bar uses, besides the `timer`, `chevron.down` and `lock.fill` F1 design §9 names. A gate checks that every SF Symbol in the code is in §6.8. Cost if wrong: none.
- **§8.1 stays, marked retired,** because its schedule editor and wind-down mode survive; §8.6 becomes a pointer to F1 design §5.15.
- **`docs/decisions.md`:**
  - one entry per lasting ruling (P2–P10), plus the flip and the Live Activity, dated 2026-10-24 (the plan's date);
  - newest first, as the file's header says, so the two 2026-10-11 entries at the bottom move up under the new ones;
  - P1 (stacking on F1a) isn't logged, because it ends when F1a merges.
- **`check-release.sh` also forbids `FakeAppPicker` and `PickerChoice`:** the DEBUG app picker's names (Task 15) contain no "Demo". Cost if wrong: a leaked fake picker would ship unnoticed.
- **The sweep:**
  - It re-shoots every screenshot Tasks 8–19 took, with the same arguments, except Task 8's placeholder shots and the three Task 8 shots that Tasks 16 and 17 took again (`home-day`, `settings`, `settings-ax5`). Each image is compared with the one that task saved.
  - Then it shoots the build before F1 (`-MapleDemoShip m1`), demos with no Focus argument, and live launches (no Core argument), which show the free build exactly as a member gets it.

- [ ] **Step 5: Write the tests for the shipped build**

Create `MapleKit/Tests/MapleServicesTests/FreeBuildTests.swift`:
```swift
import Foundation
import Testing
@testable import MapleCore
@testable import MapleServices

/// The build Maple ships once F1 is flipped on (F1 design §9): Focus has shipped, and a free build can't block
/// (F1-17). So its Screen Time leaves read "Not available in this build", F2's stay dormant, and Home's next leaf
/// stays on Rested nights, the one ladder it can earn.
@Suite("The shipped free build")
@MainActor
struct FreeBuildTests {
    private let now = at(2026, 10, 10, 15)

    @Test("This build ships M1 and F1, never F2")
    func ships() {
        #expect(ShippedFeatures.current == ShippedFeatures(releases: [.m1, .f1]))
        #expect(ShippedFeatures.current.focus && ShippedFeatures.current.screenTime)
        #expect(!ShippedFeatures.current.sleepSounds)
    }

    @Test("A live launch that can't block shows Screen Time leaves as not in this build and keeps Home on Rested nights")
    func freeBuild() async throws {
        let folder = try temporaryDirectory()
        let stores = MapleStores.live(directory: folder, calendar: utc, now: now, healthAuthorizer: FakeHealthAuthorizer())
        #expect(stores.collection.context.features == .current)
        #expect(stores.collection.context.blocking == .unavailableInBuild)
        for category in [RewardCategoryID.hoursSaved, .sessionsFinished, .focusStreak] {
            #expect(stores.collection.availability(of: category) == .notInThisBuild, "\(category)")
        }
        for category in [RewardCategoryID.phoneFreeMornings, .bedtimeKept] {
            #expect(stores.collection.availability(of: category) == .dormant, "\(category)")
        }

        stores.schedule.save(.standard, at: at(2026, 10, 1, 21))
        #expect(await stores.health.requestAccess(at: now))
        stores.health.apply(to: stores.collection)
        let evening = at(2026, 10, 10, 21)
        let next = try #require(stores.collection.nextLeaf(at: evening))
        #expect(RewardCatalog.shared.reward(forSpecies: next.speciesID)?.categoryID == .restedNights)
        #expect(next.speciesID == "saccharinum")                   // Rested nights' first rung
        #expect(stores.collection.permissionPrompt(at: evening) == nil)
    }
}
```

````markdown

````
   with:
````markdown
Shipped with F1: tabs Home · Focus · Herbarium (D10), §3.4's day and session states (its §6), and the Rest tab retired into Focus (§8.1 → its §5; item 8).
> 6. **Gold during a session (F1-18).** Amber still means "you earned something" and nothing else (§1 principle 3). A Focus session adds gold, which is not amber: `Theme.Dial.gold` `#F0C24A` (about 43°, against amber's 30°), with `goldSoft` `#C99A2C` at 62%, `goldEdge` `#FFE8A8` at 85%, `goldVein` `#725811` and `goldBloom` `#F0C24A` at 18% (`MapleDesign/Focus/DialTokens.swift`). Gold appears only over counted time: this session's share of the dial's centre leaf, the leaf the session opens, and the finish's sweep over the counted marks. A session that counted nothing finishes in white. The Lock Screen and Dynamic Island leaf is season tint, never gold. The dial's other colours are in `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-23-f1-focus-design.md` §4.2.
> 7. **No overshoot, and Focus's own motion (F1).** Every ease and spring stops at its end value without passing it: the reveal's `timingCurve(0.2, 0, 0, 1)`, the reveal leaf's settle, the finish's leaf grow (0.8s ease-out) and any spring (`dampingFraction` 1.0). Mockup curves that overshoot (`f1-timer.html`'s `--pop`) are not used. The Focus dial moves as F1 design §4.6 says, with transform and opacity only: its lit marks fade in over 0.3s, the one motion besides press feedback that is faster than `gentle` (principle 9). Under Reduce Motion there is no sweep or ripple, states cross-fade, and the marks step once a minute.
> 8. **The Rest tab is retired into Focus (F1).** The tabs are Home · Focus · Herbarium (D10, §2.1), and the Focus tab is built around the minute-marks dial (F1 design §4, §5). Rest's `SleepDial` and the `FocusTimer` ring are gone. The sleep schedule is a Settings row, "Sleep schedule ›", whose editor (§8.1) opens as a sheet over the Profile sheet; wind-down mode (§8.1) opens from Home's evening and wind-down capsule. Home's header streak is the Focus streak (§3.2), and its sheet is F1 design §5.15 (§8.6).

Without it a demo ships `ShippedFeatures.current`. It is a Focus argument (below), so it also seeds the Focus demo and starts the ticking Focus clock, which is why the Focus examples keep `-MapleDemoShip f1`. Other values are ignored. |
| `-MapleDemoFocus` | `idle`, `noSet`, `smallSet`, `expired`, `running`, `dimmed`, `break`, `minimised`, `ended`, `endedAway`, `endEarly`, `emergency`, `first` | Core (`FocusDemo`, `FocusStores.demo`) | Seeds the demo's ledger, presets, app sets and notes so the Focus tab opens in that state with no tap: `idle` the start screen (Study, Steady, Distractions holding 6 apps); `noSet` no apps chosen ("Choose apps"); `smallSet` an allow list of 24 apps, which doesn't qualify; `expired` the app set's tokens expired; `running` Study 18 minutes into 50, with "Chemistry ch. 4"; `dimmed` the running screen dimmed, as after 30 seconds; `break` the break, 31 minutes in; `minimised` the start screen with the running session's dial (with `-MapleDemoTab focus`); `ended` a session that ended on time 5 seconds before launch, so its receipt plays the finish; `endedAway` one that ended 2 hours before launch (its receipt, without the finish); `endEarly` End early's sheet over a running Steady session (Gentle with `-MapleDemoStrictness gentle`); `emergency` the emergency release over a running Locked session; `first` the first session ever (no history, Quick preselected, the first-session lines). Every Focus demo except `first` (and `-MapleDemoFresh`, which seeds nothing) behaves as if a session had started before (`hasStartedFocus`). The next hours leaf is Korean maple (the 20-hour rung), 35 minutes into a session started now. A launch with any other Focus argument and no `-MapleDemoFocus` is `idle`, unless that argument implies a state (below). |
| `-MapleDemoFocusAt` | minutes, `0`…`180` | Core (`FocusDemo`) | How far into the session a running state is (default 18; 31 for `break`), or when `-MapleDemoReceipt early` ended (default 18). Kept inside the preset's length. |
| `-MapleDemoStrictness` | `gentle`, `steady`, `locked` | Core (`FocusDemo`) and Focus (`PresetEditor`) | The selected preset's strictness, frozen into the demo session's plan (default Steady; `emergency` is always Locked, and `endEarly` is Steady unless this says `gentle`). With `-MapleDemoPresent preset`: the preset editor as it looks just after choosing that level on a Locked copy of the preset, unsaved (`steady` shows "Steady starts tomorrow", `gentle` "Gentle starts tomorrow", `locked` has nothing to save). Nothing is written. |
| `-MapleDemoScreenTime` | `approved`, `notDetermined`, `declined`, `restricted`, `noPasscode`, `unavailable`, `revoked`, `plain`, `failStart` | Core (`FocusDemo`, the preview blocker) | What the blocker says. `approved` (the default) allows blocking. `notDetermined`, `declined`, `restricted` and `noPasscode` open Needs Screen Time with that state's card. `unavailable` is a free build (`UnavailableBlockingService`): "This version of Maple can't lock apps", Screen Time leaves "Not available in this build", and no Focus history. `revoked` is a running session whose block was lost, carrying on as a plain timer; `plain` is a running plain timer (Screen Time declined), or with `-MapleDemoFocus idle` the start screen as a plain timer. `failStart` is the start screen with a blocker that fails every apply, so a start offers "Start as a plain timer". |
| `-MapleDemoReceipt` | `clean`, `unlocked`, `early`, `plain`, `revoked`, `bedtime`, `capped`, `leaf`, `leafNight`, `notQualifying` | Core (`FocusDemo`) | How the `ended` or `endedAway` session ended (it implies `ended`; default `clean`): `clean` on time, all counted; `unlocked` with an unlock that didn't count; `early` ended early at `-MapleDemoFocusAt`; `plain` a plain timer, which counted nothing and finishes white; `revoked` its block lost 10 minutes in; `bedtime` started after bedtime, so nothing counted; `capped` past the day's 6-hour cap; `leaf` it opened Korean maple; `leafNight` it opened Korean maple in wind-down, held until morning; `notQualifying` an allow list too large to count. |
| `-MapleDemoSaved` | `typical`, `capped`, `empty` | Core (`FocusDemo`, `DemoData.FocusHistory`) | Today's earlier sessions, for Saved today and the receipts' "today": `typical` Study 50m with a break and Read 35m with an unlock (1h 20m counted); `capped` three 2-hour Deep sessions and a Study over the cap (6h); `empty` none, and no streak days. Otherwise the collection has a 12-day streak (best 21). Default `typical` (`empty` for `first` and a free build). |
| `-MapleDemoLiveActivity` | `running`, `break`, `plain`, `ended` | Core (`DemoLaunchOptions`) and App (`LiveActivityDemo`, `ActivityKitController`) | Shows that state as a real Live Activity, on real dates, as a new session each launch, straight through the app's controller; the demo store gets the matching session (`running` and `plain` run, `break` is in its break, `ended` has ended). `ended` reaches its planned end 8 seconds after launch, then reads "Session complete". Any other demo launch ends an activity an earlier launch left, so screenshots start clean. Not in the sandbox, whose own store drives the controller. Shoot it with `Scripts/shoot-activity.sh`. |
| `-MapleDemoLiveActivityExpand` | seconds, e.g. `2` | App (`LiveActivityDemo`) | With `-MapleDemoLiveActivity`: that long after Maple goes to the background, sends the activity again with an alert, so the Dynamic Island shows its expanded view for a few seconds (`Scripts/shoot-activity.sh … expanded`). Nothing can press the island from the command line. |
| `-MapleDemoPreset` | `study`, `quick`, `deep`, `read` | Core (`FocusDemo`) and Focus (`FocusDemoPresenter`) | The demo session's preset, and with `-MapleDemoTab focus` that chip selected on the start screen. |
| `-MapleDemoIntention` | text, or `""` | Core (`FocusDemo`) and Focus (`FocusDemoPresenter`) | The demo session's intention (default "Chemistry ch. 4"; `""` gives none), and with `-MapleDemoTab focus` the start screen's. |
| `-MapleDemoHoldAt` | `0`…`1` | Core (`DemoLaunchOptions`); drawn by `HoldButton(frozenProgress:)` | Freezes every hold's fill at that fraction, and the dial with it where the dial shows the hold: the start screen's Locked hold, Home's Locked Start, "Hold to end", "Hold to release", and Locked's Again on the receipt. |
| `-MapleDemoEndCountdown` | seconds, `0`…`15` | Core (`DemoLaunchOptions`); End early | Opens End early (it implies `-MapleDemoFocus endEarly`) with Steady's 15-second countdown frozen at that many seconds left. It never ends the session. |
| `-MapleDemoFinishAt` | seconds, e.g. `0.5`, `1.2` | Core (`DemoLaunchOptions`); the receipt, the emergency release | Freezes the receipt's finish that many seconds in (it implies `-MapleDemoFocus ended`), as `-MapleDemoRevealAt` does for the reveal; with `-MapleDemoFocus emergency`, the release's breath instead, while the session runs on behind it. |
````
