### How the Focus screens read the stores

```swift
@Environment(FocusSessionStore.self) private var sessions
@Environment(\.focusStores) private var focus                  // FocusStores?: the composer and the start command
@Environment(FocusTabState.self) private var tab               // the Focus tab's choices for this launch (App)

let status = focus?.status(at: sessions.now, collection: collection, settings: settings)    // FocusStatus, for Home
let model = focus?.startScreen(preset: preset, minutes: 50, at: sessions.now, collection: collection,
                               settings: settings, stage: .choosing, hasTurned: tab.hasTurnedDial, locale: locale)
let outcome = await focus?.start(request, intention: tab.intention, settings: settings)  // also marks the preset used
router.showFocus(.selectPreset(id))                            // or .needsScreenTime, .receipt(id), .returnToSession, .releaseAll
```

- **Upkeep.** `.focusUpkeep()` refreshes the session store on launch, every foreground, when protected data becomes available, every 15 seconds while a session runs, and at the planned end and the break end (`FocusRefresh`). Screens never call `refresh()` themselves. A running dial samples once a second from `sessions.now`, in a `TimelineView` inside the screen that shows it.
- **Routes.** `FocusView` shows one destination, from `FocusRoute.resolve(isLoaded:running:receipt:isMinimised:canBlock:usesPlainTimer:now:)`: `.settling` (nothing drawn: before the first replay, between a planned end and the refresh that ends it, and while the ledger can't be read), `.start`, `.needsScreenTime`, `.running(id)`, `.minimised(id)`, `.breakTime(id)` or `.receipt(id)`. `FocusRoute.nextChange(running:now:)` is when the route changes by itself. The receipt is `ReceiptPicker.pending(_:seen:now:)`: the newest session that ended within 24 hours and isn't `settings.lastReceiptSeen`. `ReceiptView` marks it seen as it appears, and `tab.shownReceipt` keeps it on screen until Done or the next start.
- **`FocusTabState`** (App, `@Observable`, never saved): `selectedPresetID`, `minutes`, `intention`, `hasTurnedDial`, `isMinimised`, `plainTimer` (`PlainTimerReason`: `.chosen`, `.lockFailed`), `shownReceipt`, `lastStarted`, `releasesAll` (Settings' Release all apps during a session), and the tab's one sheet, `sheet` (`FocusTabSheet`: `.blocking`, `.preset(UUID?)`, `.intention`, `.saved`, `.streak`).
- **A session's numbers.** `sessions.running` is a `SessionRecord`, with `secondsLeft(at:)` (0 once ended), `isInBreak(at:)`, `breakSecondsLeft(at:)` and `endedAt`. `sessions.countedSoFar(id)` is its counted plus provisional seconds, `sessions.credit(for:)` the `SessionCredit` the receipt and Saved today read, and `sessions.sessionUnlocks` the leaves the running or last-ended session opened.
- **Words and decisions are MapleCore values:** `StartScreenModel` and `FocusStartLines` (the start screen, and Home's Start, built from the same model), `NeedsScreenTimeState` with `FocusCopy.card(_:)`, `RunningSessionModel` and `BreakScreenModel`, `BreakDialLayout`, `ReceiptModel` and `ReceiptFlow`, `SavedTodayModel`, `StreakWeek`, `FocusSheetCopy`, `FocusSettingsCopy` and `SelectionText`. `RunningSessionModel` and `BreakScreenModel` also carry F1 design §4.9's VoiceOver reads and announcements. The dial is a `DialFrame` drawn by `MinuteDial` (MapleDesign), and every hold is a `HoldButton` with its named accessibility action.
- **Home and the Herbarium.** Home passes `focus.status(at:collection:settings:)` to `collection.nowState(at:…focus:)`. Its Start begins a session at once only when start readiness allows it, and otherwise opens the Focus tab (`router.showFocus(.selectPreset(id))`). The next-leaf row adds a running session's provisional time (`LeafProgress.displaying(provisionalSeconds:)`), and the Herbarium shows the session's bar (`SessionMiniBar`).
- **Release all apps.** `FocusReleaseRouter(router:).releaseAll(from: sessions)` clears every store at once when no session runs, and returns true. During a session it opens that strictness level's own end path (Locked: the emergency release) and returns false.
- **The Live Activity.** `ActivityKitController` (App) is the `LiveActivityController` the session store calls after every change. It describes the running state with `FocusActivityState.described(intention:tint:leafID:)`: the intention from `session-notes.json`, capped at 40 characters; the season tint as `Theme.SeasonTints.leafColor(for:)`, never gold; and the next hours leaf, sent as a `LeafSketch`. It words it in MapleCore, `FocusActivityState.lines(locale:calendar:)` ("until 14:52 · Study", "Study · Chemistry ch. 4", "Break · back at 14:28", "Session complete"), because the widget links only MapleActivity. `LiveActivityPlan.make(activities:wanted:contentChanged:mayRequest:)` (MapleCore, pure) decides the upkeep: end every activity that isn't the running session's, update the running one when its content changed, and request one only when none shows and this launch hasn't asked for it. `LiveActivities.sync` applies the plan off the main actor, because ActivityKit's `Activity` isn't `Sendable`.
- **DEBUG.** The Focus demo arguments are in `docs/debug-launch-arguments.md`. Settings' "Ledger inspector" (`-MapleDemoProfile ledger`) lists the ledger's events by kind, time, session and sequence, never content (`LedgerInspection`).

## Files, unlocks and time zones

- [ ] **Step 19: `docs/decisions.md`**

1. Directly after the line `Newest first. Each entry: what was decided, why, and what it affects.` and the blank line under it, insert this block, followed by one blank line:
````markdown
## 2026-10-24 — F1 ships: `ShippedFeatures.current` is M1 and F1
`ShippedFeatures.current` is `[.m1, .f1]`. It was flipped last in F1b, once every Focus screen existed and had been checked through `-MapleDemoShip f1`. Why: F1's logic and screens are complete; F2's (phone-free mornings, bedtime kept, sleep sounds) are not. Affects: Focus appears wherever it is gated on `features.focus` (Home's day and session states and its header streak, Settings' "Session end" and "Daily study reminder"), and the focus ladders leave the Herbarium's Dormant section, which now holds F2's 14 leaves. A build that can't block (every free build, until F1-paid) shows those ladders as "Not available in this build", offers the plain timer with F1-17's words, and keeps Home's next leaf on Rested nights. Tests that mean "the build before F1" pass `ShippedFeatures(releases: [.m1])`, and `-MapleDemoShip m1` shows that build in demos.

## 2026-10-24 — The Live Activity: a sketch, words from MapleCore, and upkeep by a pure plan
The running session's Live Activity (F1 design §5.11) is display only: no buttons, no push and no App Group. The `MapleWidgets` extension links only `MapleActivity`, so everything it draws arrives in the activity: the next hours leaf as a `LeafSketch` (byte pairs in a 0…255 square, at most 240 outline points, under 2 KB), the season tint as a plain colour (never gold), and every line already worded by `FocusActivityState.lines(locale:calendar:)` in MapleCore ("until 14:52 · Study", "Study · Chemistry ch. 4", "Break · back at 14:28", "Session complete"). The Lock Screen shows the preset name only; the intention, capped at 40 characters, appears only in the expanded view. `LiveActivityPlan` (MapleCore, tested) decides the upkeep: end every activity that isn't the running session's, update the running one when its content changed, and ask for one at most once per session per launch, so a dismissed activity stays dismissed until the next launch. `ActivityKitController` applies it after every store change, on launch, every foreground and every 15-second refresh. Why: the widget can't link MapleCore or MapleDesign, and ActivityKit's `Activity` isn't `Sendable`, so only values cross between them. Affects: `MapleKit/Sources/MapleActivity/`, `Extensions/MapleWidgets/`, `App/Features/LiveActivity/`; the version numbers live in `Base.xcconfig` so the extension's match the app's; `check-release.sh` scans both binaries; the layouts are checked by simulator screenshots (`Scripts/shoot-activity.sh`), and the minimal view only in review, because it shows only when two apps' activities compete.

## 2026-10-24 — The Rest tab is retired into Focus (P2)
The tabs are Home · Focus · Herbarium. `RestView` and the dial-only pieces (`SleepDial`, `SleepDialGeometry`, `MoonCrescent`, `SleepScheduleSpan`, the dial-only `RestCopy` members, their tests and snapshot scenes) are deleted, because nothing uses them. `WindDownView`, `BedsideLog` and `ScheduleEditor` move to `App/Features/Sleep/`, `RestDemo` becomes `SleepDemo`, and the sleep schedule is a Settings row ("Sleep schedule · 23:00 → 07:00 ›") whose editor opens over the Profile sheet (F1-3). Why: F1 gives the tab to the timer, and a tab holding only the schedule would be empty. Affects: `-MapleDemoTab focus` replaces `rest`; `-MapleDemoPresent schedule…` opens Profile › Settings; spec D10, §2 and §8.1. If the dial is wanted again, it comes back from git.

## 2026-10-24 — Focus copy lives in MapleCore (P3)
Every Focus string and decision is a MapleCore value (`FocusCopy`, `FocusSheetCopy`, `FocusSettingsCopy`, `SelectionText`, and the screen models `StartScreenModel`, `FocusStartLines`, `RunningSessionModel`, `ReceiptModel`, `SavedTodayModel`, `StreakWeek`, `FocusActivityState.lines`), tested with Swift Testing; views only lay them out. Why: there is no app test target, so a string in a view can't be tested, and the rules about what Maple never says (no "fail", no "streak lost", nothing about leaves in notifications) need tests. Affects: every Focus view. A new string goes in one of those types, with a test.

## 2026-10-24 — The first session is remembered (P4)
`AppSettings.hasStartedFocus`, saved, turns true when the first session starts. Until then the start screen preselects Quick, shows the counts line's definition and "You can lock your phone. Maple keeps time.", and the first start asks once for notification permission if iOS hasn't asked yet (F1-23). Why: the hints are for a first session only, and a settings value survives relaunches without reading the ledger. Affects: the Focus start and running screens. A member who reinstalls sees the hints again.

## 2026-10-24 — A receipt is shown once (P5)
`AppSettings.lastReceiptSeen` holds the last receipt seen. `ReceiptPicker.pending` returns the newest session that ended within the last 24 hours and isn't that one, and the receipt marks itself seen as it appears. "Ended at" is `min(end.placed, plannedEnd)`, because an end event is stamped when the app noticed it. The finish plays only within 10 minutes of the end. Why: a session that ended while Maple was closed still gets its receipt, once, and an old one never resurfaces. Affects: the Focus tab's routing and a session-end notification's tap. An ended-away receipt older than a day is never shown.

## 2026-10-24 — The session store refreshes every 15 seconds while a session runs (P6)
`FocusSessionStore.refresh()` runs on launch, every foreground, when protected data becomes available, every 15 seconds while a session runs, and at the planned end and the break end (`FocusRefresh`). The dial ticks every second from `FocusSessionStore.now` (trusted time) without a refresh. Why: each refresh reads the ledger and the block back, and doing that every second would cost battery for nothing. Affects: a lost block is noticed up to 15 seconds late, and a Live Activity's intention can arrive up to 15 seconds after the start.

## 2026-10-24 — Every Focus demo argument is a typed Core argument (P7)
Every Focus argument in F1 design §8.2, the Focus `-MapleDemoPresent` values included, is a typed `DemoLaunchOptions` field, so any of them keeps the launch in demo stores and seeds its scenario. `-MapleDemoTab focus` stays app-level, so with nothing else it shows the live Focus tab. Why: one place parses and tests the arguments, and a Focus screenshot never touches the member's files. Affects: `docs/debug-launch-arguments.md`. `-MapleDemoShip f1` still seeds the Focus demo after F1 shipped.

## 2026-10-24 — The streak week starts on the locale's first weekday (P8)
The streak sheet shows this week as 7 dots from the first weekday of the collection's calendar. Finished days are season tint, and rest days and misses are the same neutral dot, so the week never counts the rest days left. Why: a member reads a week the way their calendar shows it, and F1-13's rest days only bridge gaps, so marking them apart from misses would read as a score. Affects: `StreakWeek`, `StreakSheet`.

## 2026-10-24 — Live Activity layouts are checked in the simulator (P9)
The Lock Screen and Dynamic Island layouts live in the `MapleWidgets` target and are checked with `-MapleDemoLiveActivity` simulator screenshots (`Scripts/shoot-activity.sh`), not in `FocusScenes`, because the macOS snapshot build has no ActivityKit. Affects: the Live Activity's screenshot lists. The minimal view is checked in review only.

## 2026-10-24 — The Focus tab icon is SF `timer` (P10)
The Focus tab uses SF `timer`, drawn once into a template image as Rest's moon was, so the tab bar can't swap in a filled variant when the tab is selected. Affects: `RootView`; spec §2.1 and §6.8.
````

If a `shoot-activity.sh … lock` line stops with exit 3, the terminal isn't allowed to press keys in the Simulator. Shoot every other line, list the missing `lock` images, and don't bypass the permission.

Compare each new image with the one that task saved (open both). "Must show what X shows" means the same screen, words and states. Clock times, times relative to the launch and the status bar may differ. Any other difference must be one of these:
- a change a later task made to that screen on purpose: `git log --oneline -- <the screen's file>` names it;
- one of the flip's changes marked below.

Report every difference with its reason, or as a regression.
